Applied to a 5B video model with LoRA on 77 hours of manipulation video on a single GPU, it better matches unseen real continuations and reduces error accumulation.

</details>


### [347] [Can an Agent Trust Its Own Zoom? Cross-Magnification Provenance Verification for Whole-Slide Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29150)
*Yan Wang,Yiran Song,Zizhuo Gong,Jianxiang Qi,Zhongxing Xu,Lingfei Qian,Minquan Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究视觉智能体在全切片图像中如何验证放大观测与所声称空间位置之间的来源一致性，提出跨放大倍率来源验证任务CMPV，并发布PyraFault基准与ZoomTrace验证器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉上合理的观测不一定来自其声称的位置，尤其在不同放大倍率和相似组织区域中，这种错配会导致智能体产生错误或静默失败，因此需要验证视觉证据是否支持给定的空间关联。

Method: 作者形式化跨放大倍率来源验证CMPV；构建PyraFault基准，包含5个TCGA队列、2200例、306万坐标监督样本，覆盖上下文替换、来源缺失和几何扰动；提出ZoomTrace，先估计观测来源再与声称位置比对，结合物理尺度对齐、视觉检索、几何精化和基于空间不相交竞争匹配的可靠性估计。

Result: 在503320个测试样本上，ZoomTrace达到0.969 AUPRC和0.987 AUROC，优于Efficient LoFTR的0.789和0.903；进一步评估揭示了可靠性估计的权衡，以及视觉语言模型、跨数据集检索和校准方面的局限。

Conclusion: 将ZoomTrace集成到视觉智能体工具路径中可降低对损坏观测和静默失败的暴露，但下游准确率提升取决于具体智能体和验证阈值。

Abstract: Visual agents navigate whole-slide images through magnified observations associated with claimed locations. However, a visually plausible observation does not necessarily originate from its claimed location, particularly across magnifications and in regions with similar tissue structures. We formulate cross-magnification provenance verification (CMPV) to evaluate whether visual evidence supports a claimed spatial association, recover the source when possible, and abstain when evidence is insufficient. We introduce PyraFault, a benchmark of 3.06 million coordinate-supervised examples from 2,200 cases across five TCGA cohorts, covering within-context substitutions, absent-source faults, and geometric perturbations. We further propose ZoomTrace, a claim-independent verifier that estimates the observation's source before evaluating its agreement with the claimed location. It combines physical-scale alignment, visual retrieval, geometric refinement, and reliability estimation using spatially disjoint competing matches. On 503,320 test examples, ZoomTrace achieves 0.969 AUPRC and 0.987 AUROC, compared with 0.789 and 0.903 for Efficient LoFTR. Further evaluations reveal trade-offs in reliability estimation and limitations in vision-language models, cross-dataset retrieval, and calibration. Integrating ZoomTrace into visual agent tool paths reduces exposure to corrupted observations and silent failures, while downstream accuracy improvements depend on the agent and verification threshold.

</details>


### [348] [MOVER: Planning Beyond Motion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30022)
*Xiangyu Li,Yu Jiang,Tianyi Wang,Liang He,Qixing Huang,Zhaomiao Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 MOVER，一种事件路由机制，用于弥补残差世界模型中弱时序变化证据（如等待行人、停止车辆）在残差通路中被削弱的问题，并通过教师-学生训练在不增加推理成本的情况下提升规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 残差世界模型通过时序变化预测驾驶场景，导致随时间几乎不变的特征组件从残差通路中消失；因此等待行人或停止车辆等弱时序变化但关键的证据可能无法被规划充分利用。

Method: MOVER 使用训练时教师：移除历史帧并测量空间事件查询的敏感性，再与该事件的池化时序残差对比，优先选择依赖历史但残差证据弱的事件；学生从无扰动历史预测这些优先级。固定总路由质量下，一个分布用于缩放低秩未来 BEV 更新并偏置轨迹条件事件读取。

Result: 在 nuScenes 上，MOVER 将 ResWorld 的 UniAD 风格平均 L2 从 0.65 m 降至 0.55 m，碰撞率从 0.23% 降至 0.12%（使用直接规划器自车状态时为 0.50 m 和 0.09%），每帧增加 4.1 ms。匹配对照表明互补教师优于单一信号，且分配主要发生在训练阶段。适配 BridgeDrive-LEAD 后，在 220 路线 Bench2Drive 闭环基准上三个种子达到 96.52 +/- 0.65 驾驶分数，每个配对种子均超过匹配对照，差距在种子波动范围内。

Conclusion: MOVER 能更有效利用弱时序变化证据进行规划，在不增加推理成本的情况下显著提升开环与闭环驾驶性能，并验证了互补事件路由信号的有效性。

Abstract: Residual world models forecast a driving scene through its temporal change, so feature components that stay constant over time vanish from the residual pathway. We ask whether evidence with weak temporal change, such as a waiting pedestrian or a stopped vehicle, can be used more effectively for planning, and introduce MOVER, a complementary event-routing mechanism. A training-time teacher measures how each spatially grounded event query responds when a past frame is removed from shared history and contrasts that sensitivity with the event's pooled temporal residual, prioritizing events that depend on history but receive weak residual evidence. A student predicts the resulting priorities from unperturbed history, so the teacher adds no inference cost. Under fixed total routing mass, one distribution scales a low-rank future bird's-eye-view update and biases trajectory-conditioned event reading. On nuScenes, MOVER reduces ResWorld's UniAD-style average L2 from 0.65 to 0.55 m and its collision rate from 0.23% to 0.12% without direct planner ego status (0.50 m and 0.09% with it), adding 4.1 ms per frame. Matched controls show that the complementary teacher outperforms either signal alone and that the allocation acts mainly during training. Adapted to BridgeDrive-LEAD, MOVER reaches a 96.52 +/- 0.65 driving score over three seeds on the 220-route Bench2Drive closed-loop benchmark, exceeding matched controls in each paired seed by a margin within seed variation.

</details>


### [349] [Inclusive Hand Pose Estimation via Topology-Aware Distillation and Progressive Kinematic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29163)
*Kanglei Zhou,Zikai Hao,Liyuan Wang,Xiaohui Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究手部结构不完整条件下的手部姿态估计问题，构建了生理约束基准 IncNYU，并提出 InsHaPE 框架，在缺失结构下保持鲁棒性，同时不牺牲完整手部上的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法大多假设手部结构完全 articulated，当运动链中部分结构持续缺失时，预测会不稳定或不合理，导致性能下降甚至系统失败，即使仍存在部分观测。

Method: 构建 IncNYU 基准，通过形态修改模拟结构不完整并保留完整与移除区域的参考位置；提出 InsHaPE，基于层次运动学建模，包含拓扑感知蒸馏策略和渐进式运动学推理模块。

Result: 在 NYU/IncNYU 及 MSRA 外部验证上，InsHaPE 提升了结构不完整条件下的鲁棒性，并在完整手上保持有竞争力的性能；系统级评估显示其可提升依赖固定拓扑手部姿态表示的下游应用鲁棒性。

Conclusion: InsHaPE 能有效应对手部结构不完整场景，同时保持完整手部性能，并有利于需要固定拓扑手部表示的下游系统。

Abstract: Hand pose estimation aims to recover the spatial configuration of hand joints from visual observations and serves as a fundamental perception module for downstream systems that rely on complete and topologically consistent hand representations. Most existing methods are developed under the assumption of fully articulated hand structures and tend to produce unstable or implausible predictions when parts of the kinematic structure are persistently absent, resulting in degraded performance or even system failure despite available partial observations. To study this challenge, we construct IncNYU, a physiologically constrained benchmark that simulates structural incompleteness through morphological modification of complete hand models and retains reference locations for both intact and synthetically removed regions. Based on this benchmark, we propose InsHaPE, an Inclusive Hand Pose Estimation framework designed to remain robust under structural incompleteness while preserving performance on standard, fully articulated hands. Built on hierarchical kinematic modeling, InsHaPE introduces two complementary components. First, a topology-aware distillation strategy transfers joint-level and relational priors from fully articulated hand representations, providing anatomically consistent initialization under missing structures. Second, a progressive kinematic reasoning module performs structured inference along the kinematic chain, enabling complete and anatomically consistent pose estimation under severe structural variations. Extensive experiments on NYU/IncNYU, together with external validation on MSRA, demonstrate that InsHaPE improves robustness under structural incompleteness while maintaining competitive performance on complete hands. System-level evaluations further show that InsHaPE improves robustness for downstream applications that require fixed-topology hand pose representations.

</details>


### [350] [RadarOSV: Unified 3D Scene and Motion Perception from mmWave Radars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30078)
*Yuan Fang,Long Zhuang,Xijia Wei,Jingqi Jiang,Fangzhan Shi,Simon Julier,Kevin Chetty*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RadarOSV 是首个仅利用原始雷达数据、在统一体素中联合预测占用、动态对象语义和地相对速度的框架，融合级联成像雷达与单芯片雷达的互补信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有雷达占用方法多侧重几何建模，语义与运动联合建模不足；成像雷达空间细节好但无模糊速度范围有限，单芯片雷达速度范围宽但空间分辨率粗，因此需要融合二者优势。

Method: 提出 Polar-to-Cartesian Geometry 主干，通过固定与可变形采样将极坐标成像雷达特征映射到笛卡尔体素并引导跨雷达融合；利用单芯片检测输出提供类别证据，原始多普勒谱提供运动特征与径向速度候选；速度读出模块用融合特征选择候选以解模糊，并结合学习运动；使用雷达估计速度进行自运动补偿，无需外部里程计或其他传感器。

Result: 在 K-Radar 上，单帧 PCG 在 12.8 m 内达到 40.7% mIoU，优于 RadarOcc 报告的 34.3%；在 BRIDGE-Liv 上，相较使用外部自速度且预测相同输出的级联雷达基线，四类动态对象标注区域内宏平均准确率由 63.1% 提升至 75.5%，对象径向速度相对人工多普勒标注的 MAE 由 1.03 降至 0.51 m/s，同时保持几何占用 mIoU。

Conclusion: 融合成像雷达与单芯片雷达可在仅用雷达的条件下实现占用、动态语义和速度的联合预测，并提升几何、语义和运动估计性能，且无需外部里程计。

Abstract: Millimeter-wave radar offers weather-resilient sensing for 3D occupancy prediction. Existing radar occupancy methods mainly model geometry, with limited joint modeling of semantics and motion. Cascaded imaging radar provides fine spatial detail but has a limited unambiguous velocity range, whereas single-chip radar offers a wider range but coarser spatial resolution. We propose RadarOSV, to our knowledge the first radar-only framework that jointly predicts occupancy, dynamic object semantics, and ground-relative velocity from raw radar data in unified voxels, by exploiting complementary measurements from both radars. Its Polar-to-Cartesian Geometry (PCG) backbone maps polar imaging-radar features into Cartesian voxels through fixed and deformable sampling, guiding cross-radar fusion for geometry and attribute prediction. Single-chip detection outputs provide class evidence, while raw Doppler spectra supply motion features and radial-velocity candidates. The velocity readout selects from these candidates using fused features to resolve aliasing, then combines the selected radial estimate with learned motion. Ego-motion compensation uses radar-estimated velocity, so inference requires no external odometry or other sensors. On K-Radar, single-frame PCG achieves 40.7% mIoU within 12.8 m, compared with RadarOcc's reported 34.3%. On the BRIDGE-Liv dataset, compared with a cascaded-radar baseline predicting the same outputs with external ego velocity, RadarOSV improves macro-averaged accuracy across four dynamic object classes within annotated object regions from 63.1% to 75.5% and reduces object radial-velocity MAE against manual Doppler annotations from 1.03 to 0.51 m/s, while maintaining geometric occupancy mIoU.

</details>


### [351] [Training-Free 3D Editing via Feature-Divergence Localization and Trajectory Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29165)
*Tri Ton,Siwoo Lim,Joshua Tian Jin Tee,Chang D. Yoo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FocusFlow 是一个无需分割、无需反演的 3D 资产编辑框架，通过将生成轨迹分为粗结构形成与轨迹校正两个阶段，实现局部结构修改并保留未编辑区域的几何一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于概率流模型的免训练 3D 编辑方法在高维潜空间难以约束修改范围，全局速度更新会导致空间泄漏到应保留结构，并出现轨迹欠承诺使编辑中途停滞。

Method: 提出 FocusFlow，将积分轨迹分为两个不相交阶段：早期粗结构形成阶段使用 Feature-Divergence Localization（FDL），基于内在交叉注意力对速度场进行空间门控；粗结构形成后使用 Reference Generation Guidance（RGG），通过将轨迹拉向显式干净潜变量目标来校正轨迹并驱动收敛。

Result: 在 Google Scanned Objects 与 PartObjaverse-Tiny 联合基准上，FocusFlow 在对比方法中取得最佳保留分数和最大编辑幅度，表明可缓解传统的保留-修改权衡。

Conclusion: 该阶段调度方法无需人工空间标注即可提供稳定、局部化的几何控制，降低合成 3D 媒体修改的技术门槛。

Abstract: Modifying 3D assets requires enacting targeted structural transformations while strictly preserving the geometric identity of unedited regions. While recent probability flow models enable training-free editing, bounding these modifications within a high-dimensional latent space presents severe mathematical challenges. Current inversion-free trajectories rely on global velocity updates, which often cause spatial bleed into preserved structures and induce trajectory under-commitment, causing edits to stall mid-path. To resolve these dual failures, we introduce FocusFlow, a segmentation-free framework that structures the integration trajectory into two disjoint phases. During early coarse structure formation, FocusFlow applies Feature-Divergence Localization (FDL) to spatially gate the velocity field using intrinsic cross-attention. Once coarse structure has formed, FocusFlow applies Reference Generation Guidance (RGG), a trajectory-correction term that drives convergence to the target shape by pulling the trajectory toward an explicit clean-latent target. Evaluated on the joint Google Scanned Objects and PartObjaverse-Tiny benchmarks, FocusFlow obtains the best preservation scores and the largest edit magnitude among compared methods, suggesting that it can reduce the traditional preservation-modification trade-off. By providing stable, localized geometric control without manual spatial annotations, this phase-scheduled approach lowers technical barriers to the modification of synthetic 3D media.

</details>


### [352] [RMR-VLA: Recurrent Memory Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30145)
*Yiheng Du,Jingqi Tian,Xu Jiang,Jiexuan Zhang,Shuyu Wang,Zecheng Tang,Jian Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出RMR-VLA，在视觉-语言-动作模型内部加入显式的循环记忆推理，通过事件推断、任务状态修订和子目标接地，将记忆与动作生成连接起来，以处理长时程、历史依赖的机器人操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程机器人操作常需依据已经消失的视觉线索行动，例如先前指示的物体或移动杯子下隐藏的目标；关键挑战是在场景变化中持续保持过去证据对下一步动作的意义。

Method: RMR在VLA内部执行显式推理步骤，无需外部推理模型。每次更新时，VLA先从视觉证据推断事件，再修订任务状态，并在当前场景中接地子目标以指导动作生成；状态和子目标跨更新传递。模型采用联合训练同时进行推理与行动；由于记忆决策是带精确似然的文本token，可用GRPO基于rollout奖励优化，同时不使动作生成随机化。

Result: RMR使RoboMME成功率相对无循环的同构模型翻倍。RMR-VLA在RoboMME上达到66.46%总体成功率、Reference类别79.83%，在LIBERO-Mem上达到90.08%，在比较方法中取得最佳结果。

Conclusion: 显式循环记忆推理能有效提升VLA在长时程记忆依赖操作中的表现，并使同一模型联合优化推理与动作决策。

Abstract: Long-horizon, history-dependent robotic manipulation often requires acting on visual cues that have disappeared, such as an object indicated earlier or a target hidden under a moving cup. The key challenge is to maintain what past evidence means for the next action as the scene changes. We introduce Recurrent Memory Reasoning (RMR), an explicit reasoning step that connects memory to action inside a vision-language-action model (VLA), with no external reasoning model. At each update, the VLA first infers an event from visual evidence, then revises the task state and grounds a subgoal in the current scene to guide action generation. Carrying the state and subgoal across updates lets remembered identities and task progress determine the current target, doubling RoboMME success over an otherwise identical model without recurrence. Joint training lets one VLA both reason and act; because its memory decisions are text tokens with exact likelihoods, GRPO refines them from rollout rewards without making action generation stochastic. Among the compared methods, RMR-VLA achieves the best results on RoboMME (66.46% overall, 79.83% on the Reference category) and LIBERO-Mem (90.08%).

</details>


### [353] [Decoupling Perception from Generation for Agentic 3D CT Report Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29167)
*Chenyu Wang,Mingyu Chen,Wenchao Li,Kayhan Batmanghelich*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文将胸部CT报告生成重构为由大语言模型智能体协调的一系列视觉问答决策，并提出Rad-VL-JEPA感知模块，将视觉感知与推理、报告撰写解耦，从而提升细粒度CT理解与报告生成性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CT报告生成模型多采用通用视觉-语言建模，在训练数据有限时容易漏掉细微异常；而CT报告反复评估相同解剖区域及结节是否存在、位置等属性，更适合直接学习回答视觉问题，而非将感知耦合到开放式文本生成中。

Method: 将报告生成形式化为由LLM智能体协调的视觉问答决策集合；提出Rad-VL-JEPA，通过视觉-语言联合嵌入预测统一报告检索、发现识别和细粒度属性描述；使用强化学习训练智能体获取患者特异性视觉证据，并由独立编辑器将证据整合进最终报告。

Result: Rad-VL-JEPA在细粒度CT理解任务上表现较强，且相较使用相同CT编码器和VQA数据训练的生成式VLM基线，具有更低的摊销单查询推理时间；最终报告系统优于强VLM基线和智能体基线。

Conclusion: 将判别式视觉感知、LLM智能体推理和独立报告编辑分离，是提升CT报告生成与细粒度视觉理解的有效方案。

Abstract: Chest CT reports repeatedly assess the same anatomical regions for findings and their attributes, such as whether a lung nodule is present and where it is located. These assessments suggest learning to answer visual questions directly, rather than coupling perception to open-ended text generation. Yet current CT report generation models largely follow generic vision-language modeling, which may miss subtle abnormalities when training data are limited. We therefore formulate report generation as a set of visual question-answering decisions coordinated by a large language model (LLM) agent. This decouples visual perception from reasoning and report writing: perception can be learned as a discriminative, non-generative task, while the LLM focuses on reasoning over patient context and posing relevant visual queries. We introduce Rad-VL-JEPA, which unifies report retrieval, finding recognition, and fine-grained attribute characterization through vision-language joint-embedding prediction. Building on this perception module, an agent trained with reinforcement learning (RL) acquires patient-specific visual evidence, while a separate editor incorporates the evidence into the final report, further separating evidence acquisition from report realization. Experiments show that Rad-VL-JEPA achieves strong performance on fine-grained CT understanding tasks with lower amortized per-query inference time than a generative VLM baseline trained with the same CT encoder and VQA data. The resulting reporting system outperforms strong VLM-based and agentic baselines.

</details>


### [354] [STAR: Structure-Aware Temporal Action Recovery for Point Supervised Temporal Action Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30354)
*Yawar Rehman,Min Young Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出STAR，一种面向点监督时序动作定位的结构感知时序动作恢复框架，通过增强片段变化建模、学习动作内部起止与核心结构、改进伪标签生成并引入检测器反馈监督，提升点监督下的时序动作定位性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在视频数据持续增长的背景下，点监督时序动作定位需求上升。现有方法主要依赖片段级动作响应生成伪标签，但这些伪标签常存在边界模糊、提案过度扩展和时序结构弱等问题。

Method: STAR通过带注意力模块的时序差分交互增强基础S模型，以捕捉前后片段变化；引入start、core、end角色学习以建模动作内部时序结构；通过All point proposal ranking和Rolebank结构重排序改进伪标签生成，抑制邻居交叉和结构不一致提案；最后利用时序动作检测器向STAR反馈软start、core、end、action和background目标，将高质量检测预测回传以进一步精炼伪标签。

Result: 在四个标准基准上的实验验证了STAR的有效性。使用I3D特征时，STAR在THUMOS'14上达到67.2% AVG@0.1:0.7，在GTEA上达到58.1%，在BEOID上达到74.6%，在ActivityNet-1.3上达到31.7% AVG@0.5:0.95，并在多个基准上优于先前点监督方法。

Conclusion: STAR能够有效缓解点监督伪标签中的边界模糊和结构弱问题，通过结构建模、提案重排序和检测器反馈持续提升伪标签质量与时序动作定位性能。

Abstract: Point supervised temporal action localization is becoming the need of time in this era of ever growing and non-stop video data. Existing method mainly rely on snippet level action response to generate pseudo labels. However, these labels often suffer from boundary ambiguity, over extended proposals, and weak temporal structure. To address these issues, we propose STAR, a structure-aware Temporal Action Recovery framework for point supervised temporal action localization. STAR works by enhancing the base S model with temporal difference interaction with attention module to capture forward and backward snippet changes, and introduces the learning of start, core, and end roles to model the internal temporal structure of actions. In addition, STAR further improves the pseudo label generation through All point proposal ranking and Rolebank based structural re-ranking, which suppress neighbor crossing and structurally inconsistent proposals. Finally, temporal action detector to STAR feedback supervision transfers high quality detector prediction back to the STAR model through soft start, core, end, action, and background targets. This helps to further refine the pseudo labels. Extensive experiments on four standard benchmarks shows the effectiveness of STAR. By using I3D features, STAR achieves 67.2% at AVG@0.1:0.7 on THUMOS'14, 58.1% on GTEA, 74.6% on BEOID, and 31.7% at AVG@0.5:0.95 on ActivityNet-1.3, outperforming previous point supervised methods across multiple benchmarks.

</details>


### [355] [GeLiFiSH: Recursive LiDAR Keypoint Estimation with Ground and Moving Object Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30402)
*Nikolaos Stathoulopoulos,George Nikolakopoulos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 GeLiFiSH，一种无需学习的 LiDAR 关键点过滤方法，通过滚动体素图上的高度-结构检测与序贯假设检验，实时递推估计持久关键点，并融合地面分割与动目标剔除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LiDAR 配准与回环检测依赖稀疏且需跨会话、视角和传感器可重复的关键点；累积子图检测带来延迟且不融合重复观测，基于高度的检测受地面估计不一致影响，动态物体还会产生被误认为静态结构的鬼影轨迹。

Method: GeLiFiSH 在扫描频率下递推估计持久关键点：在滚动体素图上运行高度-结构检测器；检测结果以位置、协方差和存在概率初始化轨迹，并通过序贯概率比检验接收或拒绝；采用地面分割提供传感器无关的高度参考；在点云插入地图前用动目标分割剔除动态点。

Result: 在 SemanticKITTI、HeLiMOS 和 HeLiPR 上，覆盖五种 LiDAR 和多次会话，GeLiFiSH 在对比检测器中取得最高平均关键点可重复性；仅用关键点进行跨会话配准时召回率第二，仅次于提取关键点多四倍的 ISS；使用单一参数集且无需传感器高度先验时，地面分割与动目标分割模块平均优于基线。

Conclusion: GeLiFiSH 能以无需学习、单参数集且不依赖传感器高度先验的方式，实时生成更可重复的持久关键点，并改善地面与动目标分割，为跨会话、跨传感器 LiDAR 配准与回环检测提供有效前端过滤方案。

Abstract: LiDAR registration and loop closure often rely on sparse keypoints, which must remain repeatable across sessions, viewpoints, and sensors. To handle differing scan patterns, detectors typically operate on accumulated submaps, which introduces latency and processes each submap independently, so repeated observations are never fused. Height-based detectors also reference structure to an estimated ground, so its inconsistency across sessions propagates into the keypoints. Moreover, dynamic objects leave ghost trails that can be mistaken for static structure. We present GeLiFiSH (Geometric LiDAR Filtering with Sequential Hypothesis testing), a learning-free filter that recursively estimates persistent keypoints at scan rate. A height-structure detector runs on a rolling voxel map, and detections initialize tracks with a position, covariance, and existence probability, accepted or rejected by a sequential probability ratio test. Ground segmentation provides a sensor-agnostic height reference, and moving object segmentation removes dynamic points before map insertion. On SemanticKITTI, HeLiMOS, and HeLiPR, spanning five LiDARs and multiple sessions, GeLiFiSH attains the highest average keypoint repeatability among the compared detectors and the second-highest cross-session registration recall from keypoints alone, behind ISS which extracts four times as many keypoints. With one parameter set and no sensor-height prior, both ground and moving object segmentation modules outperform their baselines on average.

</details>


### [356] [PhyCoVE: Benchmarking Physical Counterfactual Video Editing across Diverse Material Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29184)
*Conghan Yue,Yuanjie Chen,Yunyan Xiao,Zeyu Peng,Xingsong Ye,Ya Gao,Yanglin Huang,WeiYao Zhang,Yue Han,Zhineng Chen,Yu-Gang Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 PhyCoVE，一个用于物理反事实视频编辑的基准，覆盖刚体、弹性体和流体的多种交互，并评估现有视频编辑模型能否再现编辑后的物理演化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有反事实视频编辑评测多局限于物体移除或特定刚体运动，而真实场景还涉及弹性变形、流体流动以及刚体-弹性体-流体交互，缺乏系统基准。

Method: 构建包含 110 个源视频、533 个案例的 PhyCoVE 基准，覆盖五类交互模式和移除物体、改变物理量、插入物体三类编辑；仿真案例由语言模型设计场景、编码智能体调用合适求解器和物理渲染并仿真，人工检查各阶段；真实案例在同一机位连续拍摄编辑前后；提出跨材料与交互的“反事实保真度”指标。

Result: 评估 7 个开源和商业视频编辑模型，发现反事实保真度与人类偏好排序接近，但最佳模型仅再现约七分之一的物理变化；模型主要改变场景外观，很少改变其演化过程。

Conclusion: 物理反事实视频编辑仍远未解决，PhyCoVE 为开发和评估相关方法提供了基础。

Abstract: Physical counterfactual video editing turns a source video and a language-specified physical edit at a given execution frame into a counterfactual video that shows how the scene would evolve after the edit. Existing evaluations with counterfactual target videos mainly cover object removal or specific rigid-body motions, although real scenes also involve elastic deformation, fluid flow, and interactions among rigid bodies, elastic solids, and fluids. We introduce PhyCoVE, a benchmark of 533 cases on 110 source videos that covers rigid, elastic, and fluid dynamics in five interaction patterns, with edits that remove an object, change a physical quantity, or insert a new object. For the simulated cases, a language model proposes scene designs, coding agents build them with solvers suited to each material and physically based rendering and then simulate each edit from the source scene state, and humans check every stage. For the real cases, we record continuously from one camera position before and after each edit. We also propose counterfactual fidelity, a metric that applies across materials and their interactions and measures how much of the physical change from the source video to the target video a generated video reproduces. We evaluate seven open-source and commercial video editing models and find that counterfactual fidelity ranks them nearly as human preference does, but even the best model reproduces only about one seventh of the physical change. The models change how a scene looks but rarely how it evolves, whereas a physical edit requires understanding the dynamics that it changes. Physical counterfactual video editing thus remains far from solved, and PhyCoVE provides a foundation for developing and evaluating methods for it.

</details>


### [357] [loopxDINO: Dense Visual Prediction via Iterative Latent Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29180)
*Xiangjing An,Zhibin Jiao,Aiting Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 loopxDINO，用迭代潜在推理替代传统密集视觉预测中堆叠解码器层的方式，在冻结 DINOv2-Base 特征基础上，通过紧凑的权重共享循环交叉注意力解码器实现语义分割，并以更少参数取得更高 mIoU 和边界 IoU。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准密集视觉预测架构依赖堆叠 6-16 层 Transformer 解码器扩展表示能力，带来反向传播激活内存开销、非共享权重的高片外内存带宽需求，以及无法根据图像空间复杂度自适应分配的静态计算问题。

Method: loopxDINO 包含两个解耦组件：一是冻结的 DINOv2-Base 主干，一次前向提取空间特征并缓存静态 Key-Value；二是紧凑的权重共享 Looped Cross-Attention Decoder，核心 7.96M、总可训练 14.85M 参数，在 T 次迭代中循环更新查询。使用步条件 adaLN、基于 LayerNorm 的超椭球流形正则和可学习残差收缩阻尼稳定循环，并将中间掩码预测反馈为空间注意力偏置以引导模糊轮廓，且不增加额外参数。

Result: 在 Pascal VOC 2012 语义分割、单张 RTX 5060 Ti 16GB 上，loopxDINO（T=2）达到 85.66% mIoU 和 65.01% Boundary IoU；相比 54.06M 参数的 6 层 DINO-Trans6L 提升 +1.09% mIoU 和 +7.41% Boundary IoU，同时参数少 72.5%。相比 2.43M 参数的 4 层 DINO-FCN4L probe，边界 delineation 提升 +6.43% bIoU，在 60% patch masking 下遮挡鲁棒性提升 +6.76% mIoU。结合 ACT 达到 87.3 FPS，并在 60% 遮挡下保留 29.64% mIoU，比 DINO-Trans6L 高 +5.83%。

Conclusion: loopxDINO 表明用循环潜在推理替代物理解码器深度，可以在显著减少参数和计算开销的同时提升语义分割精度与边界质量，并具备更好的遮挡鲁棒性和自适应计算潜力；代码、预训练权重和评估套件已以 Apache 2.0 开源。

Abstract: Standard dense visual prediction architectures scale representation capacity by stacking deep feedforward decoders (6-16 transformer layers with 50M-200M parameters). This explicit layer stacking brings substantial activation memory overhead during backpropagation, requires high off-chip memory bandwidth for non-tied weights, and uses static computational allocation that cannot adapt to spatial image complexity.
  We propose loopxDINO, which replaces physical decoder depth with iterative latent reasoning. It has two decoupled components: (1) a frozen DINOv2-Base backbone extracting spatial features in one forward pass and caching static Key-Value representations in GPU memory; (2) a compact weight-tied Looped Cross-Attention Decoder (7.96M core, 14.85M total trainable parameters) that recurrently updates queries across T iterations. Recurrence is stabilized by step-conditioned adaLN, LayerNorm-based hyper-ellipsoid manifold regularization, and learnable residual contraction damping. Intermediate mask predictions are fed back as spatial attention biases to guide queries toward ambiguous contours with no extra parameters.
  On Pascal VOC 2012 semantic segmentation with a single RTX 5060 Ti 16GB GPU, loopxDINO (T=2) achieves 85.66% mIoU and 65.01% Boundary IoU. It outperforms 6-layer DINO-Trans6L (54.06M params) by +1.09% mIoU and +7.41% Boundary IoU with 72.5% fewer parameters. Compared to 4-layer DINO-FCN4L probe (2.43M params, 83.82% mIoU), loopxDINO improves boundary delineation by +6.43% bIoU and occlusion resilience by +6.76% mIoU (60% patch masking). With Adaptive Computation Time (ACT), it reaches 87.3 FPS and retains 29.64% mIoU under 60% occlusion (+5.83% over DINO-Trans6L).
  Source code, pre-trained weights and evaluation suites are open-sourced under Apache 2.0 at https://github.com/loopxDINO/loopxDINO

</details>


### [358] [EgoDepth-Bench: Benchmarking Metric Depth for Egocentric Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30734)
*Yuan Gao,Dongchen Wei,Xinyang Lin,Shuhua Cao,Xueliang Guo,Zhuohan Li,Yihao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 EgoDepth-Bench，一个面向第一人称操作场景的大规模 RGB-深度基准，包含 94 万余个同步样本、37 个环境、6 路校准 RGB 视图及鱼眼原生度量深度，并用于评估单目、立体和多视图深度模型的精度与覆盖范围。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 第一人称操作场景中缺乏能够严格评估度量深度与相对深度估计、并检验跨未见环境泛化能力的基准，尤其是对手部和物体区域的预测覆盖评估。

Method: 构建 EgoDepth-Bench：采集 941,233 个同步样本，覆盖 37 个物理环境；每个样本包含 6 个校准 RGB 视图和由 5 个主动红外立体模块重建的鱼眼视图度量深度；使用校准球杆验证几何精度，采用环境留出划分评估泛化；对单目、立体和多视图模型评估深度精度与预测覆盖率，并微调 MapAnything。

Result: 校准球杆验证达到毫米级几何精度，已知球间距中位误差为 1.27 mm；在未见环境上微调 MapAnything 后，度量 AbsRel 从 0.708 降至 0.091，尺度对齐 AbsRel 从 0.327 降至 0.072。

Conclusion: EgoDepth-Bench 能提供有效监督，并支持对第一人称操作场景中度量深度和相对深度估计进行严格评估；项目页面提供评估代码和交互式 RGB-深度序列。

Abstract: We introduce EgoDepth-Bench, comprising 941,233 synchronized samples collected across 37 distinct physical environments. Each sample combines six calibrated RGB views with metric depth in the native fisheye view, reconstructed from five active-infrared stereo modules. A calibrated ball-bar confirms millimeter-level geometric accuracy, with a median error of 1.27 mm on a known sphere spacing. Environment-held-out splits enable evaluation of generalization to unseen environments. Across monocular, stereo, and multi-view models, the benchmark measures both depth accuracy and prediction coverage, including on hands and objects. Fine-tuning MapAnything on EgoDepth-Bench reduces metric AbsRel from 0.708 to 0.091 and scale-aligned AbsRel from 0.327 to 0.072 on unseen environments. These results demonstrate that EgoDepth-Bench provides effective supervision and enables rigorous evaluation of metric and relative depth estimation in egocentric manipulation. The project page provides the evaluation code and interactive RGB-depth sequences.

</details>


### [359] [World Models as Native Latent Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30898)
*Qinyue Li,Weijie Qiao,Qingyi Tao,Zerui Gong,Zhe Yang,Quanzhou Li,Taolin Zhang,Jinglin He,Zhonghua Wu,Chen Change Loy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 处理失败


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 处理失败

Method: 处理失败

Result: 处理失败

Conclusion: 处理失败

Abstract: Large and diverse video sources, such as egocentric human video and heterogeneous robot recordings, carry rich dynamics but come either without actions or without a shared action space. Latent action models (LAMs) can recover these dynamics, but they train their inverse- and forward-dynamics models (IDM, FDM) from scratch, trading off pixel reconstruction against latent capacity and accuracy. Pretrained video world models natively generate high-fidelity dynamics, yet represent them densely, entangled across all layers. Viewing the world model as a LAM, we show that these dynamics can be extracted with minimal changes to the model. Native LAM operates one pretrained video diffusion transformer as both IDM and FDM, with learnable dynamics registers as the only causal bridge between the two, and trains on counterfactual temporal pairs that differ in motion alone, so that the registers distill a video's dynamics into a compact native latent action. We further propose a pretraining paradigm for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, Pretraining Actions from World models (PAWlicy), in which Native LAM serves as a dynamics teacher on large-scale video; unlike world action models, it never generates video. Native latent actions outperform existing LAMs on the LARY benchmark in both action classification and control regression, and replay the same motion on new robots, in new scenes, and from human hands to robots, although no transfer objective is used in training. With a 3.8B model, PAWlicy reaches a 93.6% average success rate on RoboTwin 2.0 trained with domain-randomized demonstrations, the highest among VLAs. On RoboDojo, it is competitive on every dimension we evaluate, and its Precision, evaluated by us, is on par with the leading leaderboard entries. On real robots, it improves over the pi_0.5 baseline on both tasks. Both stages use only public data and a publicly released world model.

</details>


### [360] [Can Multimodal Fusion MakeSense for Embodied Vision in Degraded Sensing?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30836)
*Cheng-Ru Chou,Shih-Yu Lai,Pei-Lin Chiang,Shou-Po Tsai,Jing-Zhe Huang,Fukuharu Tanaka,Hirozumi Yamaguchi,Bing-Yu Chen,Yu-Lun Liu,Hsun-Ping Hsieh*

Abstract: Embodied vision systems rely on complementary sensors to perceive and act as conditions change. Even models that accept arbitrary sensor subsets can exhibit negative fusion: adding a sensor increases prediction error. We propose MakeSense, a multimodal fusion framework that preserves sensor-specific evidence in private streams and combines information through shared bottleneck tokens. Training pairs full and subset views of the same degraded observations, penalizing higher error with more sensors. Where geometry permits, the distance readout uses range measurements alone, while the rest of the prediction draws on all available inputs. Paired tests across five datasets reveal helpful and harmful sensor additions. MakeSense reduces negative fusion on MM-Fi. With lightweight adapters and per-dataset training, the same design improves UAV localization on MMAUD, cooperative 3D detection on V2X-Real, few-shot pose transfer to RELI11D, and command prediction on Humanoid-Everyday, where a world model trained on the frozen core's outputs forecasts future fused states more accurately than a linear baseline at longer tested horizons. MakeSense supports embodied sensing across human activity, aerial systems, robotics, and autonomous driving.

</details>


### [361] [GlanceNav: Efficient Vision-and-Language Navigation with Streaming Memory and Counterfactual Rewind](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30900)
*Anh Dao,Quan-Dung Pham,Danh Vinh Le,Tuyen Pham Le,Quan Nguyen,Yuzhang Shang*

Main category: cs.CV

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have become strong policies for vision-and-language navigation (VLN). However, most of them encode a sample of past frames again at every decision and are trained on isolated decisions, so computation is redundant and the usable history is short. They also learn from their own mistakes through outcome rewards that give one scalar to a whole episode. We ask whether a navigator can encode each frame only once, at a constant cost per step, and still remember what matters and learn efficiently from its mistakes. We present GlanceNav, a streaming navigator built on a hybrid MLLM. Its Gated DeltaNet layers carry a recurrent state through the whole episode, while its attention layers keep a short window of recent observations and a small bank of keyframes, selected by how much each frame changes the recurrent state. This constant-size memory keeps the cost per step fixed and allows training on whole episodes with the same memory as at inference. Because the entire memory can also be copied in constant time, we further propose Counterfactual Rewind (CoRe), a reinforcement learning stage that rewinds a drifting rollout to its closest approach to the goal, lets an expert correct a few actions, and credits decisions by the resulting change in outcome. Trained only on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE training splits, with 1,000 instructions for reinforcement learning, a 4B GlanceNav reaches success rates of 71.9% and 73.6% on R2R-CE and RxR-CE val-unseen. On R2R-CE, it outperforms the strongest previous single-RGB method trained without external data by 9.1 points, while running at 104 ms per step.

</details>

Abstract: We present PartPO, a reinforcement learning method for generating structured shape programs from 3D point clouds. Existing shape-to-program models are trained with supervised learning on procedurally generated data and generalize poorly to more diverse shapes, while reinforcement learning from execution feedback assigns a single scalar reward to a long program that builds many parts, making credit assignment difficult. PartPO instead builds on a core property of the task: shape programs are self-describing, with each semantically named part produced by its own code block. It segments each generated program by its parts and applies part-level rewards only to the code of the corresponding part, a category reward only to the object name, and a shape-level reward to the whole program. The required part supervision is obtained without manual annotation, by grounding part names on target meshes with an open-vocabulary segmentation model prompt-tuned on the model's own outputs. Applied to MeshCoder, PartPO improves reconstruction accuracy and execution success on ShapeNetCore and ABO over the base model, rejection-sampling fine-tuning and trajectory-level RL, and generalizes to the unseen HSSD dataset. Code will be released at https://github.com/HannuoZ/PartPO.

</details>

Abstract: We introduce Egocentric Human Motion Bridging, a task that generates a coherent 3D human motion sequence from two endpoint egocentric images. Unlike conventional motion in-betweening, which requires structured 3D endpoint poses, this setting uses raw first-person observations available from wearable devices in VR/AR and robotics. It presents challenges due to viewpoint variations, partial body visibility, and temporal ambiguity under cross-modal endpoint constraints. To address these challenges, we propose Ego-HMB, a unified diffusion-based framework that learns endpoint pose estimation and temporally consistent motion infilling within a single model through two training stages. First, Egocentric-to-Canonical Pretraining uses a hierarchical curriculum with progressively increasing temporal spans to strengthen endpoint pose priors. Second, Motion Bridge Diffusion Training incorporates endpoint and physics awareness, diffusing from neighboring poses to promote temporal continuity while preserving global endpoint constraints. Extensive experiments compare our approach with one-stage methods that directly generate motion from two egocentric images and two-stage pipelines that combine endpoint pose estimation with motion interpolation. Ego-HMB consistently outperforms these baselines in endpoint accuracy and motion generation quality. Code is available at https://github.com/gaogehan/Ego-HMB.

</details>


### [364] [Unleashing the Value of Raw Point Clouds for 3D Understanding with LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29194)
*Tailai Chen,Jiawei Yu,Yiming Cheng,Ping Nie,Yongyong Chen,Tao Zhou,Zheng Zhu,Ming Li*

Method: 处理失败

Result: 处理失败

Conclusion: 处理失败

Abstract: Standard 3D point cloud language models typically rely on pretrained point encoders to extract 3D features and project them into representations processable by large language models (LLMs). However, these encoders are often originally optimized for pre-defined tasks, resulting in a representation bottleneck that may lead to a substantial mismatch with downstream 3D understanding. Moreover, existing models largely follow a single pass closed-book generation, limiting their ability to actively inspect task-relevant 3D regions or retrieve necessary external knowledge. In this work, we present PointTool, an encoder-free and tool-augmented framework for 3D reasoning. PointTool introduces Alignment-Free Patch Tokenization (AFPT) to locally aggregate raw point clouds while preserving fine-grained geometric structure, and Decoupled Point-Text LoRA (DPL) to facilitate global aggregation and 3D knowledge internalization within a frozen LLM. Building upon these designs, Program-Supervised Tool Reasoning (PSTR) enables the model to explicitly operate on raw 3D data and external resources through executable tools, supporting interactive 3D reasoning grounded in spatial evidence. We further introduce PointCloud-TR, a benchmark comprising 13K 3D objects, 39.8K questions, and 35.6K tool trajectories to facilitate training and evaluation of complex 3D reasoning. Experiments demonstrate that PointTool achieves strong performance on both standard and complex 3D understanding tasks, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

</details>


### [365] [Complementary Geometry in Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29236)
*Mingle Jiang,Jikui Zhou,Chenghan Lyu,Rui Xu,Yunke Wang,Chang Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出REVEAL框架，在不修改原始高斯表示的前提下，利用多视角互补几何信息选择性优化新视角深度，并发布真实场景RGB-D基准RIG。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Gaussian Splatting在新视角合成中视觉质量高，但其渲染深度是沿射线的透明度加权平均，可能不对应真实场景表面，几何精度仍不足。

Method: 观察到同一冻结高斯表示在不同视角下的深度预测误差具有互补性。REVEAL将源视角深度重投影到目标视角，通过鲁棒多视角共识融合候选深度，并引入学习选择机制，根据预期深度误差降低决定是否采用候选深度。同时构建RIG真实基准，使用同步RGB-D相机提供静态和动态重建评估所需的真值深度。

Result: 在3个基准和6种Gaussian Splatting骨干上，REVEAL持续提升深度精度，同时保持可比的渲染质量；RIG为静态与动态重建模型提供真实深度评估。

Conclusion: 利用多视角互补几何信息可在不改动原高斯表示的情况下有效提升新视角几何精度，REVEAL具有通用性，并可结合现有高斯泼溅方法使用。

Abstract: Gaussian Splatting has achieved high visual quality in novel view synthesis, but the accuracy of its rendered geometry remains a challenge. In particular, the rendered depth is computed as an opacity-weighted average along each ray, which may not correspond to the actual scene surface. In this paper, we observe that depth predictions from different views of the same frozen Gaussian representation exhibit complementary errors, allowing us to improve novel-view geometry using information from other views without modifying the original representation. Based on this observation, we propose REVEAL, a general framework that selectively refines novel-view depth using complementary geometric information. Specifically, we first reproject depth predictions from source views to the target view and combine them using robust multi-view consensus. We then introduce a learned selection mechanism to determine whether the candidate depth is more accurate than the original prediction, based on the expected reduction in depth error. In addition, we introduce RIG, a real-world benchmark captured with synchronized RGB-D cameras, which provides ground-truth depth for evaluating both static and dynamic reconstruction models. Experiments on 6 Gaussian Splatting backbones across 3 benchmarks show that REVEAL consistently improves depth accuracy while maintaining comparable rendering quality.

</details>


### [366] [CFANet: Learning Conflict-Free Weather Adapters for All-Weather Image Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29257)
*Minglong Xue,Wenchao Yan,Guoan Guan,Palaiahnakote Shivakumara,Yirui Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出冲突无关适配器网络 CFANet，用于开放组合式全天候图像复原，可处理雨、雾、雪等多种天气同时出现的退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全天候复原方法多采用统一网络或单标签天气建模，但真实恶劣天气常具有组合性，同一图像中可能同时存在多种已知天气类型，因此需要非互斥的天气组合建模能力。

Method: CFANet 首先用天气混合路由器 WMR 从浅层特征预测雨、雾、雪的非互斥组合权重；再由共享-私有天气适配器 SPWA 在冲突无关适配块中动态组合公共适配器与天气私有适配器，实现共享复原能力与天气特定残差适配；同时引入轻量自然色彩适配器 NCA 进行受约束色彩校准。

Result: 大量实验表明，该方法在恶劣天气图像复原上取得有竞争力的性能，并有利于下游视觉任务。

Conclusion: CFANet 通过非互斥天气组合建模、共享-私有适配和色彩校准，有效应对开放组合式全天候图像复原问题，并提升复原结果及下游任务表现。

Abstract: All-weather image restoration aims to recover clean images from diverse weather degradations such as rain, haze, and snow. Most existing all-in-one methods handle different weather types with a unified network or rely on single-label weather modeling. However, real-world adverse weather is often compositional, where multiple known weather primitives may coexist in a single image. To this end, we propose Conflict-Free Adapter Network (CFANet) for open-compositional all-weather image restoration. CFANet first employs a Weather Mixture Router (WMR) to predict non-exclusive composition weights for rain, haze, and snow from shallow features. Guided by these weights, a Shared-Private Weather Adapter (SPWA) dynamically composes a common adapter with weather-private adapters inside each Conflict-Free Adapter Block, preserving shared restoration capability while providing weather-specific residual adaptation. Moreover, a lightweight Natural Color Adapter (NCA) performs constrained color calibration to improve color fidelity and visual naturalness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves competitive adverse weather image restoration performance and benefits downstream visual tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/wenchao-tech/CFANet-main

</details>


### [367] [One-shot is Enough: Boosting SAM for Medical Image Segmentation through Structured Information Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29278)
*Guilin Guan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 OB-SAM，一种面向医学图像分割的单样本增强框架，通过结构化建模充分利用单个样本中的多粒度信息，并在七个数据集上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAM 等基础模型主要在自然图像上预训练，直接用于医学图像效果较差；而获取大量医学标注数据成本高，因此单样本学习很有吸引力。但 SAM 在该范式下难以充分提取多粒度信息，性能明显下降。

Method: 提出 OB-SAM 单样本增强框架，包含三个模块：多频解耦模块 MFD 将特征分解到不同频域成分以缓解过拟合并增强表征；渐进特征整合器 PFI 促进多层级特征互补融合；选择性上下文过滤模块 SCF 通过建模前景与背景对比关系自适应选择关键上下文信息，实现病灶精确定位。

Result: 在七个多样化数据集上的大量实验表明，OB-SAM 达到了当前最优的分割性能。

Conclusion: 从结构化建模角度最大化单样本信息利用，可有效提升基础模型在医学图像单样本分割中的表现，OB-SAM 验证了该思路的有效性。

Abstract: In recent years, Foundation models such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM) have demonstrated strong generalization capabilities, but because they are primarily pre-trained on natural images, they perform poorly when faced with medical images. With sufficient labeled medical data, this challenge is somewhat alleviated. However, the difficulty and high cost of acquiring large amounts of labeled data make one-shot learning a highly attractive research paradigm. But within this paradigm, SAM struggles to fully extract its potential multi-granular information, leading to a sharp decline in performance. To address this, we propose OB-SAM, a one-shot enhancement framework for medical image segmentation. It aims to maximize the utilization of information from a single sample from the perspective of structured modeling. Specifically, we first designed a Multi-Frequency Decoupling (MFD) module, which divides features into different frequency domain components, allowing each branch to focus on information expression at different semantic levels, thereby alleviating overfitting and enhancing feature representation capabilities. Secondly, we introduce a Progressive Feature Integrator (PFI) module to promote complementary fusion among multi-level features, thereby avoiding the dominant effect of a certain level of feature in the fusion process. Furthermore, we propose an Selective Context Filtering (SCF) Module that adaptively selects key contextual information by modeling the contrast relationship between the foreground and background, thereby achieving precise localization of the lesion area. Extensive experiments across seven diverse datasets validate that OB-SAM achieves state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [368] [MM-DataLoop: Closing the Data-Side Loop for Recursive Self-Improvement in MLLM Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29254)
*Likang Peng,Chen Ju,Xu Chen,Xiangyang Wu,Jinsong Lan,Haihong Tang,Ying Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究多模态语言模型后训练中数据侧的递归自我改进，提出 MMDataLoop 工作流，将数据干预组织为五类操作，并通过共享规则记忆串联观察-诊断-计划-执行-验证-反思循环，在固定训练与评估设置下比较不同数据配方。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归自我改进为模型通过反复评估与修订提升性能提供了路径，但在多模态语言模型后训练中，异构数据操作和跨轮证据需要协调，数据侧决策如何影响最终结果仍缺乏系统研究。

Method: 提出 MMDataLoop，将数据干预归为五个操作族，并用 Observe-Diagnose-Plan-Execute-Verify-Reflect 循环和共享规则记忆连接各轮操作。在 Qwen3.5-0.8B 和五个基准上进行 34 个候选轮次，固定基础初始化、训练计划和评估协议，仅变化数据配方；并开展八候选对比，比较引导搜索与随机策略。

Result: 五基准平均分在 R33 达到 63.04，比零样本基线提升 5.32 分；R29、R32、R33 构成差距在 0.09 分内的顶部候选簇。八候选比较中，引导搜索在 6 个候选中达到预设目标并识别出观测最佳候选；随机臂均值更高但离散度更低。选出的 R29 配方在相同 epoch 计划下也优于两个全池基线。

Conclusion: MMDataLoop 可作为可追踪的数据侧自我改进工作流，并为研究数据决策如何影响多模态语言模型后训练配方结果提供了实证基础。

Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a path toward improving models through repeated evaluation and revision. We study its data side in multimodal language model (MLLM) post-training, where heterogeneous operations and cross-round evidence must be coordinated. MMDataLoop organizes data interventions into five operation families and connects them through an Observe-Diagnose-Plan-Execute-Verify-Reflect cycle with shared rule memory. Across 34 candidate rounds on Qwen3.5-0.8B and five benchmarks, we hold the base initialization, shared training schedule and evaluation protocol fixed while varying data recipes. The five-benchmark mean reaches 63.04 at R33, up 5.32 points from the zero-shot baseline; R29, R32, and R33 form a close top cluster within 0.09 points. In eightcandidate comparisons, guided search reaches the preselected target in six candidates and identifies the top observed candidate, while random arms show higher means and lower dispersion. The selected R29 recipe also scores above two full-pool baselines under the same epoch schedule. Together, these findings establish MM-DataLoop as a traceable workflow and provide an empirical basis for studying how data-side decisions shape outcomes across MLLM post-training recipes.

</details>


### [369] [Pruning Autonomous Driving VLAs: What to Preserve for Reasoning and Action](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31240)
*Seongchan Kim,Soowon Son,Sangoh Kim,Hyunah Ko,Eunbeen Hong,Hyunkoo Lee,Sanghyun Lee,WonJun Moon,Kihong Kim,Dongyeon Son,Woongchan Nam,Seungryong Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究面向自动驾驶的推理型视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的结构化剪枝，提出 MoOP 方法，在保持场景理解与轨迹预测能力的同时显著降低参数、内存和计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理型 VLA 模型通过思维链推理指导动作生成，但带来显著的内存与计算成本；现有剪枝需同时保留场景理解和轨迹预测能力，而推理目标与轨迹目标对同一 VLM 结构的重要性并不一致。

Method: 基于 Alpamayo-1.5-10B 的 Taylor 重要性分析发现：推理与轨迹目标对 VLM 结构赋予不同重要性；动作专家中 MLP 通道在去噪步间的重要性排序比 query heads 更稳定，且少量通道贡献大部分重要性。据此提出 MoOP：对 VLM 剪枝融合两个目标的重要性排序；对动作专家聚合逐步重要性以选择固定 MLP 通道子集。

Result: 在总参数减少 24.0% 时，仅剪 VLM 的 MoOP 在驾驶性能上可比或略优于最强基线，并保留稠密模型 94.0% 的 LingoQA 分数；在 30.0% 更高压缩率下，MoOP 退化显著小于其他方法，且是唯一推理未崩溃的方法。移除 93.75% 的专家 MLP 通道后总参数减少达 39.4%，开环误差相对仅剪 VLM 几乎不变，闭环性能具竞争力；最终模型实现 1.37 倍端到端推理加速和 36.6% 的峰值内存降低，且无需剪枝后微调。

Conclusion: MoOP 通过融合多目标重要性和稳定通道选择，实现了推理型自动驾驶 VLA 模型的有效结构化剪枝，在大幅压缩参数的同时较好保留推理与驾驶性能，并带来实际推理效率收益。

Abstract: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) models for autonomous driving use chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning to guide action generation, but incur substantial memory and computational costs. We study structured pruning for these models, focusing on preserving both scene understanding and trajectory prediction. Our analysis of Taylor importance in Alpamayo-1.5-10B shows that reasoning and trajectory objectives assign different importance to the same vision-language model (VLM) structures. In the action expert, MLP channels exhibit more stable importance rankings across denoising steps than query heads, and a small fraction of channels accounts for most of the measured importance. Based on these findings, we propose MoOP, which combines importance ranks from both objectives for VLM pruning and aggregates stepwise importance to select a fixed subset of expert MLP channels. At 24.0% total parameter reduction, VLM-only pruning with MoOP performs comparably to or slightly better than the strongest baselines in driving, while retaining 94.0% of the dense model's LingoQA score, far above all other methods. At a higher reduction of 30.0%, MoOP degrades much less than every other method, as it is the only one whose reasoning does not collapse. Removing 93.75% of expert MLP channels increases total parameter reduction to 39.4%, with nearly unchanged open-loop errors relative to VLM-only pruning and competitive closed-loop performance. The resulting model achieves a 1.37x end-to-end inference speedup and 36.6% lower peak memory than the dense model, without post-pruning fine-tuning.

</details>


### [370] [ContinuLoc: Continuous Pose Inference over Neural Fields for UAV Geo-Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29276)
*Weikun Zhou,Jinliang Lin,Yu Zang,Lin Xie,Haiqing Fu,Sheng Ao,Shangshu Yu,Zhiming Luo,Cheng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种解耦地图表示与位姿推断的跨视角无人机地理定位方法，将地理参考地图编码为可连续查询的语义神经场，并在连续4DoF位姿空间中显式优化定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主流方法将地图组织为离散化的2DoF候选库，导致地图表示与位姿推断耦合，且定位精度受候选采样分辨率限制。

Method: 将地理参考地图编码为连续可查询的语义神经场；把定位建模为对连续4DoF位姿空间（2D地面位置、平面内航向、观察尺度）的显式优化；利用共享语义特征空间中的全局描述子按需评估位姿假设；在ContinuScenes基准的全4DoF监督下学习位姿敏感视觉表示；推理采用从广泛位姿覆盖到高兼容区域自适应集中的分层策略。

Result: 实验表明，在逐步严格的4DoF精度标准下，该方法相较代表性定位范式取得显著提升。

Conclusion: 通过将地图表示与位姿推断解耦，并采用连续语义神经场与连续4DoF优化，可突破离散候选库的采样瓶颈，提高跨视角无人机地理定位精度。

Abstract: Cross-view UAV geo-localization involves three design choices: how to represent the UAV observation, how to represent the geo-referenced map, and how to infer pose from their interaction. The dominant paradigm organizes the map as a discretized 2DoF candidate library, coupling map representation to pose inference and thus bounding spatial localization precision by candidate sampling resolution. We decouple map representation from pose inference by encoding the geo-referenced map as a continuously queryable semantic neural field, enabling localization to be formulated as explicit optimization over a continuous 4DoF pose space parameterized by 2D ground position, in-plane heading, and viewing scale. Pose hypotheses are evaluated on demand using global descriptors in a shared semantic feature space, bypassing the sampling bottleneck of retrieval. We learn 4DoF pose-sensitive visual representations under full 4DoF supervision provided by ContinuScenes, a multi-city benchmark with dense near-nadir UAV imagery and complete pose annotations. Inference proceeds hierarchically, progressing from broad pose-space coverage to adaptive concentration on high-compatibility regions. Experiments demonstrate substantial gains over representative localization paradigms under progressively stricter 4DoF accuracy criteria.
  Code is available at https://github.com/ZhouWeikun/ContinuLoc/

</details>


### [371] [Why Adaptive Optimizers Struggle with Large Convolution Kernels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29232)
*Tianyu Ding,Jiachen Jiang,Jinxin Zhou,Yong Ma,Zhihui Zhu,Luming Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文指出大卷积核难训练的一个关键原因是 Adam 等自适应优化器会放大 k×k 卷积核均值的更新，并提出通过 DCT 系数训练大核、训练后再转换回空间域的 DCT-Rep 方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大卷积核能以较低计算成本扩大感受野，但训练困难，现有大核网络常依赖并行小核分支和 BatchNorm 等昂贵训练技巧；作者希望定位困难根源并提供低成本解决方案。

Method: 作者分析自适应优化器中卷积核均值梯度的放大效应，证明其可使最大学习率上限按 1/k^2 下降；进一步证明 DCT 基能隔离均值，且是唯一能对角化镜像边界下平稳梯度统计的正交基。因此提出用 DCT 系数训练大核，训练后逆变换回空间域，几乎不增加代码、参数、推理成本和训练开销。

Result: 在图像分类、目标检测、语义分割和图像复原任务上，DCT-Rep 稳定提升大核 ConvNet 和 ViT：ImageNet-1K 上 ConvNeXt-T 提升 0.79% top-1，ViT-S/16 提升 0.43%；COCO 提升 1.4 box AP，ADE20K 提升 1.2 mIoU，图像去模糊最高提升 0.4 dB，且增益随卷积核增大而增加。

Conclusion: DCT-Rep 是一种简单有效、无额外推理成本的大核训练方法，可一致改善大卷积核 ConvNet 与视觉 Transformer 在多类视觉任务中的性能。

Abstract: Large convolution kernels enlarge the receptive fields of ConvNets at a modest computational cost, but they are notoriously difficult to train. Existing large-kernel networks therefore rely on costly training techniques, such as parallel small-kernel branches with batch normalization. In this paper, we trace this difficulty to adaptive optimizers such as Adam, which normalize the update of every weight separately. Since input features rarely average to zero, all weights of a kernel share a common gradient, and these optimizers move the mean of a $k\times k$ kernel $k$ times as far as a single parameter. We find this mean amplification in widely used ConvNets and vision transformers, and show that it can force the maximal learning rate to fall as $1/k^2$. We further prove that the basis of the discrete cosine transform (DCT) isolates the mean and is the only orthonormal basis that diagonalizes every stationary gradient statistic with mirrored boundaries. We therefore train large kernels through their DCT coefficients and convert them back after training. The resulting method, DCT-Rep, requires only a few lines of code and adds no parameters, no inference cost and negligible training overhead. Extensive experiments on image classification, object detection, semantic segmentation and image restoration show that DCT-Rep consistently improves large-kernel ConvNets and vision transformers, by $+0.79\%$ top-1 accuracy for a large-kernel ConvNeXt-T and $+0.43\%$ for ViT-S/16 on ImageNet-1K, $+1.4$ box AP on COCO, $+1.2$ mIoU on ADE20K and up to $+0.4$ dB on image deblurring, where the gain grows with the kernel size.

</details>


### [372] [FP-Prune: Rethinking Visual Token Pruning from an Information Gain Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29327)
*Haozhe Zhao,Junxiang Zhang,Junxin Wang,Yuan Ge,Xiangchen Song,Dingyang Zhang,JingBo Zhu,Tong Xiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文从信息增益视角重新审视视觉token剪枝，利用互信息刻画候选token的增量价值，并从理论上证明frame potential可作为互信息的有效替代，据此提出免训练剪枝方法FP-Prune，在保持互补视觉信息的同时降低视觉语言模型推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉token剪枝能降低视觉语言模型推理成本，但其效果取决于在有限token预算下保留互补视觉信息。核心挑战在于量化候选token相对于已保留集合的额外信息贡献，而基于注意力或相似度的传统分数难以直接刻画这种贡献。

Method: 作者从信息增益角度出发，用互信息表征候选token的增量价值；理论上建立frame potential作为互信息的有效代理；在此基础上提出免训练的视觉token剪枝方法FP-Prune，通过迭代移除信息增益低的token，以尽可能保留互补视觉信息。

Result: 在三个广泛使用的视觉语言模型和八个数据集上的实验表明，FP-Prune在准确率和推理效率上均优于基线方法；进一步分析显示，该代理目标与模型性能高度一致。

Conclusion: 该工作为视觉token剪枝提供了理论依据和有效方法，说明基于frame potential的信息增益代理能够有效指导互补视觉信息的保留，从而在有限token预算下提升视觉语言模型的推理表现与效率。

Abstract: Visual token pruning can reduce the inference cost of vision language models, but its effectiveness depends on preserving complementary visual information under a limited token budget. A central challenge is to quantify the additional information a candidate token contributes beyond the retained set, a contribution that conventional scores based on attention or similarity struggle to capture directly. In this work, we revisit visual token pruning from the perspective of information gain and use mutual information to characterize the incremental value of candidate tokens. We further establish theoretically that frame potential serves as an effective surrogate for mutual information. Building on this observation, we propose FP-Prune, a training-free visual token pruning method that iteratively removes tokens with low information gain to preserve as much complementary visual information as possible. Experiments on three widely used VLMs and eight datasets demonstrate that FP-Prune outperforms baseline methods in both accuracy and inference efficiency. Further analysis shows that the surrogate objective closely aligns with model performance. Our work provides theoretical grounding and an effective method for visual token pruning.

</details>


### [373] [PrimiTok: Learning to Diversify and Allocate Primitives for Visual Tokenization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29311)
*Yizhu Chen,Chen Ju,Donghao Zhou,Ziyu Guo,Shuai Xiao,Jinsong Lan,Xiaoyong Zhu,Ying Chen,Haodong Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 PrimiTok，一种组合式视觉分词器，通过自适应分配并加权组合可学习码本原语来表示每个视觉 token，以兼顾图像细节重建与语义对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一视觉理解与生成需要同时保留语义信息和细粒度图像细节。现有连续分词器偏重语义对齐而可能丢失重建细节，离散分词器受码本量化信息损失影响；传统多码本设计对所有 token 分配相同数量码字，忽略局部内容差异。

Method: PrimiTok 将码字视为可复用视觉原语，对每个 token 自适应分配和加权组合。其包含 Diverse Quantitative Primitives（DQP）以增强子码本质心多样性、减少冗余，以及 Dynamic Primitive Allocator（DPA）根据 token 复杂度选择原语。嵌入量化误差用于监督各子码本选取原语数量，DPA 以输入相关权重聚合原语。训练采用联合重建与图像—文本对比学习。

Result: 实验表明，PrimiTok 在重建和语义对齐上优于当前最优基线，并在多模态理解与视觉生成任务上取得进一步验证效果。

Conclusion: 通过自适应分配与组合码本原语，PrimiTok 能更有效地保留视觉保真度并实现语义对齐，为统一视觉理解与生成提供了一种有前景的视觉表示方案。

Abstract: Unifying visual understanding and generation requires representations that preserve both semantic information and fine-grained image details. Continuous tokenizers trained primarily for semantic alignment may omit fine-grained reconstruction details, whereas discrete tokenizers face information loss from codebook quantization. Conventional multi-codebook designs assign every token the same number of codewords regardless of local content. We instead view codewords as reusable visual primitives whose allocation and composition adapt to each token. We introduce PrimiTok, a compositional visual tokenizer that represents each visual token through adaptive allocation and weighted composition of learned codebook primitives. PrimiTok integrates two complementary components: Diverse Quantitative Primitives (DQP), which encourages diversity among sub-codebook centroids to reduce redundancy, and a Dynamic Primitive Allocator (DPA), which selects primitives according to token complexity. Embedding quantization error supervises how many primitives are selected from each sub-codebook, and DPA aggregates them with input-dependent weights. Joint reconstruction and image--text contrastive learning encourage the resulting representations to retain visual fidelity and semantic alignment. Experiments demonstrate improved reconstruction and semantic alignment over SOTA baselines, with further evaluations on multimodal understanding and visual generation.

</details>


### [374] [RadioWorld: Transferring World Models to Radio-Frequency Radiance Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29282)
*Hu Zhou,Jiazhou Zhou,Shuowen Zhang,Ying-Chang Liang,Liang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 RadioWorld，一种无需参考射频测量、可直接从三维场景几何和收发机位置合成射频辐射场的通用框架，并构建了大规模城市射频基准 UrbanRF-Bench。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经射频场方法主要依赖逐场景优化，难以泛化到未见场景；推理时需目标场景中的昂贵参考射频测量；且在参考测量范围外推时性能显著下降，限制了 6G 通信与感知应用。

Method: RadioWorld 将世界模型适配到射频辐射场合成，采用双流 Mixture-of-Transformers 架构：Scene-Understanding Transformer 编码三维场景几何与收发机位置，提取环境感知的全局电磁传播特征；Field-Generation Transformer 结合局部查询条件并关注这些特征，生成射频辐射场。同时构建 UrbanRF-Bench，覆盖 657 个城市场景、32,850 个射频辐射场和 7 个全球城市的大规模射线追踪基准。

Result: 实验表明 RadioWorld 显著优于专用基线方法，并能在未见城市中的任意位置准确合成射频场，且推理时无需参考射频测量。

Conclusion: RadioWorld 通过几何与收发机位置驱动的通用射频场合成，克服了现有方法泛化差、依赖参考测量和外推退化等问题，为 6G 通信与感知提供了可扩展的射频辐射场建模方案。

Abstract: Electromagnetic (EM) wave propagation in the physical world constitutes a Radio-Frequency (RF) radiance field, providing rich information for 6G communication and sensing. However, existing neural RF field methods suffer from three fundamental limitations: (1) they predominantly rely on per-scene optimization and cannot generalize to unseen scenes; (2) they require costly reference RF measurements in each target scene; and (3) they degrade severely when extrapolating beyond the vicinity of reference measurements. To overcome these limitations, we present RadioWorld, a general framework that adapts a world model to synthesize RF radiance fields directly from physical scene geometry and transceiver locations, without requiring any reference RF measurements at inference. Specifically, RadioWorld couples two specialized modules within a dual-stream Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture: a Scene-Understanding Transformer that encodes 3D scene geometry and transceiver locations to extract environment-aware global EM propagation features, and a Field-Generation Transformer that attends to these features to synthesize the RF radiance field with the local query conditions. We also establish UrbanRF-Bench, a large-scale ray-traced benchmark spanning 657 urban scenes and 32,850 RF radiance fields across seven global cities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RadioWorld significantly outperforms specialized baselines and accurately synthesizes RF fields at arbitrary locations in unseen cities. Code, datasets, and checkpoints will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [375] [Robust Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Models via Simulating Brain Functional Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29288)
*Manyi Li,Yufan Liu,Bing Li,Xia Wu,Ziyu Li,Weiming Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出初始潜变量优化攻击 IVO，可通过优化生成起点重新激活已擦除概念；进而提出 CeFlune，通过功能定位并更新概念相关单元神经元，实现更稳健的概念擦除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到图像模型中的概念擦除仍可被攻击重新激活。已有攻击多搜索文本或图像输入空间，较少探索初始潜空间，导致擦除鲁棒性评估存在盲点。

Method: 提出 IVO：优化初始潜变量以改变图像生成起点，从而重新激活被擦除概念。提出 CeFlune：借鉴大脑功能定位，将线性模块定义为 Unit Neurons，通过比较任务态与静息态响应轨迹定位概念相关单元，并更新这些单元以约束其响应和模型预测。

Result: 在 8 种擦除方法上，IVO 比基线攻击更有效地重新激活被擦除概念。CeFlune 在 U-Net 扩散模型和 flow-matching transformer 架构上，与多达 15 种基线方法相比，在概念擦除和通用图像生成能力之间取得较好平衡；在 IVO 及其他 4 种攻击下，概念重新激活率更低。

Conclusion: 初始潜空间是被忽视的概念擦除攻击面，IVO 揭示了现有擦除方法的鲁棒性不足；基于功能定位的 CeFlune 能提升概念擦除的鲁棒性并保持生成能力。

Abstract: Concept erasure in text-to-image models aims to prevent a target concept from appearing in generated images while preserving general image generation capability. However, erased concepts can still be reactivated by attacks. Prior attacks mainly search text or image input spaces, leaving the initial latent space underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce IVO (Initial latent Variable Optimization), a new concept reactivation attack that changes the starting point of image generation by optimizing the initial latent. Comprehensive experiments across 8 erasure methods show that IVO reactivates erased concepts more effectively than the attack baselines, revealing a blind spot in erasure robustness evaluation. This motivates us to localize model components associated with the target concept and then treat them as intervention sites for more robust concept erasure. We propose CeFlune (Concept Erasure via Functional Localization of Unit Neurons), which adapts brain functional localization to text-to-image models. CeFlune defines linear modules as Unit Neurons and localizes concept-responsive ones by comparing their response trajectories in the model's task and resting states. It then updates the localized Unit Neurons to constrain their responses and the erased model's predictions. Across U-Net diffusion and flow-matching transformer architectures, CeFlune achieves a favorable balance between concept erasure and general image generation capability in comparisons with up to 15 baseline methods. Under IVO and 4 other evaluated attacks, CeFlune also shows lower concept reactivation.

</details>


### [376] [GALILEO: Geometric RoPE with Galilean Key Transport for Dynamic Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29293)
*Youngmin Kim,Seonghyun Jin,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出一种基于伽利略变换的动态场景位置编码对齐方法：在位置编码前，将每个 key 的 3D 位置按其估计速度和时差传输到 query 时刻，从而让注意力机制感知运动物体在查询时刻的正确位置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有几何感知旋转位置编码（如 RayRoPE）隐含假设场景静态，会按观测时刻的位置编码每个 key。对于时间上分离的动态场景输入视图，同一运动物体在不同帧中位置不同，导致渲染位置不准确。时间编码只能告诉注意力 token 何时被观测，不能解决其内容在 query 时刻应处于何处的问题。

Method: 提出通过伽利略传输将位置编码与动态场景几何对齐。在位置编码之前，利用估计速度和时差把每个 key 的 3D 位置传输到 query 时间；仅修改 key 位置，因此可直接集成 RayRoPE、URoPE 等现有编码而不改变其公式。速度可来自任意来源，默认从网络内 token 对应关系中估计。

Result: 集成到 LVSM 后，在 Syn4D、动态 Objaverse 和真实 Stereo4D 视频上提升动态视图合成效果。消融显示将速度作为 token 特征编码收益较小；注意力可视化表明方法会关注运动内容的 query 时刻位置，而 RayRoPE 不会。此外，方法还能降低预训练 3D 点跟踪器在动态物体上的跟踪误差，并改善视频生成器中的运动车辆生成。

Conclusion: 该方法简单通用，通过仅调整 key 位置即可将位置编码对齐到动态场景几何，并能作为插件与现有几何感知位置编码结合，在动态视图合成、3D 跟踪和视频生成等任务中带来改进。

Abstract: Geometry-aware rotary positional encodings, such as RayRoPE, help attention reason about the 3D spatial relationships between tokens and the query camera. However, they implicitly assume a static scene, encoding each key at its observed position regardless of when it was captured. For dynamic scenes with temporally separated input views, this mismatch places the same moving object at a different position in each input frame, so it can be rendered at an inaccurate position. While temporal encodings inform attention when a token was observed, they do not resolve where its content should be at the query time. We introduce a simple and general approach that aligns positional encodings with dynamic scene geometry through Galilean transport. Before positional encoding, each key's 3D position is transported to the query time using its estimated velocity and the temporal offset. By modifying only key positions, our method integrates directly with existing encodings, including RayRoPE and URoPE, without altering their formulations. Velocities can be obtained from arbitrary sources. By default, we estimate them from token correspondences within the network. Integrated into LVSM, our method improves dynamic view synthesis on Syn4D, dynamic Objaverse, and real-world Stereo4D videos over baselines. Ablations show that encoding velocities as token features yields smaller gains, while attention visualizations reveal that our method attends to query-time locations of moving content, unlike RayRoPE. Beyond view synthesis, our method also reduces tracking errors on dynamic objects in a pretrained 3D point tracker and improves moving-vehicle generation in a video generator.

</details>


### [377] [CT-Navigator: Towards Interpretable and Generalizable CT Understanding through Agentic Perception and Tool-Invocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29305)
*Yibing Fu,Huidong Xie,Yihao Niu,Wei Ji,Heming Dong,Ziyue Wang,Jingyu Chen,Jun Zhao,Haoyuan Hu,Hongming Shan,Lai Jiang,Mai Xu,Yueming Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出CT-Navigator框架，利用通用多模态大模型的2D视觉与智能体能力，通过分层视觉探索和放射学工具调用实现可追踪的CT解读，并在新基准CTNavi-Bench上取得79.50%准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D医学多模态大模型通常将专用3D视觉编码器连接到语言模型，未充分利用通用MLLM的原生2D视觉和智能体能力；且基于大规模单跳CT指令数据训练，迭代推理和视觉证据 grounding 能力有限，难以支持可追踪的CT解读。

Method: 受放射科医生工作流启发，提出agentic perception范式与CT-Navigator框架，利用通用MLLM的2D视觉和智能体能力进行分层视觉探索与放射学工具调用；构建8,904条视觉思维链轨迹用于冷启动智能体监督微调，并在33,219个问题上通过强化学习优化策略，采用数据选择和动态rollout采样；同时提出CTNavi-Bench基准。

Result: CT-Navigator在CTNavi-Bench上达到79.50%准确率，比最强基线高17.59%，并在三个外部CT基准上表现出较强泛化能力。

Conclusion: CT-Navigator表明基于通用MLLM的智能体感知与可追踪视觉证据探索能有效提升3D CT视觉问答和可解释CT解读性能，相关代码、模型和基准将开源。

Abstract: Clinical computed tomography (CT) interpretation inherently requires progressive visual exploration, where radiologists navigate from whole scans to individual slices and regions of interest and interact with external tools when necessary. However, existing 3D medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) typically connect a specialized 3D visual encoder to a language model, without fully leveraging the native 2D visual and agentic capabilities of generalist MLLMs. Trained on large-scale one-hop CT instruction-following data, these models also have limited ability to perform iterative reasoning and explicitly ground their conclusions in visual evidence, limiting their support for traceable CT interpretation. To solve these problems, we propose \textbf{agentic perception} as an alternative paradigm inspired by radiologists' interpretation workflows. We introduce \textbf{CT-Navigator}, a framework that harnesses generalist MLLMs' 2D visual and agentic capabilities to progressively ground CT interpretation in explicit, traceable visual evidence through hierarchical visual exploration and radiology tool invocation. To build these capabilities, we curate 8,904 visual chain-of-thought (V-CoT) trajectories for cold-start agentic supervised fine-tuning. We then optimize the policy through reinforcement learning on 33,219 questions, with data selection and dynamic rollout sampling prioritizing informative learning signals. Finally, we introduce CTNavi-Bench, a 3D CT visual question answering benchmark comprising 7,000 questions spanning anatomical regions throughout the human body. CT-Navigator achieves 79.50\% accuracy on CTNavi-Bench, surpassing the strongest baseline by 17.59\%, and demonstrates strong generalization across three external CT benchmarks. The code, model, and benchmark will be released on \href{https://github.com/fyb99/ct_navigator}{GitHub}.

</details>


### [378] [RSWP: Robust SO(3)-Equivariant Watermarking for Panoramic Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29468)
*Pengzhen Chen,Yanwei Liu,Xiaoyan Gu,Jinxia Liu,Siwei Ma,Weiping Wang,Wu Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出RSWP全景图像水印框架，基于二十面体群理论解决球面信号与平面表示之间的拓扑失配问题，实现对连续SO(3)旋转和视口变换的鲁棒水印。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全景图像水印受球面与平面表示拓扑失配影响；传统方法在SO(3)视角旋转下因非线性几何畸变而失效，且视口提取通常需要计算昂贵的逆映射。

Method: 利用二十面体群I60作为SO(3)最大离散子群，将球面旋转分解为局部平面旋转与面片排列；提出解耦架构将水印嵌入离散面片，并设计等变性到不变性解码范式，包括等变特征提取器和排列不变排序模块，实现从部分2D渲染中直接盲提取水印而无需几何校准。

Result: 实验表明RSWP在连续SO(3)旋转和视口变换下达到最先进鲁棒性，同时保持高视觉保真度。

Conclusion: RSWP为全景图像提供了一种理论保证且实用的鲁棒水印方案，可有效应对球面旋转和视口提取挑战。

Abstract: Robust watermarking for panoramic imagery is impeded by the topological mismatch between spherical signals and planar representations. Conventional methods fail under $SO(3)$ viewing rotations due to non-linear geometric warping and struggle with viewport extraction, which typically necessitates computationally expensive inverse remapping. To address these challenges, we propose RSWP, a watermarking framework grounded in icosahedral group theory. Leveraging the property that the icosahedral group ($\mathcal{I}_{60}$) serves as the largest discrete subgroup of $SO(3)$, we decompose spherical rotations into tractable local planar rotations and combinatorial facet permutations. Accordingly, we introduce a decoupling architecture that embeds watermarks into discrete facets and a theoretically guaranteed Equivariance-to-Invariance decoding paradigm. By employing an equivariant feature extractor followed by a permutation-invariant sorting module, this paradigm rigorously synchronizes rotation-distorted features. Moreover, the dual-extractor design inherently supports direct, blind watermark retrieval from partial 2D renderings without geometric calibration. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RSWP achieves state-of-the-art robustness against continuous $SO(3)$ rotations and viewport transformations while preserving high visual fidelity.

</details>


### [379] [Prompt-Consistent Cross-View Object Geo-Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29312)
*Lingyun Xing,Wenning Hao,Kai Jiang,Dawei Jin,Xiaohan Zhang,Xiaoxiong Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究跨视角目标地理定位（CVOGL）中的提示不遵循与过拟合问题，提出多目标数据集 CVOGL-MO、跨视角同场景多目标对比损失 CVMCL，以及提示敏感性评测协议，以提升模型对点击提示的跟随能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 CVOGL 方法存在提示不遵循的过拟合问题：当点击点移动或移除时，预测几乎不变，说明模型依赖虚假特征关联而非真正理解提示语义。作者将其归因于基准数据规模有限（每个任务仅 4,343 个提示-目标对），导致模型记忆场景对应目标而非学习提示到目标的真实对应关系。

Method: 提出两个即插即用组件：1）构建 CVOGL-MO 数据集，通过多样化多目标标注扩展训练集和测试集，缓解导致捷径学习的记忆问题；2）提出跨视角同场景多目标对比损失 CVMCL，迫使同一场景内不同点击点具有区分性特征表示，从而让模型遵循提示指令。此外设计带预测偏移指标的提示敏感性评测协议，首次定量测量 CVOGL 的提示跟随能力。

Result: 在三个代表性骨干网络上的实验表明，所提组件在新多目标测试集上显著提升提示跟随准确率，并明显提高提示敏感性；两个组件均与架构无关，可在不修改现有方法结构的情况下集成。

Conclusion: CVOGL 中的提示不遵循问题主要源于数据规模有限导致的记忆和捷径学习。通过扩展多目标数据与引入同场景多目标对比损失，可有效增强模型对点击提示的响应与跟随能力，并提供可量化评估提示敏感性的协议。

Abstract: Cross-view object geo-localization (CVOGL) aims to locate an object indicated by a click point in a ground or drone query image within a satellite reference image. Through a quantitative prompt-sensitivity evaluation, we find that existing CVOGL methods suffer from a prompt-disobeying overfitting problem: when the click point is moved or removed, their predictions barely respond, indicating that the models rely on spurious feature correlations rather than genuinely following the prompt semantics. We trace this behavior to the limited scale of the benchmark dataset, which contains only 4,343 prompt-object pairs per task, so that the models simply memorize the object associated with each scene instead of learning the true prompt-to-object correspondence. To address this, we propose two plug-and-play components. First, we construct the CVOGL-MO dataset by expanding the existing training and test sets with diverse multi-object annotations, mitigating the memorization that induces shortcut learning. Second, we propose the Cross-View Co-Scene Multi-Object Contrastive Loss (CVMCL), which enforces distinct feature representations for different click points within the same scene, compelling the model to follow prompt instructions. We further design a prompt-sensitivity evaluation protocol with prediction-shift metrics, providing the first quantitative measurement of prompt-following capability for CVOGL. Both components are architecture-agnostic and can be integrated into existing methods without any architectural modification. Experiments on three representative backbones show that our components substantially improve prompt-following accuracy on the new multi-object test sets and markedly increase prompt sensitivity. Our dataset and code will be publicly released at https://github.com/Sunny-Fresher/CVOGL-MO.

</details>


### [380] [Where Does Personalization Reside in Photo Editing? Evidence from One Photographer's Lightroom History](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29307)
*Dongwu Qian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文基于一位专业摄影师41个目录、3193张编辑照片的纵向私有数据，研究可解释的Lightroom调整预测，比较绝对目标、相对先验目标、图像条件预测器以及利用目标批次少量编辑的估计器，发现简单闭式收缩估计最有效且可审计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化照片编辑系统需要同时推断摄影师的长期偏好和单次拍摄意图，但现有评估很少将这两类信号分开；作者希望在批次级留出协议下检验不同建模方式的实际收益，并寻找只需少量同批次编辑即可适配的实用方法。

Method: 使用批次级holdout，比较绝对目标与相对先验目标、图像条件预测器、接收目标批次少量编辑的估计器；采用闭式收缩/经验贝叶斯利用4、8、16个同批次锚点，并与仅先验基线、学习式锚点条件头和门控机制对比；还用383张原生Lightroom导出做渲染空间Delta E00检查，并在附录将动作空间从6个全局控制扩展到13个。

Result: 残差预测提升验证误差，但在留出批次上的优势很小且不显著（曝光MAE 0.592 vs 0.582 EV，批次聚类bootstrap）。批次共享协议下，闭式收缩在k=4/8/16时达到0.466/0.457/0.453 EV，优于仅先验的0.586–0.592 EV，且配对下降显著；学习式锚点条件头未优于闭式估计，额外门控收益很小。渲染空间检查复现排序：k=8时在线EB相对先验降低Delta E00 0.41（p=0.042），真实参数降低0.78（p=0.034）。附录中同批次中位数look可降低渲染色度，但逐照片残差头仍无法迁移。

Conclusion: 推荐使用闭式、可审计的估计器，仅需少量同批次编辑即可适配摄影师当前拍摄意图；研究限于单一摄影师，且不声称滑块准确度等同于审美偏好。

Abstract: Personalized photo-editing systems must infer both a photographer's recurring preferences and the intent of a particular shoot, yet these signals are rarely evaluated separately. We study interpretable Lightroom adjustments in a longitudinal, private dataset of 3,193 edited photographs from 41 catalogs by one professional photographer, with holdouts formed at the batch level. We compare absolute and prior-relative targets, image-conditioned predictors, and estimators that receive a small set of edits from the target batch. Residual prediction improves validation error, but its advantage on held-out batches is small and not significant under a batch-clustered bootstrap (0.592 vs 0.582 EV exposure MAE). In a batch-shared protocol, closed-form shrinkage using 4, 8, or 16 same-batch anchors reaches 0.466, 0.457, or 0.453 EV with the best estimator at each k, compared with 0.586-0.592 EV for the prior-only baseline; the paired reductions are significant under a batch-clustered bootstrap. Learned anchor-conditioned heads do not improve on this closed-form estimator, and a negative-trained prior already yields a low cold-image false-edit rate, leaving little benefit for an additional gate. The recommended estimator is closed-form and auditable, and it requires only a handful of same-batch edits. A render-space check against 383 native Lightroom exports reproduces the ranking: at k=8, online EB lowers Delta E00 against the prior by 0.41 (p=0.042), and the photographer's true parameters lower it by 0.78 (p=0.034). An appendix extends the action space from six to thirteen global controls: a same-batch median look lowers rendered chroma toward the export, while a per-photograph residual head again fails to transfer. The study is limited to one photographer and does not claim that slider accuracy measures aesthetic preference.

</details>


### [381] [SKIA: Spatial-Knowledge Informed Attention for Robust Remote Photoplethysmography under Lower-Face Motion Artifacts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29330)
*Van-Truong Le,Viet-Tham Huynh,Minh-Triet Tran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种轻量级、基于掩码引导的rPPG框架SKIA，通过抑制面部下区域运动干扰，提升从视频中重建生理信号的鲁棒性。在UBFC-rPPG上，SKIA-Net达到0.7522的波形Pearson相关性和3.73 bpm的心率MAE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 远程光电容积描记（rPPG）可从面部视频进行非接触生理监测，但面部运动（尤其是认知与交流任务中的嘴部和下颌运动）会严重降低信号重建质量。

Method: 首先在经典CHROM流程中研究静态下脸抑制；进而提出SKIA-Net，一种紧凑的时空架构，融合原始面部帧、静态掩码表示和时间运动差分来重建血容量脉冲（BVP）波形；并进行消融研究比较静态掩码与动态光流掩码。

Result: 静态掩码将波形Pearson相关从0.3507提升至0.4166（p<0.001），心率MAE从33.50降至23.44 bpm；完整SKIA-Net在UBFC-rPPG上达到Pearson相关0.7522、心率MAE 3.73 bpm，优于单流变体；消融表明静态掩码提供互补信息，且静态解剖先验优于测试的动态光流掩码策略。

Conclusion: 空间信息引导、时间稳定的掩码可改善运动鲁棒的rPPG估计。

Abstract: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables contactless physiological monitoring from facial videos, but facial motion, particularly mouth and jaw movements during cognitive and communicative tasks, can severely degrade signal reconstruction. We present SKIA, a lightweight, mask-guided framework that suppresses motion-prone lower-face regions while preserving physiological cues from the forehead and cheeks. Using the UBFC-rPPG benchmark, we first investigate static lower-face suppression in the classical CHROM pipeline. Static masking improves waveform Pearson correlation from 0.3507 to 0.4166 (p < 0.001) and reduces heart-rate mean absolute error (MAE) from 33.50 to 23.44 bpm. Building on this finding, we introduce SKIA-Net, a compact spatiotemporal architecture that combines raw facial frames, statically masked representations, and temporal motion differences to reconstruct blood volume pulse (BVP) waveforms. The full model achieves a Pearson correlation of 0.7522 and a heart-rate MAE of 3.73 bpm on UBFC-rPPG, outperforming single-stream variants.
