Ablation studies show that the static mask provides complementary information to raw appearance and that static anatomical priors outperform the tested dynamic optical-flow-based masking strategy. These results suggest that spatially informed, temporally stable masking can improve motion-robust rPPG estimation. Code: https://github.com/lee-vtruong/SKIA-rPPG

</details>


### [382] [SCRA-CLIP: Spherical-Contextual Representation Adaptation for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29545)
*Peng Chen,Chao Huang,Wenqiang Wang,Mingbo Yang,Yannan Chen,Yunkang Cao,Wei Wang,Li Shen,Fangjun Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 SCRA-CLIP，一种用于零样本细粒度异常检测的球面-上下文表征适配框架，联合增强异常感知文本语义与上下文敏感视觉表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型虽支持零样本异常检测，但对多样化异常模式及其空间上下文建模不足，导致细粒度异常检测仍具挑战。

Method: 提出球面原型条件提示（SPCP），利用 von Mises-Fisher 混合模型建模正常/异常 patch 特征的方向分布，并将状态相关原型引入文本上下文；同时设计上下文偏差引导视觉适配（CGVA），捕获相对多尺度邻域上下文的局部特征偏差，并通过自适应门控细化 patch 表征。

Result: 在 11 个工业与医学基准上取得大量实验验证，表明 SCRA-CLIP 在多样未见类别和领域上具有有效性与泛化能力。

Conclusion: 将分布感知语义建模与上下文敏感视觉适配相结合，可提升跨模态匹配的判别性，从而促进细粒度异常检测与定位。

Abstract: Recent advances in vision-language models have facilitated zero-shot anomaly detection (ZSAD) through transferable visual-semantic representations. However, detecting fine-grained anomalies remains challenging due to inadequate modeling of diverse anomaly patterns and their spatial context. To address these challenges, we propose SCRA-CLIP, a Spherical-Contextual Representation Adaptation framework that jointly enhances anomaly-aware textual semantics and context-sensitive visual representations. Specifically, we introduce Spherical Prototype-Conditioned Prompting (SPCP), which employs von Mises--Fisher mixtures to model the directional distributions of normal and abnormal patch features. These state-specific prototypes are incorporated into textual contexts to guide the learning of more discriminative textual representations. Furthermore, we develop Context-Deviation Guided Visual Adaptation (CGVA), which captures local feature deviations relative to multi-scale neighborhood contexts and refines patch representations through adaptive gating. By integrating distribution-aware semantic modeling with context-sensitive visual adaptation, SCRA-CLIP facilitates more discriminative cross-modal matching for fine-grained anomaly detection and localization. Extensive experiments on 11 industrial and medical benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization capability of SCRA-CLIP across diverse unseen categories and domains. The code will be publicly available upon publication.

</details>


### [383] [MIMORPHEUS: Rethinking Cross-Modal Supervision for Human Pose Estimation from Radar Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29341)
*Shizhao Zhang,Yanyan Zhang,Deshui Yu,Jun Pan,Guangyou Fang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 MIMORPHEUS 框架，利用条件扩散模型从 3D 人体姿态生成 MIMO 雷达回波，以缓解雷达-姿态配对数据稀缺问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 穿墙 MIMO 雷达人体姿态估计依赖成对雷达与姿态数据，但采集成本高；视觉姿态数据集虽大却缺少对应雷达回波；物理仿真又依赖专家建模且存在仿真-真实域差距。

Method: 采用 MIMO-VAE 按通道和快时间采样结构压缩雷达回波，SkeleCoder 通过对比学习将姿态特征与回波特征对齐；以姿态特征引导扩散模型在 MIMO-VAE 隐空间生成回波潜变量，再由 VAE 解码器重建雷达回波。

Result: 在数据增强实验中，该方法使四种雷达姿态估计器的 MPJPE 降低 6.8%-11.2%；在三个公开姿态数据集上的迁移实验表明，视觉姿态标注可为雷达训练提供有用数据。

Conclusion: MIMORPHEUS 能根据姿态生成雷达回波，用于雷达数据增强和跨模态迁移，有效缓解雷达-姿态配对数据不足问题。

Abstract: Deep learning has shown promise for estimating human pose with multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) radar through walls. Building paired radar and pose datasets demands considerable time and manual effort, while large visual pose datasets provide no corresponding radar echoes. Physical simulation can supply synthetic signals, but requires expertise in scattering models and can leave a gap between simulated and real data. To address this challenge, we introduce MIMORPHEUS, a framework that generates radar echoes from 3D human poses through conditional diffusion. To prepare echo and pose representations, MIMO-VAE compresses the echoes according to their channel and fast time sample structure, while SkeleCoder learns pose features through contrastive alignment with echo features. These pose features then guide diffusion in the MIMO-VAE latent space, and the VAE decoder reconstructs echoes from the generated latents. Once trained, the generator augments radar data by producing different echoes for a recorded pose and supplies the radar modality for pose annotations in existing visual datasets. In data augmentation experiments, our method reduces MPJPE by 6.8%-11.2% across four radar pose estimators. Transfer experiments with three public pose datasets also show that visual pose annotations can supply useful radar training data. Code will be made publicly available on GitHub.

</details>


### [384] [Seeing vs. Knowing: Counterfactual Supervision and Correction for 3D-Aware Object Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29542)
*Jian Zahng,Zhijun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出反事实状态监督与对称反事实校正，用于照片中物体的旋转、平移和缩放等空间编辑，无需修改架构或增加推理步骤。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D重建资产可为目标姿态提供显式几何指导，但其不完美纹理会与照片冲突；标准配对训练未明确教编辑器在未见内容与可见外观之间该信任哪个来源。

Method: 构建受控的照片—3D状态冲突：隐藏面重绘、利用隐藏几何重渲染阴影和反射、替换可见面纹理；并引入对称反事实校正，利用状态侧和照片侧孪生构造面向条件不一致目标的定向潜变量扰动，并训练向当前条件指定目标恢复。

Result: 在OBJect和SpatialEdit-Bench上取得较强的空间编辑性能和内容保持效果；受控消融表明源选择能力提升，且采样过程中对条件保持持续响应。

Conclusion: 这些训练期策略能有效提升空间编辑中的源选择与内容保持，且无需架构改动或额外推理步骤。

Abstract: Rotating, translating, or rescaling an object in a photograph requires revealing unseen surfaces, preserving visible appearance, and updating shadows and reflections. Reconstructed 3D assets, rendered at the target pose as a 3D state, provide explicit geometric guidance, but their imperfect textures may conflict with the photograph, while standard paired training does not explicitly teach the editor which source to trust. To address this, we propose counterfactual state supervision, which constructs controlled photo--state conflicts through hidden-surface repainting, hidden geometry with re-rendered shadows and reflections, and visible-surface texture replacement. This teaches the editor to follow the 3D state for unseen content while preserving photograph-visible appearance. However, learning this distinction does not ensure that it is maintained during sampling. We therefore introduce symmetric counterfactual correction, which uses state-side and photo-side twins, which share the photograph and the state respectively, to construct directed latent perturbations toward condition-inconsistent targets and train recovery toward the target specified by the current condition. Both strategies operate only during training, requiring no architectural changes or additional inference steps. Experiments on OBJect and SpatialEdit-Bench demonstrate strong spatial editing performance and content preservation, while controlled ablations show improved source selection and sustained responsiveness to conditioning during sampling.

</details>


### [385] [Probe Before You Learn: Allocating Prompts from Initial Gradients under Label Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29336)
*Jiazhe Zhang,Zibin Geng,Qiang Ma,Xuefeng Jiang,Yijun Lin,Jingyi Wang,Yu Yan,Xingzhou Zhang,Min Liu,Yuwei Wang,Sheng Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 GPrompt，一种无需训练即可为提示学习分配文本提示与视觉提示参数预算的方法，以提升噪声标签下的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有鲁棒提示学习主要抑制噪声监督下的不可靠更新，但忽略了文本提示与视觉提示之间的参数预算分配对鲁棒性的重要影响；且最优分配因任务而异，穷举训练候选配置成本过高。

Method: GPrompt 在提示优化前仅利用初始化阶段的损失梯度进行分配。它使用少量图像和生成的伪标签作为共享监督，执行初始化探针以提取成对的文本与视觉损失梯度，并通过迹归一化 Gram 矩阵的模态内集中度和模态间重叠度刻画梯度几何，进而推导闭式分配，并在精确参数预算下投影到可行提示数量。

Result: 在十一个数据集上，GPrompt 相比最强基线最高提升 7.75%，所选配置接近穷举训练得到的最优分配；梯度探针的平均运行时间比穷举候选训练低 99.9%。

Conclusion: 提示分配是提升噪声标签下提示学习鲁棒性的关键因素；GPrompt 能以无需训练、低成本的方式实现任务特定的文本与视觉提示预算分配。

Abstract: Prompt learning provides a parameter-efficient way to adapt pretrained vision--language models through text and visual prompts, but noisy labels prevalent in real-world data inevitably bias prompt updates and thereby undermine adaptation effectiveness. Prior work on robust prompt learning focuses on suppressing unreliable updates under noisy supervision. We uncover a pivotal yet overlooked aspect--prompt allocation: shifting the parameter budget between text and visual prompts can substantially enhance robustness while keeping the training objective and total budget fixed. However, suitable prompt allocations vary across tasks and are unknown a priori, rendering brute-force candidate training computationally prohibitive. We propose GPrompt, a training-free method that derives allocation between text and visual prompts using only loss gradients at initialization before prompt optimization. Using a small sample of images and generated pseudo-labels as shared supervision, GPrompt performs an initialization probe to extract paired text and visual loss gradients, and characterizes the geometry of their trace-normalized Gram matrices through both concentration within each modality and overlap between modalities. GPrompt then derives a closed-form allocation, and projects it onto feasible prompt counts under the exact parameter budget, enabling task-specific selection without training candidate configurations. Experiments across eleven datasets show that GPrompt outperforms the strongest baseline by up to 7.75% while selecting configurations close to the best allocation identified through exhaustive training. The average runtime of gradient probe across datasets is 99.9% lower than that of exhaustive candidate training.

</details>


### [386] [A Multi-Criteria Evaluation of Color Normalization Methods in Histopathology: Nuclei Preservation, Artifact Sensitivity, Background Fidelity, and Downstream Performanc](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29348)
*Falah Jabar,Aria Torkpour,Pasquale Lombardi,Masoud Tafavvoghi,Per Niklas Benzler Waaler,Sigve Andersen,Ilona Urbarova,David J. Pinato,Mehrdad Rakaee,Tom Donnem,Lill-Tove Rasmussen Busund,Elin Richardsen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文系统评估了11种颜色归一化方法在7个细胞核数据集上的表现，并分析7种输入颜色空间对细胞核检测与分类的影响，同时发布WSI-QCN工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习细胞核检测与分类模型在不同医学中心间泛化较差，主要受染色和扫描差异影响；颜色归一化虽被用于缓解该问题，但其对核结构、背景保留、伪影敏感性及下游性能的影响缺乏系统评估。

Method: 构建基准测试流程，在7个公开和私有细胞核数据集上比较11种经典与深度学习归一化方法，并研究7种输入颜色空间的影响；同时提出并公开WSI-QCN全切片图像质量评估与颜色归一化流程。

Result: 不同归一化方法对核结构、背景和伪影敏感性的影响不同；检测与分类性能在数据集间的差异大于归一化方法间差异，输入颜色空间影响有限。没有单一方法在所有指标上最优，图像级指标不能可靠预测下游性能。

Conclusion: 需要面向细胞核和结构感知的归一化方法；作者发布WSI-QCN以支持稳健的全切片图像质量评估和颜色归一化。

Abstract: Deep learning models for nuclei detection and classification may generalize poorly across medical centers because of variations in staining and scanning. Although color normalization aims to reduce these variations, its effects on nuclear structure, background preservation, artifact sensitivity, and nuclei detection and classification performance have not been systematically evaluated. We present a procedure to benchmark 11 classical and deep learning normalization methods using 7 public and private nuclei datasets. Additionally, we investigate the effect of 7 input color spaces. The normalization methods differed in their effects on nuclear structure, background, and sensitivity to artifacts. However, detection and classification performance varied more across datasets than across normalization methods, and the input color space had limited influence. No single method performed best on all criteria, and image-level metrics did not reliably predict downstream performance, highlighting the need for nuclei- and structure-aware normalization methods. To support this work, we introduce WSI Quality Control and Normalization (WSI-QCN), a publicly available pipeline for robust whole-slide image quality assessment and color normalization; the source code is available on GitHub.

</details>


### [387] [Separating Action Allocation from Image Matching in Visual Token Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29477)
*Chenxi Wang,Bin Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文分析自适应视觉token路由器在ChartQA和TextVQA上的收益来源，区分逐图匹配带来的提升与任务级高分辨率动作频率带来的提升，并比较任务表、离散路由器和CARES连续分辨率选择器的效果与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应视觉token路由器平均分更高，可能来自对单张图像更优的分辨率选择，也可能只是更频繁地在需要高分辨率的任务上使用高分辨率；需要区分二者，并评估任务级动作频率和请求延迟的影响。

Method: 在每个任务内固定动作次数，将路由器的动作-图像配对与相同动作和图像的随机配对进行比较；在等权重的ChartQA和TextVQA上评估Qwen2.5-VL-3B和7B；比较离散路由器、任务表以及外部选择器CARES选择的连续分辨率；在带任务标签请求下比较任务表与离散路由器的得分和延迟。

Result: 7B模型上，匹配带来1.71分增益，但相对于任务表的动作频率造成3.95分损失；交换CARES选择的连续分辨率也会降低7B质量。请求带任务标签时，任务表比离散路由器高1.92分，并在完整7B请求上平均节省31.76 ms。

Conclusion: 自适应路由的平均收益更多来自任务级动作频率而非逐图匹配；任务表在带任务标签时优于离散路由器，并能提升质量与效率，说明任务感知的分辨率分配比复杂逐图路由更有效。

Abstract: Adaptive visual token routers aim to save computation while preserving the image detail needed to answer each question. A higher average score could reflect better choices for individual images or more frequent use of high resolution on tasks that need it. We distinguish the two by keeping action counts fixed within each task and comparing the router's assignments with random pairings of the same actions and images. On equally weighted ChartQA and TextVQA, both Qwen2.5-VL-3B and -7B gain from matching but lose more from their action frequencies relative to a task table, with a 1.71-point gain and a 3.95-point loss on 7B. Exchanging the continuous resolutions chosen by the external selector CARES also lowers quality on 7B. When requests arrive with task labels, the table outscores the discrete router by 1.92 points and saves 31.76 ms per complete 7B request on average.

</details>


### [388] [Ref2Light: From One Image to Interactive Glasses-Free 3D Characters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29678)
*Hanzhong Zhang,Haoyang Wang,Siyang Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Ref2Light，一种前馈框架，可将单张 A-pose 角色插画与连续姿态/表情控制映射为光场显示器原生动画，无需逐角色三维重建、绑定或测试时优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在光场显示器上动画化角色插画需要一致的双目视差、实时姿态关节控制和细粒度表情控制，同时还要支持快速角色切换；现有 2D 动画和 3D 重建流程难以同时满足这些需求。

Method: 将光场合成分解为静态身份、视角相关视差和控制驱动关节运动。共享编码器为每个角色缓存多尺度身份特征以支持快速切换；条件解码器通过反向纹理传输和直接颜色合成生成有序角度锚点；全局-局部控制方案用头身控制变形锚点，并利用更新后的对应场跨视角跟踪面部区域进行掩码局部表情细化；最后通过校准的可微子像素交织转换为原生面板栅格，实现无需全分辨率渲染所有视角的端到端原生监督。

Result: 在留出的 VRoid 身份上，Ref2Light 相比 2D 和 3D 基线将头身 LPIPS 降低 20.1%-55.6%；相比单体解码，将闭嘴任务中的非目标变化 MAE 降低 95.6%-96.5%；在消费级 GPU 上以 34.0-40.1 FPS 运行 1440x2560 原生栅格。

Conclusion: Ref2Light 能够以真实感动画方式生成显示原生光场角色动画，支持快速角色切换、连续姿态与细粒度表情控制，并达到实时性能。

Abstract: Animating character illustrations on light-field displays demands coherent binocular parallax, real-time pose articulation, and fine-grained expression control. However, existing 2D animation and 3D reconstruction pipelines cannot combine these with rapid character switching. We present Ref2Light, a feed-forward framework that maps a single A-pose illustration and continuous pose and expression controls to display-native light-field animation, without per-character 3D reconstruction, rigging, or test-time optimization. Our key insight is to decompose light-field synthesis into static identity, view-dependent parallax, and control-driven articulation. A shared encoder caches multi-scale identity features once per character for rapid switching. A conditional decoder then synthesizes ordered angular anchors from these features via backward texture transport and direct color synthesis. A global-local control scheme deforms the anchors with head-body controls and uses the updated correspondence fields to track facial regions across views for masked local facial refinement. Finally, calibrated differentiable subpixel interlacing converts the anchors into the native panel raster, enabling end-to-end native supervision without rendering all views at full resolution. On held-out VRoid identities, Ref2Light reduces head-body LPIPS by 20.1%-55.6% over 2D and 3D baselines and lowers non-target change MAE in mouth closure by 95.6%-96.5% versus monolithic decoding, while running at 34.0-40.1 FPS for 1440x2560 native rasters on a consumer GPU. Code and demo are in the Supplementary Material.

</details>


### [389] [HandiVid: A High-Quality Dataset for Hand-Driven Interactive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29693)
*Chaoyang Zhang,Shaohao Rui,Xiaofeng Mao,Yuanxun Xu,Haoyuan Xia,Xiaohong Liu,Qinghe Du,Weijie Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 HandiVid，一个面向手部驱动第一视角交互视频生成的高质量数据集，包含20万条经筛选和标注的第一视角手物交互视频片段，并通过下游视频生成实验验证其数据多样性与标注质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有第一视角视频数据集难以同时提供场景多样性、有意义的手物交互和可靠的运动标注，限制了手部驱动交互视频生成研究。

Method: 构建统一数据处理流程，整合公开数据集、在线视频和合成视频；通过视频质量评估、手部检测过滤和基于视觉语言模型的多阶段交互验证筛选高质量片段；将 SAM 3 集成到手部检测流程以减少漏检并提升3D手部标注完整性；为每个片段提供手部渲染、相机轨迹和交互描述。

Result: 构建了包含20万条精选并标注的第一视角交互视频片段的数据集 HandiVid；全面数据集分析和下游视频生成实验表明，其在数据多样性、标注质量和可控视频生成方面有效。

Conclusion: HandiVid 能够缓解现有第一视角交互视频数据集的不足，为手部驱动、可控的第一视角交互视频生成提供高质量数据支撑。

Abstract: Hand-driven egocentric interactive video generation aims to generate dynamic scenes with realistic interaction responses conditioned on hand movements and camera motion. However, existing egocentric video datasets struggle to provide scene diversity, meaningful hand-object interactions, and reliable motion annotations simultaneously. To address these limitations, we introduce HandiVid, a high-quality dataset comprising 200K curated and annotated egocentric interaction video clips for hand-driven interactive video generation. We develop a unified data processing pipeline that integrates public datasets, online videos and synthetic videos. Through video quality assessment, hand detection filtering, and multi-stage interaction validation using vision-language models (VLMs), we select high-quality video clips with meaningful hand-object interactions. Since 3D hand reconstruction relies on initial hand detections, we integrate SAM 3 into the hand detection pipeline to reduce missed detections and improve the completeness of 3D hand annotations. Each video clip is provided with high-quality hand renderings, camera trajectories, and interaction descriptions. Comprehensive dataset analysis and downstream video generation experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of HandiVid in terms of data diversity, annotation quality, and controllable video generation.

</details>


### [390] [Polytropos: What Do Vision-Language Model Descriptions Make of a Cultural Object?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29355)
*Yuechen Jiang,Enze Zhang,Yuyan Wang,Mohsinul Kabir,Chenying Lin,Sijia Li,Qianqian Xie,Stavroula Golfomitsou,Konstantinos Arvanitis,Sophia Ananiadou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 Polytropos 基准，通过将文化物品的文本描述重建为图像并与原照片比较，衡量描述保留了多少具体对象信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型正成为文化物品的描述者，而描述常把具体事物归为文化类型；描述丢失的信息反映了描述者的缺失，因此需要衡量模型描述对具体文化对象的保真度。

Method: 构建 Polytropos 基准，使用大都会艺术博物馆和盖蒂的 374 件物品，收集 5 个模型的 1,870 条描述及策展人撰写的 230 条描述；将每条描述还原为图像，再与原照片比较，评估其是否被识别为所记录文化及是否为特定对象。

Result: 重建图像被识别为所记录文化的比例高于原照片，为 54.55% 至 59.09%，原照片为 52.14%；但 16% 至 21% 的物品结果发生变化，仅 0.49% 的重建图像被识别为具体对象。模型与策展人丢失记录文化的比率相近，但模型增加文化典型性的倾向更强。

Conclusion: 模型描述倾向于赋予每个对象多种文化典型面貌，却几乎不保留对象自身；描述更多体现文化类型而非具体物品。

Abstract: Vision-language models have become a new kind of describer, writing about almost anything people see, and their descriptions now shape how cultures are known by people and by other models. Descriptions of cultures tend to turn particular things into types, and what a description loses shows what its describer lacks. We introduce Polytropos, a benchmark that measures what model descriptions of cultural objects keep of the particular object by turning each description back into an image and comparing it with the original photograph. On 374 objects from the Metropolitan Museum of Art and the Getty, with 1,870 descriptions from five models and 230 written by curators, reconstructions are recognised as the recorded culture more often than the photographs, at 54.55% to 59.09% against 52.14%, yet 16% to 21% of objects change outcome and only 0.49% of reconstructions are identified as the specific object. On the same objects, models lose recorded cultures at a rate similar to curators but gain more. Model descriptions give each object many faces, each typical of its culture and almost none the object itself.

</details>


### [391] [A Cascaded Framework with a Cross-Attention-Guided Mamba-CNN Model for Pre- and Post-Treatment Glioma Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29792)
*Siavash Taremi,Mahmoud Heidari,Seyed Mohammad Hossein Hashemi,Mohsen Hooshmand*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种级联框架下的交叉注意力引导 Mamba-CNN 模型 CMC-Seg，用于治疗前和治疗后弥漫性胶质瘤分割，在保证较低计算成本的同时取得了较高分割精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 胶质瘤人工分割耗时、主观且一致性差；CNN 擅长局部特征但难以建模长程依赖，Vision Transformer 能捕捉全局上下文但计算复杂度高；同时，治疗后伴切除腔的胶质瘤分割研究较少。

Method: 基于 BraTS 2025 弥漫性胶质瘤 mpMRI 数据，预处理后先用粗分割模型提取肿瘤中心 patch，再输入 CMC-Seg 进行细粒度分割；CMC-Seg 结合 Mamba 与 CNN，并引入交叉注意力和多方向扫描；与 3D U-Net、SegResNet、SwinUNETR、UNETR、nnFormer、SegMamba 对比，并进行消融和 Grad-CAM 可解释性实验。

Result: CMC-Seg 在测试集上取得最高平均 Dice（81.20%）和 NETC Dice（77.09%），切除腔 Dice 为 78.63%，HD95 最低为 4.39 mm；结果与 CNN 和 Mamba 基线相当，并显著优于 Transformer 基线（P < 0.05）；推理 GFLOPs 最低（381.49）。消融实验表明多方向扫描和交叉注意力提升性能，尤其对切除腔分割显著（P < 0.05）；Grad-CAM 显示模型关注诊断相关肿瘤区域。

Conclusion: CMC-Seg 在治疗前和治疗后弥漫性胶质瘤分割中实现了精度与计算成本的较好平衡，尤其改善了切除腔分割，并具有良好的可解释性。

Abstract: Accurate glioma segmentation is vital for diagnosis and follow-up, but manual segmentation is time-consuming, subjective, and variable across interpreters. Gliomas are heterogeneous in size, shape, and location. Deep learning has therefore emerged as a potential solution. CNNs excel at local features but may struggle with long-range dependencies, whereas Vision Transformers capture global context efficiently but incur higher computational complexity. Most previous studies focused on pre-treatment gliomas; post-treatment cases with resection cavities (RCs) remain less explored. This study proposes a Cross-Attention-Guided Mamba-CNN (CMC-Seg) model within a cascaded framework for pre- and post-treatment diffuse glioma segmentation, aiming to balance accuracy and computational cost. Experiments used BraTS 2025 mpMRI of diffuse glioma patients. After preprocessing, a coarse segmentation model extracted tumor-centered patches, which were fed to CMC-Seg for fine-grained segmentation. CMC-Seg was compared with 3D U-Net, SegResNet, SwinUNETR, UNETR, nnFormer, and SegMamba. On the test set, CMC-Seg achieved the highest mean Dice (81.20%) and non-enhancing tumor core (NETC) Dice (77.09%). It also achieved an RC Dice of 78.63% and the lowest 95% Hausdorff distance (HD95; 4.39 mm). Results were comparable to CNN and Mamba baselines and significantly better than Transformer-based baselines (P < 0.05). CMC-Seg required the fewest inference GFLOPs (381.49). Ablation experiments indicated that multi-direction scanning and cross-attention improved performance, particularly for RC (P < 0.05). Grad-CAM explainability experiments showed that CMC-Seg focuses on diagnostically relevant tumor regions.

</details>


### [392] [SpectralGS: Spectral Gaussian Splatting for Unsupervised Spectral Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29388)
*Qiaoying Qu,Bin Pan,Chen Jia,Haiyang Xu,Xia Xu,Zhenwei Shi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 SpectralGS，一种用于无监督光谱超分辨的光谱高斯泼溅框架，通过共享光谱高斯表示与基于光谱响应函数的投影渲染，从 RGB 图像重建高光谱信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无配对高光谱数据的无监督光谱超分辨中，RGB 观测所包含的光谱信息有限，难以学习有效的空间-光谱表示，因此需要将结构化光谱建模与传感器成像过程结合。

Method: 提出 SpectralGS，包含两个部分：共享光谱高斯表示模块利用共享光谱和局部空间高斯基元构建连续空间-光谱表示，并利用高光谱图像的低秩光谱结构；光谱响应投影渲染模块利用光谱响应函数 SRF 对连续表示进行积分投影并混合生成 RGB 图像，以渲染 RGB 与观测 RGB 的一致性作为训练监督。

Result: 大量实验表明，该方法优于当前最先进的方法。

Conclusion: 研究表明，将结构化连续空间-光谱表示与基于成像响应的渲染相结合的高斯泼溅框架，可实现无监督光谱重建。

Abstract: Unsupervised spectral super-resolution aims to recover spectral information from RGB images without paired hyperspectral data. However, the limited spectral information in RGB observations makes learning an effective spatial-spectral representation challenging, requiring the incorporation of structured spectral modeling with sensor imaging. In this paper, we propose SpectralGS, a spectral Gaussian splatting framework comprising two components: Shared Spectral Gaussian Representation and Spectral Response Projection Rendering. The representation module constructs a continuous spatial-spectral representation via shared spectral and local spatial Gaussian primitives, exploiting the low-rank spectral structure of hyperspectral images. The rendering module utilizes the spectral response function (SRF) to apply integral projection to the continuous representation, blending it to generate an RGB image. Consistency between the rendered and observed RGB images provides training supervision. Our main contribution is a Gaussian splatting framework that integrates structured continuous spatial-spectral representation with imaging response-based rendering, enabling unsupervised spectral reconstruction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms current state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [393] [S1Arena-MM: Which Multimodal Decisions Can Be Left to System 1?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29773)
*Lang Lin,Tianyu Chen,Yi Gu,Yang Zhao,Xinran Song,Xinyang Liu,Jianpeng Cheng,Mingyuan Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出多模态决策基准 S1Arena-MM，系统比较 System-1 模型与多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在图像、视频、音频静态决策及闭环游戏中的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 感知系统常需做离散决策，但尚不清楚 System-1 模型能处理哪些多模态决策，以及 MLLM 在哪些场景更优，因此需要统一基准进行比较。

Method: 构建 S1Arena-MM，包含 51,060 个问题、94 个任务，覆盖图像、视频、音频，并含 102 个闭环游戏环境；给模型相同决策请求并评分其返回概率，评估 33 个开源模型（12 个 System-1、21 个 MLLM），还测试思考 token 与实时游戏延迟影响。

Result: 静态决策中，最佳 System-1 在图像上领先最佳 MLLM 4.9 个百分点，在视频和音频上差距在 1 个百分点内；决策后训练主要改善概率质量，视频上 12 对中有 10 对 Brier 分数更低；增加最多 2,048 个思考 token 仅让最强 MLLM 略超最佳 System-1，且多数 MLLM 的 Brier 分数变差；闭环游戏中，基于 27B MLLM 的三个 System-1 模型在 BALROG 达到 22.0%-33.3% 进展，其他模型关闭思考时不超过 9.7%；实时 GameWorld 中每次决策最高 1.1 秒延迟未对 System-1 造成可测进展损失。

Conclusion: System-1 模型在静态多模态决策上具竞争力，尤其图像任务和概率校准方面优势明显；闭环实时决策中优势更突出，而 MLLM 的显式思考并未稳定带来更好决策质量。

Abstract: Perception systems often make discrete decisions: flag a hateful meme, predict whether a pedestrian will cross, detect a spoofed voice, or select the next move in a game. System-1 models, such as OneJev and Jev-Omni, read the media and return probabilities over the options in a single forward pass, while multimodal large language models (MLLMs) generate text. Which multimodal decisions can System-1 models handle, and where do MLLMs perform better? We introduce S1Arena-MM, a benchmark that gives every model the same decision requests and scores the probabilities it returns. It contains 51,060 questions across 94 tasks with image, video, and audio input, drawn from 94 public datasets and three program-generated ones. It also includes 102 closed-loop game environments that a model plays from screenshots; in real-time mode, the game continues while the model decides. We evaluate 33 open models: 12 System-1 models and 21 MLLMs read at the answer token. On static decisions, the best System-1 model leads the best MLLM by 4.9 percentage points on images and is within one point of it on video and audio. Post-training for decisions mainly improves the probabilities: on video, a System-1 model has a lower Brier score than the MLLM that it is post-trained from in 10 of 12 pairs. With up to 2,048 thought tokens per question, the most accurate MLLMs pass the best System-1 models only slightly, and thinking raises the Brier score of most MLLMs. Closed loops separate the models: three System-1 models built on a 27B MLLM reach 22.0-33.3% progression in BALROG, and no other model exceeds 9.7% with thinking off. In real-time GameWorld, latencies of up to 1.1 s per decision cause no measurable loss of progress for System-1 models. Code and data: https://github.com/zhaoyang02/S1Arena-MM.

</details>


### [394] [Data-Quality-Aware Fundus Classification with Anatomy-Guided Glaucoma Assessment and Cross-Dataset Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29834)
*Imdadul Haque Sourav,Marjana Jannat Miti,Md. Jehadul Islam Mony*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究评估九类眼底分类器在数据审计、冻结模型外部验证和解剖引导专家融合下的可靠性，发现解剖引导融合可提升跨队列迁移且不损内部精度，但阈值迁移较差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习眼底分类器内部表现好，但重复图像、标签不一致、采集差异和阈值迁移差可能削弱其可靠性，因此需要超越内部准确率进行评估。

Method: 训练ConvNeXt-Small、EfficientNetV2-Small、DenseNet169九类模型，各用三个随机种子；审计5318张图像去除重复和跨标签冲突，保留4370张；构建解剖引导青光眼专家，使用视盘中心裁剪、血管及视盘/视杯分割图和杯盘比特征；在RFMiD、JSIEC上做冻结模型外部评估，并在REFUGE预设比较后于ORIGA、G1020和PAPILA复现。

Result: ConvNeXt-Small内部准确率0.910、macro-F1 0.917、AUC 0.982，视盘和视杯Dice为0.966和0.915；解剖引导融合相对等权软投票内部准确率几乎不变（-0.001），但RFMiD外部闭集准确率平均提高4.9个百分点，JSIEC提高2.3；REFUGE平衡准确率提高7.4个百分点（95% CI 5.1至9.5），ORIGA提高2.1，G1020和PAPILA也有正向收益；阈值迁移差，REFUGE灵敏度0.950但特异度0.411。

Conclusion: 视网膜分类器应通过数据质量审计、解剖信息建模和多队列评估来判断；解剖引导融合可在不牺牲内部性能的情况下改善迁移，但收益因队列而异且阈值不能可靠迁移，因此仅凭内部指标不足以证明可靠性。

Abstract: Background: Deep learning fundus classifiers often perform well internally, but duplicated images, inconsistent labels, acquisition differences and poor threshold transfer can undermine their reliability. We assess nine-class classifiers beyond internal accuracy, using a data audit, frozen-model external evaluation and an anatomy-guided specialist. Methods: Nine-class experts (ConvNeXt-Small, EfficientNetV2-Small, DenseNet169) were trained with three seeds. Auditing 5,318 images for exact duplicates and cross-label conflicts removed 464 conflict groups (942 images) and six same-label copies, leaving 4,370 images. An anatomy-guided glaucoma specialist read disc-centred crops with vessel and disc/cup segmentation maps, plus cup-to-disc features. Frozen models were evaluated on RFMiD and JSIEC, and a prespecified comparison on REFUGE was replicated on ORIGA, G1020 and PAPILA. Results: ConvNeXt-Small reached an internal accuracy of 0.910, macro-F1 of 0.917 and AUC of 0.982; disc and cup Dice scores were 0.966 and 0.915. Across seeds, the fixed anatomy-guided mix left internal accuracy unchanged relative to equal soft voting (-0.001) but raised mean external closed-set accuracy by 4.9 percentage points on RFMiD (positive in two of three seeds) and 2.3 on JSIEC. On REFUGE (800 photographs) it improved balanced accuracy by 7.4 percentage points (95% CI 5.1 to 9.5), and by 2.1 on ORIGA, with positive gains on G1020 and PAPILA. Thresholds transferred poorly (REFUGE sensitivity 0.950, specificity 0.411). Conclusions: Retinal classifiers should be judged by data-quality auditing, anatomy-informed modelling and multi-cohort evaluation. Anatomy-guided fusion improved transfer at no internal cost, but gains varied by cohort and thresholds did not transfer, so internal metrics alone do not establish reliable performance.

</details>


### [395] [Beyond Attention Maps: Understanding and Improving Medical MLLMs via Visual Values](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29361)
*Yichen Zhao,Fenghe Tang,Wenxin Ma,Rongsheng Wang,Zihao Wan,Shaohua Kevin Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文通过配对非增强与增强医学图像构建医学VQA数据集，发现MLLM的视觉感知不仅取决于空间注意力，还关键依赖视觉value中检索到的内容；据此提出VIVID方法，利用增强图像的视觉value指导从增强到非增强图像的on-policy蒸馏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM研究多将空间注意力图视为有效视觉感知的主要关键，隐含假设模型只要关注正确视觉区域即可。作者希望检验这一假设是否完整。

Method: 构建包含配对非增强（NC）和增强（CE）图像的医学VQA数据集；分析MLLM在配对图像上的注意力模式，并进行双向干预实验比较注意力权重与视觉value对预测的影响；提出VIVID（VIsual Value Intervention Distillation），利用增强视觉value识别并精炼与有用视觉证据一致的教师纠正，以改进从CE到NC图像的on-policy蒸馏。

Result: MLLM在NC与CE配对图像上常表现出相似注意力模式却给出不同答案；对视觉value的干预比注意力权重干预引起更大的预测变化。VIVID在六个内部和外部测试集上持续优于现有on-policy蒸馏方法，适用于不同模型规模和架构，推理时仅需NC图像，并在通用域VQA基准上保持较强零样本性能。

Conclusion: 仅靠空间注意力不足以解释和提升MLLM视觉感知，通过视觉value检索到的视觉内容是关键因素；VIVID验证了利用增强视觉value指导蒸馏可有效提升医学VQA表现，并具备实际部署优势。

Abstract: Current MLLM methods largely focus on whether models attend to the right visual regions, implicitly treating spatial attention map as the primary key of effective visual perception. To examine this assumption, we introduce a medical VQA dataset with paired non-contrast (NC) and contrast-enhanced (CE) images that share corresponding anatomy while providing different cues. We show that this view is incomplete: across paired NC and CE medical images, MLLMs often exhibit similar attention patterns despite producing contrasting answers, while controlled bidirectional interventions induce substantially larger prediction changes on visual values than attention weights. These results identify the visual content retrieved through values as a critical factor in improving perception beyond spatial attention alone. Guided by this finding, we propose VIVID (VIsual Value Intervention Distillation), which uses enhanced visual values to identify and refine teacher corrections aligned with useful visual evidence to improve on-policy distillation from CE to NC images. Across six internal and external test sets, VIVID consistently outperforms existing on-policy distillation methods across different model scales and architectures, requires only NC images at inference, and maintains strong zero-shot performance on general-domain VQA benchmarks. The project page is available at https://qiuzyc.github.io/VIVID.

</details>


### [396] [LexiDet-OVD: Benchmarking Lexical Sensitivity in Open-Vocabulary Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29851)
*Amit Thakur,Mukesh Singhal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 LexiDet-OVD 基准与指标套件，系统研究开放词汇目标检测中的词汇敏感性，即用户提示词变化对检测性能的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放词汇检测评估通常只使用固定类别名，忽视了自由文本提示描述方式不同所导致的失败模式，因此需要评估提示分布下的鲁棒性。

Method: 构建 LexiDet-OVD 基准，将提示集划分为等价、条件式和宽泛语义范围；在固定 COCO 和 LVIS 样本上评估四类检测器，每类30个类别，含800张COCO留出图像和1000张LVIS图像；除均值和最差提示AP50外，还报告P10、20% CVaR、留一提示影响、检测一致性、框一致性和置信度方差，并使用一对一多实例匹配。

Result: 等价提示的最佳到最差差距在COCO1000上为5.3至23.4点，在LVIS1000-30c上为5.1至29.9点，说明高平均精度与词汇稳定性是不同属性；比较最大分数选择、加权框融合、Prompt Consensus和探索性融合规则后发现聚合可恢复部分性能，但没有方法在所有模型-数据集组合上占优；Detic/SHiNe对比表明语义层级增强本身不能消除词汇敏感性。

Conclusion: 开放词汇目标检测应除常规精度外，同时报告提示分布鲁棒性，以更全面反映检测器在真实用户描述下的可靠性。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary object detectors localize objects from free-form text prompts, but their reliability depends on how users describe the target. Standard evaluations usually test a fixed class name, leaving prompt-induced failure modes underexplored. We introduce LexiDet-OVD, a benchmark and metric suite for studying lexical sensitivity in open-vocabulary object detection. We organize prompt sets into equivalent, conditional, and broad semantic scopes, and evaluate four detector families on fixed COCO and LVIS samples, each covering 30 classes (800 held-out COCO images and 1,000 LVIS images). Beyond mean and worst-prompt AP50, we report P10, CVaR at 20%, leave-one-prompt-out influence, detection agreement, box consistency, and confidence variance using one-to-one multi-instance matching. Equivalent-prompt best-to-worst gaps range from 5.3 to 23.4 points on COCO1000 and from 5.1 to 29.9 points on LVIS1000-30c, showing that strong average accuracy and lexical stability are distinct properties. We compare maximum-score selection, weighted-box fusion, Prompt Consensus, and an exploratory fusion rule. Aggregation recovers performance in several settings, but no method dominates all model-dataset pairs. A controlled Detic/SHiNe comparison further shows that semantic hierarchy enrichment does not by itself eliminate lexical sensitivity. These results support reporting prompt-distribution robustness alongside conventional open-vocabulary detection accuracy.

</details>


### [397] [ClothCast: Generative Cloth World Modeling under Partial Observability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29369)
*Yushen Hu,Yilong Song,Zhen Zhou,Apurv Kushwaha,Harshvardhan Chandirasekar,Zhu-Tian Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ClothCast 是一个用于机器人布料操作的世界模型：利用计划夹爪轨迹作为刚性运动先验，学习布料点集的残差形变，并发布包含遮挡层真值网格的 ClothCastBench 数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 布料形变复杂且自遮挡严重，导致基于世界模型的场景演化预测非常困难；但夹爪抓取的布料会随夹爪运动，因此计划夹爪轨迹可作为有用运动先验。

Method: 输入单帧 RGB-D、相机位姿、机器人模型和计划夹爪轨迹，无需布料网格或材质参数；将观测提升为包含假设遮挡层的分层点集，用基于夹爪位姿的混合刚性先验带动点集，并用视频扩散点流模型预测残差运动；将点渲染为深度，再由几何条件补全模型合成 RGB；释放后用手工 settling 步骤替代学习运动。

Result: 在 492 个留出 episodes 上，ClothCast 的序列平均可见表面 Chamfer 距离为 14.0 mm，比最强几何基线 Flex-π 的 35.6 mm 低 2.5 倍；布料区域 PSNR 比 Cosmos-Predict2.5 高 3.7 dB。50 episode 消融中，仅刚性先验配合学习初始几何和相同后处理已优于两个几何基线，学习残差进一步将误差降低约三分之一。

Conclusion: ClothCast 通过刚性先验加学习残差有效预测布料操作中的场景演化，并提供了带真值网格和遮挡层的大规模双机械臂布料操作基准 ClothCastBench。

Abstract: World models support robotic manipulation by predicting how the scene evolves under a planned action. For garments this prediction is notoriously difficult: deformations are complex, and self-occlusion leaves much of the cloth unobserved. Planned gripper trajectories provide a useful motion prior because cloth held by a gripper moves with it, while the remaining deformation must be predicted. We introduce ClothCast, a world model that applies this prior to the cloth's points and learns the residual motion. ClothCast takes one RGB-D observation, the camera pose, the robot's own model and the planned gripper trajectories, with no cloth mesh or material parameters. It lifts the observation to a layered point set that includes hypothesized occluded layers, carries the points with a blended rigid prior derived from the gripper poses, and predicts the residual motion with a video-diffusion point-flow model. Over entire 4- to 11-second episodes at 10 Hz, the moved points are rendered into depth, from which a geometry-conditioned completion model synthesizes RGB; after release, a hand-designed settling step replaces the learned motion. We further release ClothCastBench, 10,000 simulated dual-arm cloth-manipulation episodes with the ground-truth cloth mesh, including occluded layers, at every frame. On 492 held-out episodes, ClothCast achieves 2.5x lower sequence-averaged visible-surface Chamfer distance than Flex-π, the strongest baseline in geometry (14.0 mm vs. 35.6 mm), and 3.7 dB higher cloth-region PSNR than Cosmos-Predict2.5, the strongest baseline in cloth PSNR. On a 50-episode ablation subset, the rigid prior alone, applied to ClothCast's learned initial geometry with the same post-processing, already outperforms both geometry-capable baselines, and the learned residual lowers its error by about a third.

</details>


### [398] [Antiphony: A Dual-Process Agent for Deepfake Video Detection with Real-Video Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29999)
*Xinyu Yan,Yurong Hao,Zherui Li,Yebo Wu,Tiantong Wu,Jiaming Zhang,Zihao Zeng,Zheng Lin,Zijie Wang,Pengpeng Qiao,Yang Cao,Wei Yang Bryan Lim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 Antiphony 框架，用于提升视频深度伪造检测在未见生成器上的泛化能力，并降低真实视频误报；该方法结合四个视觉专家的校准融合与对阈值附近样本的选择性多模态调查。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度伪造检测器在生成器分布偏移下容易产生过度自信错误，影响基于置信度的融合可靠性；同时真实拍摄域变化和缺乏未来生成器样本使阈值校准困难。

Method: Antiphony 使用真实视频作为共享参考进行分数融合和阈值校准，无需目标深度伪造样本即可更新阈值；在专家融合阶段提供有限样本误报控制；对接近校准阈值的视频，使用工具调用的多模态调查器进行复核并给出额外融合分数，并用生成器留出预测和反事实专家输出训练调查器。

Result: 在六个基准协议上，Antiphony 平均基准得分为 88.3%，分别比最强 MLLM 和传统检测器基线高 14.7 和 11.5 分；平均比 ARGUS 高 20.2 分，并在 FaceVid 的 20 个未见生成器上平衡准确率高 3.6 分。

Conclusion: Antiphony 通过校准专家融合与选择性调查，在未见生成器泛化和真实视频误报控制方面表现更可靠，优于现有强基线。

Abstract: Reliable video deepfake detection requires generalization to unseen generators while limiting false alarms on authentic footage. Although existing detectors capture diverse visual cues, they may produce overconfident errors under generator shift, limiting the reliability of confidence-based fusion. Threshold calibration is further complicated by shifts in authentic capture domains and the lack of future-generator examples. To address these challenges, we present Antiphony, a framework that combines calibrated fusion of four visual experts with selective investigation. Authentic videos serve as a shared reference for score fusion and threshold calibration, enabling threshold updates without target deepfakes. For this expert-fusion stage, we establish finite-sample false-alarm control when the scoring procedure is fixed independently of calibration and authentic samples are exchangeable. To refine decisions near the calibrated threshold, a tool-using multimodal investigator examines these videos and contributes an additional fusion score. We train the investigator on generator-held-out predictions and counterfactual expert outputs, to improve robustness to unreliable expert evidence. Across six benchmark protocols, Antiphony achieves a mean benchmark score of 88.3%, exceeding the strongest evaluated MLLM and conventional detector baselines by 14.7 and 11.5 points, respectively. It also outperforms ARGUS by 20.2 points on average and by 3.6 balanced-accuracy points on FaceVid's 20 unseen generators.

</details>


### [399] [PINE: Point, Instance and Normal Estimation in One-Step Diffusion Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29389)
*Zeyu Ren,Jie Ni,Rui Qian,Jiahao Wei,Hao Tang,Yongtai Liu,Zeyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PINE 是一个一步式 Omni Diffusion Transformer，可在一次前向传播中同时预测图像的点图、表面法线和实例图，统一了几何与语义理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解场景需要几何和语义，但现有模型通常通过独立网络或多次前向传播分别获取二者，效率较低且缺乏统一建模。

Method: PINE 将每个输出图视为 token 流，并用流掩码控制不同流之间的交互；采用相机感知的射线编码按相机射线而非像素定位 token；在注意力 logits 中加入预训练 DINOv3 特征的亲和度作为 grounding attention；几何训练仅使用 139K 合成图像。

Result: PINE 在给定或不给定内参时均取得最先进的点图结果，并在表面法线上取得最佳平均排名；在大物体上超过 SAM，且训练图像不足其 1%；预测三张图的速度比 MoGe-3 加 SAM 快 5.7 倍。

Conclusion: PINE 通过单步统一扩散 Transformer 高效联合预测几何与语义图，在精度和速度上均表现优异，说明统一建模场景几何与实例语义是可行且高效的。

Abstract: Understanding a scene requires both geometry and semantics: geometry recovers its spatial structure, and semantics separates it into objects. Current models obtain the two from separate networks or separate passes. We present PINE, a one-step Omni Diffusion Transformer that predicts the point map, the surface normals, and the instance map of an image in one forward pass. PINE treats each map as a token stream, and a stream mask decides which streams interact. A camera-aware ray encoding positions every token by its camera ray rather than its pixel. Grounding attention adds the affinity of pretrained DINOv3 features to the attention logits. Trained on only 139K synthetic images for geometry, PINE achieves state-of-the-art point maps whether or not intrinsics are given and the best average rank on surface normals. It also exceeds SAM on large objects with less than 1 percent of its training images, and it predicts all three maps 5.7x faster than MoGe-3 with SAM.

</details>


### [400] [AgroVG+: Generalized Visual Grounding in Agriculture with Region-Supervised Action Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29396)
*Haocheng Li,Juepeng Zheng,Guilong Xiao,Kaiqi Du,Gengmeng Pu,Haohuan Fu,Jianxi Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出农业领域广义视觉定位数据集 AgroVG+ 和框架 ReSAG，用于根据自然语言描述定位所有匹配目标，并识别无匹配目标的情况。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 农业场景中的广义视觉定位需要同时处理单目标、多目标以及目标缺失情况，现有方法对此支持不足。

Method: 构建由农业专家编写和审核指代表达的 AgroVG+ 数据集，包含 7,404 张图像、10,081 条查询，覆盖六类农业场景；提出 ReSAG 框架，将区域证据监督与显式框生成和终止决策结合，在答案生成前计算共享空间证据分布并对每个目标等权监督，采用 BOX/END 协议决定继续生成框或终止，坐标使用原词表生成，区域与序列目标联合训练共享语言解码器。

Result: 在 AgroVG+ 上，ReSAG 在单目标和多目标精确集合准确率上优于仅坐标微调，并在消融中取得高于任一单独组件的总体准确率。

Conclusion: ReSAG 能有效提升农业广义视觉定位中多目标定位与无目标识别能力。

Abstract: Generalized visual grounding in agriculture requires localizing all objects that match a natural-language description and recognizing when no matching target is present. We introduce AgroVG+, a dataset whose referring expressions are all written and reviewed by agricultural experts based on image content and corresponding target sets. The dataset comprises 7,404 images and 10,081 query records across six agricultural scene families, covering single-target, multi-target, and target-absent cases. We also propose ReSAG (Region-Supervised Action Generation), a framework that couples regional evidence supervision with explicit box-generation and termination decisions. ReSAG assigns each target an equally weighted supervision term on a shared spatial evidence distribution computed before answer generation. The BOX/END protocol exposes a choice between generating another box and terminating the response at box boundaries, while coordinates are generated using the original language vocabulary. Regional and sequence objectives jointly train a shared language decoder. On AgroVG+, ReSAG outperforms coordinate-only fine-tuning on single- and multi-target exact-set accuracy, and achieves higher aggregate accuracy than either component alone in ablations.

</details>


### [401] [MSBench: Benchmarking Script-Controlled Multi-Shot Text-to-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29417)
*Tao Huang,ZiHao Liang,Junhao Liu,Junzhe Li,Yuancheng Wei,Sifan Zuo,Beiming Yu,Taojin Liu,Zhuoyang Li,Bing Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 MSBench，一个用于可控文本驱动多镜头视频生成的基准，基于结构化 Scene-Entity-Shot 脚本，并从四个维度、11 个子指标评估 14 个商业与开源系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 T2V 模型可生成短片段，但多镜头生成需要控制剪辑时机、转场风格、镜头语言和跨镜头连续性；已有基准多评估单镜头，或只检查请求镜头是否出现，而不衡量何时切换及如何连接。

Method: 构建 MSBench，用结构化 Scene-Entity-Shot 迷你脚本指定每个镜头的时间跨度、相机状态、内容和出向转场；设计涵盖视觉质量、动态质量、语义对齐和跨镜头一致性的四维混合评估框架，共 11 个子指标；对 14 个商业和开源系统进行实验，并开展人工评估验证。

Result: 视觉质量难以区分各系统，而多镜头控制能力差异明显：许多模型主要按场景变化切换，且将请求的渐变转场渲染为硬切；MSBench 的系统排名与人类偏好达到 0.87 的 Spearman 相关性。

Conclusion: MSBench 能有效衡量文本驱动多镜头视频生成中的控制能力，揭示现有系统在转场与镜头时序控制方面的不足，并获得人工评估验证。

Abstract: Text-to-video (T2V) models can now generate visually plausible short clips, but multi-shot generation requires a different set of skills: composing multiple shots with intended cut timing, transition style, camera language, and cross-shot continuity. How far this multi-shot output can be controlled from text remains unmeasured: existing benchmarks either evaluate single shots or, when they provide shot-level scripts, typically check whether the requested shots appear but not when they change or how they are joined. We introduce MSBench, a benchmark for controllable text-driven multi-shot video generation built around structured Scene-Entity-Shot mini-scripts that specify each shot's time span, camera state, content, and outgoing transition. MSBench defines a four-dimensional hybrid evaluation framework spanning Visual Quality, Dynamic Quality, Semantic Alignment, and Cross-Shot Consistency with 11 sub-metrics. Experiments on 14 commercial and open-source systems show that visual quality does little to separate the systems, whereas multi-shot control does: many models cut mainly on scene changes and render requested gradual transitions as hard cuts. Human evaluations further validate MSBench, with its system ranking reaching a Spearman correlation of 0.87 with human preferences. The project page is available at https://totalhuang.github.io/MSBench-page/.

</details>


### [402] [Audio-Visual Rearrangement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30171)
*Ruohao Guo,Jiatong Ye,Chenwei Dong,Jinxing Zhou,Dantong Niu,Guangyao Li,Zhenbo Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出音频-视觉重排列（AVR）新任务：智能体根据语音请求找到合适物体并送达请求者或指定地点，并构建数据集与融合空间音频的视听大模型框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为使具身智能体能够理解口语请求、通过声音定位说话者并完成物体递送，推动具身智能与人机交互研究。

Method: 构建覆盖三类查询（明确目标、说话者相对空间指代、隐式用户意图）和八种子类型的AVR数据集；提出将运动感知空间音频模块集成到视听大语言模型中，编码并随智能体移动更新空间线索；通过多任务指令微调引入语音理解、空间音频感知和视觉 grounding 的辅助监督。

Result: 实验在可见与未见环境中建立了基线性能，为后续研究提供基础；代码将公开。

Conclusion: AVR任务、数据集和框架为具身智能与人机交互中的语音驱动物体递送研究奠定基础。

Abstract: We introduce Audio-Visual Rearrangement (AVR), a novel task in which an agent hears a spoken request, retrieves a suitable object, and delivers it to the requesting user or an instruction-specified destination. AVR requires the agent to understand the spoken request and acoustically localize the speaker for delivery. To support this task, we construct a dataset covering three query types: explicit target specification, speaker-relative spatial references, and implicit user intent, spanning eight subtypes with diverse object selection and delivery requirements. Moreover, we propose a framework that integrates a motion-aware spatial audio module into an audio-visual large language model to encode spatial cues from the spoken request and update them as the agent moves. We further incorporate auxiliary supervision for speech understanding, spatial audio perception, and visual grounding through multitask instruction tuning to improve action prediction. Experiments establish baseline performance in both seen and unseen environments, laying the groundwork for future research on embodied intelligence and human-robot interaction. The code will be publicly available soon.

</details>


### [403] [When "A or B" Is Less Likely than A: Coherent Probabilities for Vision Decision Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30096)
*Seongrae Noh,SeongEun Hong,HyeongYeop Kang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 视觉决策模型对图像多选题给出的各选项概率会受选项分组方式影响；合并选项“A或B”的概率平均比A与B之和低11.5个百分点。作者提出CORE，通过重新分组训练问题并让各分组答案对齐同一原始选项分布，以提升概率一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉决策模型直接使用每个选项的概率，但这些概率可能依赖选项如何分组。论文发现合并选项存在明显的欠可加性，且从0.85B到26B模型及微调后仍存在，因此需要一种训练方法来消除这种分组不一致。

Method: 提出CORE：对每个训练问题使用重新分组的选项版本，并将这些问题的答案都训练到同一个原始选项目标分布上，每个问题的分组概率由原始选项概率求和得到。

Result: 合并选项“A或B”平均比A与B概率之和低11.5个百分点。在来自七个基准的1,050个问题上，CORE将重分组问题答案与原始答案按相同分组求和之间的总变差距离从14.8降到5.8个百分点；0.85B模型上最佳同问题基线为9.4。五个模型规模上CORE均降低该距离且不降低准确率。

Conclusion: 视觉决策模型的选项概率存在分组欠可加性问题，CORE能有效提升重分组答案与原始分组求和答案的一致性，并在不同模型规模下保持准确率不下降。

Abstract: Vision decision models answer a multiple-choice question about an image with one probability per option, and software uses them directly. We show that the probabilities depend on how the options are grouped: a merged option "A or B" receives on average 11.5 points less probability than the sum of A and B. This under-additivity appears at every model size from 0.85B to 26B and remains after fine-tuning on labels. We propose CORE, which asks each training question with its options regrouped and trains the answers to all these questions toward one target distribution over the original options, summed into each question's groups. On 1,050 items from seven benchmarks, CORE reduces the total variation distance between the answer to a regrouped question and the original answer summed into the same groups from 14.8 to 5.8 points on the 0.85B model, against 9.4 for the best baseline trained on the same questions. At all five model sizes, CORE reduces this distance without lowering accuracy.

</details>


### [404] [Uncovering Separable and Composable Skill Mechanisms in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30290)
*Miaoyu Li,Boyang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 DISCO 多技能可解释性框架，用于在视觉语言模型中定位视觉推理技能的内部机制，并强调机制的可分离性与可组合性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型视觉推理技能定位方法大多忽略了机制识别与评估中的可分离性和可组合性，难以实现精确诊断、定向干预以及用少量机制解释更广泛能力。

Method: 提出 DISCO 框架：识别阶段使用 Separable Head Selection，根据注意力头在不同技能上的贡献选择技能特定头；评估阶段首次设计衡量所识别注意力头可分离性和可组合性的指标。

Result: 在三个视觉语言模型和四个基础视觉推理技能上实验，DISCO 获得最高可分离性，分别超过最强基线 24.80、18.38、13.75 分，并在三个模型上均取得最高可组合性。

Conclusion: 可分离性和可组合性应作为技能定位的重要标准；DISCO 能有效识别技能特定且可组合的内部机制，为视觉语言模型的多技能可解释性提供有效框架。

Abstract: Recent work has sought to localize the internal mechanisms underlying visual reasoning skills in vision-language models. These methods largely overlook separability and composability in both mechanism identification and evaluation. We propose separability and composability as two important desiderata for skill localization. Separability requires identified mechanisms to contribute primarily to their target skills while having limited effects on other skills, enabling precise diagnosis and targeted intervention. Composability requires skill mechanisms to be combinable to support complex tasks, allowing a small set of mechanisms to account for broader capabilities. In this work, we propose a multi-skill interpretability framework DISCO, built around these two properties. For identification, we propose Separable Head Selection, which selects skill-specific attention heads based on their contributions across skills. For evaluation, we are the first to design metrics for measuring separability and composability of identified heads. Extensive experiments on three VLMs and four fundamental visual reasoning skills demonstrate the effectiveness of DISCO. It achieves the highest separability, outperforming the strongest baseline by 24.80, 18.38, and 13.75 points across the three models, respectively, while also achieving the highest composability on all three models.

</details>


### [405] [PixelOne: From Options to Pixels in a Single Forward for GUI Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30235)
*Kanghui Tian,Shuai Dong,Yuhan Zhu,Congcong Wang,Ji Zhao,Tianxiang Jiang,Zhixiong Zhang,Shengyuan Ding,Yi Wang,Jiaqi Wang,Yu Qiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 PixelOne，将搜索教师模型的空间知识蒸馏给学生模型，使其能在原生分辨率截图上直接预测点击位置，实现高精度、低延迟的 GUI grounding。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GUI grounding 需要低延迟的精确点击。现有方法使用固定全局 bin 和局部细化，但截图下采样会丢失小控件定位所需细节，而固定 bin 在高分辨率下覆盖的像素范围较大，影响精度。

Method: PixelOne 从搜索教师向学生迁移空间知识。教师使用 VideoJEV 的文本选项打分器选择行和列并逐步放大候选区域；学生继承教师参数，通过空间蒸馏和框监督匹配教师在探索区域上的分布。推理时，同一决策头选择视觉 token，轻量像素头在该 token 内预测点击，全部在一次前向传播中完成；并使用点击对齐损失使目标框内像素得分高于框外。

Result: 在四个基准上，PixelOne-Pro-35B-A3B 达到 83.8% 平均准确率，在所评估的单次前向 grounder 中最高，平均每个目标延迟为 0.43 秒。

Conclusion: 结合原生分辨率输入、教师空间知识蒸馏和单次前向预测，PixelOne 能在 GUI grounding 中实现较高准确率与低延迟。

Abstract: GUI grounding requires precise clicks at low latency. Recent models such as GUI-Decisions and GUI-Swift predict coordinates in one forward pass using fixed global bins with local refinement. However, screenshot downsampling removes detail needed to locate small controls, while fixed bins cover larger pixel ranges at higher resolutions. We introduce PixelOne, which transfers spatial knowledge from a search teacher to a student that predicts clicks directly from screenshots at native resolution. The teacher uses VideoJEV's text-option scorer to select rows and columns and progressively zoom into candidate regions. The student inherits the teacher's parameters and matches its distributions over explored regions through spatial distillation alongside box supervision. At inference, the same decision head selects a visual token, and a lightweight pixel head predicts the click within it, all in one forward pass. A click-aligned loss encourages pixels inside the target box to score above those outside. Across four benchmarks, PixelOne-Pro-35B-A3B achieves 83.8% mean accuracy, the highest among the evaluated single-forward grounders, with a mean latency of 0.43 s per target.

</details>


### [406] [HorizonFlow: Few-Step Video Distillation in 600 Iterations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29431)
*Xianglong Guo,Haobo Xu,Zanyi Wang,Zhen Lei,Chang Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 HorizonFlow，一种改进的视频蒸馏方法，在保留 DMD 损失的基础上解耦运动与布局的校正，从而实现更快、更省训练数据的少步视频生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 DMD 的视频蒸馏方法虽然能加速生成，但常出现运动不自然和训练成本高的问题。作者认为根源在于 DMD 梯度同时优化外观、布局和运动，却未区分其学习动态：静态分量信噪比高、收敛快，运动分量噪声大且收敛慢，并且缺少对 VAE 分块运动分布和最终采样布局保持的约束。

Method: 提出 HorizonFlow，将运动校正与布局校正解耦：保留 DMD 损失，仅调整其回归目标，并在运动分量和正交布局分量中各加入一个仅训练时使用的校正。具体包括 Chunk Evenness，用于将每个潜变量分块的运动均匀分布到其帧上以缓解周期性卡顿；以及 Semantic Commitment，用于将粗粒度布局锚定到教师模型对学生最后一步的补全结果，防止物体合并和漂移。

Result: HorizonFlow 仅用 600 次迭代和 8.4k 训练样本，就将 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 蒸馏为 4 步模型，训练样本比先前工作少 4.6 至 304 倍。在 VBench 上，它优于所有已发布的少步 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 模型；同一方法迁移到 Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B 后，学生模型也优于 NVIDIA 的蒸馏模型。

Conclusion: HorizonFlow 通过解耦运动与布局的 DMD 梯度校正，有效解决了少步视频蒸馏中的运动质量差和训练昂贵问题，并在多个模型上验证了高效性和可迁移性。

Abstract: Distribution matching distillation (DMD) enables fast video generation by distilling a multi-step teacher into a few-step student. However, DMD-based methods often suffer from unnatural motion and costly training. We trace these limitations to the DMD gradient, which jointly optimizes appearance, layout, and motion without distinguishing their learning dynamics. Its static component, which carries appearance and layout, has a much higher signal-to-noise ratio than its motion component. As a result, per-frame quality converges within a few hundred iterations, whereas motion lags far behind. Beyond being noisy, the gradient also lacks two signals. (1) Video VAEs encode several frames into one latent frame (four in Wan2.1), and the gradient provides little guidance for spreading motion over these frames, causing periodic stutter. (2) DMD does not constrain the final sampling step to preserve the layout set by earlier steps, so objects merge and drift once the video moves. We propose HorizonFlow, which decouples the correction of motion from that of layout. It keeps the DMD loss and only shifts its regression target, with one training-only correction in the motion component and one in the orthogonal layout component. Chunk Evenness addresses (1) by spreading the motion of each latent chunk evenly over its frames, and Semantic Commitment addresses (2) by anchoring the coarse layout to the teacher's completion of the student's last step. In only 600 iterations, HorizonFlow distills Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B into a 4-step model using 8.4k training samples, 4.6-304$\times$ fewer than prior work. On VBench, HorizonFlow outperforms all released few-step Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B models. The same recipe transfers to Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B, where our student outperforms NVIDIA's distilled model. Code: https://github.com/XIANGLONGGUO/HorizonFlow-repo

</details>


### [407] [Ride on Anything: Contact-Coupled Monocular 4D Reconstruction of a Rider and Horse in Camera and World Frames](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29435)
*Zehang Weng,Ci Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 Ride on Anything（RoA），一种无需训练、在测试时耦合冻结的人体与动物重建器的通用方法，用于从单视频重建骑马者与马。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 独立应用人体估计器和马匹估计器时，二者虽能贴合各自轮廓，但骑手会悬空、穿模、沿马背滑动并相对抖动；这些误差沿相机轴方向，在输入视角中不可见。

Method: RoA 将 SAM 3D Body 与 4DEquine 对齐到共同帧索引，通过由马匹估计器初始化的像素各向同性相机投影二者，并在马体坐标系中定义交互项，联合优化有界修正；交互项包含基于广义绕数的碰撞项，适用于非水密马网格。结果利用背景相机旋转和 MoGe-2 视场角提升到水平世界坐标系。

Result: 在骑马片段上，原始估计使骑手骨盆平均距马背 15 cm；RoA 将座垫间隙降至 1 cm，沿脊柱和横向漂移分别降低 64% 和 89%，90 分位穿透深度降低 57%，骑手表面位于马体内的比例从 12.1% 降至 7.9%。运动更平滑：骑手相对马的加速度降低 94%，马抖动降低 80%；但骑手轮廓 IoU 从 0.59 降至 0.52。定性上骑手保持坐姿并随马运动。

Conclusion: RoA 能有效改善单视频骑马重建中的骑手-马交互一致性、穿透和相对运动稳定性，但 3D 精度定量评估仍需带标定的骑乘动物录制；论文还测试了牵马行走的非目标任务并分析了失败模式。

Abstract: We address the reconstruction of a horse and its rider from a single video. When a human estimator and a horse estimator are applied independently, both meshes can fit their silhouettes well while the rider hovers beside or passes through the horse, slides along its back and jitters relative to it. These errors lie along the camera axis and are not visible in the input view. We present Ride on Anything (RoA), a general, training-free methodology for reconstructing a person riding an animal, which couples frozen estimators of the rider and the mount at test time. We instantiate it for horseback riding with SAM 3D Body and 4DEquine. RoA aligns both estimators on a common frame index, projects both subjects through one pixel-isotropic camera initialized from the horse estimator, and jointly optimizes bounded corrections under interaction terms defined in the horse's body frame, including a collision term based on generalized winding numbers that remains valid on the non-watertight horse mesh. The result is lifted to a levelled world frame using the camera rotation from the background and the field of view from MoGe-2. On our riding clips, the raw outputs of the two estimators leave the rider's pelvis 15 cm from the horse's back on average. RoA reduces this seat gap to 1 cm, the drift of the seat along and across the spine by 64% and 89%, the 90th-percentile penetration depth by 57%, and the share of rider surface inside the horse from 12.1% to 7.9%. The motion is markedly smoother (94% lower acceleration of the rider relative to the horse, 80% lower horse jerk), while the rider's silhouette IoU decreases from 0.59 to 0.52. Qualitatively, the rider stays seated on the horse and moves together with it. A quantitative evaluation of 3D accuracy awaits calibrated recordings of ridden animals. We also test a clip outside the task, a horse led on foot, and analyse the failure modes.

</details>


### [408] [Mind the Gaps: State-Guided Supervision Allocation for Object Detection Dataset Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30369)
*Jiehui Xie,Zhengxun Jin,Jiahao Zhang,Yuxuan Luan,Dongshen Han,Caiyan Qin,Sung-Ho Bae,Chaoning Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出状态引导的监督分配框架SGSA，将目标检测数据集蒸馏建模为数据集级渐进式监督分配问题，以在有限图像预算下提升蒸馏数据集的分类与定位监督覆盖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有目标检测数据集蒸馏方法多关注单张图像的信息量，未显式考虑整个蒸馏数据集累积的监督，容易导致监督冗余以及类别-尺度覆盖不均。

Method: SGSA建立类别-尺度监督配额，并维护一个全局状态来跟踪已选合成图像上检测器预测的累积情况；根据目标配额与已累积监督之间的差距，引导自适应目标采样、检测器引导的画布细化和基于边际收益的候选选择，以促进图像间互补监督。

Result: 在MS COCO上，SGSA在0.25%-1.0%三个图像预算下相比匹配的OD3基线提升3.73-4.06 mAP；在PASCAL VOC上，相比最强评估基线在三个图像预算下提升4.53-6.90 mAP50。

Conclusion: 结果表明，在有限图像预算下，由累积检测器反馈引导的数据集级监督分配是有效的，能够提升目标检测数据集蒸馏性能。

Abstract: Recent advances in dataset distillation have enabled large-scale training datasets to be compressed into compact synthetic sets. However, dataset distillation for object detection remains challenging, as it requires preserving diverse classification and localization signals under limited image budgets. Existing approaches often emphasize individual-image informativeness without explicitly accounting for supervision accumulated across the distilled dataset, potentially leading to redundant supervision and uneven class-scale coverage. To address this limitation, we propose State-Guided Supervision Allocation (SGSA), a framework that formulates object detection dataset distillation as a dataset-level progressive supervision allocation problem. SGSA establishes class-scale supervision quotas and maintains a global state that tracks detector predictions accumulated from previously selected synthetic images. The remaining gaps between the target quotas and accumulated supervision guide adaptive object sampling, detector-guided canvas refinement, and marginal-gain-based candidate selection, encouraging complementary supervision across images. On MS COCO, SGSA outperforms a matched OD3 baseline by 3.73-4.06 mAP points across three image budgets (0.25%-1.0%). On PASCAL VOC, SGSA outperforms the strongest evaluated baseline by 4.53-6.90 mAP50 points across three image budgets. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of dataset-level supervision allocation guided by accumulated detector feedback under limited image budgets.

</details>


### [409] [Exploring Attention-Driven Deep Learning for Accurate Lung Nodule Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29450)
*Nima Shafiei Rezvani Nezhad,Meysam Mansouri,Saeid Ghayour,Ruhollah Abolhasani,Shahla Azizi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究利用LIDC-IDRI数据集探索多种深度学习模型用于肺结节分割，发现基于356个筛选样本和定制化注意力架构可取得高效且稳健的分割性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统方法通常使用完整数据集训练肺结节分割模型，本研究关注数据效率，即能否在筛选后的较小样本集上通过改进模型结构和预处理策略获得良好分割效果。

Method: 采用LIDC-IDRI数据集，仅使用356个筛选样本训练多种深度学习模型；引入注意力机制和先进预处理策略，并评估包括带Channel Attention Bridge和ResNet主干的DPL nkNet50等新配置。

Result: DPL nkNet50结合Channel Attention Bridge与ResNet主干表现最佳，Dice分数达到0.86，显著优于传统架构。

Conclusion: 研究表明，利用数据效率和定制化网络架构可实现稳健的肺结节分割性能，有助于推动临床计算机辅助诊断的发展。

Abstract: This study explores the application of various deep learning models for the segmentation of lung nodules using LIDC-IDRI. Unlike traditional approaches that utilize the full dataset, our work emphasizes the efficacy of training models on a filtered subset of 356 samples. Novel configurations, including attention mechanisms and advanced preprocessing strategies, were employed to optimize segmentation accuracy. Among the models evaluated, the DPL nkNet50 with a Channel Attention Bridge and ResNet backbone demonstrated the highest performance with a Dice score of 0.86, significantly outperforming conventional architectures. This work underscores the potential of leveraging data efficiency and tailored architectures in achieving robust segmentation performance, paving the way for improved computer-aided diagnosis in clinical settings.

</details>


### [410] [Seeing Through Preferences: Recovering Hidden Local Preference Neighborhoods for Text-to-Image Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29436)
*Pulkit Bansal,Vivek Srivastava,Shirish Karande*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 PrefLens 框架，利用稀疏人类偏好反馈恢复局部偏好邻域，从而为文本到图像扩散模型提供更丰富、更有效的偏好对齐监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有偏好对齐依赖昂贵且稀疏的成对标注；同时并非所有偏好比较都同样有信息量，语义差异过大的图像比较难以揭示细粒度感知因素。作者认为，围绕人类偏好图像的局部邻域中，语义对齐的替代样本能暴露更有意义的感知与结构差异。

Method: PrefLens 从稀疏人类反馈中恢复局部偏好邻域：在偏好图像周围生成受控的感知变化，使其尽量保持语义身份；再在由预训练奖励模型诱导的奖励定义偏好空间中选择紧凑且信息量高的邻居集合，将每个人类偏好标注转化为结构化邻域比较，无需额外人工标注。

Result: 实验和诊断评估表明，恢复出的偏好邻域能够捕捉与人类相关的偏好特征，并在多种设置下为偏好对齐提供有效监督。

Conclusion: 利用偏好图像周围的局部邻域比较，可以在不增加人工标注的情况下增强监督信号，为文本到图像扩散模型的偏好对齐提供有效且可扩展的途径。

Abstract: Aligning text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models with human preferences typically relies on large-scale pairwise annotations, which are expensive to obtain and provide only sparse supervision. Moreover, not all preference comparisons contribute equally to learning: comparisons between semantically distant images often reveal little about the fine-grained perceptual factors underlying human judgments. We argue that informative supervision can arise from local preference neighborhoods surrounding human-preferred images, where semantically aligned alternatives expose meaningful perceptual and structural differences. Motivated by this observation, we propose PrefLens, a framework that recovers local preference neighborhoods from sparse human feedback. Specifically, PrefLens generates controlled perceptual variations around preferred images that largely retain semantic identity and selects compact sets of informative neighbors in a reward-defined preference space induced by pretrained reward models. By transforming each human preference annotation into a structured neighborhood of informative comparisons, PrefLens enriches supervision without requiring additional human labeling. Our experiments and diagnostic evaluations show that the recovered neighborhoods capture human-relevant preference characteristics and provide effective supervision for preference alignment across diverse settings.

</details>


### [411] [Test-Time Latent Computation to Improve Visual Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30480)
*Chen Yang,Zheng Fang,Wenqi Fan,Jun Xia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出一种无需训练的 Latent 空间解码方法 Lobals，通过重新前向传播视觉注意力最强的连续层窗口，让多模态大模型在推理时“回看”视觉信息，从而提升视觉感知表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究表明 LLM 可在测试时通过 Latent 空间额外计算增强推理能力，因此作者想探究：多模态大模型是否也能在测试时通过 Latent 空间额外计算改善视觉感知。

Method: 作者首先验证 MLLM 中存在稳定且可复用的层，可在推理时重新前向传播而不破坏正常生成；据此提出无需训练的 Lobals 解码方法，定位对视觉 token 注意力最强的连续层窗口，并重新前向传播该窗口以在 Latent 空间中回看视觉证据。

Result: 实验表明，该 Latent 空间回看策略在多种多模态场景中提升 MLLM 表现，包括通用视觉语言任务、视觉幻觉任务和以视觉为中心的任务。

Conclusion: 在 Latent 空间中重新访问视觉证据是一种有效且无需训练的多模态大模型测试时增强策略，可改善视觉感知与多类多模态任务表现。

Abstract: Recent work on Large Language Models (LLMs) suggests that reasoning capabilities can be enhanced at test time not only through longer token-level reasoning traces, but also through additional computation in latent space. This raises a natural question for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs): can additional computation in latent space improve visual perception at test time? In this work, we first verify that MLLMs contain stable reusable layers that can be re-forwarded at inference time without disrupting normal generation. Based on this observation, we propose \textbf{Lo}ok \textbf{Ba}ck in the \textbf{L}atent \textbf{S}pace (\textbf{Lobals}), a training-free decoding method that identifies the contiguous layer window with the strongest visual-token attention and re-forwards through it, allowing the model to revisit visual evidence in latent space. We demonstrate that this latent-space revisit strategy can improve MLLMs' performance across diverse multimodal settings, including general vision-language tasks, visual hallucination tasks, and vision-centric tasks.

</details>

Abstract: Neutron imaging is highly sensitive to light elements such as lithium and is therefore valuable for non-destructive testing (NDT) and analyzing internal structural evolution in lithium batteries. However, limited neutron-source flux and detector performance often result in images with mixed noise, low contrast, and blurred edges, hindering accurate assessment of battery internal states. To address these issues, this paper proposes a lithium-battery neutron image enhancement method combining an improved Swin-Transformer with spatial-domain image fusion. First, an improved Swin-Transformer incorporating Multi-Dconv Head Transposed Attention (MDTA) and Global Response Normalization (GRN) extracts and reconstructs image features to suppress high-density white spots and Gaussian-Poisson mixed noise. Second, guided filtering and a gradient-adaptive mask are used for selective edge enhancement, while Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) improves local contrast. Finally, a spatial-frequency (SF)-based local block-weighted fusion mechanism adaptively combines the edge-enhanced and contrast-equalized images to preserve microscopic details while suppressing noise. Experiments show that, compared with BM3D, DnCNN, and GAN, the proposed method achieves strong performance in full-reference and no-reference evaluations. Its best PSNR and SSIM reach 33.0517 dB and 0.9637, respectively, while the NR-IQA and Natural Image Quality Evaluator (NIQE) scores are as low as 0.1794 and 4.0974. The method reduces artifacts and over smoothing, improving the visual fidelity and structural identifiability of lithium-battery neutron images.

</details>

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) extract structured data from documents by generating the requested JSON one token at a time, so their sequential steps grow with the length of the answer. Yet in key information extraction (KIE) the schema already fixes the answer's structure: keys, nesting and lists are known before decoding, and only the values are unknown. We exploit this with a non-autoregressive extractor that writes the structure from the schema, sizes every list with a count pass, and predicts all values in parallel, in a fixed number of passes that does not grow with the document. Each value is decoded with connectionist temporal classification (CTC) in its own block of slots, so its length never has to be predicted, and a value that is still open after its block gets a larger token budget. Zero-shot on VAREX, CORD and FUNSD, our 4B extractor is 3.5$\times$ faster than the diffusion-VLM competition on average (up to 5.6$\times$) and more accurate, with 4--6 forward passes per document where block diffusion needs 12--74. The same extractor also drafts for speculative decoding with its own autoregressive base: it runs 8.3$\times$ faster than autoregressive decoding (up to 10.4$\times$) within 0.4 points of its accuracy, and 3.3$\times$ faster than speculative diffusion decoding while 13.0 points more accurate. We release the model and code.

</details>

Abstract: Visual token pruning is an effective way to accelerate multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing methods degrade substantially under aggressive pruning, especially on visual grounding (VG). We analyze the sources of this degradation from the perspective of the output shift that pruning causes in decoder layers, and decompose this shift in closed form into two terms, an image summary error and an attention allocation error. The summary error stems from the loss of visual information, and the allocation error from the drop in the share of attention assigned to visual tokens. To reduce both errors, we propose CAR (Coverage selection and Attention Reallocation), a token pruning framework that restores attention share while maintaining information. Specifically, to minimize the summary error, whose upper bound tightens as the retained tokens better cover all visual tokens, our coverage selection retains tokens that are both salient and non-redundant, with saliency from encoder heads chosen by a label-free probe. To minimize the allocation error, our attention reallocation reassigns the attention of the discarded tokens to the retained ones through a closed-form logit bias. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B with $90\%$ of the visual tokens pruned, CAR retains $93.0\%$ of the unpruned accuracy on visual question answering (VQA) and $77.9\%$ on VG, against $26.5\%$ for the best existing method on VG; the logit bias alone raises the VG accuracy of existing methods by up to $24$ points. Experiments on multiple MLLMs across VQA, VG and video understanding show that CAR generalizes well and consistently outperforms existing methods.

</details>

Method: 提出 SRCWDNet，包含三个关键模块：交叉窗口注意力模块利用可学习全局 token 捕获局部与全局视觉上下文；双标签图模块自适应融合统计共现图与学习到的语义嵌入图以进行标签关系推理；神经分类器链顺序预测标签以利用标签间依赖。采用五折交叉验证和 Asymmetric-Graph-Consistency 损失训练。

Result: 在 MLRSNet 和 China-MAS50k 数据集上分别取得 98.93% 和 96.53% 的准确率，对应 F1 分数为 0.9365 和 0.8723，优于 CNN、Transformer 及轻量级基线。

Conclusion: 研究表明，联合建模视觉注意力与自适应标签相关性可显著改善多标签遥感场景分类，尤其在长尾类别分布下具有优势。

Abstract: Multi-label remote sensing scene classification remains a challenging task due to complex spatial-spectral patterns, extreme class imbalance, and inter-label dependencies that are often insufficiently modeled. To address these challenges, we introduce a Semantic-Relational Cross-Window Dual-Graph Network (SRCWDNet), which integrates three key modules: (1) a Cross-Window Attention module that captures local and global visual context through learnable global tokens; (2) a Dual Label-Graph module that adaptively combines statistical co-occurrence graphs and learned semantic-embedding graphs to facilitate label-relational reasoning; and (3) a Neural Classifier Chain that sequentially predicts labels to exploit inter-label dependencies. Evaluated using five-fold cross-validation and trained with an Asymmetric-Graph-Consistency loss, SRCWDNet achieves accuracies of 98.93% and 96.53%, with corresponding F1-scores of 0.9365 and 0.8723 on the MLRSNet and China-MAS50k datasets, respectively, outperforming CNN, transformer, and lightweight baselines. These findings demonstrate that jointly modeling visual attention and adaptive label correlations can substantially improve multi-label remote sensing scene classification, particularly under long-tailed class distributions.

</details>

Abstract: Representation alignment markedly accelerates diffusion training, but one-step generators raise a question that diffusion does not: \emph{which training path should receive the loss?} A one-step generator sees two kinds of inputs. Corrupted real images come with their clean counterpart, which provides an instance-paired target. Samples generated from pure noise have no corresponding real image, yet this is where the final model operates. We study this question on Priming, which trains one-step generators from scratch by reconstructing corrupted images and then matching feature distributions with optimal transport. Aligning the generative path, the natural choice, collapses recall ($0.45\!\to\!0.15$--$0.25$) in all 17 configurations we test, including five target constructions and loss weights down to $0.05$. Aligning the paired reconstruction path with a frozen DINOv2 encoder instead helps in every setting we test. A short analysis explains this asymmetry: when the target carries no instance information about the input, the optimal aligned feature is constant within each class, so the loss pulls samples toward class prototypes. A control confirms this: aligning the paired path to a random same-class image instead of the input's own image removes most of the gain. Inside the generator, paired-path alignment creates an interface block through which post-training routes noise, and the image semantics carried through it predict sample quality across 16 models. The resulting recipe, \method, accelerates \emph{both} training stages on ImageNet $256\!\times\!256$: it matches the 160-epoch baseline with $2\times$ fewer priming epochs, surpasses its final quality with $4\times$ fewer post-training updates, and lowers FID to 1.30 (B) and 1.155 (L) at the standard budget. A joint single-stage variant trains native one-step generators and reaches FID 1.22 with 115M parameters.

</details>

TL;DR: 论文提出STAGE框架，用于跨被试脑信号到图像检索，在无目标标签条件下通过结构化测试时自适应恢复跨被试对齐并优化候选排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨被试脑信号存在个体差异，导致脑-图像表示难以对齐；同时独立查询排序容易使预测集中在少数候选图像上，缺少目标标签时准确检索困难。

Method: 提出STAGE（结构化测试时自适应与全局熵软耦合）框架：用矩校准减小特征统计差异，用耦合加权初始化建立初始对齐，用耦合引导自适应修正残余特征失配，并用软耦合排序协调多个查询间的候选竞争；仅使用无标签目标批次，冻结两个编码器。

Conclusion: STAGE能够在无目标标签和编码器冻结条件下，从特征校准到图像检索保持一致匹配，有效提升跨被试脑到图像检索性能。

Abstract: Cross-subject brain-to-image retrieval aims to identify viewed images from unseen subjects' brain signals. However, inter-subject variability hinders alignment of brain-image representations, while independent query ranking tends to concentrate predictions on a few candidates, making accurate retrieval difficult without target labels. We propose STAGE (Structured Test-Time Adaptation with Global Entropic Soft-coupling), a structured test-time adaptation framework for recovering cross-subject alignment from uncertain brain-image correspondences. Moment calibration reduces statistical discrepancies between features, while coupling-weighted initialization establishes initial alignment. Coupling-guided adaptation further refines residual feature mismatches, and soft-coupling ranking coordinates candidate competition across queries to prevent overly concentrated matching assignments. Using only unlabeled target batches, STAGE maintains consistent matching from feature calibration to image retrieval while keeping both encoders frozen. Experiments on three public datasets validate STAGE's retrieval performance. On THINGS-EEG2, STAGE achieves 68.25% Top-1 and 90.47% Top-5, improving Top-1 by 18.52 percentage points over SCORE recovery and CSLS on identical frozen NICE features. Calibrated on 200 queries and a 200-image gallery covering their identities, STAGE retains 42.05% Top-1 when ranking 1,854 images with the transform frozen.

</details>

Abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models can generate harmful or sensitive content, such as pornographic or violent imagery, raising serious security concerns. Model editing has recently emerged as an efficient approach to mitigate this issue. It modifies pretrained models with minimal parameter updates to alter specific concepts while preserving overall model capabilities. However, due to the entangled representations of different concepts in diffusion models, direct modifications inevitably disrupt non-target concepts. Meanwhile, U-Net's hierarchical heterogeneity hinders unified strategies from balancing erasure and quality. To address these issues, we propose Hierarchical Orthogonal Subspace Erasure (HOSE). This method projects parameter updates into the subspace orthogonal to general knowledge, thereby eliminating interference with non-target concepts. Considering the hierarchical heterogeneity of the U-Net architecture, we further propose a hierarchical adaptive mechanism, constructing differentiated subspace projections for different layers to precisely adapt to the model's hierarchical structure, thereby resolving the inherent trade-off between erasure and image quality in unified constraints. Experimental results demonstrate the proposed method reduces harmful content generation by 80% compared with the unedited model. While it inevitably incurs some image quality degradation, it still outperforms other editing-based baselines in terms of quality preservation, and achieves a significantly better trade-off between harmful content suppression and quality loss than these baselines. Notably, our approach demonstrates higher adversarial robustness than existing SOTA method, indicating that the target concepts have been more thoroughly erased. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/sevenqiiu/HOSE.

</details>
