Abstract: When can an attribution-derived anomaly justify changing a medical-imaging training set? We formulate attribution-driven curation as three separately testable claims: anomaly detection, harmfulness estimation, and intervention utility. We test the first and third using a patient-disjoint, identifier-preserving audit of a 3D convolutional classifier for computed tomography angiography aneurysm candidates. We identify 232 exactly zero-valued arrays among 1,201 positive patches, including 170 training positives, and invalidate a historical 321-patch attention-failure subgroup whose identifier-free records were joined to files by position. On the held-out test set, GradCAM++ spatial concentration is central for every candidate class, reversing the historical pattern. GradCAM++ and Integrated Gradients show negative rank-order agreement for positives, limiting method-independent anatomical interpretation. Across five paired training seeds, removing the 170 corrupted training positives yields AUC 0.9617 +/- 0.0044 versus 0.9652 +/- 0.0039 for full-data training (difference -0.0035; 95% CI -0.0082 to 0.0007). Excluding 34 raw-zero test positives widens rather than closes the gap, countering a blank-memorization explanation. Budget-matched random-removal controls suggest the result is not simply an effect of reducing training size. Input corruption does not necessarily imply that deletion improves generalization. Our framework makes leakage control, sample identity, and intervention testing explicit in attribution-driven medical-imaging data curation.

</details>

Abstract: Proactive assistants that guide people through physical tasks must decide, every few seconds, whether a step is complete and whether a mistake has occurred. We find that two benchmarks for this task largely reward knowing when rather than seeing what: a timer that never looks at the video, raising an alarm at 25 s and confirming each step at 30 s, reaches a mistake F1 of 0.373 on Ego-MC-Bench, above every published result (at most 0.27). We formalize this as the video-blind frontier, the best trade-off between completion accuracy and mistake F1 that policies reach from the elapsed time, the instruction and training statistics alone: every published per-step result on Ego-MC-Bench lies inside it, and so do all twelve zero-shot models we run on QICD. To move beyond it, we introduce Evidence-Contrastive Training (ECT): fine-tune on the benchmark's own questions, and pair its positives with negatives from the same recording at the same elapsed time, so that elapsed time cannot separate the two sides of a pair. Trained on 209 QICD videos in about 15 GPU-hours, a 2B model with ECT crosses the frontier on both benchmarks in all four seeds; transferred to Ego-MC-Bench without adaptation, it confirms 59% of mistake-free steps in time, against 30% for a published model with the same backbone trained on about 25k synthetic counterfactuals and real recordings. Its decisions follow the video beyond what timing explains: at equal elapsed time it tells a finished step from an unfinished one in 90-92% of test pairs, where the instruction's typical duration reaches 65%, rescaling the time stamps between the frames leaves it essentially unchanged, and swapping in another recording, of the same recipe where one exists, cuts its completion accuracy by two thirds. The code and model weights will be publicly released.

</details>


### [421] [Inspect Before You Decide: Evidence-Guided Visual Search for Industrial Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29551)
*Peng Chen,Chao Huang,Yangyang Liu,Maodong Wu,Jinyi Xu,Mingbo Yang,Yunkang Cao,Fangjun Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出EVAD，一种证据引导的视觉搜索框架，使多模态大模型能够主动获取并验证细粒度视觉证据，以提升工业异常检测与推理的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在工业异常检测中难以获取和验证全局观察之外的细粒度视觉证据，导致对细微异常的可靠识别仍具挑战。

Method: EVAD先进行全局视觉评估以定位潜在异常区域，再采用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）引导的探索策略，通过语义精炼进行细粒度检查、通过空间扩展进行上下文验证，并评估整合所获证据以支持异常决策。

Result: 在多个工业异常检测任务上的广泛实验表明，EVAD在大多数评估设置中达到最先进性能。

Conclusion: 主动证据探索能够有效支持细粒度异常理解与推理，提升工业异常检测的可靠性。

Abstract: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable potential for industrial anomaly detection and understanding. However, reliably identifying subtle anomalies remains challenging, as existing approaches often struggle to acquire and verify fine-grained visual evidence beyond global observations. To address this challenge, we propose EVAD, an evidence-guided visual search framework that enables MLLMs to actively seek and examine diagnostically informative visual evidence for reliable anomaly reasoning. Specifically, EVAD begins with a global visual assessment to identify potentially anomalous regions for further inspection. Building upon this observation, we introduce a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-guided exploration strategy that progressively acquires visual evidence through two complementary operations: semantic refinement for fine-grained inspection and spatial expansion for contextual verification. The acquired evidence is subsequently evaluated and integrated to support more informed and reliable anomaly decisions. Extensive experiments across multiple industrial anomaly detection tasks demonstrate that EVAD achieves state-of-the-art performance in most evaluated settings, highlighting the effectiveness of active evidence exploration for fine-grained anomaly understanding and reasoning. The code will be publicly available upon publication.

</details>


### [422] [Replay Before You Reply: Second-Look Prompting for Unified Multimodal Encoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30909)
*Yicheng Zhang,Xun Zhang,Jingyuan Ma,Tianyu Yu,Yuan Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出无需训练的Second-Look Prompting（SLP），通过重复图像-问题对，使因果注意力下的每个token都能看到完整多模态输入，从而提升视觉语言模型表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前VLM采用因果注意力，token只能关注其前文，导致先出现的模态仅基于部分输入编码，无法获得完整的多模态上下文。

Method: SLP在输入中重复图像-问题对；在重复副本中，视觉和文本token可关注完整输入，形成统一多模态编码。额外视觉token还充当prefill scratchpad，即使替换为空白图像也能改善推理。

Result: 在12个基准上，SLP提升所有评估模型的平均分，涵盖9个3B-72B开源模型和3个专有前沿模型；Gemini 3 Flash在MATH-Vision上提升达5.6分。分析表明：问题引导第二张图像的注意力，额外视觉token的隐藏状态保留答案相关信息。

Conclusion: 输入呈现方式是简单有效的VLM性能提升手段；SLP通过统一多模态编码和prefill scratchpad两个互补机制发挥作用。

Abstract: Solving multimodal tasks requires Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to form a unified understanding of the image and the question text. However, under causal attention in current VLMs, a token can attend only to what precedes it. Whichever modality comes first is therefore encoded under partial observation of the input, uninformed by the rest of the multimodal context. We introduce Second-Look Prompting (SLP), a training-free method that repeats the image-question pair in the input. In the repeated copy, every visual and textual token can attend to the complete input, yielding a unified multimodal encoding of the pair. Moreover, the added visual tokens contribute computation beyond re-exposing the image: even a blank image in their place can improve reasoning. Across 12 benchmarks, SLP improves the overall average score of every evaluated model, spanning nine open-source models (3B-72B) and three proprietary frontier models, with gains reaching 5.6 points for Gemini 3 Flash on MATH-Vision. Our analysis reveals two complementary mechanisms: the question guides where the second image attends, and the added visual tokens act as a prefill scratchpad whose hidden states retain answer-relevant information from the image and question. These findings highlight input presentation as a simple yet effective way to improve VLM performance.

</details>

Alomaish,Pranav Rajpurkar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CTLink 是一个文本提示的 3D 分割模型，可根据胸部 CT 报告文本分割报告中描述的异常发现，并在 ReXGroundingCT 验证集和 MICCAI 2026 ReXGrounding 挑战赛中取得领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 放射学报告仅以文本描述发现，未在影像上视觉标记，读者无法直接看到每个报告发现对应的异常区域，因此需要将报告文本与 CT 影像中的具体病灶进行空间对应和分割。

Method: 提出 CTLink 文本提示 3D 分割模型；在 4123 例平扫胸部 CT、9547 个分割报告发现上训练，包括新标注的 ReXGroundingCTv2（1134 例扫描、1895 个发现，每个发现的每个实例均分割）。在 200 例验证扫描、MICCAI 2026 ReXGrounding 挑战赛测试集（48 支队伍）以及 50 例由两位独立放射科医生重复分割的测试扫描上评估。

Result: 在 200 例 ReXGroundingCT 验证扫描上，CTLink 的命中率为 0.816、实例 F1 为 0.456、平均 Dice 为 0.400；VoxTell 分别为 0.533、0.175、0.234（均 P < .001）。在 MICCAI 2026 ReXGrounding 挑战赛测试集上，7 个 CTLink 模型的集成在 48 支参赛队伍中取得最高命中率（0.782）和实例 F1（0.386）。在 50 例测试扫描上，CTLink 达到或超过放射科医生间一致性。

Conclusion: CTLink 能有效将胸部 CT 报告中的发现定位并分割，性能显著优于现有公开模型，并在挑战赛中领先，且与放射科医生间一致性相当或更好；主要局限是弥漫性非局灶性发现，因为即使放射科医生之间对其范围勾画也不一致。模型权重和数据集已公开。

Abstract: Radiology reports describe findings in text only, without visually marking them on the scan, so readers cannot directly see which abnormality each reported finding refers to. We introduce CTLink, a text-prompted 3D segmentation model that segments findings described in a chest CT report. CTLink was trained on 4123 noncontrast chest CT scans with 9547 segmented report findings, including ReXGroundingCTv2, a newly annotated dataset of 1134 scans and 1895 findings with every instance of each finding segmented. On the 200 ReXGroundingCT validation scans, CTLink achieved a hit rate of 0.816, an instance F1 score of 0.456, and a mean Dice score of 0.400, compared with 0.533, 0.175, and 0.234 for VoxTell, a publicly available text-prompted segmentation model (P < .001 for all). On the test set of the MICCAI 2026 ReXGrounding challenge, an ensemble of seven CTLink models achieved the highest hit rate (0.782) and instance F1 score (0.386) of all 48 participating teams. On 50 test scans segmented twice by independent radiologists, CTLink matched or exceeded inter-rater agreement. Diffuse non-focal findings remained the main limitation, partly because their extent is outlined inconsistently even between radiologists. The CTLink model weights are available at https://huggingface.co/rajpurkarlab/CTLink, and the dataset at https://huggingface.co/datasets/rajpurkarlab/ReXGroundingCT.

</details>


### [424] [Reasoning Beyond Imitation: Observation Conditioned Distillation for Video LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29728)
*Junzhou Chen,Jindong Wang,Gang Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究如何将强 Video-LLM 的时序推理能力蒸馏给开源学生模型，并指出现有方法存在由视频采样差异导致的“条件目标不匹配”问题。为此提出从能力获取到执行优化的框架，使蒸馏出的推理先验能够在学生模型自身观测条件下自适应执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 教师和学生 Video-LLM 可能采用不同的视频采样流程，从而从同一视频中构建不同的时序观测。教师观测下有效的推理轨迹可能依赖学生无法获取的证据，导致推理轨迹无法直接执行，形成 Reasoning Acquisition-Execution Gap。

Method: 作者将教师与学生观测差异形式化为条件目标不匹配，并提出 acquisition-to-execution 框架：先将教师推理轨迹蒸馏为学生推理先验，再在多种观测条件下优化该先验的执行能力。同时引入 Execution-Aware Reference Regularization，在当前观测下先验可执行时保留原先验，不可执行时允许更大程度自适应调整。

Result: 在多种 Video-LLM 骨干和六个视频推理基准上的实验表明，显式优化以观测为条件的执行能力，持续优于监督蒸馏和标准强化学习优化，并且增益可扩展到未见过的域外基准。

Conclusion: 推理蒸馏不能仅关注轨迹获取，还需针对学生模型自身观测条件优化执行能力。所提框架能够弥合教师轨迹与学生观测之间的差距，提升视频时序推理蒸馏的效果和泛化性。

Abstract: Reasoning distillation offers a promising approach to transfer temporal reasoning capabilities of powerful Video-LLMs to open-source student models. However, teacher and student Video-LLMs may construct different temporal observations from the same video due to the adoption of distinct video sampling pipelines. A reasoning trajectory valid under the teacher's observations may rely on evidence inaccessible to the student and thus cannot be directly executed based on the student's observations. We formalize this as a conditional target mismatch, thereby revealing the Reasoning Acquisition-Execution Gap. To bridge this gap, we propose an acquisition-to-execution framework that first distills teacher trajectories into a student reasoning prior and then further optimizes the execution capability of this prior across multiple observations. We further introduce Execution-Aware Reference Regularization, which retains the existing prior when it is executable under current observations, while allowing a greater degree of adaptive adjustment when it is not. Experiments across multiple Video-LLM backbones and six video reasoning benchmarks show that explicitly optimizing observation-conditioned execution consistently outperforms supervised distillation and standard RL-based optimization, with gains extending to held-out out-of-domain benchmarks.

</details>


### [425] [SuperFine3D: Efficient Global-Local Recursive Refinement for Extremely Detailed 3D Geometry Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29630)
*Lihan Li,Junwei Zhou,Yu-wing Tai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 SuperFine3D，一个通过全局-局部递归细化从图像高效生成极精细 3D 几何的框架，可在仅用 512^3–1024^3 表示训练的情况下生成 4096^3 解码网格几何。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率图像包含丰富细节，忠实 3D 重建需要精细几何结构；但直接从图像生成极详细 3D 几何计算量大、训练数据需求高，现有先进模型难以胜任高分辨率几何生成。

Method: 提出全局-局部递归细化框架，学习一个粗到细的共享细化算子并递归复用以合成超出训练分辨率的更精细几何；引入空间单元注意力将高分辨率交互限制在局部邻域并保持相邻单元间有界通信；提出空间锚定的跨尺度引导，用全局上下文化的粗几何指导局部细节合成；并采用几何感知训练目标保持结构稳定并增加表面细节。

Result: SuperFine3D 在仅用 512^3–1024^3 表示训练的情况下，生成 4096^3 解码网格分辨率、对应稀疏 256^3 潜格点的几何；相比全注意力递归基线，端到端推理提速 9.4 倍，峰值 GPU 显存降低 23.0%，同时提升跨尺度结构一致性并生成更干净、细节更精细的表面。

Conclusion: 递归复用共享细化算子结合局部空间注意力和跨尺度引导，可高效实现超出训练分辨率的高细节 3D 几何生成，并在效率、显存和结构一致性方面优于全注意力递归基线。

Abstract: High-resolution images contain rich visual details that require fine geometric structures for faithful 3D reconstruction. However, generating extremely detailed 3D geometry from images requires substantial computational resources and training data, making high-resolution geometry generation challenging for existing state-of-the-art models. In this paper, we present SuperFine3D, an efficient framework for generating extremely detailed 3D geometry through global-local recursive refinement. SuperFine3D learns a shared refinement operator from paired coarse-to-fine representations and recursively reuses it to progressively synthesize finer geometry beyond the training resolutions, without requiring additional paired supervision at target resolutions. To make recursive refinement computationally efficient, we introduce spatial-cell attention, which restricts high-resolution interactions to local spatial neighborhoods while maintaining bounded communication across neighboring cells. We further propose spatially anchored cross-scale guidance, which leverages globally contextualized coarse geometry to guide local detail synthesis and preserve structural consistency. In addition, geometry-aware training objectives encourage the refinement process to preserve stable geometric structures while introducing fine-grained surface details. Experiments demonstrate that SuperFine3D generates geometry at a $4096^3$ decoder-grid resolution, corresponding to a sparse $256^3$ latent lattice, using a shared refinement operator trained only on $512^3$--$1024^3$ representations. Compared with a full-attention recursive baseline, SuperFine3D achieves a $9.4\times$ speedup in end-to-end inference and reduces peak GPU memory usage by $23.0\%$, while improving cross-scale structural consistency and producing cleaner surfaces with finer geometric details.

</details>


### [426] [GravHMR: Coupling SLAM and Human Mesh Recovery in a Shared Gravity Frame](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29614)
*Hanglei Jin,Chenglu Sun,Junchen Ge,Yuchao Wang,Siqi Chen,Yuzhi Huang,Jingyan Jiang,Zhi Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GravHMR 是一个无需训练、即插即用的框架，通过共享重力对齐参考将 SLAM 与人体网格恢复耦合，从单目视频中恢复全局一致的 3D 人体运动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态相机运动下的单目视频全局 3D 人体运动恢复仍很困难；直接结合 SLAM 与 HMR 会导致朝向不一致和轨迹漂移累积。

Method: 提出 GravHMR，允许重力独立于 HMR 主干估计；使用 Yaw-Aware Orientation Optimization (YAOO) 绕共享重力轴校正身体与速度朝向；再用 Gravity-Aware Trajectory Optimization (GATO) 结合 2D 重投影、人体隐含度量尺度和自身运动，将根轨迹锚定到 SLAM 度量世界。

Result: 在 EMDB-2 上，GravHMR 使用 ViPE 达到 154.0 mm W-MPJPE100，使用 masked DROID-SLAM 达到 189.8 mm；相同 masked DROID-SLAM 相机估计下优于 TRAM 的 222.4 mm；相同 HMR 主干下，相比 GVHMR 的 276.5 mm 降低 44.3%，相比 GVHMR + HTD-Refine 的 192.4 mm 降低 20.0%。

Conclusion: GravHMR 通过重力对齐参考有效耦合 SLAM 与 HMR，在不训练的情况下显著提升全局一致的人体运动恢复精度。

Abstract: Recovering globally consistent 3D human motion from monocular videos remains challenging under dynamic camera motion. Although SLAM and human mesh recovery (HMR) provide complementary camera and body estimates, directly combining them often leads to inconsistent orientations and accumulated trajectory drift. We present GravHMR, a training-free, plug-and-play framework that couples SLAM and HMR through a shared gravity-aligned reference. By allowing gravity to be estimated independently of the HMR backbone, GravHMR accommodates world-grounded HMR models with or without explicit gravity-view representations. Specifically, Yaw-Aware Orientation Optimization (YAOO) resolves heading inconsistencies by correcting body and velocity orientations about the shared gravity axis. Conditioned on these corrected orientations, Gravity-Aware Trajectory Optimization (GATO) anchors root trajectories in the metric SLAM world by jointly leveraging 2D reprojection, the metric scale implicit in the human body, and the body's own motion. On EMDB-2, GravHMR achieves state-of-the-art performance with 154.0 mm W-MPJPE100 using ViPE and 189.8 mm using masked DROID-SLAM, outperforming TRAM (222.4 mm) under the same masked DROID-SLAM camera estimates. It further reduces W-MPJPE100 by 44.3% over GVHMR (276.5 mm) and by 20.0% over GVHMR + HTD-Refine (192.4 mm) with the same HMR backbone.

</details>


### [427] [PROPS: Can Visual Generators Keep the Current Look of a Prop?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29665)
*Xiangzhao Hao,Dianyi Wang,Keyan Zhou,Yiqian Zhang,Zefeng Zhang,Bailin Li,Kun Zhan,Junchi Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出并研究生成任务中的“道具漂移”（prop drift）问题：模型在视觉历史中未正确恢复物体当前外观，而是重绘或回退到旧外观。作者构建 PROPS 基准和 PROPS-Train 训练集，系统评估并改善该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在故事板、插画故事和多轮编辑等任务中，新请求通常只说明下一步发生什么，而不重复早期物体外观。现有生成器常无法从历史中恢复物体当前外观，导致外观错误并传播到后续步骤；现有评估又难以隔离该失败，因为与历史相似会奖励复制，且单侧历史判断无法区分模型恢复的外观与其偏好的外观。

Method: 提出 PROPS 基准，包含 2,257 对“孪生历史”：两侧最终请求相同，但同一道具呈现两种不同外观；只有生成器在两侧分别画出匹配外观并完成请求才算通过。测试 34 个开源和闭源系统，并通过交换智能体的规划器和编辑器分析性能瓶颈。另构建 PROPS-Train，包含四条轨道共 80,250 条训练链，目标包括恢复早期状态或延续脚本化变化，并用于微调。

Result: 所有 34 个被测系统均出现道具漂移；即使多数情况下能完成请求动作的系统，也常丢失道具当前外观。交换规划器和编辑器表明，历史理解与图像生成都会限制智能体表现。在 PROPS-Train 上微调可明显提升所有四个测试模型。

Conclusion: PROPS 能有效隔离并暴露道具漂移问题，说明当前生成系统在利用视觉历史恢复物体当前状态方面仍有明显不足；PROPS-Train 提供了可行的训练改进方向，两个数据集将公开释放。

Abstract: Many generation tasks draw the next image from a visual history, such as storyboards, illustrated stories and multi-turn editing. A new request often states what happens next without restating how earlier objects look. Instead of recovering an object's current look from the history, generators often redraw it from the request alone or bring back an outdated look, and the error can carry into later steps. We call this failure prop drift. Existing evaluations rarely isolate it, because similarity to the history rewards copying and a judge that sees a single history cannot tell a look recovered from that history from one the generator happens to prefer. We introduce PROPS, a benchmark of 2,257 pairs of twin histories that end on the same request but show one prop in two different looks. A pair passes only if the generator draws the matching look on each side and carries out the request, so a look preferred by the generator or the judge passes at most one side. All 34 open and closed systems we test show prop drift, and even systems that carry out the requested action on most sides often lose the current look of the prop. Swapping the planners and editors of agents further shows that both history understanding and image generation limit agent performance. We also build PROPS-Train, 80,250 training chains in four tracks whose targets recover an earlier state or carry scripted changes forward, and fine-tuning on it clearly improves all four tested models. Both datasets will be publicly released.

</details>


### [428] [ApexID: Hierarchical Learning for Multi-Species Animal Re-Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29723)
*Seifeldin Elkerdany,Mohamed ElBassat,Gamal Abouelhamd,Assem Elkady,Jana Ghoneim,Matin Mahmood,Abigail Allen Martin,Gerard de Melo,Antonio Rueda-Toicen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 ApexID，一种基于 SphereFace2 的分层损失，将全局个体身份判别与平衡的动物类别监督结合，用于动物重识别，并在多数据集上验证其跨数据集和跨物种迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动物重识别需要区分不同物种的个体并适应不同观测条件，现有方法在跨数据集和未见物种上的迁移能力仍不足，因此需要同时利用类别监督和身份判别来提升泛化性。

Method: 构建包含 19 个公开数据集、132,533 张图像的数据集，评估 3 类模型家族和 4 种目标函数；提出 ApexID 分层 SphereFace2 损失，融合全局身份判别与平衡的动物类别监督，并在 4 个外部数据集上采用观测感知的检索协议进行评估。

Result: ApexID 在 ConvNeXt-Small 上取得数据集平均 Rank-1 64.89%，在 MIEW-ID 上取得 mAP 32.54%，均优于预训练参考模型；在大象这一未参与动物重识别训练的类别上，ConvNeXt-Small 变体在 14 种评估配置中取得最佳检索性能。结果随骨干网络和数据集变化，开放集评估仍显示发现挑战。

Conclusion: 研究支持采用分层类别-身份学习来提升动物重识别对未见数据集和物种的迁移能力，同时开放集场景仍是未来需要解决的问题。

Abstract: Animal re-identification (Re-ID) must distinguish individuals across species and capture conditions. We introduce ApexID, a hierarchical SphereFace2-based loss that integrates global identity discrimination with balanced animal-category supervision. Using 132,533 images curated from 19 public datasets, we evaluate three model families and four objectives on four external datasets with observation-aware retrieval protocols. ApexID achieves a dataset-averaged Rank-1 accuracy of 64.89% with ConvNeXt-Small and an mAP of 32.54% with MIEW-ID, outperforming their pretrained reference models. On elephants, a category absent from animal Re-ID training, our ConvNeXt-Small variant achieves the highest retrieval performance among the fourteen evaluated configurations. Scores vary by backbone and dataset, and open-set evaluation reveals remaining discovery challenges. These findings support hierarchical category-identity learning to improve transfer to unseen datasets and species.

</details>


### [429] [DeclareViT: Decoupling Early Classification from Feature Refinement with Exit Query for Efficient ViTs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29674)
*Xinrui Gong,Yao Rong,Chuangtao Chen,Daniel Ochs,Ulf Schlichtmann,Bing Li,Kristian Kersting,Grace Li Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 DeclareViT，将 ViT 的早退分类与特征细化解耦，通过专用查询和单向交叉注意力实现高效早退推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有早退方法将早分类与共享主干联合训练，早分类和后续特征细化的优化目标会共同更新主干参数，可能导致梯度方向冲突。

Method: 每个出口使用专用 query，通过单向交叉注意力读取中间特征，不修改主干 token 流；仅训练 query 分支用于早分类，主干和最终分类器保持冻结。

Result: 在 ViT、DeiT、Swin 及 CIFAR-100、ImageNet-1K、Food-101 上取得更优精度-效率权衡：基于 MAC 实现 1.58 至 2.57 倍加速，精度仅下降 0.39 至 1.91 个百分点；CPU 和 GPU 墙钟时间也显示实际推理加速。

Conclusion: 将早分类与特征细化解耦可避免联合训练中的梯度冲突，DeclareViT 能稳定提升早退 ViT 的精度-效率权衡并带来实际部署加速。

Abstract: Vision Transformers achieve remarkable recognition performance but incur substantial computational cost during inference, limiting their use in latency- and compute-constrained deployment scenarios. Early-exit inference offers a promising solution by allowing easy samples to terminate at intermediate layers. However, existing approaches typically couple early classification with the shared backbone, requiring intermediate representations to support both early classification and subsequent feature refinement. Under joint training, the corresponding optimization objectives jointly update shared backbone parameters, which can lead to conflicting gradient directions. Motivated by this observation, we introduce DeclareViT, a framework that decouples early classification from feature refinement. Each exit uses a dedicated query to read intermediate features through one-way cross-attention without modifying the backbone token stream. The query branches are optimized for early classification while the backbone and final classifier remain frozen. Across ViT, DeiT, and Swin on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-1K, and Food-101, DeclareViT consistently establishes a state-of-the-art accuracy-efficiency trade-off: It achieves 1.58 times to 2.57 times multiply-accumulate (MAC)-based speed-up with only a 0.39-1.91 percentage-point accuracy drop. Wall-clock measurements on CPU and GPU further demonstrate practical inference acceleration. Code is available at https://github.com/TUDa-HWAI/DeclareViT.

</details>


### [430] [UniDR: Learning To Generate Anatomical Deformations From Images via Unified Diffusion Modeling and Registration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29712)
*Swakshar Deb,Tonmoy Hossain,Tom Fletcher,Miaomiao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出UniDR统一扩散建模与配准框架，用于从单张图像生成保持拓扑的任意解剖形变，并提升下游医学图像分析与视觉任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通常将生成过程与基于配准的形变估计分开建模，容易传播配准阶段的误差，因此需要统一生成与配准的建模范式。

Method: 提出基于条件扩散模型的形变场统一范式，将扩散过程与配准联合优化；引入配准引导的分数匹配目标，使扩散过程对齐配准诱导的形变分布，并建立生成与配准之间的显式联系。

Result: 在多个真实应用中评估UniDR，结果表明其相比现有最先进方法能生成高保真图像样本，且生成样本可提升下游医学图像分析和视觉任务性能。

Conclusion: UniDR能够以单张输入图像为条件采样多样且解剖合理的形变，统一了生成与配准，并验证了生成样本对下游任务的有效性。

Abstract: This paper presents a novel framework, Unified Diffusion modeling and Registration (UniDR), which learns to generate arbitrary anatomical deformations from images with preserved topology. Existing approaches often model the generative process separately from registration-based deformation estimation; hence making them prone to propagated errors from the registration stage. To address this limitation, we propose a unified paradigm based on a conditional diffusion model over deformation fields that are jointly optimized from the registration process. A principled registration-guided score-matching objective function is then introduced to align the diffusion process with the deformation distribution induced by registration. As a result, our UniDR establishes an explicit connection between generation and registration: the diffusion model enables exploration of the space of plausible anatomical deformations, whereas registration provides structured supervision for learning transformations consistent with observed images. Once trained, UniDR is able to sample diverse, anatomically plausible transformations conditioned on any single input image. We evaluate UniDR across multiple real-world applications and demonstrate its effectiveness in generating high-fidelity image samples compared to the state-of-the-art. Additionally, we demonstrate that these generated samples improve performance in downstream medical image analysis and vision tasks.

</details>


### [431] [Contamination at the Operating Point: Train-Test Identity Overlap Inflates Low-FMR Face Recognition Accuracy by an Order of Magnitude](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29629)
*Fu Dai,Kamal Taha,Naoufel Werghi,Maregu Assefa*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文表明，人脸验证基准中训练集与测试集的身份重叠会导致随FMR降低而放大的乘性性能偏差，而非以往认为的小幅加性偏差；作者通过校准重叠检测、受控移除污染身份和构建零重叠协议量化了该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际部署的人脸验证系统通常在FMR≤10⁻⁶下工作，但常用基准可能与训练语料共享身份，导致性能被乐观高估。已有工作仅将这种偏差视为10折准确率上的小幅加性变化，低估了其在低FMR场景下的影响。

Method: 使用基于零分布校准的重叠检测器审计训练-测试身份重叠；以WebFace42M为参照检查MS1MV3和IJB-C，并人工复核部分IJB-C受试者；在固定模型下仅移除测试集中的污染身份并与同规模随机移除对照；分析冒充者尾部与阈值变化；直接测量IJB-C中有效独立冒充者比较数；构建经审计零重叠的真实人脸协议。

Result: 相对WebFace42M，标记MS1MV3中88.6%身份和IJB-C中14.3%受试者存在重叠；人工复核100个被标记IJB-C受试者确认69.2%，推断残余重叠约9.9%。移除污染身份后，FNMR在FMR=10⁻⁴、10⁻⁵、10⁻⁶时分别增加3.6倍、6.3倍和13.9倍，而随机移除无此效果；原因在于冒充者尾部变短并降低阈值。IJB-C在FMR=10⁻⁶下仅约270万有效独立比较，低于常见报告规则；零重叠协议可解析到FMR=10⁻⁸。

Conclusion: 训练-测试重叠造成的性能偏差是乘性的，并随FMR降低而显著增大，常用基准会明显高估低FMR下的真实性能。人脸验证评估需要审计零重叠的数据协议，并保证足够的有效独立冒充者比较数。

Abstract: Face verification systems are deployed by selecting a decision threshold that achieves a target false match rate (FMR); performance is then reported as the corresponding false non-match rate (FNMR). In practice, deployed systems operate at FMR $\le 10^{-6}$, but widely used benchmarks can share identities with the models' training corpora. Prior work (Wu et al., 2024) measures the resulting optimistic bias as a small additive change in 10-fold accuracy (up to 1.01 percentage points). We show that the bias is neither small nor constant: it is a multiplicative error that grows as FMR falls. First, we audit train-test overlap with a detector calibrated against a null distribution (rather than a hand-tuned threshold). Relative to WebFace42M, we flag 88.6% of MS1MV3 identities and 14.3% of IJB-C subjects as present, despite WebFace260M's published de-overlap explicitly naming IJB-C. Manual review of 100 flagged IJB-C subjects confirms 69.2%, implying a residual overlap of roughly 9.9%. Second, holding the model fixed, removing only the contaminated identities from the test set increases FNMR by 3.6$\times$ at FMR=$10^{-4}$, 6.3$\times$ at FMR=$10^{-5}$, and 13.9$\times$ at FMR=$10^{-6}$, while a same-size random removal does not. The effect is traced to a shorter impostor tail that lowers the threshold. The magnitude of the shift depends on the training corpus and does not cancel betweent margin between our model and a publicbaseline by half. Third, we give the first direct measurement of the effective number of independent impostor comparisons in IJB-C: only 2.7 million effectively independent comparisons at FMR=$10^{-6}$, which is below all commonly accepted reporting rules. Finallyth a known training corpus, we build areal-face protocol with audited zero overlap that resolves FMR=$10^{-8}$.

</details>


### [432] [MISeg-Agent: A Human-in-the-Loop Agentic Framework for Error Diagnosis and Executable Prompt Review in 3D Medical Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29741)
*Delin An,Mingqi Xu,Jian-Xun Wang,Pengfei Gu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 MISeg-Agent，一个人在回路中的智能体框架，用于诊断医学图像分割错误并给出基于证据的修正建议，从而提升已有分割结果的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代医学图像分割模型性能虽强，但预测仍可能包含局部错误；现有交互式分割虽可修正，但错误定位、干预点选择、修正效果评估以及修正后掩码变化带来的重新诊断仍具挑战。

Method: MISeg-Agent 先根据基准性能和计算需求选择预训练分割模型；基于预测掩码识别可能漏分割和过分割的前景区域，推荐可疑切片和修正点；再利用交互式分割模型评估候选点提示，并在人工验证后应用修正；诊断过程直接基于图像和预测掩码，独立于底层分割模型架构。

Result: 在 CT 数据集上的评估表明，MISeg-Agent 能改善初始分割结果，并使最终掩码与参考标注高度一致。

Conclusion: MISeg-Agent 通过自适应错误诊断与经验证的修正建议相结合，为识别和减少现有医学图像分割中的残余错误提供了一种可解释的方法。

Abstract: Despite the strong performance of modern medical image segmentation models, their predictions can still contain localized errors that compromise segmentation quality. Identifying and correcting these errors is therefore essential for improving the reliability of existing segmentation results. While interactive segmentation models enable targeted corrections, identifying potential errors, determining where to intervene, and evaluating corrective actions remain challenging. Moreover, each correction changes the current mask, requiring subsequent error diagnosis and recommendations to adapt accordingly. To address these challenges, we propose MISeg-Agent, a human-in-the-loop agentic framework that diagnoses segmentation errors and provides evidence-based correction recommendations. MISeg-Agent first selects a suitable pretrained segmentation model based on benchmark performance and computational requirements. Given its predicted mask, the framework identifies potential missing and excess foreground regions and recommends suspicious slices and corrective points for review. The framework then evaluates candidate point prompts using an interactive segmentation model and presents the resulting corrections for human verification before applying them. By operating directly on images and predicted masks, the error diagnosis process remains independent of the underlying segmentation model architecture. Evaluations on CT datasets demonstrate that MISeg-Agent improves initial segmentation results and produces final masks closely aligned with reference annotations. By integrating adaptive error diagnosis with validated correction recommendations, MISeg-Agent provides an interpretable approach to identifying and reducing residual errors in existing medical image segmentations.

</details>


### [433] [Seeing Beyond Names: Image-Grounded Concept Linking for Robust Vision-Language Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29735)
*Behraj Khan,Shabir Ahmad,Tahir Qasim Syed,Syed Ahmad Chan Bukhari*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究零样本视觉语言分类器对类别名称变化的敏感性，并提出免训练的图像 grounding 概念链接方法来缓解词汇漂移导致的性能下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP 等零样本视觉语言分类器对输入类别名称高度敏感：即使图像不变，将熟悉标签替换为同义词、缩写或本体术语也会显著改变预测，因此需要评估并缓解这种词汇漂移问题。

Method: 采用无泄漏评估协议，在 Tiny ImageNet、ImageNet-R、ImageNet-A 和 ImageNetV2 上评估 CLIP ViT-B/16；提出免训练的 image-grounded concept linking，将类别名称映射到视觉概念，并用可靠性门控改进预测；同时比较五种视觉语言骨干和多种改进策略。

Result: CLIP ViT-B/16 在替代类别名称下 top-1 准确率下降 14.8 至 17.6 个百分点；所提方法在四个数据集上均优于模板集成，合并提升 1.8 个百分点；在 20 个骨干-数据集组合中 16 个有提升且无显著负面结果，并降低五种骨干的合并负对数似然；更强的文本链接和直推式细化没有稳定提升；第二个 CLIP ViT-B/16 种子在 ImageNetV2 上确认提升，但在 ImageNet-A 上未确认。

Conclusion: 类别名称的视觉 grounding 是缓解零样本分类器词汇漂移的有效方向，但准确的视觉类别名链接仍是主要挑战；更复杂的文本链接或直推式细化并未带来一致收益，方法效果也受数据集和随机种子影响。

Abstract: A zero-shot vision-language classifier is highly sensitive to the class names it receives. Even when images remain unchanged, replacing familiar labels with synonyms, abbreviations, or ontology terms can significantly alter predictions. We investigate this \emph{vocabulary shift} using a leakage-free evaluation protocol across Tiny ImageNet, ImageNet-R, ImageNet-A, and ImageNetV2. With CLIP ViT-B/16, alternative class names reduce top-1 accuracy by $14.8$--$17.6$ percentage points. To address this issue, we propose \emph{image-grounded concept linking}, a training-free method that maps class names to visual concepts and uses a reliability gate to improve predictions. The method outperforms a template ensemble across all four datasets, achieving a pooled gain of $1.8$ points. We further evaluate five vision-language backbones across four datasets. Our method improves performance in $16$ of $20$ backbone--dataset combinations, with no significantly negative results. It also reduces pooled negative log-likelihood across all five backbones. Stronger text linking and transductive refinement provide no consistent improvements, suggesting that accurate visual class-name linking remains the main challenge. A second CLIP ViT-B/16 seed confirms the improvement on ImageNetV2, but not on ImageNet-A.

</details>


### [434] [DREAM: Dual-Memory Reasoning for Anticipatory 3D Perception in Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29753)
*Sriram Mandalika,Athira Nambiar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出DREAM，一种面向连续LiDAR语义分割的双记忆推理框架，将感知建模为经验驱动和可预期的过程，通过在线维护潜在记忆与错误记忆提升动态场景下的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LiDAR语义分割方法多为逐帧处理，独立处理每次扫描并丢弃历史上下文经验，难以应对遮挡、稀疏观测和重复失败模式，在动态场景变化下鲁棒性不足。

Method: DREAM在严格在线设置下维护两个互补记忆库：存储历史场景紧凑语义抽象的潜在记忆，以及记录不确定预测相关表示的错误记忆。每个时间步通过余弦相似度检索相关记忆条目，并用轻量调制机制整合到特征空间；骨干网络保持冻结且不重放历史扫描，以保证计算效率和有界记忆增长。

Result: 在多个大规模LiDAR基准上的实验表明，DREAM达到最先进性能，并在动态物体和小尺度物体上取得一致提升，验证了持久且错误感知记忆对长期鲁棒感知的有效性。

Conclusion: 将持续记忆和错误感知记忆引入连续LiDAR语义分割，可在不重放历史数据和不更新骨干网络的条件下有效增强模型对动态场景和重复失败模式的适应能力，实现高效、鲁棒的长期感知。

Abstract: Autonomous driving systems must not only interpret the current scene but also anticipate perceptual challenges such as occlusions, sparse observations, and recurring failure patterns. However, most existing LiDAR semantic segmentation methods operate in a frame-centric manner, processing each scan independently and discarding past contextual experience, which limits robustness under dynamic scene changes. We propose DREAM, a Dual-memory REAsoning framework for continual LiDAR seMantic segmentation that reframes perception as an experience-driven and anticipatory process. DREAM maintains two complementary memory banks in a strictly online setting: a latent memory that stores compact semantic abstractions of previously observed scenes, and an error memory that records representations associated with uncertain predictions. At each timestep, relevant memory entries are retrieved via cosine similarity and integrated into the feature space through a lightweight modulation mechanism, enabling the model to reinforce consistent semantic patterns while suppressing recurring failure modes. The backbone remains frozen and no past scans are replayed, ensuring computational efficiency and bounded memory growth. Extensive experiments on multiple large-scale LiDAR benchmarks demonstrate that DREAM achieves state-of-the-art performance, with consistent improvements on dynamic and small-scale objects, highlighting the effectiveness of persistent and error-aware memory for robust long-horizon perception.

</details>


### [435] [Mass Forcing: On-Policy Mass-Aware Distillation for Autoregressive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29618)
*Yiyu Li,Fei Wei,Yong Wang,Zaiquan Yang,Gerhard Petrus Hancke,Xiangxiang Chu,Rynson W. H. Lau*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Mass Forcing，一种面向视频扩散蒸馏的概率质量感知框架，通过将 DMD 的在线监督从整段视频转移到单个状态，缓解 reverse-KL 目标导致的模式坍缩问题，从而提升视频保真度并保持时间动态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DMD 的 reverse-KL 目标具有模式寻求性，容易使学生模型的条件视频分布坍缩到少数模式，导致样本多样性下降、时间动态减弱和颜色过饱和。现有方法主要通过覆盖导向的学生初始化来缓解，但作者观察到这种覆盖是短暂的，动态视频比例在后续 DMD 训练中仍会急剧下降，说明退化主要由模式寻求目标而非初始化导致。

Method: 提出 Mass Forcing：在每次更新时从共享的学生生成前缀分支出多条续写，使学生在某一状态的概率质量可与教师比较。首先通过潜空间分数积分估计这些续写之间的教师-学生相对密度比，并据此重新平衡条件 DMD 更新，放大相对教师而言欠表示的 rollout；其次，由于模式概率不匹配不一定产生强局部分数修正，进一步将生成的 rollout 集合与由相同质量估计定义的重加权参考分布对齐，提供跨 rollout 监督。

Result: 在 MovieGen 和 VBench 上的实验表明，Mass Forcing 提升了视频保真度，并在整个训练过程中保持时间动态。相比基线，其取得最高的 Total 分数；在 1000 次生成器更新后 Dynamic Degree 达到 83%，而基线为 12-32%，且没有额外推理时开销。

Conclusion: Mass Forcing 通过概率质量感知的逐状态监督和跨 rollout 对齐，有效缓解 DMD 视频蒸馏中的模式坍缩，在保持实时推理优势的同时改善视频质量与时间动态。

Abstract: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) has emerged as a promising paradigm for real-time video synthesis, distilling pretrained diffusion models into few-step autoregressive generators. However, its reverse-KL objective is mode-seeking and can collapse the student's conditional video distribution onto a narrow subset of modes, leading to reduced sample diversity, diminished temporal dynamics, and color oversaturation. Existing methods mitigate this issue mainly via coverage-oriented student initialization, but we observe that such coverage is transient: across three initializations, the fraction of dynamic videos drops sharply during subsequent DMD training, indicating that the mode-seeking objective, not the initialization, drives this degradation. We propose Mass Forcing, a probability-mass-aware framework that moves on-policy DMD supervision from whole videos to individual states. Each update branches several continuations from a shared student-generated prefix, making the student's probability mass at that state measurable against the teacher. First, Mass Forcing estimates relative teacher-to-student density ratios among these continuations through latent-space score integration and uses them to rebalance conditional DMD updates, amplifying rollouts underrepresented relative to the teacher. Second, since mismatched mode probabilities do not necessarily induce strong local score corrections, it aligns generated rollout sets with a reweighted reference distribution defined by the same mass estimates, providing cross-rollout supervision. Experiments on MovieGen and VBench show that Mass Forcing improves video fidelity and sustains temporal dynamics throughout training, achieving the highest Total scores among compared methods and a Dynamic Degree of 83% after 1,000 generator updates, versus 12-32% for the baselines, with no additional inference-time overhead.

</details>


### [436] [DictaRashi: A State-of-the-Art OCR Model For Rashi Script](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29760)
*Ometz Shmidman,Yonah Taurog,Aryeh Sanders,Shlomo Bluth,Moshe Koppel,Joshua Geudalia,Avi Shmidman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文发布 DictaRashi，一个用于扫描版希伯来语“Rashi”字体书籍的 Tesseract OCR 模型，并在公开模型中达到新的最优效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扫描版希伯来语 Rashi 字体书籍缺乏高精度 OCR 工具，现有公开 Tesseract 模型识别错误率较高，影响相关文献的数字化与利用。

Method: 使用来自 100 多本书、超过 100 万行人工校正文本训练 DictaRashi；在 1120 行人工转写的 Rashi 字体扫描页测试集上评估，并与 31 个公开希伯来语 Tesseract 模型及前沿 LLM 进行比较。

Result: DictaRashi 达到 0.86% 字符错误率（CER）和 3.38% 词错误率（WER）；其他公开模型中最佳为 2.98% CER 和 11.86% WER。该模型还优于当前前沿 LLM 在该 OCR 任务上的表现。

Conclusion: DictaRashi 为公开可用的 Tesseract 模型树立了新的 state-of-the-art，并发布模型与测试集作为未来基准，采用 CC BY NC 4.0 许可。

Abstract: We release DictaRashi, a Tesseract OCR model for scanned Hebrew books printed in the so-called "Rashi" font. We trained DictaRashi on over one million manually corrected lines of text from over 100 different books of Rabbinic and post-Rabbinic literature. On a held-out set of 1,120 manually transcribed lines from scanned Rashi-script pages, DictaRashi reaches a character error rate (CER) of 0.86% and a word error rate (WER) of 3.38%, setting a new state-of-the-art for publicly-available Tesseract models. We provide a full comparison of our results to those of the 31 other publicly available Hebrew Tesseract models; the best of those models achieves a 2.98% CER and 11.86% WER. We further demonstrate that DictaRashi outperforms the current frontier LLMs on this OCR task. We release the test set of Rashi-script documents so that it may be used as a benchmark for future work in this area. We are pleased to release the model and test set to the community under a CC BY NC 4.0 license.

</details>


### [437] [Beyond Language Optimization: Enhancing Visual Representations for Radiology Report Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29783)
*Rui Zuo,Qinyue Tong,Ziqian Lu,Zheming Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出一种选择性区域视觉蒸馏框架，用于提升胸部X射线放射报告生成中对困难异常的视觉识别能力，并在不显著损害原有性能的前提下提高报告临床准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 准确的胸部X射线报告生成需要识别并描述临床相关异常。虽然GRPO能提升生成报告的临床准确性，但分析表明其对异常识别所需的视觉表征改进有限。

Method: 提出选择性区域视觉蒸馏框架：训练区域感知教师模型，对困难解剖区域进行针对性监督以获取互补视觉知识；通过区域特征替换验证教师特征效用，仅选择能提升学生模型性能的特征；引入空间门控残差适配器（SGRA）蒸馏已验证特征，以减少对学生原有视觉表征的干扰。

Result: 在MIMIC-CXR和IU-Xray上的实验表明，该方法在不同多模态大语言模型骨干上均提升了临床报告准确性和区域级异常识别能力，同时基本保持了非目标表现上的性能。

Conclusion: 选择性区域视觉蒸馏能够增强学生模型对困难异常的视觉表征，同时较好保留原有视觉能力，从而提升放射报告生成的临床准确性与区域级异常识别效果。

Abstract: Accurate chest X-ray radiology report generation (RRG) requires recognizing clinically relevant abnormalities and accurately describing them. Although Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) improves the clinical accuracy of generated reports, our analyses suggest limited improvements in visual representations for abnormality recognition. To address this limitation, we propose a selective regional visual distillation framework that enhances visual representations of challenging abnormalities while preserving existing visual capabilities. Specifically, we train a region-aware teacher with targeted supervision on challenging anatomical regions to acquire complementary visual knowledge. Rather than transferring all teacher features, we verify their utility through regional feature replacement and select only those that improve the original student's performance. We further introduce a Spatially Gated Residual Adapter (SGRA) to distill these verified features while minimizing interference with the student's existing visual representations. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR and IU-Xray demonstrate improved clinical report accuracy and region-level abnormality recognition across different multimodal large language model backbones, while largely preserving performance on non-target findings.

</details>


### [438] [CivicBench: Robust Detection of AI-Generated Political Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29766)
*Mert Onur Cakiroglu,Elham Buxton,Mehmet Dalkilic,Hasan Kurban*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 CivicBench，一个包含 10,800 个虚构政治人物生成视频和 2,632 个真实视频的政治视频检测基准，并揭示现有检测器易受对抗攻击；作者提出 Tau-Anchor，在攻击条件下显著提升检测鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 生成政治人物视频可冒充真实素材，真实视频也可能被诬称为假；平台依赖检测器，但上传者控制像素，现有政治视频数据集规模小、只含真实政客且不测试攻击。

Method: 构建 CivicBench：8 个开源生成器生成 10,800 个虚构政客视频，并收集 2,632 个公有领域或开放许可真实视频；每个片段可被攻击以隐藏伪造或构陷真实素材。提出 Tau-Anchor：微调在受攻击图像上预训练的编码器，训练时攻击真实与生成片段，并在部署阈值处加入 margin 项。

Result: 通用基准训练的已发表检测器在 CivicBench 上最高 AUC 仅 .781；每像素 1 个灰度级的对抗变化即可让几乎所有生成片段躲过未抗攻击检测器。攻击可达范围随预算近似线性增长。Tau-Anchor 达到 .941 AUC；在 2 灰度级下仍能标记 .668 的生成片段，而已发表检测器至多 .289；真实片段被构陷时，Tau-Anchor 误报仅从 8% 升至 14%，而四个已发表检测器在仅 1 灰度级下几乎标记所有被构陷真实片段。外部政治视频和两个通用基准呈相同模式。

Conclusion: 政治视频深伪检测需要同时评估隐藏伪造和构陷真实两类攻击；CivicBench 暴露现有检测器脆弱性，Tau-Anchor 在对抗条件下显著更鲁棒，但仍需关注真实素材误报上升。

Abstract: AI-generated video of politicians can pass for real footage, and once such fakes are common, real footage can be dismissed as fake. Platforms address both problems with detectors, but whoever uploads a clip controls its pixels. Existing datasets of political video are small, show real politicians, and test no attacks. We introduce CivicBench, with 10,800 generated clips of invented politicians from eight open generators and 2,632 public-domain or openly licensed real clips. Each clip can be attacked, to hide a fake or to frame real footage. Published detectors trained on a general benchmark reach at most .781 AUC on CivicBench. Adversarial changes of 1 gray level per pixel hide nearly every generated clip from the detectors not built to resist attacks. An attack's reach is how far it can move a clip's score. A clip keeps its label when its margin from the threshold exceeds this reach, and we find that the reach grows almost linearly with the budget. On this basis, we propose Tau-Anchor, which fine-tunes an encoder pretrained on attacked images. It attacks real and generated clips during training and adds a margin term at its deployed threshold. It reaches .941 AUC on CivicBench. It also keeps .668 of generated clips flagged at 2 gray levels, against at most .289 for published detectors. When real clips are framed at the same 2 gray levels, Tau-Anchor's false alarms rise only from 8% to 14%, whereas four published detectors flag nearly every framed real clip at just 1 gray level. External political footage and two general benchmarks show the same pattern under attack. Code and data are available at https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/CivicBench.

</details>


### [439] [Continuous-time 4D Reconstruction via Event-guided Latent Feature Interpolation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29838)
*Gwangtak Bae,Seunggu Kang,Junho Kim,Eun Sun Lee,Changwoon Choi,Young Min Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种连续时间4D重建方法，可在任意时刻提取3D结构和相机位姿，并利用事件相机测量提供微秒级时间引导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有几何基础模型能将视频序列转换为配准点云，但无法预测观测时间分辨率之外的时刻；事件相机虽能提供连续时间证据，却难以直接集成到基于RGB的基础模型中。

Method: 将问题建模为潜特征空间中的插值，并在图像空间加入事件损失作为辅助任务；提出自监督训练框架，利用估计几何的伪真值标签和由高帧率RGB视频生成的模拟事件来缓解配对训练数据不足。

Result: 实验表明，该方法优于对输入RGB视频或估计几何进行时间插值的基线，能泛化到未见过的真实场景，并在运动模糊和低光照等合成损坏条件下保持鲁棒。

Conclusion: 结合基础模型几何先验、事件相机物理引导和自监督训练，可有效实现连续时间4D重建，并提升跨场景泛化性与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Recent geometric foundation models can successfully convert a video sequence into frames of registered point clouds, but cannot predict moments beyond the observed temporal resolution. We propose a continuous-time 4D reconstruction method that extracts 3D structure and camera poses at any time instant, with additional guidance from event-camera measurements. While event cameras provide evidence at microsecond resolution to continuously fill the temporal gap, integrating them into existing RGB-based foundation models remains challenging. We formulate the problem as interpolation in the latent feature space and augment event-based losses in the image space as an auxiliary task to boost accuracy. Operating in the latent space leverages the powerful geometric priors of foundation models, while the event loss provides physically grounded guidance. To effectively address the lack of paired training data, we further propose a self-supervised training framework that uses pseudo-ground-truth labels of estimated geometry and simulated events generated from high-frame-rate RGB videos. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that the proposed pipeline outperforms baselines that temporally interpolate either the input RGB videos or the estimated geometry, and that it generalizes to unseen real-world scenarios. Controlled experiments with synthetic corruptions show that it remains robust under motion-blur and low-light conditions.

</details>


### [440] [Ego2Wrist: Bootstrapping Wrist-View Synthesis from Egocentric Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29850)
*Ziyao Zeng,Xiatao Sun,Hao Wang,Ziyu Guo,Youheng Yao,Jingcheng Ni,Shenyuan Gao,Fengyu Yang,Renrui Zhang,Bangya Liu,Daniel Rakita*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 Ego2Wrist，从人类头戴式自我中心视频和任务描述中合成同步腕部相机视角，用于生成机器人操作训练所需的真实腕视角视频。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 腕部相机视角与机器人操作直接相关，但大规模采集人类腕部视频困难且会干扰自然手部动作；头戴式自我中心视频更易扩展，因此希望从头视角生成腕视角。

Method: 基于约940小时配对的头和腕部相机数据训练 Ego2Wrist，联合生成三个视角；提出无需真值的以手为中心的跨视角一致性指标 HCC，用于评估生成腕视角与输入头视角中手部区域的一致性，并支持递归自改进训练。

Result: HCC 的模型排序与基于真值的 LPIPS 相当，人类评估者在77%的回答中偏好 HCC 选出的生成结果；在四个数据集上，Ego2Wrist 相比微调后的 WorldWander 将 LPIPS 降低28%，获得76%的人类偏好；通过 HCC 选择生成腕视角进行递归自改进，三轮后生成质量逐步提升。

Conclusion: Ego2Wrist 提供了一种可扩展的方法来生成真实世界腕视角人类操作视频，可用于机器人策略训练。

Abstract: Wrist cameras provide an action-centric view that is directly relevant to robot manipulation. However, collecting human wrist-camera videos at scale is challenging due to cumbersome setups that can interfere with natural hand movements. In contrast, head-mounted human egocentric videos are much easier to scale. We introduce Ego2Wrist, which synthesizes synchronized wrist-camera views from human egocentric videos and task descriptions. Trained on approximately 940 hours of paired head- and wrist-camera recordings, Ego2Wrist jointly generates three views. To evaluate generated wrist views without ground truth, we propose hand-centric cross-view consistency (HCC), which measures consistency between generated wrist views and corresponding hand regions in the input head view. HCC ranks model checkpoints comparably to ground-truth-based LPIPS, and human evaluators prefer HCC-selected generations in 77% of responses. Evaluated on four datasets, Ego2Wrist outperforms fine-tuned WorldWander, reducing LPIPS by 28% and receiving human preference in 76% of responses. More importantly, HCC facilitates recursive self-improvement on in-the-wild egocentric videos by selecting generated wrist views for further training. Generation quality progressively improves over three rounds. These results demonstrate a scalable approach to generating real-world wrist-view human manipulation videos for robot policy training.

</details>


### [441] [Towards Agentic Video Corpus Moment Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29877)
*Chenwei Xu,Shang Wu,Zhenyu Pan,Jianshu Zhang,Pranav Maneriker,Lie Lu,Fan Du,Manling Li,Han Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RELAY 是一个无需训练的 Video Corpus Moment Retrieval 框架，通过跨查询共享记忆，分搜索、排序、定位三阶段完成视频与时间片段检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VCMR 需要在视频语料中同时找到匹配文本查询的视频及时间区间；作者希望在不训练模型的情况下利用跨查询共享信息提升检索与定位效果。

Method: RELAY 分三阶段：搜索阶段用嵌入模型按最佳匹配帧打分，并用查询库惩罚对批内多个查询都高分的视频；排序阶段由 VLM 一次性为候选视频场景、人物、物体和动作写笔记，再由 LLM 重排；定位阶段由 VLM 预测最高排名视频中的时间区间，并在多个查询选中同一视频时用 prompt caching 复用帧。另用一个在少量标注查询上校准的 margin 调整预测区间。

Result: 在三个 VERIFIED 基准上，RELAY 无需训练即在视频检索 R@1 上超过训练基线；其预测区间短于标注区间，人类标注者也倾向更短片段。VCMR 上，它在一个基准上接近 VideoSearch-R1，但在另两个基准的 IoU 0.5 上落后。校准 margin 后，RELAY 在 VCMR IoU 0.5 上超过训练基线。

Conclusion: RELAY 表明无需训练的跨查询记忆机制可有效用于 VCMR；预测区间与基准标注惯例存在偏差，简单校准可弥合该差距并提升最终定位性能。

Abstract: Video corpus moment retrieval (VCMR) requires finding the video and time interval that match a text query in a corpus of videos. We present RELAY, a training-free framework for VCMR that shares memory across queries. RELAY processes a batch of queries in three stages: search with a query bank, ranking with video notes, and localization with video prompt caching. In the search stage, an embedding model scores each video by its best-matching frame. The query bank penalizes videos that score highly for many other queries in the batch. In the ranking stage, a vision-language model (VLM) writes notes on each candidate video's scenes, people, objects, and actions once. Then, a large language model (LLM) reranks the candidates from these notes. In the localization stage, a VLM predicts the time interval of the moment in the top-ranked video. When multiple queries select the same video, prompt caching lets the VLM reuse its frames. On the three VERIFIED benchmarks, RELAY outperforms the trained baselines in video retrieval R@1 without training. Without any labeled moment, its predicted intervals are shorter than the annotated ones. In VCMR, it achieves similar performance to VideoSearch-R1 on one benchmark and trails it at IoU 0.5 on the other two. Human annotators also mark shorter moments than the original annotations of the benchmarks. A single margin, calibrated on a few labeled queries, widens the predicted interval to the annotation convention of the benchmarks. With it, RELAY outperforms the trained baselines in VCMR at IoU 0.5.

</details>


### [442] [Segment Anything In-Context via Visual Demonstrations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29896)
*Yuzhu Wang,Manni Duan,Hongliang Ye,Shu Kong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 SAYD，一种基于视觉示例的上下文分割基础模型。它利用提示图像及其分割掩码，与查询图像建立视觉对应，从而分割查询图像中的连贯区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分割方法难以处理未见过、难以用语言明确描述或需要隐性视觉知识的任务，因此需要一种能通过视觉示例进行上下文分割并具备强泛化能力的模型。

Method: SAYD 使用提示图像和对应分割掩码作为视觉示例，在查询图像中建立视觉对应以完成分割；在12个全景分割公开数据集上训练，并提出轻量级掩码解码器实现与提示无关的掩码生成，以及识别提示中未出现的新查询类别的学习机制。

Result: 在24个域外基准上，涵盖自然、生物、生态、宇宙、医学、病理和卫星图像等领域，SAYD显著优于现有的上下文分割和开放词汇分割方法。

Conclusion: SAYD 能泛化到未见过的分割任务，并通过所提训练技术提升计算效率和域外泛化能力，展示了视觉示例驱动的上下文分割基础模型的有效性。

Abstract: We present the Segment Anything Model via Visual Demonstrations (SAYD), a foundation model for in-context segmentation. Given visual demos comprising prompt images and their segmentation masks, SAYD segments coherent regions (e.g., objects or their parts) in a query image by establishing visual correspondences between the prompts and the query. SAYD generalizes to previously-unseen segmentation tasks, including those requiring tacit visual knowledge or involving concepts that are difficult to articulate unambiguously in language. We train SAYD on 12 public datasets originally curated for panoptic segmentation using our proposed techniques, including a lightweight mask decoder for prompt-agnostic mask generation and a learning mechanism for recognizing novel query classes absent in the prompts. These innovations enhance both computational efficiency and out-of-domain generalization. Consequently, SAYD significantly outperforms existing methods of in-context segmentation and open-vocabulary segmentation across 24 out-of-domain benchmarks, spanning natural, biological, ecological, cosmological, medical, pathological, and satellite imagery.

</details>


### [443] [Benchmarking VLM Medical Hallucination across 5 Modalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29934)
*Zhixing Cao,Yusen Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出医学幻觉基准 Multi-Med，包含跨五种医学影像模态的1000个图像-问题对，并系统评估10个常用视觉语言模型在五模态、四类问题上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学领域视觉语言模型的幻觉问题仍难以理解，已有医学幻觉基准对多种医学影像模态的覆盖不足，模型失效位置尚不明确。

Method: 构建 Multi-Med 医学幻觉基准，覆盖五种影像模态、共1000个图像-问题对；在五种模态和四类问题上对10个广泛使用的视觉语言模型开展深入实验研究。

Result: 模型性能因影像模态和问题类型不同而存在显著差异；表现最好的模型之间差异在统计上不显著。

Conclusion: 医学视觉语言模型的幻觉表现具有明显的模态和问题类型依赖性，现有顶尖模型之间未显示出统计显著优势，仍需更全面理解模型失效机制。

Abstract: Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) within the medical domain remain a difficult and not well-understood problem, and it is still unclear where these models break down. Although several benchmarks targeting medical hallucination have been introduced, they often lack broad coverage across different medical imaging modalities. We introduce Multi-Med, a medical hallucination benchmark containing 1,000 image-question pairs spanning five distinct modalities. Using this benchmark, we perform an in-depth experimental study of 10 widely used VLMs across five modalities and four question categories. Our findings indicate that model performance differs substantially depending on the imaging modality and question type, and that the differences among the best-performing models are not statistically significant.

</details>


### [444] [SpectralRoute: Adaptive Spectral Routing for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Hyperspectral Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29919)
*Qingmei Li,Xiaoya Fan,Juepeng Zheng,Jianxi Huang,Haohuan Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SpectralRoute，一种无需训练的开词汇高光谱语义分割框架，通过互补光谱视图、外部光谱知识增强类别描述、类自适应光谱路由和物理光谱先验，使冻结视觉语言模型有效利用高光谱信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放词汇分割方法多面向三通道光学或有限波段多光谱影像，预训练视觉语言模型难以直接利用高光谱丰富光谱信息；同时不同地物类别依赖不同光谱线索，统一融合可能削弱判别性光谱响应。

Method: 从高光谱影像构建互补光谱视图，并利用外部光谱知识丰富类别描述，使冻结视觉语言模型提取多样化的光谱-语义响应；设计类自适应光谱路由机制，为每个类别选择性放大判别性光谱响应；引入物理光谱先验细化视觉相似地物类别的预测。

Result: 在三个高光谱基准数据集上，SpectralRoute 无需额外训练即持续优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: 结果表明，无需训练框架结合类自适应光谱路由与物理光谱先验，可有效将视觉语言模型扩展到开放词汇高光谱语义分割任务。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation enables the recognition of arbitrary categories through natural language descriptions and has recently been extended from natural images to remote sensing. However, existing approaches primarily focus on three-channel optical imagery or limited-band multispectral data, while pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) struggle to directly exploit the rich spectral information of hyperspectral imagery (HSI) without additional adaptation. More importantly, different land-cover categories rely on distinct spectral cues, which may be weakened by uniform fusion. To address these challenges, we propose SpectralRoute, a training-free framework for open-vocabulary hyperspectral segmentation. Specifically, we construct complementary spectral views from HSI and enrich category descriptions with external spectral knowledge, enabling frozen vision-language models to extract diverse spectral-semantic responses. We then introduce a class-adaptive spectral routing mechanism that selectively amplifies discriminative spectral responses for each category, overcoming the limitations of uniform fusion. Furthermore, physical spectral priors are incorporated to refine predictions for visually similar land-cover categories. Experiments on three hyperspectral benchmarks demonstrate that SpectralRoute consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods without additional training.

</details>


### [445] [Dynamic Gaussian Scene Reconstruction by Integrating Events and Structural Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29920)
*Zihao Yu,Guozhen Liu,Jie Yan,Jialiang Liu,Panlong Tan,Qinglin Sun,Hao Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ESC-DGR，利用事件观测独立于现有高斯支撑与光度优化收敛假设，协同完成动态高斯重建中的支撑增强、可靠运动参考选择与目标时刻残差预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有事件驱动动态高斯重建依赖两个假设：已有高斯可吸收重建误差，且光度优化已充分收敛以用解析方差估计可靠性。快速运动下这两个假设可能失效，导致无高斯支撑区域无法生成致密化候选，未收敛运动区域的高斯也可能被排除为运动参考。

Method: 提出事件-结构协同动态高斯重建（ESC-DGR）。事件首先识别需要额外支撑的变化，并仅在渲染深度有效处放置支撑；利用在线渲染统计和历史事件证据，将可靠高斯的位移估计传播到弱观测邻域；再用目标时刻事件对活动高斯的有限位置残差进行条件约束。支撑放置、参考选择和残差预测在同一优化运行中的同一演化表示上完成。

Result: 在E-D3DGS基准的事件驱动单目动态场景重建中取得所评估方法中的最佳重建质量。相比E-D3DGS，合成与真实场景的动态区域PSNR（dPSNR）分别提升1.02和1.45 dB；八个合成场景的动态高斯总数减少8.5%。平均帧率相对E-D3DGS下降约21%-25%，但十二个场景渲染均保持80 FPS以上。

Conclusion: ESC-DGR通过统一利用事件观测、在线渲染统计与历史事件证据，缓解快速运动下支撑不足和运动参考不可靠的问题，在提升动态重建质量与减少高斯数量的同时保持实时渲染能力。

Abstract: Existing approaches to event-based dynamic Gaussian reconstruction rely on two assumptions for support augmentation and reliability estimation. First, existing Gaussians can absorb reconstruction errors. Second, photometric optimization has converged sufficiently to estimate reliability using analytical variance. Both assumptions can fail under fast motion. When the first fails, regions without Gaussian support cannot generate densification candidates. When the second fails, Gaussians in moving regions where optimization has not converged may be excluded as motion references. We propose Event-Structure Collaborative Dynamic Gaussian Reconstruction (ESC-DGR), using event observations independent of both conditions. Events first identify changes that require additional support, placed only where rendered depth is valid. The augmented representation still needs reliable motion references. Online rendering statistics and historical event evidence therefore propagate displacement estimates from reliable Gaussians to weakly observed neighborhoods. These references describe dominant motion at the frame-interval timescale. Target-time events therefore further condition bounded position residuals for active Gaussians. Support placement, reference selection, and residual prediction thus operate on the same evolving representation within one optimization run. For event-driven monocular dynamic scene reconstruction, our method achieves the best reconstruction quality among the evaluated methods on the E-D3DGS benchmark. Relative to E-D3DGS, dynamic-region PSNR (dPSNR) improves by 1.02 and 1.45 dB on synthetic and real scenes, respectively. The total dynamic Gaussian count across eight synthetic scenes decreases by 8.5%. Although mean frame rate decreases by about 21%-25% relative to E-D3DGS, rendering remains above 80 FPS in all twelve scenes. Code: https://github.com/zh-yu1/ESC-DGR.

</details>


### [446] [KGLP-Net: Kalman-Reliable Global--Local Learning With Group Fisher Pruning for Hyperspectral Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29944)
*Wenshuai Deng,Wen Xie,Abdel Hamid Soliman,Qianzheng Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出KGLP-Net统一框架，将不确定性感知的全局-局部特征融合与可靠性引导的结构化剪枝相结合，用于高光谱图像分类，并在多个公开数据集上实现高精度与轻量化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高光谱图像分类需要同时利用大范围空间上下文和目标像素邻域的细粒度光谱-空间信息，但不同异质场景中两类表示可靠性差异较大，且特征融合中的不确定性很少用于指导模型压缩。

Method: 采用非对称双视图架构：Global Mamba Encoder提取长程空间依赖，Local CNN Encoder提取邻域细粒度光谱-空间特征；提出Kalman-Reliable Fusion（KRF）在特征空间估计相对不确定性，并以Kalman式后验更新融合全局先验与局部观测；进一步提出Kalman-Reliable Group Fisher Pruning（KRGF），用归一化后验精度量化组级可靠性，并与Group Fisher重要性结合剪枝Kalman耦合通道组。

Result: 在四个公开HSI数据集上，剪枝后的Compact48（隐藏宽度48）在十个代表性对比分类器中取得最高总体精度；相比未剪枝Dense64，参数量、FLOPs和推理时间平均分别减少38.5%、34.8%和37.6%，平均总体精度仅下降0.03个百分点。

Conclusion: KGLP-Net能够通过可靠性感知融合提升全局-局部特征整合效果，并利用融合不确定性指导结构化剪枝，在保持分类精度的同时显著降低模型计算与存储开销。

Abstract: Accurate hyperspectral image (HSI) classification requires both the effective integration of broad spatial context and fine-grained spectral--spatial information surrounding target pixels. However, the reliability of these complementary representations may vary considerably across heterogeneous scenes, and uncertainty estimates obtained during feature fusion are rarely exploited to guide subsequent model compression. To address these challenges, we propose Kalman-Reliable Global--Local Learning with Group Fisher Pruning (KGLP-Net), a unified framework that couples uncertainty-aware feature fusion with reliability-guided structured pruning. Specifically, an asymmetric dual-view architecture employs a Global Mamba Encoder to capture long-range spatial dependencies and a Local CNN Encoder to extract fine-grained spectral--spatial features from target neighborhoods. To adaptively integrate these complementary representations, Kalman-Reliable Fusion (KRF) estimates their relative uncertainties in feature space and performs a Kalman-inspired posterior update, treating global features as a contextual prior and local features as an observation. Building upon the resulting posterior uncertainty, Kalman-Reliable Group Fisher Pruning (KRGF) quantifies group-level reliability through normalized posterior precision and integrates it with Group Fisher importance to identify and prune Kalman-coupled channel groups, enabling structurally consistent model compression. Experiments on four public HSI datasets demonstrate that the resulting Compact48 model, with a hidden width of 48, achieves the highest overall accuracy among ten representative competing classifiers. Compared with the unpruned Dense64 model, Compact48 reduces the number of parameters, FLOPs, and inference time by 38.5%, 34.8% and 37.6% on average, respectively, while incurring only a 0.03-percentage-point decrease in mean overall accuracy.

</details>


### [447] [Revisiting RadioGalaxyNET: modern detectors for radio galaxy detection and host identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29798)
*Argo Saakyan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在 RadioGalaxyNET 基准上训练 D-FINE-seg、YOLO26-pose 和 RF-DETR 三个当前检测器，用基准自带评测代码打分（能精确复现 Gal-DINO 已发表数值），三者均超过 2023 年最好已发表结果，并系统披露了该基准评测协议与标签标注中的若干问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RadioGalaxyNET 是用于在 EMU 试点巡天图像中寻找延展射电星系、对其分类并定位红外宿主天体的公开基准，但其最佳公开结果仍停留在 2023 年的 54.5 box AP（Gal-YOLOv8）和 48.1 host 关键点 AP（Gal-DINO），需要检验当前检测器能达到什么水平，并为基准使用者提供实用信息。

Method: 在同一数据上训练三个当代检测器 D-FINE-seg、YOLO26-pose 与 RF-DETR，使用基准自带的官方评测代码打分，该代码可精确复现已发表的 Gal-DINO 结果；同时对比端到端速度与同尺寸引擎速度；并对基准本身进行分析，包括打分协议、宿主标签位置、框标签偏移以及图像可由公开巡天数据重建的特性；此外提出以宿主识别 F1 作为更贴近星表实际使用的指标。

Result: 全部模型超过已发表结果。D-FINE-seg M 达到 67.1 box AP 和 72.4 host AP，分别高出最好已发表结果 12.6 和 24.3 点，在测试的检测器中宿主 AP 最高，box 上与 YOLO26 持平；其宿主优势主要来自占基准多数的宿主居中图像。端到端速度上 D-FINE-seg S 最快，为每图 1.9 ms，但同尺寸引擎对引擎比较时 YOLO26 更快。宿主识别 F1：D-FINE-seg M 71.8、YOLO26-pose M 70.5、RF-DETR 63.8、Gal-DINO 59.2。分析还发现：评测协议会额外增加 5 到 10 AP，宿主标签位于图像中心，框标签相对图像有 1.5 像素偏移，且图像可由公开巡天数据重建，从而恢复天球位置并兼作额外训练数据。

Conclusion: 当前检测器显著优于该基准已发表结果，D-FINE-seg M 综合表现最佳。作者建议未来工作报告宿主识别 F1，以更贴近星表制作的评估需求；并提醒基准使用者注意评测协议带来的 5 到 10 AP 虚高、宿主标签居中与框标签 1.5 像素偏移等约定，同时指出基准图像可由公开巡天数据重建，可用于恢复天球坐标并扩充训练集。

Abstract: RadioGalaxyNET is the public benchmark for finding extended radio galaxies in EMU pilot-survey images, classifying them and locating their infrared hosts. Its best published results date from 2023: 54.5 box AP (Gal-YOLOv8) and 48.1 host keypoint AP (Gal-DINO). We train three current detectors, D-FINE-seg, YOLO26-pose and RF-DETR, on the same data and score them with the benchmark's own evaluation code, which reproduces the published Gal-DINO numbers exactly. All exceed the published results. D-FINE-seg M reaches 67.1 box AP and 72.4 host AP, 12.6 and 24.3 points above the best published results, and the highest host AP of the detectors we tested; on boxes it is level with YOLO26. Its host lead over YOLO26 comes from host-centered images, which make up most of the benchmark. End to end, D-FINE-seg S is the fastest model at 1.9 ms per image; engine against engine, YOLO26 is faster at the same size. We also report what matters for anyone using the benchmark: its scoring protocol adds 5 to 10 AP, its host labels sit at the image center, its box labels are offset from the image by 1.5 pixels, and its images can be rebuilt from the public survey data, which recovers sky positions and doubles as extra training data. We suggest that future work report host identification F1, as a measure closer to catalog use: D-FINE-seg M 71.8, YOLO26-pose M 70.5, RF-DETR 63.8, Gal-DINO 59.2.

</details>


### [448] [Reparameterizing Your Object Detectors for Weight Space Programming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29882)
*Chien-Yao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 IR-ODWSP，一种无需反向传播的目标检测权重空间编程方法，通过函数保持的逆重参数化将检测器层映射到多个解耦子空间，实现稳定的权重编辑，并在多类检测器与多个场景中提升性能且支持无重训练延迟调节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Weight-Space Programming 可直接编辑网络权重而无需反向传播，但直接编辑已收敛目标检测器会停滞或崩溃：集合预测会把重复框当作假阳性惩罚，紧凑参数化又使权重陷入各向同性欧氏极小值。

Method: 提出 Inverse-Reparameterized Object-Detection WSP（IR-ODWSP），用精确函数保持算子（E、C）将检测器层提升到解耦的矩、2D-DCT、PCA 和 Stiefel-Procrustes 子空间；采用 winner-exclusive 更新并折叠回原空间（Delta Params=0%，Delta FLOPs=0%），从而诱导各向异性黎曼度量；并给出 bridged contraction、1.00x folding、动态 IR-ODWSP-DYN 和静态 IR-ODWSP-SG 等图结构。

Result: 在 17 个 YOLO26、EdgeCrafter 和 RF-DETR 检测器上，26/26 个 MS COCO 设置均提升，最高 +0.31 APs；COCO-O 跨域 +1.42 mAP，零图像修复 +2.95 mAP，无标签天气自适应 +2.79 AP。无需重训练即可支持 -100% 到 +100% 延迟预算：-10% 仍保留 51.62 AP / 33.48 mAP；+10% 提升 +0.30 AP，RF-DETR-N 上 +1.12；+100% 达 54.83 AP；IR-ODWSP+ 达 55.91 AP / 35.44 mAP。

Conclusion: IR-ODWSP 能稳定实现目标检测器的权重空间编程，在多种检测器、域偏移和延迟预算下取得一致提升，并支持无需重训练的延迟适配与性能扩展。

Abstract: Weight-Space Programming (WSP) edits network weights without backpropagation, yet directly editing converged object detectors stalls or collapses because set prediction penalizes duplicate boxes as false positives while compact parameterizations trap weights in an isotropic Euclidean minimum. We propose Inverse-Reparameterized Object-Detection WSP (IR-ODWSP), lifting detector layers via exact function-preserving operators (E, C) into decoupled moment, 2D-DCT, PCA, and Stiefel-Procrustes subspaces. Solving winner-exclusive updates and folding back (Delta Params=0%, Delta FLOPs=0%) induces an anisotropic Riemannian metric, improving all 26/26 MS COCO settings across 17 YOLO26, EdgeCrafter, and RF-DETR detectors (up to +0.31 APs), +1.42 mAP cross-basin COCO-O, zeroimage repair (+2.95 mAP), and label-free weather adaptation (+2.79 AP). Without retraining, IR-ODWSP supports -100% to +100% latency budgets across bridged contraction, 1.00x folding, dynamic (IR-ODWSP-DYN), and static (IR-ODWSP-SG) graphs: -10% retains 51.62 AP / 33.48 mAP, while positive budgets scale monotonically (+0.30 AP at +10%, +1.12 on RF-DETR-N; 54.83 AP at +100%; 55.91 AP / 35.44 mAP in IR-ODWSP+). Source code is released at https://github.com/WongKinYiu/ODWSP.

</details>


### [449] [When Should We Trust Medical Image Models? Evaluating Confidence Reliability under Cross-Dataset Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29955)
*Haoran Zhang,Sarah Lam,Yuting Lin,Nuo Chen,Mingyang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究系统评估胸部X射线深度学习模型在跨数据集部署时的预测性能与置信度可靠性，发现跨域AUC显著下降，且源域温度缩放会提高错误预测的置信度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床中模型常从一个医院系统迁移到另一个医院系统，数据分布和标注差异可能影响预测准确性与模型置信度，因此需要明确跨数据集部署下的可靠性问题。

Method: 在CheXpert上训练ResNet-50和DenseNet-121，并在MIMIC-CXR上测试，围绕Pneumothorax和Pleural Effusion设置五种实验；用AUC评估性能，用ECE、Brier分数和错误预测平均置信度评估置信可靠性，并报告95% bootstrap置信区间；同时评估源域验证集拟合的温度缩放，并用Grad-CAM分析跨域差异机制。

Result: 跨域AUC下降7-13个百分点，域内最佳模型不一定是跨域最佳模型；源域温度缩放对ECE影响有限，但在四组模型-病理组合中均系统性提高错误预测置信度；Grad-CAM显示DenseNet依赖难以迁移的集中空间先验，而ResNet更分散的注意力具有更好泛化性。

Conclusion: 医疗AI评估应重视跨站点验证，并引入面向安全性的校准指标；仅依赖源域校准可能掩盖跨域部署中的错误置信问题。

Abstract: Deep learning models for chest X-ray analysis often achieve strong performance on benchmark datasets, but their reliability under cross-dataset deployment remains unclear. In clinical practice, models trained in one hospital system may be applied to data from another, where distributional and labeling differences can affect both prediction accuracy and model confidence.
  We conduct a controlled empirical study of model confidence under cross-dataset transfer. We train ResNet-50 and DenseNet-121 on CheXpert and evaluate them on MIMIC-CXR across five experimental settings, focusing on Pneumothorax and Pleural Effusion. We measure predictive performance using AUC and confidence reliability using Expected Calibration Error (ECE), Brier score, and average confidence on incorrect predictions, all reported with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. We further evaluate post-hoc temperature scaling fit on the source validation set and use Grad-CAM to examine the mechanism behind cross-domain performance differences.
  Cross-domain AUC drops 7-13 percentage points, and the best in-domain model is not the best cross-domain model. Source-domain temperature scaling produces marginal ECE changes but systematically increases confidence on incorrect predictions across all four model-pathology combinations. Grad-CAM reveals that DenseNet relies on a concentrated spatial prior that fails to transfer, while ResNet's more distributed attention generalizes better. These findings argue for cross-site validation and safety-specific calibration metrics in medical AI evaluation.

</details>


### [450] [One Size Doesn't Fit All: Input Adaptive Class Activation Mapping for Improved Visual Explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29993)
*Ayesha Sahar,Tahir Mustafa Madni,Tehseen Zia,David Windridge,Uzair Iqbal Janjua,Waleed Umar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出ADAPT-CAM，一种基于梯度且参数自适应的类激活图框架，用于提升CNN和ViT模型解释的定位精度与架构适应性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CAM方法在通道加权、定位和跨网络架构适应性方面存在不足，可能产生噪声大或不精确的解释，影响安全关键应用中的信任与采用。

Method: ADAPT-CAM结合一阶梯度能量与激活加权的二阶曲率来计算通道贡献，并引入自适应局部对比度归一化和膝点引导的软通道选择；关键参数针对每个输入独立估计，以适配不同网络架构的特征表示。

Result: 在ImageNet和Oxford 102 Flowers上，跨CNN和ViT架构的定量评估显示ADAPT-CAM在多个指标上达到竞争性或更优性能；定性比较表明其能突出判别性图像区域，参数分析和消融实验验证了各自适应组件的作用。

Conclusion: ADAPT-CAM在不同架构和数据集上具有适用性，可提供更精确且适应性更强的模型解释。

Abstract: Despite their widespread use in tasks such as image classification, object detection and semantic segmentation, the limited interpretability of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs) can undermine trust and hinder adoption in safety-critical applications. Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) methods seek to address this by providing human-understandable explanations for model predictions. Class Activation Maps (CAM) constitute one such widely used XAI technique for visualizing discriminative regions. However, existing CAM methods may exhibit limitations in channel weighting, localization, and adaptability across network architectures potentially resulting in noisy or imprecise explanations. To address these issues, we propose ADAPT-CAM, a gradient-based, parameter-adaptive CAM framework. The method combines first-order gradient energy with activation-weighted second-order curvature to derive channel contributions. It further incorporates adaptive local contrast normalization and knee-guided soft channel selection to refine the resulting explanations. Importantly, key parameters are estimated independently for each input, allowing the framework to adapt to variations in feature representations across network architectures. We validate ADAPT-CAM on ImageNet and Oxford 102 Flowers across CNN and ViT architectures. Quantitative results demonstrate competitive or superior performance against established CAM methods across multiple evaluation metrics. In parallel, qualitative comparisons illustrate its ability to highlight discriminative image regions. Further parameter analysis and ablation experiments examine the behaviour and contributions of the individual adaptive components. These findings demonstrate the applicability of ADAPT-CAM across different architectures and datasets.

</details>


### [451] [3AGameFactory-Motion: Agentic Rigging and Reliable Complex Motion Generation for Diverse 3D Assets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30013)
*Bohan Zeng,Kaixin Zhu,Yifan Yang,Dongge Yu,Zihao Wu,Yifan Dai,Zhou Liu,Junbo Niu,Xiaochen Ma,Shiran Ge,Zimo Meng,Junzhu Liang,Huanyao Zhang,Jinhang Liu,Tianqi Xiao,Jinhao Zhang,Tianyi Bai,Zhixiong Zeng,Penghao Zhao,Yuanbo Peng,Key Zhang,Wentao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 DivDynBench，用于评估六类形态资产的绑定与指令驱动运动生成，并系统比较三类运动生成范式，进而提出 Agentic Motion Framework。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有运动基准多聚焦常规人体或动物骨架及简单指令，难以评估任意3D资产在复杂多阶段协调、时序、角度、重复和轨迹约束下的绑定与运动生成能力。

Method: 构建 DivDynBench，覆盖六种形态类别和带复杂约束的指令；借助大语言模型系统比较专用运动生成、先生成视频再恢复运动、以及智能体直接驱动生成三种范式；分析其控制能力、跨形态适应性和生成成本；提出由智能体编写紧凑参数化骨架与运动程序、确定性执行器完成绑定、运动学求解和几何校正的 Agentic Motion Framework。

Result: 比较揭示了三类范式在控制能力、跨形态适应性和成本上的差异；所提框架通过紧凑参数控制降低生成开销，并提升绑定可靠性和运动控制精度。

Conclusion: 紧凑参数化与确定性执行相结合的智能体式框架为复杂3D运动生成部署提供了实用指导，并展示了在多样形态资产上兼顾可靠绑定与精确运动控制的潜力。

Abstract: Animating arbitrary 3D assets from instructions requires both structural inference and motion control, yet existing motion benchmarks mostly cover conventional human or animal skeletons with simple instructions. We introduce DivDynBench, which evaluates rigging and motion generation across six morphology categories, with instructions requiring multi-phase part coordination and explicit timing, angle, repetition, and trajectory constraints. With large language models, we systematically compare three common paradigms: specialized motion generation, video generation followed by motion recovery, and direct agent-driven generation. We analyze their control capabilities, cross-morphology adaptability, and generation costs. Guided by this comparison, we propose an Agentic Motion Framework in which an agent writes compact parametric skeleton and motion programs, and a deterministic executor performs rigging, kinematic solving, and geometric correction. Compact parameter control reduces generation overhead and improves rigging reliability and motion-control accuracy, providing practical guidance for deploying complex 3D motion generation.

</details>


### [452] [FASCIA: Seeing Beneath the Surface with Queryable, Personalized Anatomy in Any Pose](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29970)
*R. James Cotton,Tim Unger,Lucinda Williamson*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FASCIA 是一个以 MHR 为锚点的框架，可从外部体型和骨骼比例预测并摆姿个体内部解剖结构，并在 CT 和全身 MRI 上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人体内部解剖因个体而异，即使外形相同也可能不同；研究希望从外部形状推断内部结构，并仅依赖 MHR 拟合即可由图像、视频或动作数据驱动个体化数字孪生。

Method: FASCIA 将包含 290 个结构的群体模板通过平滑可逆形变映射到个体；用依赖体型的 Gaussian 先验预测平均形变坐标及个体间变异；形变将学习到的基础模板变形为骨骼、肌肉、器官和脂肪库；将 MHR skinning 扩展到内部以直接监督模型，并在四个自动标注 CT 队列和一个全身 MRI 队列上训练。

Result: 在 82 例留出 CT 上，命名骨骼平均体积 Dice 为 0.48，肌肉为 0.63，多数骨骼和肌肉保持完整，并给出校准的体素概率；在 33 例留出全身 MRI 受试者上，逐点场在所有分区上优于 HIT 的组织重叠，能预测全身脂肪百分比的人际差异（女性 R²=0.88 vs 0.38，男性 R²=0.54 vs -0.01），并将分割质心恢复到 1.1 mm 内。

Conclusion: FASCIA 只需一个 MHR 拟合即可运行，因此可由图像、视频或任何输出 MHR 的系统驱动，为基于视频动作数据拟合个体化、校准的肌肉骨骼数字孪生提供了可能。

Abstract: We present FASCIA (*Functional Anatomical Structures and Composition via Implicit Atlas*), a Momentum Human Rig (MHR)-anchored framework that predicts and poses a person's internal anatomy from their external body shape and skeletal proportions. FASCIA maps a single 290-structure population template onto each individual through a smooth, invertible warp. As people with the same shape can differ internally, a body-dependent Gaussian prior predicts both average warp coordinates and their inter-subject variability. The warp deforms a learned base template into bones, muscles, organs, and fat depots. Extending MHR skinning into the interior enables direct supervision of this model across four automatically labeled CT cohorts and one whole-body MRI cohort. On 82 held-out CT scans, FASCIA reaches a mean volumetric Dice (volume agreement) of 0.48 on named bones and 0.63 on muscles, keeps the majority of bones and muscles in one piece, and yields calibrated voxel probabilities. On 33 held-out whole-body MRI subjects, FASCIA's pointwise field improves tissue overlap over HIT across all compartments, predicts between-person differences in whole-body adipose percentage ($R^2 = 0.88$ vs. $0.38$ in women and $0.54$ vs. $-0.01$ in men), and recovers segment centers of mass within 1.1 mm. Because it needs only an MHR fit, FASCIA can be driven from images, video, or any system that outputs MHR. This opens the door to fitting individualized calibrated musculoskeletal digital twins to video motion data.

</details>


### [453] [QSRadar: Query-Conditioned Sparse Radar-Camera Fusion for Efficient 3D Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30023)
*Chenhao Yan,Hongyu Liu,Xiang Cai,Yifei Sun,Zhe Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出QSRadar，一种查询条件化的稀疏雷达融合框架，用于自动驾驶卡车的高效长距离3D目标检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有雷达-相机检测器通常构建全局雷达BEV表示，计算和内存开销随感知范围增长；稀疏查询式检测器效率更高，但全局特征构建会削弱点级雷达几何与运动信息。

Method: 基于Sparse4Dv3风格视觉-时序检测器，QSRadar围绕每个演化中的目标假设检索少量原始雷达点，将点表示在锚点对齐坐标系中，并加入运动残差、雷达截面积和扫描时序信息，通过查询条件化集合编码器聚合；每次锚点细化后重新检索雷达邻域，使证据选择与目标估计耦合。

Result: 在MAN TruckScenes官方验证协议下，QSRadar达到38.09 mAP和52.20 NDS，优于复现的Sparse4D-Radar全局Radar-BEV基线的37.08 mAP和50.78 NDS；在RTX 4090 D匹配测试中，延迟降低45%，峰值内存降低49%，GFLOPs降低43%。

Conclusion: QSRadar通过查询条件化的稀疏雷达点检索与融合，在提升长距离3D检测性能的同时显著降低计算、内存和时延开销。

Abstract: Reliable 3D object detection for autonomous trucks requires both the semantic detail provided by cameras and the geometric and motion cues measured by 4D radar. Existing radar-camera detectors commonly construct global radar bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations, whose computational and memory costs grow with the perception range. Sparse query-based detectors offer greater efficiency, but global feature construction can obscure point-level radar geometry and motion information. We present QSRadar, a query-conditioned sparse radar fusion framework for efficient long-range 3D detection. Built on a Sparse4Dv3-style visual-temporal detector, QSRadar retrieves a compact set of raw radar points around each evolving object hypothesis. The selected points are represented in an anchor-aligned coordinate frame, augmented with motion residuals, radar cross section, and sweep timing, and aggregated by a query-conditioned set encoder. Radar neighborhoods are retrieved again after each anchor refinement, coupling evidence selection with object estimation. Under the official MAN TruckScenes validation protocol, QSRadar achieves 38.09 mAP and 52.20 NDS, compared with 37.08 mAP and 50.78 NDS for our reproduced Sparse4D-Radar global Radar-BEV baseline.
