  We present Tri-DNO, a diffusion noise optimization strategy to sample from a pretrained multimodal HOI diffusion model, improving hand-object contact. Rather than modifying or retraining the generative model, our approach iteratively optimizes the initial noise of the diffusion generator, thereby generating firm hand object contact, while mitigating penetration and keeping the hand position realistic. Experiments on the GRAB dataset demonstrate improvements over the baseline in grasp quality without additional model training or increased computational cost compared to existing methods. We further demonstrate the applicability of our approach to practical media production scenarios.

</details>


### [528] [GSDet: Gaussian Splatting for Oriented Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30602)
*Zeyu Ding,Jiaqi Zhao,Yong Zhou,Wen-liang Du,Hancheng Zhu,Rui Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出GSDet，将旋转目标检测建模为高斯泼溅，在3D特征空间用3D高斯表示旋转目标，并投影为2D高斯再转换为旋转框。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CNN和Transformer检测器依赖预定义目标候选（如锚框或查询），难以有效捕捉空间信息，因此需要新的目标表示与检测范式。

Method: GSDet在由图像特征构建的3D特征空间中进行检测，用3D高斯表示旋转目标；将3D高斯投影到图像平面形成2D高斯并转换为旋转框；通过含3D高斯采样的解码器优化随机初始化高斯的均值、各向异性协方差和置信度；支持自适应控制和推理时动态高斯数量。

Result: 在3个数据集上，GSDet在自适应控制评估下于DIOR-R取得AP50提升0.7%，DOTA-v1.0提升0.3%，DOTA-v1.5提升0.55%，并优于主流检测器。

Conclusion: GSDet通过高斯泼溅式旋转目标检测框架克服预定义候选的局限，具备灵活的自适应控制能力，并在多个数据集上取得优于主流方法的性能。

Abstract: Oriented object detection has advanced with the development of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and transformers. However, modern detectors still rely on predefined object candidates, such as anchors in CNN-based methods or queries in transformer-based methods, which struggle to capture spatial information effectively. To address the limitations, we propose GSDet, a novel framework that formulates oriented object detection as Gaussian splatting. Specifically, our approach performs detection within a 3D feature space constructed from image features, where 3D Gaussians are employed to represent oriented objects. These 3D Gaussians are projected onto the image plane to form 2D Gaussians, which are then transformed into oriented boxes. Furthermore, we optimize the mean, anisotropic covariance, and confidence scores of these randomly initialized 3D Gaussians, using a decoder that incorporates 3D Gaussian sampling. Moreover, our method exhibits flexibility, enabling adaptive control and a dynamic number of Gaussians during inference. Experiments on 3 datasets indicate that GSDet achieves AP$_{50}$ gains of 0.7\% on DIOR-R, 0.3\% on DOTA-v1.0, and 0.55\% on DOTA-v1.5 when evaluated with adaptive control and outperforms mainstream detectors.

</details>


### [529] [Towards an Armenian Epigraphic Corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30603)
*Chahan Vidal-Gor{è}ne,Arpine Avetisyan,Edita Matevosyan,Seda Kirakosyan,Victoria Khurshudyan,Pollet Samvelian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文介绍 Corpus Inscriptionum Armenicarum Electronicum，将十卷《Divan hay vimagrut'yan》亚美尼亚铭文印刷语料库转为开放数字语料库，包含近7600条记录。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 亚美尼亚铭文常因损坏或毁坏仅存于印刷卷册中，但亚美尼亚铭文学缺乏类似希腊、拉丁或格鲁吉亚铭文的数字资源。

Method: 使用版面检测、OCR 和视觉语言模型生成每条记录的结构化初读结果，再由专家在校对平台上复核修正。

Result: 初步校订显示字母识别较可靠，残余错误主要集中在编辑符号上。

Conclusion: 该语料库既是记录亚美尼亚铭文的长期平台，也可为古典亚美尼亚语和中古亚美尼亚语的语言模型与计算语言学研究提供“银数据”。

Abstract: The Divan hay vimagrut'yan (1960-2017), the printed corpus of Armenian inscriptions, comprises nearly 7,600 records; a growing number of the inscriptions they describe, damaged or destroyed in recent decades, survive only in its pages. Armenian epigraphy nevertheless lacks a digital resource of the kind available for Greek, Latin or Georgian. This paper presents the Corpus Inscriptionum Armenicarum Electronicum, which turns the ten volumes of the Divan into an open digital corpus. Layout detection, OCR and a vision-language model produce a first structured reading of each record, which specialists then check on a proofreading platform. First corrections show that letters are read reliably and that residual errors concentrate in the editorial signs. The corpus is designed as a lasting platform for documenting Armenian inscriptions and as a source of silver data in Classical and Middle Armenian for language models and computational linguistics.

</details>


### [530] [Motion on Demand: Adaptive Optical Excitation for Event Cameras](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30641)
*Yingtao Li,Chaoran Feng,Haoran Jiang,Zhenyu Tang,Wangbo Yu,Zhankuo Xu,Jianbin Zhao,Li Yuan,Yonghong Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 EvGaze，一种受果蝇眼动控制启发的事件相机系统，通过自适应调节楔形棱镜转速来增强边缘可见性，同时减少冗余事件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机只响应亮度变化，边缘可见性依赖与边缘垂直的图像运动；固定转速棱镜无法适应动态场景，自然运动充足时会造成冗余事件和对齐误差。

Method: EvGaze 使用学习型多模态控制器融合亮度、事件和惯性观测，并设置快速惯性通路在视觉更新间细化转速决策；同时利用编码器角度按事件时间戳补偿棱镜诱导的图像运动以保持几何一致性。

Result: 在 EvMotion 上，EvGaze 比全速棱镜恢复更多边缘且事件数少 39%；在 DSEC 模拟光学调制下，特征跟踪成功率达 0.73，高于原生事件的 0.55 和 180 RPM 的 0.67，同时比 360 RPM 少 26% 事件；真实设备实验实现闭环自适应，平均事件率较全速旋转降低 17%。

Conclusion: 自适应棱镜转速控制可在保持几何一致性的同时提升边缘恢复与特征跟踪性能，并显著降低事件冗余，验证了类果蝇多模态眼动控制策略在事件相机系统中的有效性。

Abstract: Event cameras respond only to brightness changes, so whether an edge is visible depends on image motion perpendicular to it---a motion that constantly shifts with camera and scene dynamics. Rotating a wedge prism in front of the lens introduces controlled image motion to reveal static or slow edges. However, a fixed rotation speed cannot adapt to changing motion conditions: when natural motion is already sufficient, additional optical excitation generates redundant events and introduces unnecessary alignment errors. Inspired by the division of labor between fast haltere feedforward and slower visual feedback in fly gaze control, we present EvGaze, an event camera system that adaptively regulates prism rotation speed. EvGaze employs a learned multimodal controller that integrates luminance, event, and inertial observations, with a fast inertial pathway that refines speed decisions between visual updates. To preserve geometric consistency during speed changes, we compensate for prism-induced image motion at individual event timestamps using measured encoder angles. On EvMotion, EvGaze recovers more edges than full-speed prism rotation with 39% fewer events. On DSEC with simulated optical modulation, it reaches 0.73 feature-tracking success (compared with 0.55 on native events and 0.67 at 180 RPM) while generating 26% fewer events than 360 RPM. Real-device experiments further demonstrate online closed-loop adaptation, reducing average event rates by 17% relative to full-speed rotation.

</details>


### [531] [ViDiHand2: Unifying Video Diffusion Priors and Hand Geometry for 3D Hand Motion Reconstruction in the Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30597)
*Yuxi Wang,Yufei Liu,Chengkai Jin,Qingyue Chen,Wenqi Ouyang,Tianyi Wei,Kerui Ren,Siyuan Huang,Zhiqi Shen,Hongsheng Li,Xingang Pan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ViDiHand2几何驱动框架，利用视频扩散模型从第一视角视频恢复遮挡手部的度量3D运动，并提升跨相机泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从自我中心人类视频学习机器人操作需要准确的度量3D手部运动，但现有基于VDM的外观深度回归在未见相机上泛化较差。

Method: 将VDM手部深度估计从直接回归重构为细粒度几何约束求解，引入Fine-Grained Geometric Lifting和Clip-Level Ray Fitting，通过2D关节与MANO度量结构的几何一致性并利用片段时序恢复深度；采用Confidence-Gated Fusion按定位置信度融合几何提升关节与MANO预测；增强VDM骨干以捕捉时空表示并输出逐帧2D关节和MANO预测。

Result: 在七个公开数据集上优于18个基线，野外绝对关节误差降低42%，检测失败降低8.82倍，运行速度57 FPS。

Conclusion: ViDiHand2通过几何约束求解和置信门控融合，实现了更鲁棒、准确的度量3D手部运动估计，尤其改善了跨相机场景下的泛化与遮挡处理。

Abstract: Learning robot manipulation from egocentric human videos requires accurate metric 3D hand motion. Recent methods leverage pretrained video diffusion model (VDM) priors to recover occluded hands directly from full-frame videos, but their appearance-based depth regression generalizes poorly to unseen cameras. In this work, we propose ViDiHand2, a geometry-driven framework that reformulates VDM-based hand depth estimation from direct regression into fine-grained geometric constraint solving. Specifically, we introduce Fine-Grained Geometric Lifting and Clip-Level Ray Fitting, which recover metric depth by enforcing geometric consistency between pixel-aligned 2D joints and the metric structure of MANO hands, while leveraging temporal observations across the clip. Since the lifting relies on these 2D joints, to improve robustness under occlusion and image truncation, we further develop Confidence-Gated Fusion to adaptively combine geometrically lifted joints with MANO predictions according to localization confidence. Finally, we enhance the VDM backbone to better capture spatial-temporal representations and produce the per-frame 2D joint and MANO predictions that both steps rely on. Extensive experiments on seven public datasets demonstrate that ViDiHand2 consistently outperforms 18 baselines, reducing in-the-wild absolute joint error by 42% and detection failures by 8.82x compared with the best baseline on each metric, while running at 57 FPS. The code is available at https://github.com/NTUYWANG103/ViDiHand.

</details>


### [532] [CineAct: Interaction-State Agents for Playable, Branching Film Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30613)
*Junyan Lin,Jianqi Ma,Shujie Duan,Hanxin Zhu,Zhihao Hu,Jinming Liu,Shuai Li,Jun Zhang,Xin Jin,Chang Wen Chen,Weidong Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CineAct，一个状态优先的智能体框架，用于目标驱动的交互式视频生成，使多片段视频中的用户选择与后果能够持续保持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成器每次只能生成数秒到十几秒短片；扩展长视频依赖预设脚本或从上一片段末帧自回归续写，会丢失屏幕外状态并累积幻觉，用户无法明确选择实现目标的方式并让其跨片段持续。

Method: 让语言模型智能体负责推理，冻结图像与视频生成器仅作渲染器；交互前由Architect初始化空间布局、相机、资产库和场景图；每回合推断计划状态变化，用图像生成器生成目标末帧并严格验证，再用FL2V模型合成中间运动；构建多空间基准，包含长程步骤执行与开放意图分支可采纳性两套测试。

Result: 显式世界状态建模相比纯像素基线提升多步rollout一致性：自动指标+11.4、人类评分+23.1；面向共享目标的配对分支成功率提升+30.8分。

Conclusion: 显式世界状态建模与状态优先智能体框架能有效支持目标落地、多路径选择及跨片段后果持久，优于纯像素基线。

Abstract: Open video generators such as MiniMax-H3 produce short clips of only several to a dozen seconds per run. To synthesize longer sequences, existing methods either rely on agentic systems following preset scripts, or roll out autoregressively from the previous clip's last frame, losing off-screen states and accumulating hallucinations across turns. Consequently, users still cannot take an explicit goal, choose how to accomplish it, and see that choice persist across subsequent clips. We study goal-grounded interactive video generation, where one goal admits multiple valid approaches, the user's chosen approach must be executed on screen, and its consequences must persist across clips. To this end, we propose CineAct, a state-first agentic framework in which language-model agents handle reasoning while frozen image and video generators serve purely as renderers. Before interaction, the Architect initializes the world as a spatial layout with cameras, an asset library, and a scene graph; at each turn, the system deduces the planned state change, generates a target end frame with an image generator and rigorously verifies it, and synthesizes intermediate motion with an FL2V model. We further introduce a multi-space benchmark covering two suites: long-horizon step execution and open-intent branching admissibility. Experiments show that explicit world-state modeling boosts multi-step rollout consistency over the pixel-only baseline (+11.4 automated, +23.1 human points) and raises paired branching success toward a shared goal by +30.8 points.

</details>


### [533] [Part-wise Certified State Estimation of Articulated Objects from Passive Stereo](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30646)
*Orion Desbonnet,Kei Higuchi,Alex Sykes,Ayush Deshmukh,Victor Leve,Joao Moura,Sethu Vijayakumar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 处理失败


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 处理失败

Method: 处理失败

Result: 处理失败

Conclusion: 处理失败

Abstract: Robots in manufacturing often handle thin, hinged objects known from CAD models that change shape during the task, like folding cartons. Monitoring such tasks requires estimating the object's articulation state, its pose and the shape of any semi-deformable part. Learning-based estimators generalise across objects but lose precision while handling thin parts. Model-based fitting is precise but often needs accurate depth, a close initial estimate and a clean object mask. We present part-wise certification of an articulated object's state, estimated from passive stereo. Our estimator rivals the precision of the best model-based fitting method without using depth, a close initial estimate or a mask. We detect the corners that the CAD model defines in both stereo images and fit the articulated model to them. Geometric certificates, which we extend from rigid to articulated objects, then tell whether to trust each part, because the fit returns a state even for hidden parts. Certified estimates on unlabelled video become labels that improve sim-to-real transfer. On five of seven simulated objects, we locate the parts we certify three to five times more precisely than the strongest learned baseline on the same readings, given depth and true masks. On a real folding carton, our median corner error on the end panels is 2.1% of the carton's size, at least 40% lower than every learned baseline and also lower than a depth-based fit initialised near the true state.

</details>

Abstract: Vision-language classifiers identify species by matching images to text prompts containing species names. Abstract: Self-speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive image generation by leveraging the same model for parallel drafting and sequential verification, without requiring an additional draft model. While existing methods primarily focus on improving drafting and verification strategies, recent advances in random-order autoregressive modeling introduce an additional degree of freedom: the generation order. In this work, we theoretically analyze how generation order affects self-speculative decoding efficiency, identifying two key factors: draft-target mismatch, which determines token rejection probabilities, and early-rejection cost, which reflects the higher cost of rejecting tokens earlier in a speculative round. Motivated by these insights, we propose Speculation-Aware Ordering (SAO), a training-free framework for offline optimization of generation orders. Instead of evaluating candidate orders through costly speculative decoding, SAO uses simple pairwise conditional-TV statistics to formulate a rejection-cost-aware objective and efficiently construct speculation-friendly generation orders offline. Extensive experiments across different backbones and speculative widths demonstrate that SAO improves decoding efficiency, with the additional benefit of improved generation quality. Furthermore, SAO provides complementary efficiency gains when combined with existing self-speculative decoding methods. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to identify generation order as a new optimization dimension for efficient self-speculative decoding in autoregressive image generation.

</details>

Abstract: Head serves a critical role in human cognitive and perceptual functions while remaining vulnerable to external impacts, making the understanding of head contact essential for human safety. Despite its importance, dense head-object contact estimation remains largely unexplored, primarily due to the absence of head-object contact data. Recently, it has been shown that synthetic data can serve as powerful training data in limited data scenario, implying the potential of synthetic data in head-object contact estimation. There are two core challenges for dense head-object contact estimation. First, head-object interactions are highly diverse, resulting in substantial variations in contact regions and patterns across different objects and interaction types. Second, head contact regions are often heavily occluded by hair, making direct visual observation of the actual contact regions difficult. To address these issues, we introduce HEad COntact estimation (HECO) with synthetic data. To handle diverse head-object interactions, we leverage semantic context from text features that encode semantic relationships between head regions and interacting objects. To resolve hair occlusion issue of actual head contact regions, we introduce occlusion-aware contact learning that learns to infer head contact beyond visible information from images via amodal inpainting. As a result, we enable head-object contact estimation with HECO trained with our synthetic dataset, overcoming the issue of absence of contact data. The codes will be released.

</details>

Abstract: Identifying subtle errors in generated videos is an important step toward automated video generation, where errors must be detected to assess and refine generated clips. Recent work shows that pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) can localise such errors, but their effectiveness depends strongly on the workflow used: choices about which frames to inspect, which tools and model calls to make, and how to combine predictions can lead to substantially different results. We study VLM harnesses for video error localisation. Instead of relying on manually designed harnesses, we propose Harness Search and Merge (HSM), an algorithm that automatically constructs them by searching over executable evaluation programs. An LLM orchestrator refines candidate harnesses independently on random training subsets, records findings in a memory, and constructively merges complementary candidates. We evaluate HSM on Spotlight, a recently proposed benchmark for localising errors in generated videos. HSM achieves 0.234 +- 0.012 F1, exceeding the strongest benchmark strategy (0.173 +- 0.016), and retains its lead on an unseen video generator (0.213 +- 0.008 versus 0.140 +- 0.003). On IPV-Bench, it achieves strong localisation performance with lower false-alarm rates than existing optimisation baselines. Together, these results show that searching over complete VLM harnesses can outperform existing evaluation strategies, transfer to an unseen video generator, and reduce false alarms on real videos.

Abstract: Controllable generation can expand training data for driving perception, but visual realism alone does not ensure learning gains. Effective generation must adapt both what data to generate and how to construct them as the perception model evolves. In this paper, we present DriveDreamer-RSI, a framework for recursive self-improvement of driving perception and agentic data generation through feedback between perception learning and data construction. Its outer loop implements Gap-Guided Target Adaptation, generating labeled videos from current perception gaps and updating targets after training. Its inner loop uses a vision-language agent to iteratively edit scenes through observation and execution feedback. Across rounds, Learning-Feedback-Driven Strategy Refinement derives reusable construction advice from execution experience and downstream learning outcomes. On the nuScenes validation set, DriveDreamer-RSI surpasses the dataset-replay baseline by 4.09 mAP and 4.13 NDS points using approximately half the synthetic frames.

Abstract: Direct visual world models predict the effects of candidate action sequences without recursive latent rollout, yet they leave the temporal structure of action effects unspecified. We introduce Zhengrong (Zhengrong-PoleWM), a world model that decomposes a latent trajectory into an initial-condition anchor, a free response, and delayed responses to action innovations. Nonlinear networks map visual history and causal action prefixes to response coefficients. A shared bank of stable conjugate poles determines how each response evolves with elapsed time. This factorization preserves nonlinear interactions across actions, anchors predictions exactly at the initial state, prevents future actions from affecting earlier predictions, and yields bounded responses to finite control plans. We derive an exact re-anchoring identity that identifies the additional basis direction $Ψ_κ(s)$ needed to represent shifted trajectory tails. Across four offline image-goal control benchmarks (Cube, TwoRoom, PushT, and Reacher), Zhengrong-PoleWM achieves $90.83\% \pm 0.47\%$ macro-average success over two training seeds at epoch 20, exceeding the strongest baseline (QQWorld) by 6.08 percentage points. Selecting checkpoints by validation loss yields $91.21\% \pm 1.00\%$. In a controlled first-epoch Cube study without restart regularization, neural and pole response heads outperform a generic direct predictor by 20.67 and 23.34 percentage points, respectively. On an NVIDIA A100 GPU, median latency for a full 30-iteration cross-entropy method search ranges from 74 to 87 ms across the four tasks. The mean of these medians is 77.5 ms, a 15.8% latency reduction relative to Fast-LeWM and a $7.1\times$ speedup over autoregressive LeWM.

</details>

Abstract: Person re-identification (ReID) aims to retrieve images of the same pedestrian across different cameras. However, the non-overlapping identities between training and testing sets, together with large intra-class variation, make it challenging to learn generalizable pedestrian representations. Most existing ReID loss functions mainly focus on intra-class compactness and inter-class separation, which may overlook useful intra-class differences. To address these issues, we propose a novel Intra-Class Diversity (ICD) loss that aims to maximize intra-class differences in classification-irrelevant directions. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to introduce this class-weight-orthogonal diversity learning objective for person ReID. Specifically, based on the geometric relationship between the learned representation and its corresponding class-weight vector, we decompose each representation into the component along the class-weight direction and its orthogonal component. This decomposition provides a clear and interpretable geometric basis for modeling intra-class diversity. ICD then encour- ages larger differences among the orthogonal components of samples belonging to the same identity, while the classification loss maintains identity discrimination. The proposed ICD loss can be incorporated into existing ReID frameworks as an additional regularization term without modifying the feature extraction network. Extensive experiments on three widely used ReID datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of ICD and its complementarity with existing metric learning losses.

</details>

Abstract: Few-step samplers make large text-to-image flow models fast, but from the same noise they no longer generate the image of the standard 50-step sampler. Subjects, attributes and layout change, not just fine detail. We trace this loss of seed fidelity to the start of sampling. The coarse part of the initial noise decides coarse structure first, while the noise level is still above 0.9. Few-step samplers cross this range in their first steps, which account for 25-52% of their distance to the 50-step reference. Because this decision is coarse, a half-resolution run from the same coarse noise can make nearly the same decision at a third of the cost. We therefore propose Decide-then-Render (DtR), a training-free sampler that decides the composition in a few low-resolution steps, rebuilds the full-resolution state with the seed's own noise and renders the details. On 4 large models, DtR runs 11-25$\times$ faster than the reference sampler. At each speed-up, it is closer to the reference and rated higher by ImageReward than every compared sampler, including few-step schedules calibrated per budget and published multi-resolution samplers. On FLUX.1-dev, it remains the most faithful sampler down to about $8\times$, ahead of caching accelerators. A user study on this model found DtR's samples closer to the reference in 86% of pairwise trials. DtR transfers to a held-out model and to video, and distilled models can serve as its renderers. Project link: https://duanhuiran.github.io/DtR

</details>

Abstract: Co-speech gestures convey meaning alongside speech, but annotating their physical attributes in video is labour-intensive. We propose two approaches to automate annotation of ten gesture attributes using human mesh recovery (HMR), which estimates a full 3D body skeleton from a single video frame: AI-assisted geometrical rules and a graph convolutional network (SL-GCN). Both use pose estimates from SAM 3D Body, evaluated on 2,020 gestures from the GESRes dataset. For physically defined attributes such as height, arm swivel and movement speed, both methods achieve agreement with expert annotation comparable to that between human annotators. For attributes whose annotation requires higher-level multimodal contextual inference, performance remains lower. The rule-based approach requires substantially less annotated data, is fully transparent, and can be adapted to different annotation schemes, offering a practical and interpretable complement to data-driven methods

### [543] [PestWeave: Linking Semantic Modeling and Evidence-Guided Text Modulation through Visual Prototypes for Fine-Grained Pest Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30796)
*Xueheng Li,Yu Wang,Yuxiang Shen,Wen Xue,Rui Li,Jie Zhang,Chengjun Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出多模态害虫识别框架PestWeave，通过视觉原型连接内容自适应视觉组织与文本融合，以提升复杂背景下害虫识别效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 农业害虫外观多样，单一视觉信息难以准确识别；引入文本可补充物种知识，但复杂背景会掩盖视觉线索，且文本可能包含当前图像不支持的信息，影响跨模态融合。

Method: PestWeave在视觉通路上基于RWKV架构加入语义token分组和三类辅助token（聚类原型、全局、寄存器token），实现内容自适应扫描与上下文建模并保留空间结构；同时利用视觉原型评估文本语义成分的视觉支持度，调节其相对贡献和整体融合强度。

Result: 在多个害虫识别数据集上的大量实验表明，PestWeave具有有效性，并展现出用于实际害虫管理的潜力。

Conclusion: 通过视觉原型引导的自适应视觉组织与受控文本融合，PestWeave能够减少不支持描述带来的干扰，提高多模态害虫识别的实用性。

Abstract: Agricultural pests threaten crop yield and quality, making accurate pest recognition essential for targeted management and sustainable agriculture. Their diverse appearances complicate recognition and motivate multimodal approaches incorporating complementary species knowledge from text. However, complex backgrounds can obscure discriminative visual cues, while textual descriptions may contain information unsupported by the current image, limiting effective cross-modal fusion. To address these challenges, we propose PestWeave, a multimodal framework connecting content-adaptive visual organization with text fusion through visual prototypes. Its visual pathway augments a Receptance Weighted Key Value (RWKV) architecture with semantic token grouping and three types of auxiliary tokens, enabling content-adaptive scanning and contextual modeling while preserving spatial structure. Feature-similar tokens are reordered into adjacent scanning positions, while cluster prototype, global, and register tokens provide group-level summaries, global context, and additional interaction capacity, respectively. These prototypes also guide text modulation by assessing visual support for semantic components and regulating their relative contributions and overall fusion strength, reducing interference from unsupported descriptions. Extensive experiments on multiple pest recognition datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of PestWeave and its potential for practical pest management.

</details>


### [544] [BridgeMVS: Bridging Multi-View Stereo and Monodepth via Bidirectional Dynamic Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30787)
*Jianfei Jiang,Haochen Yu,Qiankun Liu,Rui Yang,Hongyuan Liu,Xianglong Meng,Jiansheng Chen,Huimin Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BridgeMVS 提出一种统一的级联多阶段多视图立体框架，通过双向动态融合（BDF）连接单目深度特征与多视图代价体表示，实现 MDE 与 MVS 的相互增强，并在多个基准上取得领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有混合方法主要单向利用单目线索，未充分挖掘单目深度估计（MDE）与多视图立体（MVS）之间的相互增强；MVS 在特征匹配不可靠区域表现不佳，而 MDE 虽能提供稳健结构先验但存在尺度歧义。

Method: 提出 BridgeMVS 级联多阶段 MVS 框架，并在每个阶段引入双向动态融合（BDF），执行单目到代价体和代价体到单目的动态更新：用单目结构特征引导代价体细化，用多视图几何证据校准单目表示。融合表示由粗到细逐阶段传播，并分别采用相对尺度的 MDE 监督和度量尺度的 MVS 监督。BDF 设计为可插拔模块，可集成到现有级联 MVS 框架中。

Result: 在 DTU、Tanks-and-Temples 和 ETH3D 基准上达到最先进性能，同时提升单目深度估计精度；在 Tanks-and-Temples Intermediate 和 Advanced 基准上均排名第一。

Conclusion: BridgeMVS 通过双向动态融合有效桥接单目深度特征与多视图代价体表示，实现 MDE 与 MVS 的互补增强，并可方便集成到现有级联 MVS 框架中。

Abstract: Multi-View Stereo (MVS) and Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE) provide complementary cues for dense 3D reconstruction. While MVS leverages explicit geometry for metric depth, it struggles in challenging regions where feature matching is unreliable. Conversely, MDE provides robust structural priors but typically yields scale-ambiguous results. Existing hybrid methods mainly exploit monocular cues in a unidirectional manner, leaving the mutual enhancement between MDE and MVS insufficiently explored. To address this limitation, we propose BridgeMVS, a unified cascaded multi-stage MVS framework that bridges monocular depth features and multi-view cost volume representations through Bidirectional Dynamic Fusion (BDF). At each stage, BDF performs dynamic mono-to-cost and cost-to-mono updates, where monocular structural features guide cost volume refinement for more robust MVS depth estimation, while multi-view geometric evidence recalibrates monocular representations to improve their metric-scale consistency. Furthermore, the fused monocular and multi-view representations are progressively propagated from coarse to fine stages and constrained by stage-wise relative-scale MDE supervision and metric-scale MVS supervision, enabling cross-branch interactions to benefit subsequent high-resolution depth estimation. In addition, BDF is designed as a plug-and-play module that can be conveniently integrated into existing cascaded MVS frameworks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BridgeMVS achieves state-of-the-art performance on the DTU, Tanks-and-Temples, and ETH3D benchmarks, while simultaneously boosting the accuracy of monocular depth estimation. Notably, BridgeMVS ranks first on both the Tanks-and-Temples Intermediate and Advanced benchmarks. The source code is available at \href{https://github.com/JianfeiJ/BridgeMVS}{https://github.com/JianfeiJ/BridgeMVS}.

</details>


### [545] [DyLoMo-DiT: Dynamic Looped Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30844)
*Lernie Li,Yuanliu Liu,Pengfei Xiong,Wei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 DyLoMo-DiT，通过权重共享循环复用中间层，并结合稀疏 MoE 专家，在不增加参数的情况下加深网络并动态分配计算，从而更高效利用参数与计算预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DiT 通过增加参数和计算提升容量，MoE DiT 虽扩大参数容量但每 token 计算固定且仍需大量参数存储；作者希望在有限参数和计算预算下更高效地提升扩散 Transformer 性能。

Method: 提出 Dynamic Looped MoE DiT：对中间层进行权重共享的循环复用，不增加参数即加深网络；用稀疏专家将参数容量分配到不同 token；并按噪声水平动态调整循环次数，将更多 pass 分配给低噪声阶段。

Result: 在 ImageNet 256×256 上，匹配参数和计算预算时，DyLoMo-DiT 相比 DiT 降低 FID 11–24%，相比 DiT-MoE 降低 36–56%；文本到图像任务中，缩放版 DyLoMo-DiT 的 GenEval 分数达 0.714，高于 FLUX.1 的 0.673，而活跃参数仅 1.05B，低于其 12B。

Conclusion: DyLoMo-DiT 能更有效利用参数和计算预算，权重共享循环与动态计算分配带来显著收益，并在图像生成和文本到图像生成中优于基线。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) scale model capacity by increasing both parameter count and computation. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) variants expand parameter capacity while keeping per-token computation roughly fixed, but still require substantial parameter storage. In this paper, we propose Dynamic Looped MoE DiT (DyLoMo-DiT), which reuses parameters rather than adding them: a weight-shared loop repeatedly applies the middle layers, while sparse experts allocate parameter capacity across tokens. This design deepens the network without adding parameters, freeing the parameter budget for other uses, such as more experts or more distinct layers. It also allocates compute dynamically, varying the number of passes across noise levels. Experiments show that DyLoMo-DiT makes more effective use of parameter and compute budgets, with further gains from assigning more passes to low-noise steps. On ImageNet $256\times256$, DyLoMo-DiT reduces FID by 11-24% relative to DiT and 36-56% relative to DiT-MoE at matched parameter and compute budgets. For text-to-image generation, a scaled DyLoMo-DiT achieves a higher GenEval score than FLUX.1 (0.714 vs. 0.673), with less than one tenth of its active parameters (1.05B vs. 12B).

</details>


### [546] [Go Far, Look Less: Active Multi-Room Reconstruction with Persistent Goals and Selective Views](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30802)
*Jiawei Jiang,Haonan Zhou,Wendi Hu,Jiabei Hu,Yina Xiang,Kaiyue Zhou,Gaoang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的主动多房间三维重建框架 ROAM-GS，通过持久目标与选择性视图策略，实现用极少视图高效覆盖多房间几何与高保真渲染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主动三维重建方法在多房间住宅中表现急剧下降：短视的次优视角评分无法为前往远处房间的移动过程赋予价值，且过度优化近距离不可消除的残差；而稠密建图方法虽能覆盖远处房间，却需流式处理数千帧。

Method: ROAM-GS 将持久目标与选择性视图相结合：每次决策选择一个目标以及通向该目标的变长前缀，仅在端点处采集视图。通过表面重建记忆（Surface Reconstruction Memory）投影更新后缺陷与观察方向来为位姿评分；持久目标以其剩余价值为移动过程计入收益，并在到达后不再带来可测改进时释放。方法无需逐场景调参。

Result: 在多房间重建上达到最先进水平，同时保持单房间 Replica 保真度；HSSD 平均覆盖率从 74% 提升至 93%，HM3D 从 47% 提升至 96%（+11.7 dB PSNR），并以少 173 倍的视图数匹配 90 分钟稠密建图效果。

Conclusion: ROAM-GS 证明通过持久目标与选择性端点采集，可在无需训练与调参的情况下，以极稀疏视图预算高效完成多房间主动三维重建，兼顾覆盖完整性与渲染保真度。

Abstract: Active 3D reconstruction aims to allocate a sparse view budget to recover complete geometry and high-fidelity renderings. However, existing methods degrade sharply in multi-room homes: myopic next-best-view scoring gives transit no credit for distant rooms and over-polishes irreducible nearby residuals, whereas dense mappers reach far rooms only by streaming thousands of frames. We propose ROAM-GS, a training-free active multi-room reconstruction framework that couples persistent goals with selective views: each decision selects a goal and a variable-horizon prefix toward it, capturing only at its endpoint. A Surface Reconstruction Memory scores poses by projecting post-update defects and viewing directions. Persistent goals credit transit with their remaining value and are released once arrivals stop measurably improving them. Without per-scene tuning, ROAM-GS achieves state-of-the-art multi-room reconstruction while preserving single-room Replica fidelity, raising mean coverage from 74% to 93% on HSSD and from 47% to 96% (+11.7 dB PSNR) on HM3D, and matching 90-minute dense mapping using $173\times$ fewer views.

</details>


### [547] [Certified Defense against Adversarial Patches on Traffic Signs via Mask-Aware Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30840)
*Rudra Saxena,Vishal Dev Verma,Rohan Sharma,Palani Thanaraj K*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对交通标志识别中的对抗贴片，PatchCleanser认证防御与普通训练分类器结合时认证准确率极低；作者提出掩码感知训练，在不改变防御与认证流程的前提下显著提升认证鲁棒性和实际攻击下的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对抗贴片能通过小贴纸改变交通标志分类器的判断。PatchCleanser理论上能对任意落入单个掩码的贴片返回正确标签，但在交通标志上，单个掩码可能遮住区分类别的小型中心符号，导致与普通分类器结合时几乎无法认证。

Method: 提出mask-aware training：使用防御自身掩码集合中的随机掩码对训练分类器，并对覆盖标志中心的掩码进行偏向采样。防御、掩码集合和认证过程均保持不变，因此认证保证仍成立；实验使用ImageNet预训练ResNet-50。

Result: 在GTSRB上，普通训练分类器的认证准确率仅1.7%至4.8%；掩码感知训练将ResNet-50的认证准确率从4.8%提升到60.0%。在真实逐图像对抗贴片下，防御后的ResNet-50达到85.7%准确率，而原始PatchCleanser配合普通训练ResNet-50为74.6%。

Conclusion: 掩码感知训练能在不修改PatchCleanser认证机制的情况下，显著改善交通标志识别任务中的认证准确率和实际对抗贴片鲁棒性。

Abstract: Adversarial patches are a practical threat to traffic-sign recognition: a small sticker on a sign can change a classifier's decision. PatchCleanser is a certified defense that applies two rounds of masking and, for every image it certifies, provably returns the correct label for any patch that fits inside one mask. We show that on traffic signs the defense certifies almost nothing when paired with a normally trained classifier (1.7% to 4.8% certified accuracy on GTSRB), because a single mask can hide the small central symbol that distinguishes sign classes. We propose mask-aware training, which trains the classifier on images occluded by random pairs drawn from the defense's own mask set, with a sampling bias toward masks over the sign's centre. The defense, mask set and certification procedure are unchanged, so the guarantee is preserved. For an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50, mask-aware training raises certified accuracy from 4.8% to 60.0%. Under real per-image adversarial patches, the defended ResNet-50 reaches 85.7% accuracy, versus 74.6% for the original PatchCleanser with a normally trained ResNet-50.

</details>


### [548] [XFreq: Geometry-Aligned Cross-View Residual Learning for Sparse 3D Ultrasound Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30869)
*Yuhuan Lu,P. Ellen Grant,Davood Karimi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出XFreq，一种几何对齐的稀疏3D超声重建框架，融合已知切片位姿、样条强度与查询到的2D特征，通过低频平滑场和高频残差预测实现稀疏2D切片到3D体积的重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D超声能提供解剖评估所需的体积信息，但从广泛可得的2D切片重建3D体积时，稀疏切片导致大部分体积未被观测；现有方法对观测强度插值与学习到的2D特征在预测平滑结构和残余细节中的互补作用探索不足。

Method: XFreq利用已知切片位姿和有限覆盖范围，在3D位置查询2D图像特征，并与样条化强度和采样几何互补；低频解码器从样条表示预测平滑3D场，高频解码器结合查询到的2D特征预测残差细节；学习门控模块根据几何和跨切片特征变化调节残差贡献。

Result: 在内部胎儿脑数据集和公开CETUS心脏数据集上，用3D超声体积重采样切片和五折交叉验证评估；XFreq在多数设置下取得最高PSNR和SSIM，在CETUS使用32个输入切片时达到26.82 dB PSNR；消融实验验证局部特征查询、几何线索和残差预测的贡献，且输入切片增多时增益通常增加。

Conclusion: 几何对齐的跨视角特征集成对从稀疏2D切片重建3D超声体积具有重要价值。

Abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) ultrasound provides valuable volumetric context for anatomical assessment, motivating reconstruction from widely available two-dimensional (2D) slices. Sparse slices leave much of the volume unobserved, even when their acquisition poses are known. Existing methods interpolate observed intensities or incorporate learned 2D image features into 3D reconstruction, but their complementary roles in predicting smooth structure and residual details remain less explored. We introduce XFreq, a geometry-aligned framework for sparse 3D ultrasound reconstruction. It uses known slice poses and finite footprints to query 2D image features at 3D locations, complementing splatted intensities and sampling geometry. A low-frequency decoder predicts a smooth 3D field from the splat representation, while a high-frequency decoder additionally incorporates the queried 2D features to predict residual details. A learned gating module regulates the residual contribution based on geometry and cross-slice feature variation. We evaluate XFreq on an in-house fetal brain dataset and the public CETUS cardiac dataset, using slices resampled from 3D ultrasound volumes and fivefold cross-validation. Among the compared methods, XFreq achieves the highest PSNR and SSIM in most settings across both datasets, reaching 26.82 dB PSNR on CETUS with 32 input slices. Ablation studies further show the contributions of local feature querying, geometric cues, and residual prediction, with gains generally increasing as more input slices are used. Our findings highlight the value of geometry-aligned cross-view feature integration for reconstructing 3D ultrasound volumes from sparse 2D slices.

</details>


### [549] [A High-Resolution UAV Benchmark Dataset and Baseline Evaluation for Teak Crown Segmentation in Western Ghats Tropical Forests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30888)
*Anand S Sahadevan,Sunita Arya,Anup Kumar Das,Bimal Kumar Bhattacharya,S Manthira Moorthi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出TeakTreeNet数据集与评测协议，用于2cm分辨率无人机影像中的柚木树二分类分割，并系统评测四种主流分割架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率无人机影像中的柚木树精准分割对可持续种植园管理至关重要，但该任务缺乏专用基准数据集和可复现评测协议。

Method: 构建包含6391个224x224专家标注无人机影像块的TeakTreeNet数据集，并在原始训练和ImageNet预训练两种设置下，对U-Net、PSPNet、DeepLabV3和SegFormer进行三随机种子可复现评测。

Result: SegFormer取得新的SOTA性能：柚木类F1为0.938 +/- 0.002，IoU为0.968 +/- 0.001，Accuracy为0.986 +/- 0.001，优于所有预训练CNN；且从头训练的SegFormer也优于ImageNet预训练基线。

Conclusion: Transformer在密集种植园场景中具有更优边界刻画能力；SegFormer在精度、效率和可部署性之间取得最佳平衡，适合印度西部热带森林柚木种植园的运营化林业监测。

Abstract: Accurate teak-tree segmentation from high-resolution drone imagery is critical for sustainable plantation management, yet lacks dedicated benchmarks. We introduce TeakTreeNet, a comprehensive dataset and evaluation protocol for binary teak-tree segmentation at native 2cm resolution. Four state-of-the-art architectures: U-Net, PSPNet, DeepLabV3, and SegFormer were rigorously benchmarked across scratch and ImageNet-pretrained settings with three-seed reproducibility. SegFormer establishes new SOTA performance with F1 0.938 +/- 0.002 (Teak), IoU 0.968 +/- 0.001 (Teak), and Accuracy 0.986 +/- 0.001, outperforming all pretrained CNNs. Domain-adaptive training suffices, as the scratch SegFormer outperforms ImageNet pretrained baselines, avoiding large-scale pretraining overhead. Comprehensive analysis reveals Transformer's superior boundary delineation for dense plantation scenarios. TeakTreeNet provides researchers with 6391 expertly annotated drone patches (224x224) and establishes reproducible evaluation protocols, enabling direct comparison of future methods. Our benchmark demonstrates SegFormer's optimal balance of accuracy, efficiency, and deployability for operational forestry monitoring of teak plantations for India's western tropical forests.

</details>


### [550] [Age and Gender Estimation from Face and Ocular Smartphone Images via Identity Transfer and Ordinal Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30850)
*Fernando Alonso-Fernandez,Kevin Hernandez-Diaz,Jose Maria Buades,Josef Bigun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究人脸与眼部图像中的身份识别表征能否迁移到性别和年龄估计任务，并比较不同复杂度CNN、预训练方式、眼部区域组合及序数损失的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有性别和年龄估计常依赖ImageNet预训练或从头训练，作者希望验证与目标域更匹配的人脸/眼部身份识别预训练是否能提供更有效的表征迁移。

Method: 使用11,299张Adience智能手机正面人脸图像，遵循五折协议和受试者不重叠验证；采用三种不同复杂度的CNN，分别进行人脸或眼部身份识别预训练，并以固定特征+SVM和端到端适应两种方式评估；同时提出利用年龄组顺序信息的序数损失。

Result: 域匹配的身份预训练在端到端训练中优于ImageNet预训练和从头初始化；联合双眼区域可缩小与全脸估计的差距，尤其对年龄估计；序数损失在不同架构和输入区域上均稳定提升1-off准确率。最佳性别准确率为全脸88.1%、联合眼部82.9%；年龄估计在眼部图像上达到59.0%精确准确率和93.1%的1-off准确率，全脸为57.6%和95.2%。

Conclusion: 人脸和眼部身份识别预训练可有效迁移到性别与年龄估计，联合眼部区域和序数损失能提升性能；报告的眼部年龄准确率在Adience上达到已知最高水平。

Abstract: We investigate the transferability of identity-recognition representations to gender and age estimation from face and ocular images. Three CNNs of varying complexity, pre-trained for face or ocular identity recognition, are evaluated using fixed features with SVMs and end-to-end adaptation. Experiments use 11,299 frontal smartphone images from Adience, following its predefined five-fold protocol and subject-disjoint validation. Results show that domain-matched identity pre-training outperforms direct ImageNet and scratch initialisation in end-to-end training, while combining both ocular regions narrows the gap with full-face estimation, especially for age. We additionally introduce an ordinal loss that exploits the ordering of age groups and consistently improves 1-off accuracy across architectures and input regions. Across the evaluated configurations, best gender accuracies reach 88.1% for the face and 82.9% for combined ocular regions, while age estimation reaches 59.0% exact and 93.1% 1-off accuracy for ocular images, versus 57.6% and 95.2% for the full face. To our knowledge, these are the highest ocular age accuracies reported on Adience.

</details>


### [551] [CableMoE: Harm-Regularized Mean-Residual Expert Fusion for Transmission-Corridor Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30859)
*Shima Salehi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 CableMoE：一种后置式混合模型，将四个冻结的分割专家组合起来，用于输电走廊语义制图。其可部署预测是围绕可用性感知概率平均的校准残差，并用伤害惩罚避免在均值已正确分类的点上造成额外损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构 LiDAR 与图像引导预测器有利于输电走廊语义制图，但用学习路由器替换强集成可能损害稀有电力资产，因此需要更保守、稳健的组合方式。

Method: CableMoE 采用四个冻结分割专家构成后置混合；预测为可用性感知概率平均附近的校准残差；引入伤害惩罚约束额外损失。通过匹配组件研究分析各设计必要性，并使用三个拟合区域、两个不相交残差强度选择区域以及未触碰路由器的 t5b5 做最终报告。

Result: 无约束学习混合比概率平均低 1.032 mIoU；固定容量下伤害正则恢复 0.359 点；移除不必要的逐点门控略提升精度与稳定性。最终 CableMoE 达 84.906% mIoU 和 98.140% 总体精度，比 SPT 高 10.000 点，比概率平均高 0.263 点，三个种子均优于概率平均；pylon、conductor、structural-cable、insulator 的 macro-IoU 从 SPT 的 84.517% 和概率平均的 97.153% 提升到 98.144%。

Conclusion: 结果支持保守的残差组合策略，而非宣称新的分割骨干网络或通用最先进性能。

Abstract: Semantic mapping of transmission corridors benefits from heterogeneous LiDAR and image-guided predictors, but replacing a strong ensemble with a learned router can damage rare electrical assets. We introduce CableMoE, a post-hoc mixture of four frozen segmentation experts. Its deployable prediction is a calibrated residual around availability-aware probability averaging, while a harm penalty discourages extra loss on points that the mean already classifies correctly. A matched component study shows why each design choice is needed: an unconstrained learned mixture loses 1.032 mIoU points relative to probability mean, harm regularization restores 0.359 points at fixed capacity, and removing an unnecessary point-wise gate slightly improves accuracy and stability. With three zones for fitting, two disjoint zones for residual-strength selection, and router-untouched t5b5 for final reporting, CableMoE obtains 84.906% mIoU and 98.140 % overall accuracy. This is +10.000 points over SPT and +0.263 over probability mean; all three seeds improve the latter. Across pylon, conductor, structural-cable, and insulator classes, macro-IoU rises from 84.517% for SPT and 97.153% for probability mean to 98.144 %. The results support conservative residual composition, not a claim of a new segmentation backbone or universal state of the art

</details>


### [552] [AvatarAnyone: Agentic Reconstruction of Mesh-Based Layered Avatars from YouTube Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30777)
*Aymen Mir,Peter Wonka,Stefanos Zafeiriou,Rıza Alp Güler*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AvatarAnyone 提出一种从日常 YouTube 视频重建分层网格化身的方法，将每件服装和鞋履作为独立网格叠加在身体网格上，并利用 AI 智能体为每个人规划定制优化流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 日常视频中人物的服装类别、服装类型和层叠方式差异很大，单一固定的分层重建流程难以适用；现有化身多为融合表面或高斯表示，无法支持换装、布料模拟和接触建模等应用。

Method: 使用 AI 智能体预测服装类别、服装类型和层叠关系，并据此选择初始化方式、分阶段安排优化；将身体、每件服装和鞋履重建为分层网格，支持虚拟试穿、布料模拟，并可导入 Blender、Unreal Engine 和 MuJoCo 等平台。

Result: 在约 150 个 YouTube 视频上展示结果，并在四个数据集上优于现有基于网格的可动画单目重建方法；分层网格化身可更换服装层、渲染不同服装和姿态，并可用标准布料模拟器模拟服装层。

Conclusion: AvatarAnyone 通过 AI 智能体驱动的定制化分层网格重建，解决了多样化日常视频中化身重建流程不统一的问题，并拓展了虚拟试穿、布料模拟和机器人仿真等应用。

Abstract: We introduce AvatarAnyone, a method for reconstructing avatars from casual YouTube videos as layered meshes, with each garment and footwear as a separate mesh layered on top of the body mesh. In such videos, people differ in garment classes, clothing types, and layers, and each combination needs a different reconstruction. A single fixed layered reconstruction pipeline therefore fails. AvatarAnyone solves this problem with AI agents that plan a custom optimization for each person's reconstruction. The agents predict the garment classes, the clothing type, and the layering. They use these predictions to choose an initialization and stage the optimization. Because the avatars are layered meshes, they support applications such as virtual try-on and cloth simulation. We change the clothing layers of an avatar and render it in different garments and poses. We can also simulate a clothing layer as cloth over the animated body with a standard cloth simulator. Most existing avatars are one fused surface or a set of Gaussians and cannot do this. We load the avatars directly into Blender, Unreal Engine, and robotics simulators such as MuJoCo. As the avatars are meshes, they support contact modeling with other objects. We show results from around 150 YouTube videos. On four datasets, AvatarAnyone outperforms existing mesh-based methods for animatable monocular reconstruction. Our project page is available at https://miraymen.github.io/avataranyone.

</details>


### [553] [GRAIN: Shared-Budget Complementary Re-observation for Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30770)
*Chengxuan Zhou,Shaoyang Zhang,Rui Qian,Juntao Cheng,Feng Liu,Wanru Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 GRAIN，一种面向冻结检测器的跨图像裁剪调用分配与有界输出准入框架，以在无需重训练的情况下恢复小目标和拥挤目标，并提升裁剪调用效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在放大图像裁剪上重跑冻结检测器可恢复小目标和拥挤目标，但每次裁剪都会增加检测器调用成本；现有切片和自适应裁剪流程通常按单张图像独立规划，忽略了整个图像集合中检测需求差异很大的问题。

Method: GRAIN 将跨图像调用分配与有界输出准入统一起来，基于边界安全裁剪内部区域上跨图像可比较的分辨率闭合增益进行规划。粗假设携带分辨率缺陷，裁剪为其内部正区域中的假设闭合一定几何比例的分辨率缺陷，并用乘性残差在单调子模代理中折减已覆盖证据。该方法用前缀和与全局最大堆在 CPU 上于裁剪推理前执行集合级规划，并通过 Positive-Region Fusion 在类平衡 top-k 选择前将推理后空间准入与规划的内部支持对齐。

Result: 在 COCO、CrowdHuman 和 VisDrone-DET 上，GRAIN 在来自五个家族的 17 个冻结检测器中，于 102 个 AP@100 设置中的 100 个优于调用匹配的平铺方法，并可迁移到 AI-TOD-v2。使用 RF-DETR-S 在 CrowdHuman 上时，它以八分之一的裁剪调用几乎匹配双裁剪平铺。固定预算下，代理对候选方案的排序 Spearman 相关系数为 0.95 至 0.99，同时扫描达到精确代理最优的至少 98%。

Conclusion: GRAIN 表明，跨图像集合统一规划裁剪调用能够在冻结检测器上高效提升小目标和拥挤目标检测表现，并且在调用受限条件下优于传统按图平铺策略。

Abstract: Re-running a frozen detector on enlarged image crops recovers small and crowded objects without retraining, yet every crop costs an extra detector call. Existing slicing and adaptive-cropping pipelines plan crops per image in isolation, even though inspection demand varies widely across an image collection. We present GRAIN, which unifies cross-image call allocation and bounded-output admission around cross-image comparable resolution-closure gains over boundary-safe crop interiors. Coarse hypotheses carry resolution deficits, crops close a geometric share of those deficits for hypotheses enclosed in their interior positive region, and multiplicative residuals discount covered evidence within a monotone submodular surrogate. Prefix sums and a global max-heap execute this collection-wide plan on CPU before crop inference, and Positive-Region Fusion aligns post-inference spatial admission with the planned interior support before class-balanced top-
  selection. Across 17 frozen detectors from five families on COCO, CrowdHuman, and VisDrone-DET, GRAIN beats call-matched tiling in 100 of 102 AP@100 settings and transfers to AI-TOD-v2. With RF-DETR-S on CrowdHuman, it nearly matches two-crop tiling using one eighth of the crop calls. At fixed budgets, the surrogate orders candidate plans with Spearman correlations of 0.95 to 0.99 while the sweep attains at least 98% of the exact surrogate optimum. Code will be publicly released.

</details>


### [554] [Do Waste Classifiers Recognise Items They Have Never Seen? Object-Disjoint Evaluation on Household and Medical Waste](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30911)
*Nusrat Jahan,Mst. Eshrat Jahan Esha,Masuma Sadia,Saad Ahmed,Md Zahim Hassan,S M Jahangir Alam*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文构建了包含孟加拉国家庭与医疗废物的BanglaWaste-23数据集，并按物理对象不重叠方式评估垃圾图像分类器，发现随机划分会明显高估性能，预训练模型在未见对象上表现较好但跨数据集泛化下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动垃圾分类有助于源头分类、回收以及避免医疗废物进入生活垃圾。但已有研究常采用随机图像划分，使同一物品照片同时出现在训练集和测试集，导致接近完美的准确率，无法反映分类器对从未见过物品的识别能力。

Method: 构建BanglaWaste-23数据集，包含23类家庭和医疗废物、172个物理对象、4160张图像，并记录每张图对应的物品。评估11个ImageNet预训练模型和2个从零训练模型（紧凑自定义网络和MobileNetV3-L），采用对象不重叠五折交叉验证与随机划分，并在达卡第二数据集上测试。

Result: 在未见对象上，最佳预训练模型宏平均F1达98.8%，六个模型统计上并列。随机划分使从零训练模型准确率高估15至19个百分点。从零训练模型漏检医疗物品11%至13%，预训练模型低于1%。在达卡第二数据集上，预训练模型准确率下降15至22个百分点。

Conclusion: 分类器应在未见对象上评估，随机划分结果只能作为性能上限。数据已发布在Zenodo，代码见https://github.com/saadbaust/BanglaWaste-23。

Abstract: Automatic waste classification supports source separation, which enables recycling and keeps hazardous medical items out of household waste. Waste classification studies often report near-perfect accuracy on random image splits, which put photographs of one item in both training and test sets. To measure how well classifiers recognise items they have never seen, we built BanglaWaste-23, with 4,160 images of 172 objects in 23 household and medical waste classes from Bangladesh. Every image also records which physical item it shows. We evaluated 11 ImageNet-pretrained models and two models trained from scratch (a compact custom network and MobileNetV3-L) using object-disjoint five-fold cross-validation and a random split. On unseen objects, the best pretrained model reached a macro-averaged F1 score of 98.8%, and six models were statistically tied. The random split overstated from-scratch accuracy by 15 to 19 percentage points. The from-scratch models also missed 11 to 13% of medical items, against under 1% for pretrained models. On a second dataset from Dhaka, pretrained accuracy fell by 15 to 22 points. Classifiers should therefore be evaluated on unseen objects, with random-split results read as an upper bound. The data are on Zenodo and the code at https://github.com/saadbaust/BanglaWaste-23.

</details>


### [555] [Screening for nonrigidity in structure from motion using projected reprojection residuals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30769)
*Íñigo Cirauqui-Viloria*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出一种基于重投影误差空间与时间排列模式的诊断方法，用于筛查静态SfM假设下由场景变形产生的“看似合理”重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏SfM假设场景静止，但变形仍可能得到看似合理的重建；传统重投影误差幅值汇总忽略了误差在点和视图之间的分布方式。

Method: 先去除可由小幅点和相机调整及随时间变化的简单空间趋势解释的残差成分，再衡量剩余误差与固定空间和时间模式的一致性；仅使用一次估计的SfM重建，作为筛查证据而非物理变形估计。

Result: 在四个合成管状场景族中，该方法检测出全部8个预设运动采集，而误差幅值汇总仅检测出5或6个；相同阈值下，在20个外观和重建流程变体中保留19个正检测，另有1次数值弃权；但最高静态采集也会出现阳性。

Conclusion: 重投影误差在点和视图间的排列可揭示幅值汇总遗漏的不一致性；在该设定下，该方法可仅凭估计相机、3D点和图像观测标记需进一步检查的疑似重建，但研究场景已知且存在静态误报局限。

Abstract: Sparse structure from motion (SfM) assumes a static scene, yet deformation may still yield plausible reconstructions. Reprojection-error summaries discard how errors are arranged across points and views. We propose a diagnostic that first removes residual components explainable by small point and camera adjustments and simple spatial trends that change over time. It then measures alignment with fixed spatial and temporal patterns. The diagnostic uses one estimated SfM reconstruction and provides screening evidence rather than a physical deformation estimate. Across four synthetic tubular families, the diagnostic detected all eight acquisitions with prescribed motion, compared with five or six for summaries of reprojection-error magnitude. Each family's cutoff was the highest static score among the other three families, so the static acquisition with the highest score also screened positive. With the same cutoffs, the diagnostic retained positive detections in 19 of 20 reconstruction variants spanning changes in appearance and reconstruction pipeline, with one numerical abstention. These findings show that the arrangement of reprojection errors across points and views can reveal inconsistencies that their magnitudes alone miss. The four families were known during development, and the transfer variants reused two of them. Within this setting, the diagnostic offers a practical way to flag a plausible reconstruction for closer inspection using only its estimated cameras, 3D points and image observations.

</details>


### [556] [Reconstructing 3D+t Cardiovascular Flow From Sparse Planar Velocity Fields With Neural Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30775)
*Viraj Patel,Deblina Bhattacharjee,Katharine Fraser*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种平面感知神经场框架，从稀疏平面测量中学习连续的3D+t心血管速度场，并研究物理约束的作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 三维时间分辨心血管流重建具有挑战性，因为每个平面只能观测小部分体积内的两个面内速度分量。

Method: 采用平面感知神经场，通过逐平面投影从时空坐标学习连续3D速度场；在计算主动脉和动脉瘤数据集及真实心脏4D Flow MRI重采样平面上评估，并与RBF插值比较，同时测试普通MLP和物理约束SIREN（PC-SIREN）。

Result: 普通MLP在两个计算数据集上均优于RBF。主动脉中PC-SIREN将rRMSE降至0.3756，优于普通MLP的0.4273和RBF的0.7256，并在MRI数据每个解剖段最准确；动脉瘤中普通MLP最准确，rRMSE为0.07至0.16，而PC-SIREN为0.55至0.71。

Conclusion: 连续神经场能够从稀疏平面测量重建体积心血管流，但物理约束必须与具体流场相匹配。

Abstract: Reconstructing time-resolved three-dimensional (3D+t) cardiovascular flow from sparse planar measurements is challenging because each plane observes only the two in-plane velocity components, on a small part of the volume. We propose a plane-aware neural-field framework that learns a continuous 3D velocity field from space and time coordinates through a per-plane projection, and then investigate the potential benefits of physics constraints. We evaluate the framework on computational aortic and aneurysm datasets, and on planes resampled from a real cardiac 4D Flow MRI scan. A plain multi-layer perceptron (MLP) was more accurate than classical radial basis function (RBF) interpolation on both computational datasets. For the aorta, a physics-constrained SIREN (PC-SIREN) reduced the rRMSE further to $0.3756$, compared with $0.4273$ for the plain MLP and $0.7256$ for RBF, and it was the most accurate model in every anatomical segment of the MRI data. For the aneurysms the plain MLP remained the most accurate model, with an rRMSE of $0.07$ to $0.16$ against $0.55$ to $0.71$ for PC-SIREN. Further experiments investigated scanning configuration, number of scans, and spatial resolution. These findings show that continuous neural fields can reconstruct volumetric cardiovascular flow from sparse planar measurements, and that physics constraints have to be matched to the flow.

</details>


### [557] [SIAMBA: A Pseudo-Siamese Mamba-based Deep Learning Network for Multimodal Flood Change Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30938)
*Muhammad Fasih Ishfaq,Giulio Weikmann,Lorenzo Bruzzone*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出SIAMBA，一种伪孪生Mamba网络，融合Sentinel-1 SAR与Sentinel-2多光谱双时相影像进行洪水变化检测，并在OMBRIA基准及多个区域子集上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 洪水变化检测需要快速响应，Sentinel-2提供判别性光谱信息，Sentinel-1 SAR提供不受天气影响的结构信息；联合使用需处理云污染、光照变化、成像几何、斑点噪声和地物异质响应等跨模态与时相挑战。

Method: SIAMBA采用模态专用编码器、双池化SE重校准和选择性状态空间处理建模长程空间上下文；通过门控跨模态变化模块在多语义层级提取绝对、带符号和相对对数比差异；并用注意力细化跳跃连接进行渐进多尺度解码。

Result: 在OMBRIA独立测试集上达到81.98% IoU和93.57% OA，为对比方法中最高；在法国、阿尔巴尼亚、圭亚那和东帝汶四个空间不相连区域子集上也取得最高平均IoU和OA。

Conclusion: 将选择性状态空间上下文建模与门控多尺度差异学习结合，可有效提升不同地理场景下的洪水变化制图性能。

Abstract: Flood change detection from bi-temporal multispectral and synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images is essential for rapid disaster response. In this context, Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery provides discriminative spectral observations, whereas Sentinel-1 SAR provides weather-independent structural information. Using these modalities jointly requires modelling temporal evidence while accounting for cross-modal heterogeneity. In particular, change detection is complicated by cloud contamination, illumination variability, acquisition geometry and speckle, and heterogeneous land-cover responses. To address these challenges, we propose SIAMBA, a pseudo-siamese Mamba-based network for bi-temporal flood change detection from paired Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 observations. SIAMBA uses dedicated modality-specific encoders with dual-pooling squeeze-and-excitation recalibration and selective state-space processing for long-range spatial context. A gated cross-modal change module derives absolute, signed, and relative log-ratio differences at multiple semantic levels, and attention-refined skip connections support progressive multi-scale decoding. Experiments are carried out on OMBRIA benchmark, which includes an independent test set and geographically diverse subsets in France, Albania, Guyana, and Timor. SIAMBA achieves 81.98% IoU, and 93.57% OA on the independent test set, reaching the highest values in the considered comparison. It also provides the highest unweighted average IoU and OA across four regional subsets spatially disjuncted. These results indicate that combining selective state-space contextual modelling with gated multiscale discrepancy learning effectively improves flood change mapping across the evaluated geographic settings.

</details>


### [558] [Graph2Scene: Relation-Aware Text-to-Image Generation with Graph-Guided Diffusion Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30964)
*Peizheng Li,Xin Ai,Guanghui Cheng,Zikang Dong,Qiange Wang,Yanfeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Graph2Scene，一个无需训练的文生图框架，将场景图作为扩散生成的核心控制信号，通过选择性注意力引导实现元素定位与关系交互控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文生图扩散模型难以处理包含多元素与交互的复杂提示；现有注意力控制方法主要关注元素出现位置，忽视对象间交互，导致关系 token 错误关注无关区域，出现缺失或错误交互。

Method: Graph2Scene 以节点表示元素、边表示关系，将元素-关系依赖转化为选择性注意力引导：将每个元素定位到对应区域，并引导相关元素间的关系交互；同时根据场景复杂度自适应调整控制时长，并在去噪过程中逐步放松图引导，以避免过度约束生成。

Result: 在 T2I-CompBench 与 ConceptMix 上显著提升组合式生成，尤其对象关系；在 ConceptMix 上关系准确率从 0.59 提升至 0.84（对比最强 FLUX.1 区域控制基线）；在 LongBench-T2I 上对长且复杂提示展现优势。

Conclusion: 将场景图作为核心控制信号并结合自适应、渐进式注意力引导，可在无需训练的情况下有效提升复杂提示下的关系与组合生成能力。

Abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models still struggle with complex prompts containing many elements and interactions. Existing attention-control methods mainly focus on controlling where elements appear, but often ignore how objects interact with each other. As a result, relation tokens describing interactions between elements may assign high attention to irrelevant regions, leading to missing or incorrect interactions. In this paper, we propose Graph2Scene, a training-free framework that treats scene graphs as a core control signal for diffusion generation. It represents elements as nodes and their relations as edges, and translates these element-relation dependencies into selective attention guidance. It grounds each element to its corresponding region and guides relational interactions among the involved elements. To achieve appropriate relation control without over-constraining the generation process, Graph2Scene further adapts the control duration to scene complexity and progressively relaxes graph guidance during denoising. Experiments on T2I-CompBench and ConceptMix show clear improvements in compositional generation, especially for object relations. On ConceptMix, Graph2Scene improves relationship accuracy from 0.59 to 0.84 over the strongest FLUX.1-based regional-control baseline. Results on LongBench-T2I further show its advantage on long and complex prompts.

</details>


### [559] [Diffutoon-2: Toon Shading with Video Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30945)
*Yuze Sun,Zhongjie Duan,Yingda Chen,Jingjing Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Diffutoon-2 是一个基于视频扩散的卡通渲染框架，通过动画重建学习风格化，无需跨域训练配对或外部风格参考，并在定量指标和人工评估中优于通用及领域基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散模型卡通化方法通常依赖精心构建的源视频与风格训练配对或额外视觉参考；Diffutoon 虽避免这些要求，但基于图像扩散主干、短时窗运动模块和重复重叠窗口去噪，存在局限。

Method: 提出 Diffutoon-2：冻结视频扩散主干，使用两个互补模块分别从轮廓和模糊颜色独立重建动画片段；推理时，用从真实视频提取的同类条件联合引导生成，无需跨域训练配对或外部风格参考。

Result: 大量实验表明，Diffutoon-2 在多项定量指标和人工评估中均优于通用基线及领域专用基线。

Conclusion: Diffutoon-2 能有效实现无需配对训练数据和外部风格参考的视频卡通渲染，验证了通过动画重建学习卡通风格的视频扩散框架的有效性。

Abstract: Toon shading renders objects with a flat, stylized appearance. Diffusion models open a new route to this task by transforming photorealistic videos into an anime style. However, existing approaches often rely on curated source and style training pairs or additional visual references. Diffutoon avoids these requirements through structure guidance and colorization, but builds on an image diffusion backbone with short-window motion modules and repeated overlapping-window denoising. We present Diffutoon-2, a video diffusion framework that learns toon shading through animation reconstruction. Two complementary modules independently reconstruct animation clips from outlines and blurred colors, with the video backbone frozen. At inference, the modules jointly guide generation using the same types of conditions extracted from photorealistic footage, requiring neither cross-domain training pairs nor external style references. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Diffutoon-2 outperforms both general-purpose and domain-specific baselines, across quantitative metrics and human evaluation.

</details>


### [560] [FGSCalib: Targetless Camera-LiDAR Extrinsic Calibration from Foreground Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30935)
*Marcell Kégl,Csaba Benedek*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种无需标定靶标的相机-LiDAR外参标定方法FGSCalib，利用场景中运动物体的前景分割结果，在固定基础设施场景中完成相机与LiDAR的周期性重标定，并在仿真和真实数据上验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定安装的相机-LiDAR对需要定期重标定，但传统标定靶标会使设备暂停服务，因此需要一种无需靶标、无需人工初始外参的自动标定方法。

Method: FGSCalib仅假设场景中存在任意运动物体，不依赖物体类别；各传感器分离运动前景与静态背景，将相机掩码转换为边界邻近场，并通过两阶段模拟退火在选定帧对上搜索外参。方法无需测量初始外参，随机初值可得到相近结果，且适用于旋转式和非重复扫描LiDAR。

Result: 在21个有精确真值的仿真场景中，中位误差为5.3 cm和0.19°。在72个真实场景（8个场景中的9对相机-LiDAR）上，以43次人工标定平均值为参考，18 cm/1.8°容差被93%的单次人工标定满足；取5次运行中最低代价，FGSCalib在51/72场景满足该容差。其中Livox在20/24场景满足，而5个基线中最强者仅11个；两个旋转LiDAR在31/48场景满足，而仅有一个基线估计能满足。FGSCalib中位误差为9.5 cm和0.9°，单次人工标定为7.3 cm和0.7°。

Conclusion: FGSCalib表明利用运动物体前景即可实现无需靶标、无需初始外参的相机-LiDAR外参标定，在仿真和真实数据上均取得有效结果，并公开代码和数据集。

Abstract: Camera-LiDAR pairs installed as fixed infrastructure need periodic recalibration, but a calibration target takes the installation out of service. We present FGSCalib, a targetless method that calibrates a stationary camera-LiDAR pair from the objects moving in its view. We only assume that arbitrary moving objects are present in the scene: each sensor separates the moving foreground from the static background, without relying on object classes. With the correct extrinsic, the LiDAR foreground points project onto the camera foreground. FGSCalib turns the camera mask into a boundary-proximity field and finds the extrinsic by two-stage simulated annealing over selected frame pairs. It needs no measured initial extrinsic (random starts give similar results) and works with both rotating and non-repetitive LiDARs. We evaluate it on 21 simulated scenarios with exact ground truth and on 72 real ones (nine camera-LiDAR pairs in eight scenes), with a reference averaged from 43 manual calibrations. In simulation the median error is 5.3 cm and 0.19°. On real data we use a tolerance of 18 cm and 1.8°, met by 93% of single manual calibrations. Keeping the lowest-cost of five runs, FGSCalib meets it in 51 of the 72 scenarios: in 20 of 24 with the Livox, where the strongest of five baselines reaches 11, and in 31 of 48 with the two rotating LiDARs, where only one baseline estimate does. Its median error is 9.5 cm and 0.9°, against 7.3 cm and 0.7° for a single manual calibration. The code and the dataset are available online.

</details>


### [561] [Token Pruning Needs a Protected Sink Token: Coherent Spatial Aggregation in Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31025)
*Julian Wyatt,James Willoughby,Allison Clement,Irina Voiculescu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出蒙特卡洛Token剪枝（MCTP），通过在推理时显式移除Token来估计其对预测的影响，并研究不同ViT模型在不同深度对Token剪枝的响应差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作多比较Token缩减算法本身，却较少分析模型如何响应剪枝，以及这种响应是否随模型深度变化。

Method: 提出MCTP，在前向传播中显式移除Token并估计每个Token对预测的影响；将其应用于DINOv3、SigLIP 2等预训练模型，分析Token重要性排序在不同深度的一致性，并考察prefix token与高范数sink token的作用。

Result: DINOv3等多数模型在各深度保持相似的Token重要性排序，即高一致性聚合；SigLIP 2则不一致。该一致性依赖预测在剪枝后存活，并需保留高范数sink token。移除DINOv3的prefix token会导致预测与一致性崩溃；对SigLIP 2仅保护5个Token，可使物体边界框外Token影响最多降低62%。

Conclusion: MCTP可作为事后评估预训练ViT对剪枝响应的方法，并表明Token缩减方法应保留sink token。

Abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) are a predominant architecture for computer vision, with token reduction emerging as a popular paradigm to improve their efficiency. Prior work compares reduction algorithms, but not how models respond to them, nor how their response changes with model depth. We propose Monte Carlo Token Pruning (MCTP), which estimates each token's impact on the prediction when tokens are explicitly removed during the forward pass. Applying MCTP to recent pretrained models, we observe that most, such as DINOv3, maintain a similar ranking of token importance at every depth (high Coherent Aggregation), while SigLIP 2 does not. This coherence requires predictions to survive pruning, which depends on keeping high-norm "sink" tokens: prefix tokens are kept by design, while prefix-free SigLIP 2 forms them on patch tokens, which pruning may remove. We show that in removing DINOv3's prefix tokens, its predictions and coherence collapse, while protecting only 5 tokens for SigLIP 2 cuts the token impact outside the object's bounding box by up to 62%. Beyond this, MCTP offers a post-hoc method to evaluate how a pretrained ViT responds to pruning, and suggests that token reduction methods should keep "sinks".

</details>


### [562] [WildAnySplat: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting in the Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31023)
*Richard Shaw,Arthur Moreau,Athanasios Papaioannou,Thomas Tanay,Zhensong Zhang,Eduardo Pérez-Pellitero*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 WildAnySplat，一种面向野外多视角图像的前馈 3D Gaussian Splatting 框架，可在存在瞬态遮挡、光照变化和相机 ISP 差异等不一致情况下实现鲁棒的新视角合成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界多视角图像常因瞬态遮挡、光照变化和相机 ISP 导致跨视角不一致，现有前馈重建方法在此类野外数据上质量下降，因此需要更鲁棒且保持快速推理的重建方案。

Method: 采用学生-教师框架：教师网络处理干净图像并提供监督，学生网络处理野外输入以学习一致的规范表示；结合真实配对数据、合成增强和优化式重建生成的伪干净标签构建混合数据策略；使用 transformer 架构及 DPT 头预测相机位姿、深度和高斯；预测逐视角瞬态掩码以重加权光度监督并抑制不可靠高斯；引入 bilateral grid 模块建模逐图像颜色变换，恢复规范辐射表示。

Result: 在具有挑战性的野外基准上，WildAnySplat 提升了对瞬态遮挡和外观变化的鲁棒性，同时保留了前馈 Gaussian Splatting 的快速推理能力。

Conclusion: WildAnySplat 通过学生-教师学习、瞬态掩码和颜色校正等设计，有效缓解野外多视角不一致问题，实现鲁棒且高效的新视角合成。

Abstract: We present WildAnySplat, a feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that enables robust novel-view synthesis from in-the-wild multi-view images. Unlike controlled captures, real-world images often contain multi-view inconsistencies caused by transient occluders, illumination changes, and camera ISP, which degrade the quality of existing feed-forward reconstruction methods.
  To address this challenge, we introduce a student-teacher framework that learns transient-robust and appearance-consistent 3D representations. A teacher network operates on clean images, while a student processes the corresponding in-the-wild inputs. The teacher provides clean supervision to guide the student toward a consistent canonical representation. Since paired clean and in-the-wild data are scarce, we use a hybrid data strategy, combining real paired captures, synthetic augmentations, and pseudo-clean labels generated from optimization-based reconstructions, bridging the domain gap between synthetic and real-world data.
  We adopt a transformer architecture with dedicated DPT heads for camera pose, depth, and Gaussian prediction. We additionally predict per-view transient masks to reweight photometric supervision and suppress unreliable Gaussians. To account for cross-view appearance variation, we incorporate a bilateral grid module that models per-image color transformations and enables recovery of a canonical radiance representation.
  Experiments on challenging in-the-wild benchmarks show that WildAnySplat improves robustness to transient occlusions and appearance variation while retaining the fast inference of feed-forward Gaussian Splatting.

</details>


### [563] [OmniV-Bench: Can MLLMs Comprehend Immersive Spatio-temporal Scenes?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31022)
*Liu Yang,Huiyu Duan,Yixuan Gao,Sirui Liu,Lu Liu,Zhaolin Cai,Ke Gu,Xiongkuo Min,Xiaoping Zhang,Guangtao Zhai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文针对多模态大模型理解360°全景视频时空信息能力不足的问题，构建了OmniV-Bench评测基准，并提出OmniV-Harness代理框架以提升沉浸式时空推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全景视频能够提供丰富的360°空间上下文与时间动态，但现有MLLMs对这类沉浸式360°时空信息的理解尚未被充分探索，缺乏系统评测与有效提升方法。

Method: 构建OmniV-Bench，包含4,123段高质量全景视频和8,923个人工标注问答对，覆盖11个细粒度任务及通用、空间、时空理解三大类；并提出OmniV-Harness，通过视角引导证据初始化、任务相关证据获取和自适应工具使用来增强全景视频理解。

Result: 基准实验表明，全景视频的时空复杂性对当前MLLMs构成显著挑战；OmniV-Harness能够持续提升MLLMs的沉浸式时空推理能力。

Conclusion: 论文揭示了MLLMs在全景视频理解上的不足，提供了系统评测基准与代理增强框架，有助于推动沉浸式360°视频时空理解研究，并承诺发布OmniV-Bench和OmniV-Harness。

Abstract: Omnidirectional videos (ODVs) capture dynamic environments with a full $360^\circ$ field of view, providing rich spatial context and temporal dynamics for applications such as virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), and embodied intelligence. Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made great progress in spatial and temporal understanding, yet their ability to comprehend the immersive 360 spatio-temporal information conveyed by ODVs remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we first introduce OmniV-Bench, a Benchmark designed to comprehensively evaluate the capabilities of MLLMs on spatio-temporal Omnidirectional Video understanding. OmniV-Bench contains 4,123 high-quality ODVs collected from diverse scenes, along with 8,923 human-annotated question-answer pairs spanning 11 fine-grained tasks across three categories, i.e., general, spatial, and spatio-temporal understanding. Extensive benchmark experiments reveal that the spatio-temporal complexity of ODVs poses significant challenges for current MLLMs. To address these limitations, we further propose OmniV-Harness, an agentic harness that enhances ODV understanding through viewpoint-guided evidence initialization and task-relevant evidence acquisition with adaptive tool use. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that OmniV-Harness consistently improves immersive spatio-temporal reasoning ability of MLLMs. Both OmniV-Bench and OmniV-Harness will be released upon publication.

</details>


### [564] [Tokens as Locality-Preserving Anchors: Scalable Novel View Synthesis with Target-Adaptive Token Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31156)
*Sagnik Ghosh,Aswin C. Sankaranarayanan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于路由器的Transformer视角合成方法，通过预测并只让解码器关注少量关键源token，使渲染成本不再随源图像数量增长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Transformer视角合成模型虽能保留细节和视角相关效果，但解码器需对每帧关注所有源token，导致源图像越多渲染越慢；光栅化可通过剔除不可见图元加速，但源token没有显式位置和范围，无法直接剔除。

Method: 利用源token作为空间锚点、每个token编码局部场景区域的观察，训练轻量路由器根据源token和视角预测少数关键token；解码器只关注固定预算的top-ranked token，并用解码器注意力监督路由器，同时用非极大值抑制降低冗余token排名。

Result: 在24张源图像和两个视角token设置下，模型渲染速度比LagerNVS快6.4倍，PSNR仅低0.68 dB。

Conclusion: 该方法将解码器注意力成本与源token数量解耦，且同一排序可服务不同预算，因此可在渲染时动态调整token预算。

Abstract: Transformer-based view synthesis models render each target viewpoint from the source images, without an explicit 3D representation, which lets them reproduce fine detail and view-dependent effects. However, their decoder attends to every source token for every frame, so rendering slows with each source image. Rasterization avoids this by culling primitives that the viewpoint does not see, but source tokens cannot be culled this way, as they have no explicit position or extent. Our key insight is that source tokens are nonetheless spatial anchors: each encodes a local region of the scene, so the decoder's attention for any viewpoint concentrates on a few of them. A lightweight router predicts these tokens from the source tokens and the viewpoint, and the decoder attends only to a fixed budget of top-ranked tokens, so its cost no longer depends on the number of source tokens. We supervise the router with the decoder's attention, using non-maximum suppression to demote redundant tokens. With 24 source images and two views' worth of tokens, our model renders 6.4 times faster than LagerNVS, at a PSNR only 0.68 dB lower. One ranking serves every budget, so the budget can change at render time.

</details>


### [565] [Head Anything: Correspondence-Guided Joint Generation of 3D Heads from Few Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31143)
*Umut Kocasari,Bartłomiej Baranowski,Richard Shaw,Eduardo Pérez-Pellitero,Matthias Nießner*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Head Anything，可从同一人的少量不同表情和视角图像生成细节丰富的头部三维网格，并提升多图一致性与人脸跟踪效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像到3D生成器把每张图当作新对象，对同一人的多张图像会独立幻觉未见区域，无法利用图像间信息，导致多图结果不一致。

Method: 将预训练的单图生成器改造成联合生成器，在多图3D潜空间中共同去噪；引入轻量对应注意力适配器，使每个3D token只关注其他图像中的对应点；对应关系通过将神经参数化头模型拟合到生成器自身单图输出来获得，无需测试时真值，并用真值和拟合对应共同训练以增强鲁棒性。

Result: 在头部扫描数据上，相比最佳图像到3D生成器，Head Anything将头部Chamfer距离降低32%，跨帧不一致性降低47%，生成网格还能改善人脸跟踪。

Conclusion: 通过联合去噪和对应注意力复用多图信息，可在不依赖多图先验训练的情况下生成像素对齐且跨视角一致的详细头部网格，并能借其他图像补全未见区域。

Abstract: Large image-to-3D generators recover detailed heads from a single photograph but treat every image as a new object. For several images of one person, they hallucinate unseen regions independently without using information from the other images. We present Head Anything, which generates detailed head meshes from a few images with changing expressions and viewpoints. Instead of training a multi-image prior, we turn a pretrained single-image generator with a native 3D latent space into a joint generator that denoises all images together. Since global attention between images is hard to learn from scarce 3D head data, lightweight correspondence-attention adapters let every 3D token attend only to its corresponding points in the other images. We obtain correspondences by fitting a neural parametric head model to the generator's own single-image outputs, requiring no ground truth at test time. Training on both ground-truth and fitted correspondences makes the adapters robust to fitting errors. Each mesh stays pixel-aligned with its own image and borrows the unseen regions from all others. On head scans, Head Anything lowers the head Chamfer distance of the best image-to-3D generator by 32% and its cross-frame inconsistency by 47%, and its meshes improve face tracking. Code and models will be released.

</details>


### [566] [CrownFusion: 3D Dental Crown Generation Using Geometry Images and Latent Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31128)
*Johan Ziruo Ye,Xingguang Yan,Søren Hauberg,Angel X. Chang,Hao Zhang,Peter Lempel Søndergaard*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 CrownFusion，一种基于几何图像（CrownImage）的潜扩散模型，用于从二维网格编码生成三维牙冠设计，并发布包含 11,513 例标注口内扫描的 FDI 16 Crown Dataset。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统牙冠生成方法多采用点云表示，存在分辨率受限和三维生成平滑伪影等问题；同时临床中同一病例可能存在多种有效牙冠设计，需要更高质量且适应个体解剖形态的生成方法。

Method: 将牙冠表面坐标编码为二维几何图像 CrownImage，利用图像生成架构在高空间分辨率下保留细节；以周围牙列联合学习嵌入为条件，构建概率扩散模型生成具有形态变化的解剖合理牙冠；并提出基于与对颌牙邻接程度的咬合适配度量以容纳多种有效设计。

Result: 定量实验和专家参与的定性研究验证了方法有效性；生成的牙冠具有个体化形态变化和合理解剖结构；同时发布了包含 11,513 例标注口内扫描的 FDI 16 Crown Dataset 以支持牙科 CAD 研究。

Conclusion: CrownImage 表示结合扩散模型可有效生成高细节、解剖合理且个体适配的三维牙冠设计，并为多解设计评估和新数据集支持下的牙科 CAD 研究提供新思路。

Abstract: We introduce CrownFusion, a latent diffusion model to generate 3D dental crown designs from geometry images, a 2D-grid encoding of surface coordinates. Departing from traditional approaches that use point clouds, our "CrownImage" representation not only unlocks the full power of image-based generative architectures, but also preserves fine geometric detail by operating at far higher spatial resolutions than point clouds to alleviate smoothing artifacts in the 3D generation. Conditioned on jointly learned embeddings of the surrounding dentition, our probabilistic diffusion model produces anatomically plausible crowns with morphological variations tailored to individual patient cases. To accommodate multiple valid designs, we propose an occlusal fit metric based on proximity to the antagonist teeth. We evaluate our method through quantitative experiments and qualitative studies involving expert testimonials. We also release the FDI 16 Crown Dataset, comprising 11,513 annotated intra-oral scans, to support future research in dental CAD.

</details>


### [567] [HoloSplat: Real-Time Token Streaming for Feed-Forward Human Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31140)
*Chaofan Li,Qihan Ding,Shihan Wang,Zhehao Shen,Boyu Shen,Quanyu Chen,Haoyu Wu,Lan Xu,Xin Lou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HoloSplat 是一个面向人体体积视频的实时自由视点流式传输框架，通过拆分前馈重建器与高斯头，并结合服务器端 token 压缩和客户端 token 恢复，实现低带宽、低延迟、轻量 GPU 可解码的高质量 3D 高斯流媒体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自由视点人体视频流媒体需要实时重建、严格带宽预算和轻量客户端 GPU 解码，但逐帧优化或前馈推理会产生巨大的 3D Gaussian 数据量，超出实际流式传输限制；激进压缩又会严重降低渲染质量。

Method: HoloSplat 将前馈重建器在高斯头之前拆分，构建多速率流式编解码器：服务器端采用不透明度引导的 token 剪枝、基于 PCA 的降维以及 token anchors 的无损几何编码；客户端将特征重建超网络融合进高斯头以恢复压缩导致的质量损失；并提出 Neural Session Calibration（NSC），在预热阶段利用 incoming camera views 在线快速微调高斯头，且无逐帧开销。

Result: 在评估中，HoloSplat 在 50 Mbit/s 下于四块 RTX 5090 上平均达到 32.2 FPS；在 RTX 3050 Ti 笔记本 GPU 上每帧解码为 3D Gaussians 仅需 22.1 ms；相比未压缩 float32 Gaussians 传输数据量减少 22.8 倍；校准解码将 PSNR 提升 1.050 dB。

Conclusion: HoloSplat 表明通过重建器拆分、多速率 token 编解码、客户端特征恢复和在线会话校准，可以在严格带宽和轻量客户端条件下实现高质量实时人体体积视频流式传输。

Abstract: Live free-viewpoint video streaming of humans enables immersive telepresence and interactive XR applications. However, this requires reconstructing each frame in real time, transmitting the data within strict bandwidth budgets, and decoding it on lightweight client GPUs. Existing approaches, whether relying on per-frame optimization or feed-forward inference, generate massive 3D Gaussian payloads that exceed practical streaming limits, while aggressive compression severely degrades rendering quality. In this work, we present HoloSplat, a real-time streaming framework for human-centric volumetric video. HoloSplat splits a feed-forward reconstructor before its Gaussian head, introducing a multi-rate streaming codec driven by server-side token compression and client-side token restoration. On the server side, we apply opacity-guided token pruning, PCA-based dimensionality reduction, and lossless geometry coding for token anchors. On the client side, a feature reconstruction hypernetwork is fused into the Gaussian head to recover compression-induced quality loss.
