Furthermore, we introduce Neural Session Calibration (NSC), which rapidly fine-tunes the Gaussian head online using incoming camera views during a warm-up phase. This resolves quality degradation from novel camera parameters and varying capture conditions with zero per-frame overhead. In our evaluations, HoloSplat averages 32.2 FPS on four RTX 5090 GPUs at 50 Mbit/s. It decodes each frame into 3D Gaussians in 22.1 ms on an RTX 3050 Ti laptop GPU, transmitting 22.8$\times$ less data than uncompressed float32 Gaussians, while calibrated decoding improves PSNR by 1.050 dB.

</details>


### [568] [Analyzing and Improving FlowMap Distillation of Autoregressive Video Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31164)
*Yong-Hyun Park,Guande He,Joon Hyeok Kim,Hansheng Chen,Kaifan Yu,Chaoqi Luo,Xun Huang,Jiatao Gu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文分析独立自回归FlowMap蒸馏的局限，并提出防漂移引导与运动感知引导两种机制，使纯FlowMap蒸馏在少步自回归视频生成中达到有竞争力效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有少步自回归视频生成仍依赖分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）以保持竞争力，但这会牺牲样本多样性，且需要大型双向教师模型。作者希望分析并解决独立AR FlowMap蒸馏的瓶颈。

Method: 提出两种互补引导机制：1）防漂移引导，训练辅助模型模拟学生漂移，并作为负向引导分支帮助AR教师纠正漂移的学生 rollout；2）运动感知引导，定位运动区域并选择性应用跳层引导，使FlowMap学生更易学习运动。方法应用于1.3B AR教师下的π-Flow、MeanFlow和一致性蒸馏。

Result: 方法提升了生成质量，并减少30秒 rollout 中的漂移。4步π-Flow学生在VBench上可匹配由14B教师蒸馏的DMD学生，同时保留其AR教师的样本多样性。

Conclusion: 纯FlowMap蒸馏可有效用于少步自回归视频生成，无需依赖DMD即可兼顾质量与多样性。

Abstract: FlowMap distillation offers a natural route to few-step generative modeling by directly learning a teacher's denoising trajectories. Yet for autoregressive (AR) video generation, existing few-step models still rely on distribution matching distillation (DMD) to remain competitive, sacrificing sample diversity and requiring a large bidirectional teacher. In this work, we analyze what limits standalone AR FlowMap distillation and introduce two complementary guidance mechanisms to close this gap: (1) anti-drifting guidance, which helps the AR teacher correct drifted student rollouts by training an auxiliary model to mimic student drift and using it as a negative guidance branch; and (2) motion-aware guidance, which makes motion easier for a FlowMap student to learn by locating motion patches and selectively applying skip-layer guidance. Empirically, our approach applies to $π$-Flow, MeanFlow, and consistency distillation with 1.3B AR teachers, improving generation quality and reducing drift over 30 s rollouts. Notably, our 4-step $π$-Flow students match DMD students distilled from 14B teachers on VBench while preserving the sample diversity of their AR teachers, demonstrating that pure FlowMap distillation is effective for few-step autoregressive video generation.

</details>


### [569] [On-Policy Codec Distillation for Efficient All-in-One Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31184)
*Boyang Wang,Kevin Blackburn-Matzen,Oindrila Saha,Matheus Gadelha,Zezhou Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 CodecOPSD，将视频编解码思想用于视觉生成模型的条件 token 剪枝，并通过在线自蒸馏训练 DiT 适配器，在几乎不损失质量的情况下显著降低计算与缓存成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代视觉生成模型将身份、涂鸦、深度图、运动视频等条件都 token 化后拼接到输入序列，导致条件 token 主导计算成本，但其中大量 token 包含冗余的时空信息。

Method: 首先引入基于编解码器的 token 剪枝方法丢弃冗余条件 token；然后提出 on-policy self-distillation（OPSD）策略，训练能够适应编解码器剪枝模式的 DiT 适配器，二者共同构成 On-Policy Codec Distillation（CodecOPSD）。

Result: 在自研视频扩散模型上扩展到 16 种条件模态，平均剪掉 66% 的条件 token 且几乎无质量下降；去噪速度提升 2 倍，KV cache 模式下缓存内存最多减少 73%。该方法还可扩展到其他先进预训练图像和视频生成模型，且条件越多、帧越长、分辨率越高收益越明显。

Conclusion: 利用经典视频编解码思想识别条件 token 中的新增信息，并结合在线自蒸馏训练适配器，可在保持生成质量的同时显著加速视觉生成模型并降低内存开销。

Abstract: Modern visual generative models operate on tokens, and every visual asset they receive, whether an identity, a scribble, a depth map, or a motion video, is tokenized and appended to the input token sequence. Consequently, conditioning quickly dominates the computation cost. Yet most of these tokens carry redundant spatiotemporal information. Our key insight is that identifying what is genuinely new is exactly the problem that classical video codecs have long solved. Thus, we first introduce a codec-based token pruning method that discards redundant tokens. Then, we propose an on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) strategy to train a DiT adapter capable of learning the codec pruning pattern well without quality degradation. Together, they form On-Policy Codec Distillation (CodecOPSD). We scale CodecOPSD to 16 condition modalities on our own video diffusion model, where it prunes 66% of the condition tokens on average with almost no quality drop. Therefore, denoising becomes 2x faster, and the cache memory shrinks by up to 73% in KV cache mode. CodecOPSD also extends to other state-of-the-art pretrained image and video generative models, where its benefit grows further with more conditions, longer frames, and higher resolution.

</details>


### [570] [Déjà VAE: When Do Autoencoder Traces Reveal Generated Images?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31036)
*Saugat Pandey*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文分析潜扩散模型生成图像经自编码器再次往返后变化很小的“既视感”痕迹，探讨其何时能揭示生成图像，并指出基准测试中的匹配协议可能改变检测器比较结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重建型生成图像检测器依赖潜扩散模型输出再次通过自编码器后变化很小这一现象，但该痕迹何时有效、受何因素影响尚不清晰；同时现有基准可能因协议偏差导致不稳健结论。

Method: 使用冻结的视觉基础模型、无需训练读取中间层痕迹；比较生成器精确解码器与近似自编码器；仅用真实照片及其自编码器副本训练检测器，并在Synthbuster、GenImage等基准上与大规模生成图像训练及融合方法比较；分析JPEG重存、缩放、模糊和真实图像尺寸匹配协议的影响。

Result: 痕迹在中间层最强，且与像素重建误差不同，会将模糊视为真实图像迹象。Synthbuster上，Stable Diffusion 1.3/1.4/2/XL的精确解码器在8个自编码器中最强，5%虚警率下捕获其生成图像94-100%，近似版本仅7-42%。仅用真实照片及自编码器副本训练的检测器在GenImage上与大162k生成图像训练相当（+2.3点，95%CI[0.9,3.7]）并可融合互补，但一次缩放加JPEG重存或轻度模糊会损失19-27点。Chameleon可由图像宽度单独解决；Synthbuster中真实照片与生成图像尺寸匹配方式可使检测器领先或落后（+4.4或-9.7点）。

Conclusion: 潜扩散模型的精确解码器留下可利用的“既视感”痕迹，冻结视觉基础模型中间层可无需训练检测；但检测对图像后处理敏感，且基准中的尺寸匹配等协议足以逆转检测器比较，因此生成图像检测评估需严格控制基准协议。

Abstract: A latent diffusion model's output has already passed through its autoencoder, so a second round trip changes it very little. This "déjà vu" underlies reconstruction-based detectors of generated images; we analyse when it reveals a generated image and when it does not. Read by a frozen vision foundation model without training, the trace is strongest in intermediate layers, and, unlike pixel-level reconstruction error, it treats blur as a sign of a real image. It belongs to the generator's exact decoder: on Synthbuster, the exact decoders of Stable Diffusion 1.3, 1.4, 2 and XL are the strongest of eight autoencoders and catch 94-100% of their generators' images at a 5% false-alarm rate (SDXL's version identified post hoc), while near-identical versions catch 7-42%. A detector trained only on real photographs and their autoencoder copies matches one trained on 162k generated images on GenImage (+2.3 points, 95% CI [0.9, 3.7]) and complements it in fusion, but one resize with JPEG re-save, or a mild blur, costs it 19-27 points. Two lessons concern benchmarks. The in-the-wild benchmark Chameleon can be solved from image width alone. And on Synthbuster, how the real photographs are matched to the generated images' size decides whether our detector leads or trails (+4.4 or -9.7 points): the matching protocol alone can reverse a detector comparison. Code and per-image scores: https://github.com/iamsaugatpandey/deja-vae

</details>


### [571] [SPROUT: Predicting Objective-Grounded Prompt Utility for Efficient Text-to-Image Preference Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31163)
*Kangping Hu,Akshay Mehra,Stephen Mussmann*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出SPROUT提示选择方法，用于文本到图像扩散模型的偏好调优，通过预测目标相关效用选择最有信息量的提示，减少无效图像生成并提升计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 偏好调优大部分计算花在生成候选图像上，但训练提示通常均匀随机采样，导致大量计算用于生成对模型对齐信号不足的图像。

Method: 将提示选择分为效用分数、效用估计器和批次选择三部分。SPROUT用纯文本模型对提示池中所有提示（包括未见提示）预测效用，并在每轮用已观察效用重新拟合；再用随机接受规则形成批次，不额外生成训练外图像。在DGPO中，目标相关效用定义为提示对应图像组所产生目标梯度的范数。

Result: 用DGPO微调Stable Diffusion 1.5并在GenEval上评估，SPROUT约用44%的迭代达到均匀采样的最终分数，并提升学习曲线AUC，优于均匀采样和基于方差的CGPO。效率增益在四个未参与训练的留出奖励模型下仍成立，方法排名也延续到DPG-Bench和T2I-CompBench++。

Conclusion: 通过预测目标相关效用来选择提示，可显著提高偏好调优的计算效率，并具有较好的泛化性。

Abstract: Preference tuning of text-to-image diffusion models spends most of its compute generating candidate images, yet training prompts are typically sampled uniformly at random, wasting compute generating images that provide too little signal for model alignment. To best utilize the available compute, we study prompt selection, where at each iteration we identify the most useful prompts for preference tuning. We separate prompt selection into a utility score, an estimator of that utility score, and batch selection. Within this framework, we propose Selection by PRedicting Objective-grounded UTility (SPROUT). The utility score is predicted on every prompt in the pool, including unseen prompts, by a text-only model, refit after every iteration on all utilities observed so far. A randomized acceptance rule then turns these predictions into a batch, so no images are generated beyond those used for training. For direct group preference optimization (DGPO), the objective-grounded utility is the norm of the gradient that the objective produces from a prompt's group of images. Fine-tuning Stable Diffusion 1.5 with DGPO on GenEval, SPROUT matches the final score of uniform sampling in about 44% of the iterations and improves the area under the learning curve with respect to both uniform sampling and CGPO, a recent variance-based prompt sampler. The efficiency gains hold under four held-out reward models never used in training, and the ranking of methods carries over to DPG-Bench and T2I-CompBench++. Our code is available at https://github.com/ADDAPT-ML/SPROUT.

</details>


### [572] [Distill the Correction, Not the Rewrite: Hindsight Twins for Self-Improving Text-to-Image Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31048)
*Jiaze Li,Jingyang Chen,Wenhao Zhao,Haoran Xu,Zhenlong Yuan,Dianmo Sheng,Yuanxing Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 Hindsight Twins（HinT），通过构造“预期修正”和“观察到的错误”两个孪生提示并蒸馏其速度差，在提升文生图对齐性的同时抑制 critic 引入的无关场景偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自蒸馏和事后对比方法虽能让文生图模型从 VL critic 的修订提示中学习，但对齐提升有限，且会吸收 critic 无意添加的光照、场景等细节。作者归因于两点：修订提示常重写整个场景而掩盖目标修正；自教师以重写提示为条件，使预期修正与无意添加纠缠。

Method: HinT 将 critic 的修订模板分别填入“预期修正”和“观察到的错误”，以用户原始提示为锚点，仅蒸馏两者的速度差；同时考虑文本编码器会将单槽编辑扩散到其他 token，进一步对齐孪生提示在目标槽之外的 token 状态。

Result: 在 Qwen-Image-2512、SD3.5-M 和 FLUX.2-klein 上，HinT 将 critic 诱导偏差保持在基模型水平，同时匹配或超过已有自蒸馏方法的对齐增益；在十二轮自训练中持续提升，而对比基线会衰减。

Conclusion: HinT 能有效隔离 critic 的目标修正与无意添加，实现更稳定、可持续的文生图自训练对齐改进。

Abstract: Text-to-image models can learn from their own mistakes by distilling a self-teacher conditioned on a vision-language critic's revised prompt. However, such self-teachers barely improve alignment, and both they and their hindsight-contrast variants absorb the critic's unintended additions to the scene, such as lighting or scenery. We attribute this to two factors: (1) the prompt already specifies the desired fix, so a useful revision must go beyond the failed span, often rewriting the entire scene and adding details that overshadow the fix; (2) although the critic localizes the error to a single span, self-teachers condition on the rewrite, entangling the intended fix with unintended additions. Motivated by these insights, we propose Hindsight Twins (HinT), which fills the critic's revision template once with the intended fix and once with the observed error and distills only their velocity difference, anchored at the user's prompt. Because text encoders spread the edit of a single slot to all other tokens, HinT further aligns the twins' token states outside the slot. Across Qwen-Image-2512, SD3.5-M, and FLUX.2-klein, HinT keeps the rate of critic-induced bias at the base-model level while matching or exceeding the alignment gains of prior self-distillation, and it keeps improving over twelve rounds of self-training where contrastive baselines decay.

</details>


### [573] [WorldLatent: A Unified 4D Latent Space for World Perception and Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31209)
*Jingxi Chen,Yujia Chen,Cornelia Fermuller,Yiannis Aloimonos,Wen-Sheng Chu,Du Tran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 WorldLatent，用统一 4D 潜空间作为世界感知与生成的共同表示协议，通过多模态 VAE 融合外观、几何和动态信息，并用单一生成模型统一建模感知与生成任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前 4D 时空视觉缺乏统一表示协议，感知与生成通常由分离的单向流水线处理，或依赖未对齐的单模态表示拼接，难以像 GPT 一样用统一架构和优化流程学习多种任务。

Method: 提出 WorldLatent 框架：构建多模态 VAE，将复杂 4D 视觉外观、几何和动态压缩并融合为结构化统一潜表示；在该潜空间中，感知与生成被视为互补的去噪过程，使一个生成模型在单一训练循环中同时学习两类能力。

Result: 在代表性 4D 基准上，该融合潜协议实现了专家级零样本 4D 感知、连贯的 4D 生成以及可控编辑，且均由单一模型完成。

Conclusion: 多种 4D 任务可在共享表示协议下统一建模，为通用 4D 空间智能提供了可扩展基础。

Abstract: Generative Pre-Training (GPT) represents a profound milestone in natural language processing, serving as the foundation for most of today's state-of-the-art large language models. By casting diverse understanding and generation problems into a shared token representation, GPT enables a single architecture and unified optimization loop to master heterogeneous tasks across massive corpora, giving rise to powerful foundation models for natural language. In contrast, 4D spatiotemporal vision lacks a common representational protocol: perception (such as depth and camera estimation) and generation are either handled by separate one-way pipelines or bolted together from unaligned single-modality spaces. In this work, we introduce WorldLatent, a framework that formulates a unified 4D latent space as a common protocol for both world perception and generation. Rather than relying on fragmented, task-specific models or stacked single-modality representations, our framework proposes a multimodal VAE architecture that compresses and fuses complex 4D visual appearance, geometry, and dynamics into a single structured latent representation. Within this formulation, perception and generation operate as complementary denoising processes over the same latent space, enabling one generative model to learn both capabilities simultaneously within a single training loop. Experiments across representative 4D benchmarks verify that our fused latent protocol achieves specialist-level zero-shot 4D perception, coherent 4D generation, and controllable editing from a single model. By demonstrating that diverse 4D tasks can be seamlessly unified under a shared representational protocol, our work provides a scalable foundation for general-purpose 4D spatial intelligence.

</details>


### [574] [Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation via Mutual Information Maximization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31225)
*Mohammad Hossein Moslemi,Mahdi Beitollahi,Zhimin Mei,Jiale Cai,Bissan Ghaddar,Boyu Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MIPA方法，用于自监督学习中的数据集蒸馏，通过优化合成图像以保留增强不变信息，并在图像分类基准上取得优于现有方法的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据集蒸馏在监督学习中已较成功，但在自监督学习中仍研究不足；蒸馏数据需保留学习对数据增强保持一致的表征所需的信息。

Method: MIPA将合成图像视为可学习原型，用冻结编码器根据特征相似度把真实样本分配给原型；通过最大化同一真实图像不同增强视图之间跨视图分配结果的互信息，促使合成数据保留增强不变性，同时避免所有样本仅分配到少数原型的平凡解。

Result: 在图像分类基准上的评估表明，MIPA生成的合成数据能训练出比现有蒸馏方法更高质量的表征，同时降低蒸馏过程中的时间和存储需求。

Conclusion: MIPA是一种高效的自监督学习数据集蒸馏方法，可有效保留增强不变信息，并在表征质量和蒸馏效率方面优于现有方法。

Abstract: Dataset distillation (DD) aims to compress a large dataset into a small synthetic one that remains effective for training neural networks. Despite its success in supervised learning, DD remains underexplored in self-supervised learning (SSL), where distilled data must preserve the information needed to learn representations that remain consistent across augmentations. To bridge this gap, we introduce Mutual Information Prototype Alignment (MIPA), an efficient SSL dataset distillation approach that optimizes synthetic images to preserve augmentation-invariant information. Specifically, MIPA treats synthetic images as learnable prototypes and uses a frozen encoder to assign real samples to them based on feature similarity. A synthetic dataset that preserves such augmentation invariance should yield stable prototype assignments across multiple augmented views of the same real image. MIPA encourages this by maximizing mutual information between cross-view assignments while avoiding trivial solutions in which all real samples are assigned to only a few synthetic prototypes. Evaluations on image classification benchmarks show that synthetic data generated by MIPA yield higher-quality representations than existing distillation approaches while reducing time and storage demands during distillation.

</details>


### [575] [Let Vision-Language Models Generate Images through Their Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31237)
*JB Kim,Byungwoo Jeon,Kyungmin Lee,Hyeonmo Kang,Cheonbok Park,Shinyoung Joo,Jinwoo Shin,Jeonghoon Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Integral，通过构建共享视觉表示空间，将预训练视觉语言模型转化为统一的多模态模型，同时保留理解能力并增强视觉生成能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一多模态模型难以有效整合视觉理解与生成，核心挑战在于两类能力使用的视觉表示异质；作者希望利用预训练视觉语言模型已学到的多模态知识来支持生成。

Method: 提出 Integral，包含两个组件：Abstraction Fusion 聚合冻结视觉编码器的分层表示以构建共享视觉 token；Block-wise MoT 引入轻量生成流，仅在块边界与视觉语言模型交互。

Result: 该方法有效保留预训练理解能力，同时扩展到较强视觉生成；在重建保真度相当的情况下，共享视觉表示比独立视觉表示空间显著提升生成学习效果。

Conclusion: 预训练视觉语言模型学到的表示已能为视觉生成提供有效基础，共享理解与生成的视觉表示是统一多模态模型的关键设计。

Abstract: Recent unified multimodal models aim to combine visual understanding and generation within a single model, yet effectively integrating the two capabilities remains challenging. Leveraging pretrained vision-language models offers a way to build on already learned multimodal knowledge, but making this knowledge effectively accessible to visual generation remains nontrivial. We find that a central challenge lies in the heterogeneous visual representations used for understanding and generation. To address this challenge, we introduce Integral, which converts a pretrained vision-language model into a unified multimodal model by constructing a shared visual representation space across the two capabilities. Integral implements this design through two complementary components. Abstraction Fusion constructs shared visual tokens by aggregating hierarchical representations from the frozen vision encoder, while Block-wise MoT introduces a lightweight generative stream that interacts with the vision-language model only at block boundaries. Our approach effectively preserves the pretrained understanding capability while extending it to strong visual generation. Controlled comparisons further demonstrate that sharing visual representations between understanding and generation substantially improves generative learning compared with using a separate visual representation space, despite comparable reconstruction fidelity. These results suggest that representations learned by pretrained vision-language models already provide an effective foundation for visual generation.

</details>


### [576] [Lyris: Layout-Guided Long Video Generation with Persistent 3D Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31239)
*Chen Wang,Jiahui Huang,Riccardo de Lutio,Alex Trevithick,Bryan Chu,Jiawei Ren,Laura Leal-Taixé,Shengyu Huang,Lingjie Liu,Haithem Turki*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Lyris 是一个长视频生成框架，仅需单张照片即可生成超长、相机可控、回到原处仍保持一致的三维场景漫游视频。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于记忆的视频生成能保留已见内容，但在未见区域缺乏锚定，导致相机漂移且文本提示无法精确放置物体；布局条件方法虽能提供精确控制，但依赖人工制作布局。

Method: 提出 Lyris，将持久点云记忆（用于已观察或已生成区域）与视觉语言模型自动生成的三维布局（用于未观察区域）结合；用每个物体一个带标签3D框的粗粒度布局作为视频模型与视觉语言模型之间的接口，并沿相机路径渲染供视频模型遵循。

Result: 可从单张照片生成超过3分钟、50米的漫游视频，并能穿过门进入未展示房间；在四个数据集的一分钟往返评测中，相机误差降低3.8倍，返回一致性平均提升22%，显著优于现有方法。

Conclusion: Lyris 通过点云记忆与自动3D布局为视频模型持续提供锚定，实现了长距离、可控且回到原处一致的单图场景漫游生成。

Abstract: Exploring a scene from as little as a single photo requires generating a long, camera-controlled walkthrough that extends far beyond what was captured, yet remains consistent upon return. Memory-based video generation methods preserve what they have already seen, but have no anchor beyond it, where the camera drifts from its path and a text prompt can name objects but not place them. Layout-conditioned methods provide such an anchor and precise control over what appears where, but rely on layouts that are typically authored by hand. Both limitations arise because, beyond what was captured, nothing anchors the video model unless a human authors one. To overcome both, we propose Lyris, a long video generation framework that never leaves the video model without an anchor: a persistent point-cloud memory where the scene has been observed or generated, and a 3D layout that a vision-language model authors where it has not. Our key insight is that the interface between the two models can be surprisingly coarse. A layout of one labeled 3D box per object is simple enough for a vision-language model to author (and for a user to edit), yet expressive enough for a video model to follow once rendered along the camera path. We demonstrate walkthroughs of over three minutes and 50 meters from a single photo, passing through doorways into rooms it never shows. When evaluated on minute-long round trips across four datasets, Lyris outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a wide margin, reducing camera error by 3.8x and improving consistency upon return by 22% on average.

</details>


### [577] [LeJEPA Features Are Not Isotropic, and Should Not Be](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31216)
*Richeek Das,Pratik Chaudhari*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文分析LeJEPA中SIGReg正则化器的问题，指出其难以实现各向同性高斯特征，且该目标过强；提出仅约束幅值和方向边缘分布的PolarReg，从而更稳定高效地训练自监督编码器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LeJEPA使用SIGReg将特征正则化为各向同性高斯分布，但作者质疑该正则器在实践中的有效性以及各向同性高斯特征是否适合自监督编码器。

Method: 首先设计改进版SIGReg以更好实现原目标；其次分析LeJEPA对齐项与SIGReg的冲突，说明对齐项将特征幅值与方向耦合，而各向同性高斯要求二者独立；最后将各向同性高斯正则化重构为仅约束幅值和方向边缘分布、不强制独立性的PolarReg。

Result: 改进SIGReg在ImageNet-100上以1.3倍更少epoch达到SIGReg最终精度；LeJEPA特征实际并非各向同性，且其正则器较弱、目标过严；PolarReg在多数据集、batch size和嵌入维度下无需调参即可稳定优化，在ImageNet-1k上以4.7倍更少epoch匹配LeJEPA及其变体，并提升最终精度1.8个百分点。

Conclusion: LeJEPA存在正则器弱和各向同性高斯目标过严两个问题；不应强制自监督编码器特征各向同性高斯；仅约束幅值和方向边缘分布的PolarReg是更简单、稳定且高效的正则化方案。

Abstract: The SIGReg term in LeJEPA regularizes features to have an isotropic Gaussian distribution. Our first result is to show that this regularizer, in practice, cannot achieve its goal. We design a modified regularizer to enforce the objective better. This leads to slightly improved performance. For example, on ImageNet-100, our modified regularizer reaches the final accuracy of SIGReg in 1.3$\times$ fewer epochs. Our second result argues that self-supervised encoders should not have isotropic Gaussian features. We show that the alignment term in LeJEPA conflicts with SIGReg, because it couples the magnitude of the features with their directions. In contrast, isotropic Gaussian features would entail independent magnitude and directions. Features obtained with LeJEPA are, in fact, not isotropic. So LeJEPA has two issues. Its regularizer is weak, and the isotropic Gaussian target is too strict. Our third result is about reformulating the isotropic Gaussian regularizer to enforce only the marginal distributions of the magnitude and direction, without enforcing independence. This leads to a simple regularization term, PolarReg, that can be optimized reliably across many different datasets, batch sizes and embedding dimensions without any hyper-parameter changes. On ImageNet-1k, our technique matches the accuracy of LeJEPA and its variants in 4.7$\times$ fewer epochs. It improves the final accuracy by 1.8 points.

</details>


### [578] [TowerBridge: Bridging the Dual-Encoder Modality Gap via Weight-Space Programming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31233)
*Hani Alomari,Md Atabuzzaman,Chris Thomas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究CLIP双编码器中的模态间隔与检索失败问题，提出一种无需反向传播的闭式权重修正方法TowerBridge，通过削弱难负样本与匹配对过度一致的特定方向来提升检索性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP双编码器将图像和文本映射到共享嵌入空间，但两个模态占据不同区域形成模态间隔；错误匹配或难负样本常排在正确匹配之前，而事后直接消除模态间隔会在测试的每个CLIP检查点上降低检索性能，因此需要更精准的修正方式。

Method: 作者引入成对统计量，识别两个塔在难负样本上比匹配对上更一致的方向，并轻度衰减这些方向。通过权重空间编程，让LLM代理检查两个塔并写出闭式权重编辑，无需反向传播。随后将反复出现的修正提炼为TowerBridge：一种基于难负样本间隔一阶分析的闭式配方，可从25,000个标注对在数秒内计算，无需模型特定调参，且不改变架构和推理成本。

Result: LLM代理在全部13个CLIP检查点上提升COCO测试检索，并在其中12个上编辑输出投影。TowerBridge在全部21个评估CLIP检查点上平均提升COCO测试检索16.8 RSUM、Flickr30k测试检索6.6，其中包括8个代理未见过的检查点，同时将ImageNet零样本准确率下降限制在0.5个百分点以内。它还在全部21个检查点上降低hubness，并在其他家族的5个双编码器中的4个上提升检索。

Conclusion: 直接消除模态间隔并非有效方案；针对性地衰减难负样本过度一致的方向可以在基本保留模态间隔的同时改善检索。TowerBridge提供了一种通用、低成本、闭式且不改变架构与推理成本的修正方法，并能提升跨检查点和其他双编码器家族的检索表现。

Abstract: CLIP-style dual encoders map images and text through two separate towers into a shared embedding space, where the two modalities occupy distinct regions separated by a modality gap. Retrieval fails when wrong matches, or hard negatives, outrank the correct one, and the gap is the usual suspect. Yet removing it post hoc degrades retrieval on every CLIP checkpoint we test. We introduce a paired statistic that identifies directions where the two towers agree more on hard negatives than on matched pairs. Mildly attenuating these directions improves retrieval while largely preserving the gap. We arrive at this correction through weight-space programming: guided by the statistic, an LLM agent inspects both towers and writes closed-form weight edits without backpropagation. Free to edit any component, the agent improves COCO test retrieval on all 13 CLIP checkpoints and edits an output projection in 12 of the 13. We distill and refine its recurring correction into TowerBridge, a closed-form recipe motivated by a first-order analysis of the hard-negative margin. Computed in seconds from 25,000 labelled pairs, it requires no model-specific tuning and leaves the architecture and inference cost unchanged. TowerBridge improves COCO test retrieval by 16.8 RSUM and Flickr30k test retrieval by 6.6 on average across all 21 evaluated CLIP checkpoints, including 8 unseen by the agent, while limiting any drop in ImageNet zero-shot accuracy to 0.5 points. It also reduces hubness on all 21 checkpoints and improves retrieval on 4 of 5 dual encoders from other families.

</details>


### [579] [Modern Self-Supervised Vision Transformers Are Pareidolic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31238)
*Zihang Lin,Huaiyuan Qin,Liangli Zhen,Qing Guo,Jun Liu,Yew-Soon Ong,Hongyuan Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文发现自监督ViT在纯白噪声上仍会产生空间连贯的“空想性错视”特征子空间，该子空间在DINOv2/DINOv3中占主导并抑制物体涌现；作者提出无需训练的PSC校准方法，通过噪声估计并缩放该子空间，显著提升目标发现、显著性检测和视频目标分割性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DINOv2和DINOv3具有更强的稠密特征，却在物体涌现能力上明显落后于DINO。作者希望解释这一矛盾，并找到恢复其物体发现能力的方法。

Method: 作者定义pareidolic subspace，即在无物体和空间结构的白噪声输入上仍形成空间连贯模式的少数特征方向；分析不同模型、不同层和不同训练损失下该子空间的形成与作用；提出Pareidolia Subspace Calibration（PSC），仅用噪声输入测量该子空间，再将自然图像特征沿这些方向的方差缩放到其余方向的水平。

Result: 该子空间在DINOv2/DINOv3中占据大部分特征方差，而在DINO中较少；缩小该子空间可逐步恢复物体涌现能力。PSC在目标发现上最高提升31.7 CorLoc，在显著性检测上提升30.2 maxF，在视频目标分割上提升59.9 J。逐层追踪表明该现象在每个自监督模型的中层形成，但只有使用patch级损失的模型会使其保持到最后一层，受控训练证实仅用image级损失会使其消退。

Conclusion: DINOv2/DINOv3的物体涌现能力是被pareidolic subspace阻碍而非丢失；PSC可作为无需训练的校准方法提升多种物体涌现任务；patch级损失是维持该子空间并影响物体涌现的重要因素。

Abstract: In human perception, pareidolia is the tendency to perceive a meaningful pattern, such as a face, in a random or ambiguous stimulus.We find a similar phenomenon in modern self-supervised Vision Transformers (ViTs): on white noise, which contains neither objects nor spatial structure, a few directions of their features still form spatially coherent patterns across the patches, imposed by the features themselves.We call this behavior pareidolia, and the span of these directions the pareidolic subspace.On natural images, it holds most of the feature variance in DINOv2 and DINOv3 but little in DINO.This excess explains why DINOv2 and DINOv3, despite stronger dense features, fall far behind DINO in object emergence, the hallmark ability of self-supervised ViTs to identify the patches of an object on their own.Our experiments further show that scaling down their pareidolic subspaces steadily restores their ability to discover objects, so their object emergence is hindered rather than lost.These findings naturally lead to a training-free calibration: Pareidolia Subspace Calibration(PSC) measures the pareidolic subspace only on a noise input and then calibrates the features of natural inputs by scaling its directions down to the variance level of the remaining directions.Across diverse object emergence tasks, PSC improves DINOv2 and DINOv3 by up to 31.7 CorLoc on object discovery, 30.2 maxF on saliency detection and 59.9~$\mathcal{J}$ on video object segmentation.To identify the cause of pareidolia, we trace it block by block and find that it forms in the middle blocks of every self-supervised model we examine but stays strong to the last block only in models trained with a patch-level loss; controlled training confirms that an image-level loss alone lets it fade.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [580] [What Counts as Attack Success? Evaluating Harmfulness in Red Teaming LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28038)
*Ruyuan Wan,Adriana Alvarado Garcia,Md Toufikuzzaman,Dongwon Lee,Ting-Hao `Kenneth' Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文考察红队研究中“有害性”标准如何被指定并影响结果：许多论文沿用既有数据集、分类器或评审提示，而非自行定义有害性；同一回答在不同评估器下可能得到不同判断，甚至改变模型比较结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 判断模型回答是否有害涉及语境和规范选择，但红队研究常把这一判断交给自动评估器，因此需要审视有害性标准如何被界定并传导到研究结论。

Method: 综述76篇论文，分析其有害性标准的来源；并将这些论文中的评估器应用于相同输出，比较其对同一回答的判断差异及对模型比较结论的影响。

Result: 许多研究直接采用先前数据集、分类器或评审提示中的标准；不同评估器对同一回答可作出不同判断，并可能改变模型比较结论。差异部分源于对“有害”边界界定不同：有的把任何未拒绝的回答计为有害，有的只计算可能实际造成伤害的输出。

Conclusion: 红队研究应明确说明有害性标准，并报告评估器的选择与验证方式，以支持更可靠的测量和解释。

Abstract: Judging whether a model response is harmful requires contextual and normative choices, yet red-teaming studies often delegate this judgment to automated evaluators. We examine how harmfulness criteria are specified in red-teaming research and how they carry through to reported results. Reviewing 76 papers, we find that many adopt their criteria from prior datasets, classifiers, or judge prompts rather than defining harmfulness themselves. Applying evaluators from these papers to identical outputs, we find that they can reach different judgments on the same response, which can change conclusions when comparing models. These differences arise partly because evaluators draw the boundary of harm in different places: some count any response that does not refuse, while others count only output that could plausibly cause harm. We argue that red-teaming studies should state their harmfulness criteria and report how they chose and validated their evaluators to support more reliable measurement and interpretation.

</details>


### [581] [Distributionally-Verifiable Rewards for Human-Behavior Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28048)
*Ruoyun Ma,Shuang Liu,Peiye Liu,Ao Qu,Baichuan Mo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出一种用于社会调查受访者模拟的强化学习奖励 DVR，在保持个体回答准确率的同时改善总体分布拟合与人口统计差异捕捉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型越来越多用于模拟调查受访者，但常见训练方法难以同时兼顾个体预测、总体分布对齐和人口统计差异。精确匹配奖励会偏向最常见的人类回答，与分布对齐目标冲突；而聚合分布匹配即使忽略人口统计信息也可能表现良好。

Method: 提出 Distributionally-Verifiable Rewards（DVR），一种基于人口统计群体分布差距的强化学习奖励。该方法在每个问题-群体边际内，将策略生成答案的频率与人类回答频率对齐，并在 OpinionQA 数据集上评估。

Result: 与仅优化准确率的 RLVR 相比，DVR 保持逐回答准确率，同时将分布内 JSD 降低 34.5%、留出问题 JSD 降低 14.6%，并在两个划分上取得更高的 DPC 点估计。将 KL-SFT 与忽略人口统计的边际分布比较还表明，低 JSD 不足以证明对人口异质性的忠实性。

Conclusion: 准确率、分布拟合和人口统计结构应被共同评估；仅凭低 JSD 不能说明模型充分捕捉了 population heterogeneity。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate survey respondents in social-science research. A useful simulator should predict individual responses, reproduce population response distributions, and capture demographic differences. Common training approaches struggle to balance these goals: exact-match rewards encourage the model to concentrate on the most frequent human response, which is contradictory to the goal of distributional alignment. Meanwhile, aggregate distribution matching can look good even when demographic information is ignored. To this end, we introduce Distributionally-Verifiable Rewards (DVR), a reinforcement-learning reward that uses demographic group distribution gaps to guide individual responses, designed by aligning policy generated frequencies with human response frequencies within each question-group margins. We evaluate the method using the OpinionQA dataset and find that comparing with accuracy-only RLVR, DVR preserves per-response accuracy while reducing JSD by 34.5% in-distribution and 14.6% on held-out questions, with higher DPC point estimates on both splits. Comparing KL-SFT with the demographics-blind marginal further shows that low JSD is insufficient to establish fidelity to population heterogeneity, highlighting that accuracy, distributional fit, and demographic structure should be evaluated together.

</details>


### [582] [Benchmarking and Adapting LLMs for English-Swedish Medical Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28050)
*Seyed Alireza Molavi,Zhan Su,Stefan Byttner,Yan Hu,Peyman Sheikholharam Mashhadi,Prayag Tiwari*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文构建了英瑞医学多选题对齐基准，并提出用英文数据和开放教师模型提升小模型瑞典语医学表现的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在英语医学考试上表现较好，但瑞典语等小语种尤其是医院可本地部署的小型开放模型表现不足，相关评测和缩小差距的方法缺乏。

Method: 从十个医学多选题数据集构建英瑞逐项对齐基准，瑞典语题目保留英文源题的选项和答案；采用保守翻译精修流程，由三个家族的开放模型找错并结合瑞典医学术语库定位，仅在盲评投票通过时保留模型修改。随后翻译训练数据，让教师模型生成推理轨迹，并在英语、瑞典语或双语的金标准答案或推理轨迹上微调两个小型学生模型。

Result: 小模型在瑞典语下准确率损失远大于大模型，尤其在无推理作答时。使用含瑞典语的推理轨迹训练可弥合差距，将1.2B学生模型瑞典语成绩从23.5%提升到52.0%，略高于20B开放模型快速模式，且内存仅为其约六分之一。

Conclusion: 高质量对齐基准和含瑞典语推理轨迹的开放教师蒸馏能显著提升小模型瑞典语医学能力，并发布基准、编辑历史和代码。

Abstract: Large language models do well on English medical exams, but less is known about Swedish. This matters most for small open models that hospitals can run locally. To reduce this gap, we first build an item-aligned English-Swedish benchmark from ten medical multiple-choice datasets; each Swedish item keeps the options and answer of its English source. A conservative refinement loop repairs the translations: open models from three families find errors, ground them in a Swedish medical term base, and keep a model-written edit only if blind judges vote for it. On this benchmark, small models lose much more accuracy in Swedish than large ones, especially when they answer without reasoning. Second, we ask whether English data and open teacher models can close this gap. We translate the training data, let teachers write reasoning traces, and fine-tune two small students on gold answers or traces in English, Swedish, or both. Training on reasoning traces that include Swedish closes the gap and lifts the 1.2B student from 23.5\% to 52.0\% in Swedish, slightly above a 20B open model in its fast mode, with a sixth of its memory. We release the benchmark, its edit history, and the code.

</details>


### [583] [SnakeTranslate: Weakly Supervised Policy Learning from Offline Parallel Text for Simultaneous Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28055)
*Yu Pu,Zhiyun Fan,Baiji Liu,Zhifu Gao,Xiangang Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 SnakeTranslate，通过将损失导出的对齐适配到采样的因果历史，联合学习自适应同传中的前缀翻译与 READ/WRITE 决策，并在多个基准上改善质量—延迟权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应同传既需要可靠的前缀翻译，又需要及时的 READ/WRITE 决策，但普通平行语料不提供动作标注，难以直接监督学习。

Method: SnakeTranslate 将损失导出的对齐适配到采样的因果历史，以联合学习翻译与决策；支持在平行文本上进行监督微调（SFT），以及在学生生成翻译上使用反向 KL 散度进行同策略蒸馏（OPD）；推理时源语言与目标语言 token 构成单一的仅追加交错历史，实现带缓存复用的增量解码。

Result: 在 FLEURS、NTREX128 和 WMT24++ 上，4B 模型相比应用于同一离线调优骨干的流式策略改善了质量—延迟权衡，OPD 带来进一步提升；在低到中等延迟下优于更大的翻译模型，但在 WMT24++ 上高延迟场景仍存在质量差距。

Conclusion: SnakeTranslate 能有效利用平行语料和自生成翻译联合学习同传翻译与读写决策，并在低/中等延迟下取得有竞争力的质量—延迟表现，但高延迟质量仍是后续改进方向。

Abstract: Adaptive simultaneous translation requires reliable prefix translation and timely READ/WRITE decisions, but ordinary parallel corpora provide no action annotations. We present SnakeTranslate, which adapts loss-derived alignment to sampled causal histories for jointly learning both capabilities. The framework supports supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on parallel text and on-policy distillation (OPD) with reverse Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence on student-generated translations. At inference, source and target tokens form one append-only interleaved history, enabling incremental decoding with cache reuse. On FLEURS, NTREX128, and WMT24++, our 4B model improves quality--latency trade-offs over streaming policies applied to the same offline-tuned backbone, with further gains from OPD. It also compares favorably with larger translation models at low and moderate latency, while higher-latency quality gaps remain on WMT24++.

</details>


### [584] [Language Model Harnesses can be Compositional Generalizers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28298)
*Alex L. Zhang,Souradip Chakraborty,Omar Khattab*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文研究训练神经符号化的语言模型harness（如递归语言模型RLM），通过程序化外部管理上下文来实现组合泛化。实验表明，短任务训练可迁移到长2-64倍的任务，且能跨域迁移；提出surrogate harness training，用合成替代环境训练harness内单个LLM调用，使RLM-27B在长上下文任务上平均提升26.9%，推理token约减少一半。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准harness会不断累积上下文，迫使神经网络泛化到这些上下文，导致长程任务训练昂贵且耗时。作者希望探索训练神经符号化harness是否能以更高计算回报实现组合泛化，使神经LM每次只处理局部同分布的观察。

Method: 研究RLM等神经符号化harness，并采用强化学习后训练；用短任务训练测试长任务泛化和跨域迁移；提出surrogate harness training，通过生成含假工具/子调用的更简单合成替代环境，针对harness内单个LLM调用进行训练；并利用递归子harness调用进行组合。

Result: 仅在短任务上训练即可泛化到长2-64倍的任务，且优于基础神经LM的改进；在一个领域训练可迁移到共享潜在结构的新领域；RLM-27B在CTC-Bench和ExpertLongBench等困难长上下文任务上平均提升26.9%，推理时token约少2倍；harness可通过递归子harness调用组合已学分解。

Conclusion: 训练神经符号化LM harness能带来更好的计算回报，促进组合泛化并支持长程任务；surrogate harness training和递归子harness组合是有效路径。

Abstract: Modern language models (LMs) are post-trained and deployed as agents inside a "harness", but standard harness designs accumulate context that the neural network is forced to generalize to, making training for long-horizon tasks expensive and time-consuming. We study an alternative emerging path: training inherently neurosymbolic LM harnesses, which externalize and manage context programmatically to compose existing LM capabilities. We hypothesize that training around these harnesses can offer a better return on compute by enabling compositional generalization, as they can learn to decompose complex problems so that every observation their neural LM receives is locally in-distribution, even when the full task is novel. We find that harnesses like the Recursive Language Model (RLM) learn such decompositions readily under reinforcement learning post-training: (1) we demonstrate that training only on short tasks can generalize to tasks 2-64$\times$ longer while the base neural LM improves less, and (2) training on one domain transfers to novel domains that share latent structure. On messier, complex tasks, we find that we can target individual LLM calls within a harness by generating and training on easier, synthetically generated surrogate environments with fake tool / sub-calls, a technique we call surrogate harness training. From this finding, we train RLM-27B on synthetic data, and show it improves Qwen3.8-27B in the same RLM harness on a hard suite of long-context tasks like CTC-Bench and ExpertLongBench by 26.9% on average while using $\sim$2$\times$ fewer tokens at inference time. Finally, we show that harnesses can compose over these newly learned decompositions using recursive sub-harness calls.

</details>


### [585] [Contrastive On-Policy Distillation via Dual-Branch Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28359)
*Zhibo Hou,Fan Zhao,Yiping Li,Zhiyu An,Wan Du*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出对比式在策略蒸馏（cOPD），通过在学生生成前缀处对比强教师、弱教师和学生的预测，提供双分支监督，从而提升蒸馏效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在在策略蒸馏中，能力更强的模型常被选为教师，但更高任务性能不一定意味着更强的可教性；受控 token 干预研究表明，即使比学生弱的模型也可作为有信息量的对比参考。

Method: 基于受控 token 干预观察，提出 cOPD：在学生生成的前缀处，对比强教师、弱教师和学生的预测，形成三路比较与双分支监督，以选择与更好或更差推理结果相关的 token 候选；并在数学推理、指令遵循和带弃答的问答任务上，跨不同训练阶段、参数规模和模型家族评估。

Result: cOPD 在三类任务上均取得最佳或顶尖表现；数学推理整体 Pass@16 相比最强基线最高提升 7.51%；分析显示其抑制不良响应模式，并可能促进探索。

Conclusion: 弱教师可作为有效的对比参考；cOPD 能利用强/弱教师与学生预测的三路对比提升在策略蒸馏效果，并在多种教师-学生配置下表现稳健。

Abstract: For on-policy distillation (OPD), more capable models are a natural choice as teachers. However, higher task performance does not necessarily imply greater teachability. A controlled token intervention study suggests that even a model weaker than the student can serve as an informative contrastive reference. Building on this observation, we propose Contrastive On-Policy Distillation (cOPD), which provides dual branch supervision by contrasting strong teacher, weak teacher, and student predictions at student generated prefixes. Our analysis explains how this three way comparison helps select token candidates associated with better or worse reasoning outcomes under an idealized model. We evaluate cOPD across diverse teacher student configurations spanning different training stages, parameter scales, and model families, on tasks including mathematical reasoning, instruction following, and question answering with abstention. cOPD achieves the best or top-tier performance among the evaluated baselines across all three tasks, improving overall Pass@16 on mathematical reasoning by up to 7.51\% over the strongest baseline. Further analyses show that cOPD suppresses undesirable response patterns and suggest that it facilitates exploration.

</details>


### [586] [Grammar-as-a-Draft: More Tokens per Speculative Decoding Step on Grammar-Constrained Structured Outputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28349)
*John Zhang,Silky Arora*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Grammar-as-a-Draft（GaaD），将语法约束作为第二个草稿器，与任意投机解码草稿器融合，在结构化输出场景显著提高接受长度和解码速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化输出（JSON schema、正则、工具调用）中，草稿器看不到语法约束，会反复提出非法键、分隔符和缩进，而语法引擎已知下一批必须生成的 token，造成投机解码浪费。

Method: 在每次验证前，调度器将草稿器提议与语法强制 token 合并为一行草稿：一致 token 标为 GRAMMAR，提议偏离强制路径处截断，并用强制 token 填充更宽的行；验证阶段对 GRAMMAR 草稿不计算 logits 直接接受。实现于 vllm-torchtpu 和独立 Rust serving runtime，在 TPU v7x 上评估 MTP、DFlash、n-gram 草稿器及 JSON 基准。

Result: 平均接受长度从 2.06 提至 5.43（MTP Qwen3.5-0.8B）、1.99 至 5.31（MTP Qwen3.5-35B-A3B）、1.57 至 4.13（DFlash Qwen3-4B）、1.30 至 3.64（n-gram Qwen3-4B）；batch size 1 解码快 2.66-2.81x，batch size 64 快 1.14-1.70x。Rust 中 MTP+GaaD 在 Qwen3.5-0.8B 快 2.23x、Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8 快 2.02x，128 并发快 1.22x；混合流量下整体完成快 1.03-1.23x，结构化请求快 2.2-3.2x，但纯文本 TPOT 上升 7-42%。

Conclusion: GaaD 可零新内核、无关键路径编译地组合任意草稿器，显著加速结构化输出；但由于提交规范强制 token 会改变输出分布，且语法掩码贪心解码可能选择非规范 tokenization，GaaD 可能产生不同但同样合法的输出。

Abstract: Under structured outputs (JSON schemas, regexes, tool calls), speculative drafters do not see the grammar constraint and repeatedly propose invalid keys, delimiters, and indentation, while the grammar engine already knows which tokens must come next.
  We present Grammar-as-a-Draft (GaaD), which treats the grammar as a second drafter. Before each verify step, the scheduler merges the drafter's proposal with grammar-forced tokens into one draft row: matching tokens stay as GRAMMAR, the proposal is cut where it leaves the forced path, and forced tokens fill the rest of a row wider than the drafter's proposal. The verify step accepts GRAMMAR drafts without computing their logits, composing with any drafter with no new kernels or compilation on the critical path. Because grammars fix text rather than tokens, committing canonical forced tokens changes the output distribution relative to grammar-masked target decoding.
  We implement GaaD in vllm-torchtpu and an independent Rust serving runtime, evaluating on TPU v7x with MTP, DFlash, and n-gram drafters on a JSON character-profile benchmark. GaaD raises average acceptance length from 2.06 to 5.43 (MTP, Qwen3.5-0.8B), 1.99 to 5.31 (MTP, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B), 1.57 to 4.13 (DFlash, Qwen3-4B), and 1.30 to 3.64 (n-gram, Qwen3-4B), decoding 2.66-2.81x faster at batch size 1 and 1.14-1.70x at batch size 64. In Rust, MTP+GaaD is 2.23x faster on Qwen3.5-0.8B, 2.02x on Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8, and 1.22x at 128 concurrent requests. Under mixed traffic (25-50% structured), GaaD finishes the workload 1.03-1.23x sooner (structured requests 2.2-3.2x sooner) while plain-text TPOT rises 7-42%. We also show grammar-masked greedy decoding can pick non-canonical tokenizations, so GaaD can yield different valid outputs that an fp32 reference finds equally likely.

</details>


### [587] [Taking the PULSE of Enterprise Workflows: Evaluating Persistent Project-State Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28374)
*Jiexin Ding,Lin Ai,Adam Davies,Scott Counts*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出“持久项目状态理解”（PPSU）问题，并发布PULSE基准，包含30个企业项目历史中的1573个问题，用于评估智能体对分布式、演化且可见性不均的工作信息的理解能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业智能体需要持续掌握分散在异构工件、随时间演化且不同协作者可见性不均的项目状态，现有系统难以有效维护和调和这种状态。

Method: 构建PULSE基准：基于源链接记录生成确定性的、按时间索引的项目状态及有文档记录的协作者视图；设计三类问题（未闭环事项、项目演化、视图缺口）；评估检索智能体、图与记忆增强检索、长上下文及oracle条件。

Result: 当前系统存在显著提升空间；检索与抽取是差距的最大来源，但在金标证据上额外提供显式项目状态仍能带来大幅提升，说明PPSU不能仅归约为检索问题；需跨多个项目历史部分调和信息的问题即使提供相关证据仍较难，项目状态综合与视角条件化仍是持续挑战。

Conclusion: 需要企业智能体显式维护并调和跨来源、行动者和时间的、基于时间的状态，以应对PPSU挑战。

Abstract: Enterprise agents must maintain an up-to-date understanding of work distributed across heterogeneous artifacts, evolving over time, and unevenly visible to different collaborators. We formulate this challenge as persistent project-state understanding (PPSU) and introduce PULSE, a benchmark of 1,573 questions over 30 enterprise project histories. PULSE constructs deterministic, time-indexed project state and documented collaborator views from source-linked records, and evaluates three families of questions: open loops, project evolution, and view gaps. Across retrieval agents, graph- and memory-augmented retrieval, long-context, and oracle conditions, we find substantial headroom for current systems. Retrieval and extraction account for the largest share of the gap, but providing explicit project state on top of gold evidence yields further substantial gains, showing that PPSU cannot be reduced to retrieval alone. Further analysis shows that questions requiring information to be reconciled across multiple parts of the project history remain difficult even when the relevant evidence is provided, while project-state synthesis and perspective conditioning remain persistent challenges. These results motivate enterprise agents that explicitly maintain and reconcile temporally grounded state across sources, actors, and time.

</details>


### [588] [Language models compress human preference geometry while political structure remains prompt-sensitive](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28383)
*Adolfo Ignacio Fuentes-Jofre,Cristian Candia*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文检验大语言模型模拟合成公众时，能否同时复现个体选择、群体异质性和政治结构，发现现有模型普遍压缩潜在偏好空间，政治结构则高度依赖提问方式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM越来越多用于构建合成公众，但已有研究分别记录了单次回答错误、群体异质性和提示稳健性问题，尚不清楚这些失败是否反映共同的保真度损失，还是合成群体的不同特性。

Method: 使用1,991名智利、843名法国和434名巴西成年人的匹配成对政策选择，在三个开放权重模型家族中重放；设计27种条件的智利网格和跨国因子复制，比较个体选择、群体异质性与政治组织，并操纵提案位置和左右自评量表端点标签。

Result: 没有条件能同时复现个体选择、群体异质性和政治组织；合成参与者方差仅为人参考的0.4%至10.5%，在全部270次匹配重拟合中均低于人类方差。反转提案位置改变12.3%至31.2%的解码选择；明确标注左右量表端点改变20.5%至28.1%的选择，并使三国提案层面的左右分裂更接近人类模式，但匹配一致率仅提高3.1至4.2个百分点，参与者几何仍被压缩；在智利该干预还进一步压缩了合成群体。

Conclusion: 结果区分了政治可读性与群体保真度：语言模型可恢复显著政治分歧，却无法保留人类偏好变异的广度。合成公众保真度是检查点、提示和设置共同作用的属性，而非仅由检查点决定，需在个体、群体和政治结构三个层面分别评估。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to construct synthetic publics. Prior work has documented errors in individual responses, population heterogeneity, and prompt robustness, but whether these failures reflect a common loss of fidelity or distinct properties of synthetic populations remains unclear. We tested this using matched pairwise policy choices from 1,991 Chilean, 843 French, and 434 Brazilian adults replayed through three open-weight model families. Across a 27-condition Chilean grid and cross-country factorial replications, no condition jointly reproduced individual choices, population heterogeneity, and political organization. The most consistent result was compression of the latent preference space: synthetic participant variance was only 0.4-10.5% of the corresponding human reference in the primary comparisons and remained below human variance in all 270 matched refits. Political structure was much more sensitive to how choices were elicited. Reversing proposal position changed 12.3-31.2% of decoded choices. Explicitly labeling the endpoints of the numeric left-right self-placement scale changed 20.5-28.1% of choices and moved an independent proposal-level measure of left-right cleavage toward the human pattern in all three settings. Yet matched agreement improved by only 3.1-4.2 percentage points and participant geometry remained compressed. In Chile, the same intervention compressed the synthetic population further. These results separate political legibility from population fidelity: language models can recover salient political divisions while failing to preserve the breadth of human preference variation. Synthetic-public fidelity is therefore a property of the checkpoint, prompt, and setting, not of a checkpoint alone, and must be evaluated separately at individual, population, and political-structure levels.

</details>


### [589] [Muted Distillation: Sealing Reasoning from Teacher Unlocks Token-Efficient Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28445)
*Yuwei Zhang,Ian Miao,Wentao Zhang,Chen Qu,Bill Bi,Jingbo Shang,Donna Schut*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出一种名为 Muted Distillation（MD）的在线策略蒸馏简单变体，通过向教师隐藏学生的推理过程，避免学生推理干扰教师评分。在多轮智能体任务中，MD 显著缩短输出长度，同时保持或提升准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）常用于大语言模型后训练，但在多轮智能体任务中，学生模型训练后推理长度会增加。实证分析表明，推理 token 长度受学生能在多大程度上干扰教师评分影响。

Method: 提出 Muted Distillation（MD），一种 OPD 的简单变体：将学生的推理内容对教师隐藏，使教师仅根据学生行为进行评判，不受学生推理干扰。该方法只需少量代码修改，不增加额外数据或超参数。

Result: 在 OfficeQA Pro 和 SpreadsheetBench 上，相比标准 OPD，MD 将每个 episode 的输出 token 分别减少 57% 和 53%，使学生比训练前更简洁；在 OfficeQA Pro 上准确率与 OPD 相当，在 SpreadsheetBench 上 pass@1 提升 4.8 个百分点。

Conclusion: MD 是一种简单有效的 OPD 变体，可缓解多轮智能体任务中在线策略蒸馏导致的推理长度膨胀问题，并在保持或提升准确率的同时显著降低输出长度。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is commonly adopted as one of the components in post-training of large language models (LLMs), but in multi-turn agentic tasks we find that the student model increases their reasoning lengths after training. Our empirical analysis shows that the reasoning token lengths is affected by how much the student can distract the teacher's scores. We introduce Muted Distillation (MD), a simple variant of OPD that hides the student's reasoning from the teacher, so the teacher judges what the student does without the interference of student's reasonings. MD takes a few lines of code and adds no extra data or hyperparameters. On the knowledge-work benchmarks OfficeQA Pro and SpreadsheetBench, it reduces output tokens per episode by 57\% and 53\% compared with standard OPD, making the student more concise than it was before training. At the same time, it matches OPD's accuracy on OfficeQA Pro and improves pass@1 by 4.8 points on SpreadsheetBench.

</details>


### [590] [Digital Knockoffs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28482)
*Niuniu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出用激活引导与贝叶斯优化校准语言模型智能体，使其多维人格特质剖面更接近目标人群；在500名OpenPsychometrics受访者的Big Five数据上，误差低于提示和引导基线，最佳匹配时比随机搜索低16.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社会模拟常用语言模型智能体代表具有不同可测特质的人，但仅在提示中描述特质剖面，并不能保证智能体按预期水平表达每个特质。

Method: 采用激活引导：先提取每个特质的引导方向，再学习从引导强度到实测特质分数的共享映射，最后用贝叶斯优化为每个目标搜索引导干预；在500名受访者的Big Five人格分数上分五轮评估。

Result: 每轮指定干预的平均绝对误差均低于提示与引导基线；同一干预产生的特质剖面不随目标对象变化，因此对某受访者匹配较差的结果可能是另一人的最佳匹配；在所有测试干预中为每人匹配最接近剖面时，贝叶斯优化在相同评估预算下比均匀随机搜索的平均绝对误差低16.6%。

Conclusion: 该方法可构建测量特质与所代表人群更吻合的社会智能体，但更接近的特质匹配是否能改善对下游行为的预测仍待研究。

Abstract: Social simulations often use language model agents to represent people who differ on several measurable traits. However, describing a trait profile in a prompt does not guarantee the agent will express each trait at its intended level. We propose a method that calibrates agents to multidimensional profiles using activation steering: (i) extract steering directions for each trait, (ii) learn a shared mapping from steering strengths to measured trait scores, and (iii) search for a steering intervention for each target. We use Bayesian optimization for this search and evaluate the method on the Big Five personality scores of 500 OpenPsychometrics respondents. In each of five rounds, the assigned interventions yield lower mean absolute error across respondents than the prompting and steering baselines. Further, the model's responses to a given intervention yield the same trait profile regardless of whose target motivated it, so a poor match for one respondent can be the best match for another. When we match each respondent to the closest profile found across all tested interventions, Bayesian optimization yields 16.6% lower mean absolute error than uniform random search at the same evaluation budget. Our method thus offers a way to build social agents whose measured traits dovetail with those of the people they seek to represent. Whether this closer fit translates to improved predictions of downstream behavior remains an open question.

</details>


### [591] [Digital Twins for Multi-Agent Systems: When to Trust, What to Change](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28517)
*Truc Nguyen Thi Le,Phuoc Nguyen T. H*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 PAV-Twin，用于网络化数字孪生的预测可靠性监测与干预选择；监测器结合雅可比传播特征、近期误差和集成 disagreement 估计预测超阈值风险，规划器通过模拟候选编辑并按预测集体结果排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字孪生网络需要标记不可靠预测并帮助用户选择干预；但误差会在网络中传播，轨迹易预测的编辑未必带来好的集体结果，因此需要研究传播信息何时有助于故障检测，以及不完美预测下学习型孪生能否选出有效网络编辑。

Method: 提出 Propagation-Aware Validation for Networked Digital Twins（PAV-Twin）。其监测器将基于雅可比的传播特征与近期误差、集成 disagreement 结合，估计预测超过误差阈值的风险；其规划器模拟每个候选编辑，并根据预测的集体结果对编辑排序。

Result: 在仿真中，监测器在较大且拓扑熟悉的振荡器网络上将 PR-AUC 提高 0.13，在较大且留出拓扑的网络上提高 0.09，优于无传播特征的图基线；在收缩共识中增益较小，给图基线相同特征后差距缩小。规划研究中，集成模拟在振荡器中恢复约 99% 的随机干预可选改进，在共识中几乎全部恢复；在简化振荡器孪生中，按预测结果选择比按轨迹保真度选择 regret 更低。

Conclusion: 结果表明传播特征在何时有助于标记不可靠预测，并说明应直接衡量干预选择质量，而非仅依赖轨迹保真度。

Abstract: Digital twins of agent networks need to flag unreliable forecasts and help users choose interventions. Both decisions depend on what happens over several steps: an error can spread through the network, and an edit whose trajectory is easy to predict may still yield a poor collective outcome. We ask when information about error propagation improves failure detection and whether a learned twin can select effective network edits despite imperfect forecasts. We propose Propagation-Aware Validation for Networked Digital Twins (PAV-Twin). Its monitor combines Jacobian-based propagation features with recent errors and ensemble disagreement to estimate the risk that a forecast exceeds an error threshold. Its planner simulates each candidate edit and ranks the edits by their predicted collective outcomes. In simulations, the monitor gained 0.13 in area under the precision-recall curve on larger oscillator networks with familiar topologies and 0.09 on larger networks with held-out topologies, relative to a graph baseline without propagation features. Gains were small in contractive consensus. Giving the graph baseline the same features narrowed the gap. In a separate planning study, ensemble simulation recovered about 99% of the possible improvement over random intervention selection in oscillators and nearly all of it in consensus. With a simplified oscillator twin, selecting by predicted outcome also gave lower regret than selecting by trajectory fidelity. These results show when propagation features help flag unreliable forecasts and why the quality of intervention choices should be measured directly.

</details>


### [592] [SupportChain: Trace-Calibrated Aggregation of Quote-Grounded Reasoning Chains for Multi-Hop RAG with Small Readers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28519)
*Zhexi Gu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SupportChain 提出一种无需构建图索引的多跳检索增强问答方法，通过将问题拆分为多个跳、把每跳答案绑定到检索段落中的原句、根据执行轨迹估计可靠性，并按答案支持度合并多次执行，从而以较小模型取得更强效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多跳检索增强问答的强结果通常依赖 70B 以上参数模型读取图索引，而构建此类索引需要大语言模型处理整个语料，成本高。研究希望在不构建索引、不使用超大模型的情况下提升多跳问答性能。

Method: SupportChain 将问题拆成若干跳；每一跳的答案需绑定到从检索段落中引用的一句话；根据每次执行自身的轨迹估计其可靠性；合并多次执行时，按答案获得的支持度以及支持该答案的执行池化可靠性进行选择，并在支持度足够高时停止。

Result: 在 HippoRAG 2 协议下，使用 9B 阅读器在 MuSiQue 上达到 63.0 F1，高于此前使用 20B 阅读器的最佳结果 59.2。相同阅读器和嵌入器下，在五个数据集上均显著优于 HippoRAG 2，最高提升 17.2 F1，且不构建索引。按支持度合并比多数投票和让阅读器选择候选在五个数据集中的三个上显著更好，另外两个上持平。可靠性模型仅需 100 个有答案的训练问题。

Conclusion: SupportChain 表明，通过跳级答案溯源、执行可靠性估计和支持度合并，可以在不构建图索引的情况下显著提升多跳检索增强问答，并以更小模型超过依赖索引和大模型的方法。

Abstract: Strong results in multi-hop retrieval-augmented question answering come from graph indexes read by models of 70B parameters or more, and building such an index calls a large language model over the whole corpus. We present SupportChain, which splits a question into hops, binds each hop's answer to a sentence quoted from a retrieved passage, estimates how reliable each execution is from its own trace, and merges several executions by the support of their answers, the pooled reliability of the executions that agree, stopping once support is high enough. With a 9B reader under the HippoRAG~2 protocol, SupportChain reaches 63.0 F1 on MuSiQue, above the best earlier result of 59.2, which used a 20B reader. With the same reader and embedder, it is significantly better than HippoRAG~2 on all five datasets, by up to 17.2 F1, and it builds no index. Merging by support is significantly better than majority voting, and than letting the reader choose among the candidates, on three of the five datasets and level with both on the other two. The reliability model needs only 100 answered training questions.

</details>


### [593] [BIRD-Persona: A Persona-Aware Benchmark for SQL and pandas Analytics Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28542)
*Davin Hill,Pawan Chorasiya,Bhawani S. Leelar,Oren Avram,Robert E. Tillman,Tamer Soliman*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 BIRD-Persona 基准，用于在匹配 SQL 与 pandas 真值、并控制用户措辞（新手/专家）和模式变体的条件下，比较文本到 SQL 与文本到 pandas 代码的系统表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准覆盖 SQL 和 pandas 任务，但未隔离二者性能在何种条件下出现差异，尤其缺少对用户表述风格与任务结构因素的控制。

Method: 构建 BIRD-Persona：基于 BIRD-Python 的人设分层扩展，加入新手与专家改写、匹配的 SQL/pandas 真值、schema 变体及任务结构标注；在 1,534 个任务、9 个模型、245,592 次评估上进行比较分析。

Result: 9 个系统中有 8 个在 SQL 上优于 pandas；专家式、schema 显式提示提升两种范式但更利于 SQL；schema 表示影响因模型而异；需选择列会扩大差距，而子查询不会。

Conclusion: 将用户措辞作为受控基准维度，可支持人设感知和范式感知的自然语言分析系统评估；BIRD-Persona 数据集已公开。

Abstract: Production text-to-code systems use large language models to turn natural-language analytics requests into executable SQL and pandas code. Existing benchmarks cover both tasks but do not isolate when performance diverges between them. We introduce BIRD-Persona, a persona-stratified extension of BIRD-Python that adds novice and expert rewrites to tasks with matched SQL and pandas ground truth, along with schema variants and task-structure annotations. Across 1,534 tasks, nine models, and 245,592 evaluations, SQL outperforms pandas for eight of nine systems. The gap varies by condition: expert, schema-explicit prompts improve both paradigms but help SQL more; schema representations have mixed, model-dependent effects; and selected-column burden widens the gap while subqueries do not. By making user phrasing a controlled benchmark dimension, BIRD-Persona supports persona-aware and paradigm-aware evaluation of natural-language analytics systems. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/optum-cognition-lab/BIRD-Persona.

</details>


### [594] [Information Access and Gain-Loss Framing in Six Large Language Models and Human Decision Makers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28525)
*Aadithya Chandramouli,Jeremy M. Gernand*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究测试六个大语言模型在收益/损失框架下的风险选择偏差，并检验先阅读信息卡是否能缩小该框架效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 风险选择会因表述为“获得”或“损失”而改变，作者想了解大语言模型是否也表现出增益-损失框架效应，以及提供更多选项信息能否减弱这种偏差。

Method: 让GPT-4.1、GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Qwen3 235B和Llama 4 Maverick在四个风险场景中完成11,519次选择；每个场景含原始表述、两个改写和相反框架的镜像版本。选择前可打开0、2、3或4张信息卡（共7张）。另与198名学生进行探索性比较。

Result: 无信息卡时，六个模型均显示明显框架效应：损失框架下选择安全选项的比例比收益框架低27至79个百分点。所有模型在2张卡时差距小于无卡时；但按预设10个百分点阈值，GPT-4.1在4张卡时达标，Qwen3仅在2张卡时达标；汇总比较中GPT-4.1从2张卡起达标、GPT-4o从3张卡起达标。GPT-4o-mini和Llama 4 Maverick即使有卡仍保持28至66个百分点差距，GPT-4o-mini和Qwen3从2到4张卡时差距反而扩大。提示格式变化和卡片内容多不利于风险选项可能影响结果。学生探索性比较中，打开0或1张卡后，先问收益场景与后问损失场景存在19个百分点差异，更多卡片后无明显差异，但该设计不能证明卡片减少了人的框架效应。

Conclusion: 大语言模型普遍存在增益-损失框架效应，信息卡可在部分模型中缩小差距，但效果不一致且多数未达到预设阈值；提示格式和卡片内容存在混杂，人类探索性结果不足以证明信息卡能减少框架效应。

Abstract: A risky choice can be described by what will be saved or what will be lost, and people often choose differently depending on that wording. We test whether six large language models (LLMs) show this gain-loss framing effect, and whether it shrinks when they can first read more about the options. GPT-4.1, GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Qwen3 235B and Llama 4 Maverick made 11,519 choices across four risk scenarios, each in its original wording, two paraphrases and a mirrored version in the opposite wording. Before choosing, a model could open up to 0, 2, 3 or 4 of seven information cards. With no cards, all six models showed large framing effects: the share choosing the safe option was 27 to 79 percentage points lower under loss than under gain wording. The gap was smaller at 2 cards than with no cards in every model. Against a 10-point threshold set in our analysis plan, GPT-4.1 fell within it at 4 cards and Qwen3 only at 2 cards; in the plan's pooled comparison over all versions, GPT-4.1 was within it from 2 cards and GPT-4o from 3. GPT-4o-mini and Llama 4 Maverick kept gaps of 28 to 66 points with cards, and for GPT-4o-mini and Qwen3 the gap grew again from 2 to 4 cards. Part of the drop from 0 to 2 cards may reflect a change in prompt format, and most card content counted against the risky option, which may favor the safe choice. In an exploratory comparison with 198 students who saw the same scenarios and cards but opened cards one at a time and chose how many, decisions made after opening 0 or 1 cards showed a 19-point difference between the gain scenarios, asked first, and the loss scenarios, asked later, and no clear difference appeared in decisions made after opening more, though this design cannot show that cards reduced framing in people. With these cards, in the balanced comparison 17 of 18 card gaps were below the model's no-card gap, but few were within the threshold.

</details>


### [595] [From Reward Engineering to Data-Centric Reinforcement Learning for Effective Agentic Visual Tool Use](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28558)
*Jin Cui,Xinyue Long,Jiepeng Zhou,Boran Zhao,Pengju Ren,Hao Dong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出AOVO，一种以数据为中心的框架，使多模态大语言模型在不引入工具专用奖励的情况下学习何时调用外部视觉工具，并通过感知归因与策略自适应数据采样提升工具使用效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具使用强化学习方法常依赖与调用相关的奖励来鼓励有益工具调用，但此类奖励工程可能扭曲任务目标并导致退化性调用行为；作者认为关键不只是识别难题，而是识别哪些失败源于缺失视觉证据并可通过工具观察纠正。

Method: AOVO通过反事实探测模型的推理状态来识别对观察敏感的问题，将其与推理主导的问题区分开；随后使用策略自适应数据采样（PADS）定期从近期策略 rollout 中估计类别级观察效应，并动态将训练分布重新分配到视觉观察能提供有效学习信号的问题上，同时仅以最终答案正确性为优化目标。

Result: 在多种视觉感知和多模态推理基准上，AOVO相较具有竞争力的工具使用MLLM取得一致提升；因果分析进一步验证了以数据为中心视角学习有效视觉工具使用的有效性。

Conclusion: 有效工具使用学习应聚焦于可通过视觉观察纠正的失败，而非依赖工具调用奖励；AOVO表明通过感知归因和策略自适应数据采样，可以在不引入工具专用奖励的情况下提升MLLM的视觉工具使用能力。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly use external visual tools to acquire evidence during reasoning, yet learning when to invoke these tools remains challenging. Existing tool-use reinforcement learning (RL) methods often rely on call-contingent rewards to encourage beneficial tool use, but such reward engineering can distort the task objective and lead to degenerate calling behaviors. We argue that effective tool-use learning requires identifying not merely which questions are difficult, but which failures are attributable to missing visual evidence and can therefore be corrected through tool observations. We propose AOVO, a data-centric framework that enables MLLMs to learn effective tool use through perception attribution and policy-adaptive data sampling (PADS), without introducing tool-specific rewards. It counterfactually probes the model's reasoning states to identify observation-sensitive questions, distinguishing them from reasoning-dominated ones. PADS then periodically estimates category-level observation effects from recent policy rollouts and dynamically reallocates the training distribution toward questions where visual observations provide informative learning signals, while optimizing solely for final-answer correctness. Experiments across diverse visual perception and multimodal reasoning benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over competitive tool-use MLLMs, with causal analysis further validating the data-centric perspective for learning effective visual tool use.

</details>


### [596] [Modeling Perceived Promptness in Simultaneous Interpreting from Quality, Structure, and Timing Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28566)
*Ziyu Zhang,Satoshi Nakamura*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 处理失败


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 处理失败

Method: 处理失败

Result: 处理失败

Conclusion: 处理失败

Abstract: Simultaneous interpreting requires interpreters to convey the source accurately while keeping pace with it in real time. Timing measures such as segment-onset delay capture part of this requirement, but may not fully reflect how professional evaluators judge promptness. We investigate whether these judgments can be explained by timing alone or whether the interpreted output provides additional information. Our dataset contains 622 Chinese-English and English-Chinese segments from 16 source speeches and seven interpreters. Two senior professional interpreters rated each segment for language quality (LQ), expressiveness (EXP), and perceived latency (LAT), which we also refer to as professional promptness. On held-out source speeches, onset delay alone achieves a Pearson correlation of r = .318 with LAT ratings. Combining predicted LQ and EXP with delay improves the correlation to r = .475. Lexical and structural features provide a stronger signal, reaching r = .632 when combined with delay and r = .658 when predicted quality is also included. These results suggest that professional promptness judgments reflect properties of the interpreted output beyond when the interpreter begins speaking. The additional contribution of predicted quality over structural features, however, is modest. Although the two evaluators differ in how strongly quality relates to LAT, cross-evaluator predictions remain positively correlated with LAT ratings. The overall pattern also holds when each interpreter is held out in turn.

</details>


### [597] [Tool-to-Self: Internalizing Visual Tool Capabilities via Scaffolded Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28564)
*Jin Cui,Hao Dong,Xinyue Long,Boran Zhao,Pengju Ren*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 处理失败


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 处理失败

Method: 处理失败

Result: 处理失败

Conclusion: 处理失败

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly rely on external visual tools to access fine-grained visual evidence, but repeated tool execution incurs substantial inference overhead and deployment dependencies. Moreover, conventional tool-use RL can improve visual-task performance, yet the resulting tool gains are often unstable. Motivated by this, we propose Tool-to-Self (T2S), a tool-scaffolded reinforcement learning framework that turns external visual tools into temporary training scaffolds. T2S cold-starts tool-use ability and observation prediction from tool-repairable examples, then progressively anneals tool execution on a per-tool basis during RL. By combining answer-correctness and observation-consistency rewards with privileged on-policy self-distillation from actual tool observations, T2S effectively teaches the model both to reproduce tool outputs and to reason from them. Experiments across diverse visual perception and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over both explicit tool-use models and implicit zooming models while enabling tool-free inference with reduced latency.

</details>


### [598] [Reducing Permutation Sensitivity in Multimodal Large Language Models via Shared Positions and Attention-Only Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28612)
*Yifei Cheng,Xiaolin Zhang,Yu-Xuan Qiu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统研究如何在保持准确率的同时提升模型对排列扰动的鲁棒性，提出共享位置结构与仅注意力蒸馏来缓解排列偏差并恢复模型能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 排列偏差会降低模型鲁棒性，因此需要在不大幅损失预测准确率的前提下改善排列鲁棒性。

Method: 将排列偏差现象分为四类，以多项选择问答中的文本选项重排为例分析根因；基于根因分析和集合编码策略，研究带阻塞跨单元注意力的共享位置（SP-B），并扩展为双向跨单元注意力（SP-V）以进行模态交换；同时提出从冻结原生模型进行仅注意力蒸馏，以恢复SP结构下的模型能力。

Result: 共享位置降低排列敏感性，仅注意力蒸馏提升共享位置结构下的准确率；在三个模型上，方法在全排列宏平均准确率上可与多数投票相当或更优，并比监督微调高1.95至4.20个百分点。

Conclusion: 该工作为排列偏差缓解和模型能力恢复提供了有效方法与有价值见解。

Abstract: In this paper, we conduct a systematic study on improving permutation robustness while preserving accuracy. First, we categorize permutation bias phenomena into four representative scenarios. Then, we take the multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) dataset as an example under text-option reordering scenario to analyze the root cause of permutation bias. Based on this root cause analysis and set encoding strategy, we investigate shared positions with blocked cross-unit attention (SP-B) and extend this design to bidirectional cross-unit attention (SP-V) for modality exchange. However, these structural changes may reduce predictive accuracy. To recover model capability across different scenarios under the SP structure, an attention-only distillation from frozen native models is proposed. Shared positions reduce permutation sensitivity, and attention-only distillation improves accuracy under the shared-position structure. Across all three models, our method is comparable to or better than majority voting in macro-average all-permutation accuracy, and outperforms supervised fine-tuning by 1.95-4.20 percentage points. This work provides valuable insight into permutation bias mitigation and model capability recovery.

</details>


### [599] [Make Position Uninformative: Exchangeable Self-Distillation Flattens the Lost-in-the-Middle Curve](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28638)
*Qingsen Ma,Dianyun Wang,Jiahong Liu,Irwin King*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文研究检索增强语言模型中“相关信息位于上下文中部时表现差”的位置偏差问题，提出 Exchangeable Self-Distillation（ExSD），通过打乱上下文的蒸馏训练一个小适配器，在不使用金标答案的情况下提升中位及最差位置准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检索增强语言模型对相关文档出现位置敏感：位于开头或结尾时回答较好，位于中间时较差。部分微调方法通过降低开头表现来抬高中间表现，因此需要理解训练上下文如何导致位置偏差，并提出更合理的训练方法。

Method: 作者先在统一答案槽和打乱干扰项的设置下说明最优阅读器应忽略位置；据此提出 ExSD，在打乱上下文中训练小适配器，使其复现模型单独阅读答案文档时的输出。该方法不需要金标答案，仅需数千样本。

Result: 在1.5B到32B参数的六个模型上，ExSD相对冻结模型同时提升平均准确率和最差位置准确率，并在留出测试集上有效。在受控LoRA比较中，ExSD在两项指标上显著优于Pos2Distill；相对CORD平均差异不显著，但在20和30文档设置下最差位置准确率显著提升。ExSD还可匹配或超过金标答案微调，对其他任务行为改变更小，并能迁移到未见任务；头部探针显示模型更依赖内容而非位置。

Conclusion: ExSD通过打乱上下文的自蒸馏有效缓解检索增强语言模型的位置偏差，在不依赖金标答案的情况下提升平均和最差位置性能，并具有较好的泛化性和较低的任务副作用。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented language models answer well when the relevant document comes first or last and poorly when it sits in the middle. Some fine-tuning recipes lift the middle by lowering the start. We show how training contexts teach positional bias. With a uniform answer slot and shuffled distractors, the optimal reader ignores position. Building on this result, Exchangeable Self-Distillation (ExSD) trains a small adapter on shuffled contexts to reproduce the model's answer when it reads the answer document alone. It needs no gold answers and only a few thousand examples. On six models from 1.5B to 32B parameters, ExSD raises both average and worst-position accuracy against the frozen model, including on a held-out test split. In controlled LoRA comparisons, it significantly improves both criteria over Pos2Distill. Against CORD, mean differences are not significant, while worst-position accuracy improves significantly in the 20- and 30-document settings. ExSD also matches or beats gold-answer fine-tuning, changes behavior on other tasks far less, and transfers to unseen tasks. Head probes show greater reliance on content over position.

</details>


### [600] [MedCoast: Semantic Abstraction of Reasoning Trajectories for Test-Time Biomedical Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28586)
*Yishan Zhong,Jieru Li,Xuanzhe Ding,Shaunna Wang,Yanxin Yang,Micky C. Nnamdi,J. Ben Tamo,Yifei Wang,Yining Yuan,Benoit L. Marteau,Shaun Q. Y. Tan,Carrie Moore,Luyu Xie,Yang Xie,Wenqi Shi,May D. Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 MedCoast，一种离线到在线的生物医学推理框架，通过将思维链轨迹转化为结构化抽象推理树，并训练轻量过程奖励模型来指导测试时搜索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物医学问答常需在有限推理预算下进行多步推理。现有 Tree-of-Thought 等测试时搜索直接在自由文本上搜索，计算昂贵且存在大量语义等价中间步骤的冗余。

Method: 离线阶段，在共享前缀下递归聚类语义相似的推理步骤，构建抽象推理树以捕捉常见临床推理模式；根据推理进展到正确解的进度生成节点级监督，训练轻量过程奖励模型（PRM）评估部分推理状态。在线推理时，用该奖励模型优先探索更有希望的推理前缀。

Result: 在七个生物医学问答基准上，MedCoast 在固定推理预算下常优于自洽性方法，提升最高达 15 个点；尽管奖励模型规模小 50 倍以上，在多种设置下性能可与先进奖励模型相当。

Conclusion: MedCoast 通过结构化过程监督和轻量奖励模型，在资源受限的生物医学推理场景中实现了有效且高效的测试时推理引导。

Abstract: Biomedical question answering often requires multi-step reasoning under limited inference budgets. While test-time search methods such as Tree-of-Thought can improve reasoning performance, directly searching over free-form language is computationally expensive and highly redundant, as many reasoning trajectories contain semantically equivalent intermediate steps expressed in different surface forms. We introduce MedCoast, an offline-to-online reasoning framework that converts sampled chain-of-thought trajectories into a compact space for structured process supervision. Offline, we recursively cluster semantically similar reasoning steps under shared prefixes to construct an abstract reasoning tree that captures recurring clinical reasoning patterns. We then derive node-level supervision from progress toward correct solutions, and train a lightweight process reward model (PRM) to evaluate partial reasoning states. At inference time, the learned critic guides test-time exploration by prioritizing promising reasoning prefixes. Across seven biomedical QA benchmarks, MedCoast often improves over self-consistency under fixed inference budgets, with gains of up to 15 points. Despite using a reward model more than 50 times smaller, MedCoast achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art reward models in several settings, highlighting its potential for resource-constrained biomedical reasoning.

</details>


### [601] [Legal Is Not Good: A Pre-Registered Benchmark of Low-Cost Language and Decision Models on a New Strategy Game](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28713)
*Federico Lucca*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文将“先测量再训练”的预注册评测协议迁移到回合制策略游戏 hexfolk，考察低成本智能体在预先固定协议下的真实表现。结果显示，小型语言模型即使被约束为只下合法棋，也仍可能输给随机玩家；而简单的 60ms/步搜索可胜过所有付费模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受 Measure Before You Train 启发，作者主张在训练或替换模型前，应先用预先固定的协议和真实基准测量智能体决策；并希望在一个模型从未见过的第二个领域——回合制策略游戏中——检验低成本智能体的实际能力。

Method: 作者设计了最小双人 4X 游戏 hexfolk，使用确定性引擎、统一智能体接口、不纠正非法或超时动作的裁判和逐决策日志，使每局可回放。问题与预期答案在比赛前提交，使用留出种子、镜像座位和 95% Wilson 区间。测试对象包括两个小型开源语言模型（8B、3B）、两个原生决策模型、付费智能体、本地 7-8B 模型，并与规则玩家、随机玩家、一步搜索和免费 60ms/步搜索对比。

Result: 8B 和 3B 模型全部输给几行代码的规则玩家；自由文本回答时 98% 决策无效；约束为合法动作后不再非法，但仍输给均匀随机玩家，8B 对随机玩家胜率仅 10.0% [4.3, 21.4]%，推翻其能击败随机玩家的预期，且选项顺序打乱控制后结果仍成立。两个原生决策模型均不产生非法动作并击败随机；其中一个对规则玩家 50 局全败，另一个 50 局内与规则玩家不可区分并击败一步搜索。付费智能体每局调用模型数十至上百次，但免费 60ms/步搜索在相同对手上全面胜过所有付费模型；本地部署的两个 7-8B 模型表现类似。未包含前沿模型。

Conclusion: 在预注册协议下，低成本智能体表现很弱；合法动作约束只能保证合法性，不能保证竞争力；简单搜索比大量模型调用更有效。该结果支持在训练或替换模型前，先用固定协议和真实基准进行测量。

Abstract: Measure Before You Train argued that an agent's decisions should be measured against ground truth, under a protocol fixed in advance, before anyone trains or replaces the model behind them. We carry the method to a second, very different domain, a turn-based strategy game, and ask a deliberately modest question: how well do low-cost agents play under a pre-registered protocol? hexfolk is a minimal two-player 4X game written for this purpose, so no model has seen its rules or positions. A deterministic engine, one agent interface, a referee that never corrects an illegal or late move, and per-decision logs make every game replayable; questions and expected answers were committed before the games, on held-out seeds with mirrored seats and 95% Wilson intervals. Two small open language models (8B and 3B) lose every game to a few-line rule player. Answering in free text they are invalid on 98% of their decisions; constrained to legal moves they never play an invalid one, yet they lose to the uniformly random player (the 8B model wins 10.0 [4.3, 21.4]% of games), refuting our expectation that they would beat it; the result survives a control that shuffles the order of the options. Two native decision models never play an invalid move and both beat random; one loses all 50 games to the rule player, the other is not distinguishable from it in 50 games and beats a one-step search. The paid agents make tens to over a hundred model calls per game; against the same opponents a free 60 ms-per-move search, which makes none, outplays every paid model by the full range of the scale. Two 7-8B models served locally behave the same way. No frontier model is included.

</details>


### [602] [KMed-31B Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28719)
*KMed Team*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 KMed-31B，一个面向有限硬件本地部署的医疗大语言模型，通过按任务类型训练专家并用多教师同策略增量蒸馏整合，显著提升 HealthBench 表现且保持多选题基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在有限硬件上进行本地部署的医疗大模型需求上升，但多任务医疗后训练困难：提升某类任务可能损害另一类任务。作者认为原因在于不同任务在期望输出和可用反馈上存在差异，例如医学问答/诊断预测有参考答案，而临床问询无唯一正确答案、需用评分量表评价。

Method: 将医疗训练任务按“期望输出”和“可用反馈”两个属性分为四类，每类训练一个由相应反馈支持的专家模型；再用 Multi-teacher On-policy Delta Distillation（MOPD^2）将专家整合为单一学生模型。针对临床问询构建 Synthetic Health Dialogue 模拟咨询语料，覆盖基层医疗常见临床场景，并详细描述训练配方、数据构建和设置。

Result: 相较基座模型，KMed-31B 在非思考模式下将 HealthBench Hard 从 22.95 提升至 41.87、HealthBench Professional 从 37.92 提升至 50.20；思考模式下分别从 23.80 提升至 51.48、从 41.97 提升至 59.18，同时四个多选题医疗基准保持或略升。其未调整 HealthBench Hard 分数在比较模型中最高（含专有模型），HealthBench Professional 高于所有比较的开源权重模型，包括总参数超过其十倍者。相同训练配方应用于另一基座模型 Qwen3.8-27B 也提升两项 HealthBench 分数。

Conclusion: 按任务反馈类型训练专家并进行多教师蒸馏，可有效缓解医疗多任务后训练中的相互干扰；该配方和数据构建方法可帮助需要本地部署的机构基于开源权重模型开发医疗模型。

Abstract: We present KMed-31B, a medical large language model post-trained from an open-weight model for on-premises deployment with limited hardware. Post-training a model for diverse medical tasks remains difficult, because improving one kind of task can lower performance on another. We attribute this to differences between tasks in expected output and available feedback. Medical question answering and diagnosis prediction have reference answers, whereas clinical inquiry has no single correct response and is judged with rubrics. We therefore divide medical training tasks into four categories by these two properties, train one specialist per category with a reward that its feedback supports, and integrate the specialists into a single student with Multi-teacher On-policy Delta Distillation (MOPD$^2$). For clinical inquiry, we build Synthetic Health Dialogue, a simulated corpus of consultations with lay users and clinicians whose patient cases span common clinical presentations in primary care. Relative to its base model, KMed-31B raises HealthBench Hard from 22.95 to 41.87 and HealthBench Professional from 37.92 to 50.20 in non-thinking mode, and from 23.80 to 51.48 and from 41.97 to 59.18 in thinking mode, while its scores on four multiple-choice medical benchmarks are maintained or slightly improved. KMed-31B has the highest unadjusted HealthBench Hard score among the compared models, including proprietary ones, and scores higher on HealthBench Professional than every open-weight model we compare, including models with more than ten times as many total parameters. Applied to another base model, Qwen3.8-27B, the same training recipe also raises both HealthBench scores. We describe the training recipe, data construction, and settings in detail so that institutions requiring on-premises deployment can develop medical models from open-weight foundations.

</details>


### [603] [Multimodal LLMs Know the Game but Assume the Real World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28745)
*Jianxin Gao,Bohan Chen,Runze Li,Qi Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 RuleCraft 基准，用 1,240 个 Minecraft 图像问题检验多模态大模型是否会在只看图像时应用游戏规则，而非默认现实物理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型能说出游戏规则，但研究关注它们是否能在仅观察游戏画面时真正应用这些规则。
