Such a design fundamentally limits the achievable performance, particularly for contact-rich and dexterous manipulation tasks where different skills exhibit distinct couplings between action dimensions. In this paper, we present a skill-adaptive noise diffusion framework (SaND) which introduces a learnable, skill-conditioned noise schedule that modulates the diffusion process per action dimension, adapting the noising dynamics to each skill. To prevent the learned noise schedule from collapsing into trivial solutions, we employ an auxiliary inverse objective that reconstructs the skill embedding from the Legendre coefficients of the derivative of the noise schedule, encouraging the schedules to remain skill-discriminative. This formulation naturally enables adaptive control over the denoising steps for each skill, where noise schedules are clustered in the Legendre coefficient space, and the appropriate number of denoising steps is determined at the point where reconstruction error abruptly increases. At inference, we identify each skill embedding's cluster from its noise schedule and apply the corresponding number of denoising steps, dedicating more compute to skills requiring fine-grained control and less to simpler ones. In simulation and on real robot hardware, SaND outperforms existing skill learning and planning baselines on contact-rich and dexterous manipulation tasks, achieving higher success rates while requiring fewer denoising steps.

</details>


### [823] [Beyond Which: Where, How, and When in Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30291)
*Yunhe Zhang,Long Gao,Yuedong Fu,Gang He,Li Xu,Chang Wu,Songyuheng Gao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 W^3H-VLA，将视觉-语言-动作模型的感知与动作预测围绕“哪个实体、在哪里、如何作用、何时贡献”进行组织，以增强机器人精细操作能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型主要依赖 VLM 特征作为感知源，虽能识别与动作预测相关的实体，但缺乏对实体空间位置、几何结构约束以及空间/几何信息何时应更重要的理解，限制了精确操作。

Method: W^3H-VLA 保留基于 VLM 的语义实体感知（which），引入空间距离感知（where）和几何结构感知（how），并通过自适应空间-几何引导（when）调节这些信息对动作预测的贡献。

Result: 在真实世界设置和仿真基准上的实验表明，W^3H-VLA 有效且性能优越。

Conclusion: 围绕 which、where、how、when 组织 VLA 感知与动作预测，可丰富动作预测所需信息并提升机器人操作表现。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models typically rely on vision-language model (VLM) features as the primary perceptual source for action prediction, showing strong generalization across diverse robotic manipulation tasks. Although VLM features can identify which entities are relevant to action prediction, precise manipulation also requires understanding where task-relevant entities are located within the spatial layout, how their geometric structure constrains physical interaction, and when spatial or geometric information should make a greater contribution to action prediction. To this end, we introduce {\mathcal{W}^{3}\mathcal{H}}-VLA to organize VLA perception and action prediction around which, where, how, and when. Specifically, {\mathcal{W}^{3}\mathcal{H}}-VLA retains VLM-based semantic entity perception which and further introduces spatial distance perception where and geometric structure perception how with adaptive spatial-geometric guidance when to enrich the perceptual information available for action prediction. Experiments across real-world settings and simulation benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and superior performance of {\mathcal{W}^{3}\mathcal{H}}-VLA.

</details>


### [824] [Counterfactual Velocity Steering for World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30204)
*Xufeng Zhan,Yuanzhi Liang,Ye Lu,Haibin Huang,Chi Zhang,Xuelong Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文研究流式机器人策略在测试时的偏差校正，指出简单减去任务无关条件下的速度场通常是错误的，因为参考速度中包含大量共享传输分量；提出基于几何校准的动作去偏方法，并在RoboTwin任务上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式策略通过反复评估条件速度场生成动作，因此直观上可通过任务无关条件查询并减去其速度来校正测试时偏差。但作者发现这种朴素校正会损害生成，因为任务无关参考与任务条件速度高度对齐，包含共享传输分量而非仅有害偏差。

Method: 在Fast-WAM和50个RoboTwin 2.0任务上分析速度场对齐与参考平均效果；提出同状态诊断和收缩分析，说明最优校正尺度取决于参考信噪比；进而提出几何校准动作去偏，仅移除与任务速度正交的分量，并依据指令几何预测小的任务相关尺度。

Result: 平均指令预测与任务条件速度余弦相似度约0.94-0.95；八个完成状态参考的平均范数为个体平均范数的98.3%，说明共享分量强。指令损坏下仍有25.1%成功率，而动态视觉损坏几乎消除成功。固定中心正交校正在1000次随机试验中达92.7%，基线92.1%，但增益非单调且处于运行间波动内；角度尺度试点离线oracle门控上界94.5%，最佳在线学习实现92.5%。

Conclusion: 共享流分量和训练-服务不匹配是流式机器人策略测试时校正的核心障碍；朴素减去任务无关速度不可取，条件化、几何校准且考虑信噪比的校正更有前景，但当前增益有限，需要更稳健的可复现方法。

Abstract: Flow-based robot policies generate actions by repeatedly evaluating a conditional velocity field, so test-time bias correction seems simple: query the action expert under a task-agnostic condition and subtract that velocity from the task-conditioned prediction. We show this is often wrong. On Fast-WAM across 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, mean-instruction predictions align strongly with task-conditioned velocities (cosine approximately 0.94-0.95). Averaging eight completed-state references barely cancels this direction: their mean norm is 98.3% of the mean individual norm. References thus contain a large shared transport component, not only harmful bias, and aggressive subtraction damages generation. We propose a same-state diagnostic and shrinkage analysis showing that the optimal correction scale depends on reference signal-to-noise. This motivates geometry-calibrated action debiasing, which removes only the component orthogonal to the task velocity and predicts a small task-dependent scale from instruction geometry. In controlled RoboTwin experiments, corrupting instructions still permits 25.1% success (50 tasks, 20 episodes), whereas dynamic visual corruption nearly eliminates success. A fixed centered orthogonal correction reaches 92.7% versus a 92.1% baseline in one randomized 1000-trial sweep, but gains are non-monotonic and within run-to-run variation. An angular scale pilot has an offline oracle-gated bound of 94.5%; its best learned online realization reaches 92.5%. These results identify shared flow and train-serve mismatch as central obstacles and provide a reproducible foundation for conditional correction.

</details>


### [825] [ConsisX: Cross-View Consistency Thinking in 3D for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30308)
*Yunhe Zhang,Long Gao,Yuedong Fu,Gang He,Li Xu,Chang Wu,Pengyu Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 ConsisX，一种面向机器人操作的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，通过跨视角关联与实体一致性组织，实现 3D 跨视角一致推理，以提升物理一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型虽利用多视角观测，但基于 2D 特征相似性建模跨视角交互，易导致不同实体被错误关联，以及同一实体跨视角信息碎片化，进而造成物理不一致。

Method: 提出 ConsisX 框架，包含三个模块：跨视角关联建模（CAM），在共享 3D 空间引入空间邻近约束以减少错误关联；实体一致性组织（ECO），将跨视角局部信息整合为一致的 3D 实体证据；一致动作条件化（CAC），基于任务相关的 3D 实体证据条件化动作预测。

Result: 在 3 个真实机器人操作任务和 4 个仿真基准上实验，ConsisX 表现出有效性和竞争力。

Conclusion: ConsisX 通过跨视角一致性的 3D 推理，可缓解跨视角错误关联与信息碎片化问题，实现更物理一致的机器人操作。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models integrate visual perception and language understanding from vision-language models (VLMs) with action prediction for robotic manipulation. Although multi-view observations provide complementary scene information, VLMs model cross-view interactions based on 2D feature similarity, which can lead to physical inconsistency in the form of cross-view incorrect association between distinct entities and cross-view information fragmentation about the same entity. To address these challenges, we propose ConsisX, a novel VLA framework that integrates cross-view association and entity coherence to enable cross-view consistency thinking in 3D for physically consistent robotic manipulation. Specifically, Cross-View Association Modeling (CAM) is proposed to introduce cross-view spatial proximity constraints in a shared 3D space to reduce cross-view incorrect association. Entity Coherence Organization (ECO) is designed to organize cross-view local information into coherent 3D entity evidence, thereby addressing cross-view information fragmentation. Consistent Action Conditioning (CAC) is introduced to condition action prediction on task-relevant 3D entity evidence for cross-view consistent action execution. Experiments on 3 real-world manipulation tasks and 4 simulation benchmarks establish ConsisX as an effective and competitive framework for robotic manipulation.

</details>


### [826] [Seeing Together, Acting Apart: Shared Environmental Understanding for Multi-Robot Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30310)
*Haihong Hao,Lei Chen,Mingfei Han,Chenglong Yan,Dong An,Yuqiang Yang,Changlin Li,Minghao Guo,Salman Khan,Xiaojun Chang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出共享环境理解框架SEER，将多机器人部分观测聚合为共享潜在世界模型，使协作在决策前通过共享环境表示实现，并提升下游导航性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多机器人具身系统通常通过协调动作、共享轨迹或学习联合策略来协作。作者提出互补问题：能否在决策之前，通过先建立对环境的共享理解来实现协作。

Method: 提出Shared Environment Encoding and Retrieval（SEER）框架：将多机器人观测组织为共享记忆，基于时空相似度检索相关上下文，并利用预测性潜在世界模型进行编码；所得表示以token形式注入下游导航智能体。该方法与策略无关，支持去中心化决策。

Result: 实验表明，SEER能够捕捉与动作相关的环境结构，并在专用VLN智能体和通用视觉语言模型智能体上持续提升导航性能，同时保持单智能体能力。

Conclusion: 协作可以从策略空间转移到表示空间：通过共享环境理解构建策略无关的共享表示，能够为多机器人去中心化决策提供有效的共享环境上下文。

Abstract: Multi-robot embodied systems are typically designed to collaborate by coordinating actions, sharing trajectories, or learning joint policies. We ask a complementary question: can collaboration emerge before decision-making, by first building a shared understanding of the environment? We introduce Shared Environmental Understanding, a policy-agnostic representation that aggregates partial egocentric observations from multiple robots into a shared latent world model. This shifts collaboration from the policy space to the representation space, enabling decentralized decision-making with shared environmental context. To this end, we propose Shared Environment Encoding and Retrieval (SEER), a framework that organizes multi-robot observations into a shared memory, retrieves relevant context via spatio-temporal similarity, and encodes it using a predictive latent world model. The resulting representations are injected into downstream navigation agents as tokens. Experimental results demonstrate that SEER captures action-relevant environmental structure and consistently improves navigation performance across both specialized VLN agents and general vision-language model agents, while preserving single-agent capabilities.

</details>


### [827] [One Policy, Many Bodies: Cooperative Human-Object Interaction with Heterogeneous Teams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30312)
*Zhihao Cao,Tianxu An,Chenhao Li,Chenyangguang Zhang,Stelian Coros,Marco Hutter*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 MorphHOI，一个面向异构具身多智能体物理协作的分散式框架，使单一策略能够跨不同身体形态、团队组成和交互技能完成人-物协作任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有物理仿真中的协作人-物交互方法多假设同构具身和预定义交互任务，难以支持不同形态智能体、不同团队组成及新交互技能之间的通用协作。

Method: MorphHOI 基于统一异构具身表示的思想，引入规范化身体接口以统一观测与动作空间，并使用具身条件 Transformer 根据各智能体及队友的物理能力调整协作决策；通过任务特定 token 和轻量微调复用已学协作策略，以扩展新交互技能并保留原能力。

Result: 在已见具身上成功率达 96.7%，未见具身上达 95.6%，新 payload 上达 91.4%；学习到的协作还能扩展到搬箱子、楼梯运输和路点跟随等多种交互技能，并保持已有协作能力。

Conclusion: 单一物理策略可在多样具身、团队组成和交互技能间实现高效异构协作，说明统一身体接口与具身条件决策相结合是提升通用协作能力的有效途径。

Abstract: Physics-based human-object interaction (HOI) has enabled multiple characters to cooperatively transport objects, but existing cooperative controllers largely assume homogeneous embodiments and predefined interaction tasks. We ask whether a single physics-based policy can enable cooperation across diverse embodiments, team compositions, and interaction skills. We present MorphHOI, a decentralised framework built on a key insight: effective heterogeneous cooperation requires a unified representation across embodiments while accounting for differences in their physical capabilities. To realise this insight, we introduce a canonical body interface that unifies observation and action spaces, together with an embodiment-conditioned transformer that adapts cooperative decisions to the physical capabilities of each agent and its teammates. To extend cooperation to new interaction skills, we reuse the learned cooperative policy through task-specific tokens and lightweight adaptation, preserving its original capabilities. Our framework achieves success rates of up to 96.7\% on seen embodiments, 95.6\% on unseen embodiments, and 91.4\% on novel payloads. Furthermore, the learned cooperation extends to diverse interaction skills with high success rates, including box carrying, transport on stairs, and waypoint following, while preserving previously acquired cooperative capabilities.

</details>


### [828] [SOAR: temporal Structure-guided One-step Action generation for Robotic manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30363)
*Di Xin,Mingfei Han,Genming Cui,Yuanxiang Chen,Xiaolong Wu,Siyu Ning,Xiaojun Chang,Zhihui Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SOAR 是一种结构引导的一步生成策略，通过预测未来动作的 DCT 表示并在动作空间直接生成干净轨迹，在保持一步推理低延迟的同时提升动作质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多步扩散/流策略动作质量高但迭代推理成本大；一步策略推理快但动作质量受限。研究旨在兼顾高质量与低推理延迟。

Method: SOAR 预测以观测为条件的未来动作离散余弦变换表示，捕捉多频段时间结构；直接在动作空间生成干净动作轨迹，并利用频谱差异对轨迹进行结构校准；训练时由校准动作推导 MeanFlow 速度进行一致性学习，并用端点目标对齐一步推理的纯噪声条件。

Result: 在 53 个 Adroit 和 Meta-World 任务上达到 83.9% 总成功率，推理延迟仅 8.7 ms；应用于 VLA 模型 π0.5 时，LIBERO 达 97.2%，RoboTwin 2.0 达 71.7%；真实实验和消融验证了有效性与效率。

Conclusion: SOAR 能显著提升一步生成策略的动作质量并保持低延迟，且可有效扩展到 VLA 模型和真实机器人场景。

Abstract: Efficient robotic manipulation requires temporally coordinated actions with low inference latency. Multi-step diffusion and flow policies progressively refine action trajectories but require costly iterative inference, whereas one-step policies eliminate iterative trajectory refinement to reduce inference cost. We introduce **SOAR**, a structure-guided one-step generative policy that improves action quality while preserving one-step efficiency. SOAR predicts an observation-conditioned discrete cosine transform (DCT) representation of future actions, capturing temporal variations across multiple frequency bands to provide explicit guidance from key temporal structural information. Unlike velocity-parameterized one-step flow policies that recover clean actions indirectly from a predicted velocity field, SOAR directly generates clean action trajectories in action space. This aligns the model output with the executable control target and provides a direct interface for structural calibration. The predicted structure further corrects the generated trajectory according to their spectral discrepancy, without requiring an additional evaluation of the generative backbone. During training, the corresponding MeanFlow velocity is derived from the calibrated clean action and used for consistency learning, while an endpoint objective aligns training with the pure-noise condition used for one-step inference. Across 53 Adroit and Meta-World tasks, SOAR achieves 83.9% overall success with only 8.7 ms inference latency. When applied to the VLA model, π0.5, SOAR further achieves 97.2% on LIBERO and 71.7% on RoboTwin 2.0. Real-world experiments and extensive ablations further validate its effectiveness and efficiency.

</details>


### [829] [AgentMoT: An Agentic Mixture-of-Transformers for End-to-End Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30389)
*Qihang Huang,Collister Chua,YuJie Yan,Shiyu Fang,Zhan Chen,Haoran Xu,Zirui Li,Chen Lv*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出AgentMoT，一种内置智能体推理与系统调度的混合Transformer驾驶模型，在Bench2Drive基准上取得SOTA表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 驾驶模型需动态决定使用何种能力以及何时重新评估决策，现有方法缺乏灵活的能力选择与调度机制。

Method: 将智能体、世界和动作专家组合成直动作、视觉-语言-动作、世界-动作三条联合训练路径；Router选择原生路径，智能体专家提供推理与技能选择；执行反馈触发唤醒请求，自调度器决定是否重审任务；采用相对能力原则权衡额外计算收益与成本；开环初始化后进行双循环进化训练，并以失败驱动更新精炼技能。

Result: 在Bench2Drive v0.0.3和v0.0.4上分别达到94.48/92.33驾驶分数和85.45/82.73%成功率；禁用技能时学习路由仍比最强固定路径高1.79分和4.09个百分点；消融显示闭环智能体学习、双视图查询和事件触发唤醒均带来增益。

Conclusion: AgentMoT通过混合专家路径、路由器与自调度机制实现自适应能力选择，验证了闭环学习与事件触发调度的有效性，达到SOTA性能。

Abstract: Driving models need to choose which capabilities to use and when to reconsider their decisions. We introduce AgentMoT, a Mixture-of-Transformers with built-in agent reasoning and system scheduling. Combinations of agent, world, and action experts form three jointly trained pathways for direct-action, vision-language-action, and world-action computation. The Router selects a native pathway, while the agent expert supplies reasoning and selects skills. Execution feedback raises wake-up requests, and the agent self-scheduler learns whether to reconsider the task decision or keep it. Mandatory requests invoke the agent directly. The relative-capability principle guides these choices by relating the benefit of additional computation or intervention to its cost. After open-loop initialization, dual-loop evolution trains the Router, agent, and self-scheduler from closed-loop experience while failure-driven updates refine skills and execution feedback. AgentMoT achieves state-of-the-art results on Bench2Drive v0.0.3 and v0.0.4, with 94.48/92.33 driving score and 85.45/82.73% success rate, respectively. With skills disabled, learned routing improves over the strongest fixed pathway by 1.79 driving-score points and 4.09 percentage points of success rate on v0.0.3. Ablation studies further show gains from closed-loop agent learning, two-view queries, and event-triggered wake-up.

</details>


### [830] [ROSE-Drive: Runtime Orchestration and System Evolution for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30438)
*Qihang Huang,Zhidong Wang,Zirui Li,YuJie Yan,Jingsong Liang,Shiyu Fang,Collister Chua,Zhan Chen,Chen Lv*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出模型无关的ROSE-Drive框架，通过联合编排驾驶执行与计算，协调冻结的驾驶模型、驾驶技能、感知工具和反馈控制器，以提升复杂交通中的闭环驾驶可靠性和计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端驾驶模型虽进展显著，但复杂交通中的可靠闭环驾驶仍具挑战；除改进单个模型外，系统级编排可协调驾驶能力与计算资源，是一种互补路径。

Method: ROSE-Drive协调冻结驾驶模型与技能、感知工具、反馈控制器；用蒸馏VLM提出驾驶任务和场景关系；通过共享物理状态与持久任务支持能力组合、任务连续性和自适应调度；编排器融合多控制通道输出、在交接中保持任务责任，并利用执行反馈选择控制器、复用有效运动参考和调度模型推理；离线修订利用执行记录通过稳定任务接口优化技能及其协调，后续系统阶段继承修订而模型、感知和VLM权重保持固定。

Result: 在Bench2Drive v0.0.3、v0.0.4和Fail2Drive上用四个驾驶模型评估，显示目标基准修订前的能力积累与迁移；在留出集Longest6上，AutoMoT的驾驶分数DS从25升至52，SimLingo从22升至47，且两个系统在超过71%的控制步中跳过新的模型推理。

Conclusion: 系统级运行时编排与演化可在不更新模型权重的情况下累积和迁移驾驶能力，并显著提升闭环驾驶表现与推理效率，说明协调驾驶执行和计算是改进端到端驾驶系统的有效补充方向。

Abstract: End-to-end driving models have made substantial progress, yet reliable closed-loop driving in complex traffic remains challenging. Beyond improving individual models, system-level orchestration offers a complementary approach by coordinating driving capabilities and computation. We introduce ROSE-Drive (Runtime Orchestration and System Evolution), a model-agnostic framework that jointly orchestrates driving execution and computation. It coordinates frozen driving models with driving skills, perception tools, and feedback controllers. A distilled vision-language model (VLM) proposes driving tasks and scene relations. Shared physical state and persistent tasks support capability composition, task continuity, and adaptive scheduling. The orchestrator combines model and skill outputs across control channels, maintains task responsibility through handover, and uses execution feedback to select controllers, reuse valid motion references, and schedule model inference. Offline revisions use execution records to refine skills and their coordination through a stable task interface. Successive system stages inherit these revisions while model, perception, and VLM weights remain fixed. Evaluations with four driving models on Bench2Drive v0.0.3, Bench2Drive v0.0.4, and Fail2Drive show accumulated capability and transfer before target-benchmark revision. On held-out Longest6, driving score (DS) rises from 25 to 52 for AutoMoT and from 22 to 47 for SimLingo across system stages, while both systems skip new model inference on over 71% of control steps.

</details>


### [831] [CHAMP: Coordinated Humanoid Loco-Manipulation with Whole-Body Motion Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30449)
*Lijun Han,Muyuan Ma,Zichen Wang,Siyuan Liu,Yuxi Liu,Yutong Wang,Bohao Zhang,Heng Zhou,Wei Sui*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: CHAMP 是一个面向人形机器人全身移动操作（loco-manipulation）的统一框架，通过大规模人体与机器人数据预训练全身运动先验，并结合自适应特征提取实现协调控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人在人类环境中需要协调移动与灵巧操作，关键难点在于如何从多样数据中学习运动先验，并有效用于机器人协调控制。

Method: CHAMP 先用约2298小时异构人体和机器人数据预训练视觉语言模型，预测未来身体与手部运动；通过共享运动表示统一不同标注类型和不同本体的全身运动学习；再引入面向协调的动作专家CAE，在目标控制器回放数据上训练，并通过稀疏路由自适应选择、变换和融合预训练模型多层特征，联合生成身体和手部动作。

Result: 实验表明，CHAMP在7个仿真任务上总体成功率为84.8%，在Unitree G1的7个真实任务上为91.4%，均优于评估基线；在长程爆米花递送任务上成功率达70.0%，最佳基线为40.0%。

Conclusion: CHAMP验证了大规模全身运动预训练与自适应特征融合对协调人形机器人移动操作的有效性，并在仿真和真实环境中取得优于基线的表现。

Abstract: Coordinating locomotion and dexterous manipulation is fundamental to humanoid robots operating in human environments. A key challenge is learning motion priors from diverse data and using them effectively for coordinated robot control. We present CHAMP, a unified framework for humanoid loco-manipulation that combines whole-body motion pretraining with adaptive feature extraction. CHAMP pretrains a vision-language model to predict future body and hand motion from approximately 2,298 hours of heterogeneous human and robot data. A shared motion representation enables unified whole-body motion learning across embodiments from datasets with body annotations, hand annotations, or both. To ground these motion priors in robot control, we introduce a Coordination-oriented Action Expert (CAE) and train it on replay data generated using the target controller. Through sparse routing, CAE adaptively selects, transforms, and fuses features from multiple layers of the pretrained model to jointly generate body and hand actions. In experiments, CHAMP achieves overall success rates of 84.8% on seven simulated tasks and 91.4% on seven real-world tasks with a Unitree G1, outperforming the evaluated baselines in both settings. In particular, CHAMP achieves 70.0% success on the long-horizon popcorn-serving task, compared with 40.0% for the best-performing baseline.

</details>


### [832] [EgoStudy: How Does Scaling Egocentric Data Affect VLA and WAM Pretraining?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30490)
*Puzhen Yuan,Yanjiang Guo,Yichen Liu,Xiang Zhu,Qingzhou Lu,Chenxin Liu,Tun Ban,Haodong Yan,Zhide Zhong,Jianyu Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 处理失败


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 处理失败

Method: 处理失败

Result: 处理失败

Conclusion: 处理失败

Abstract: Egocentric human manipulation data offer a scalable resource for training dexterous robot policies. However, how effectively robots can learn and benefit from these data remains unclear due to the embodiment gap between humans and robots. We present EgoStudy, a systematic, controlled study of egocentric data for robot learning. Holding the robot dataset fixed, we vary the scale and diversity of egocentric data, data processing strategies, and co-training configurations. We investigate three questions: (1) Which data processing and pretraining choices most effectively exploit egocentric data? (2) Which components of robot action prediction benefit most from scaling these data? (3) How do scaling effects differ between vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs)? Our experiments yield three main findings. First, data diversity, alignment between trajectories, and detailed language annotations are key factors in effective transfer. Second, scaling egocentric data yields larger gains in predicting end-effector translation than in predicting fine-grained finger movements. Third, WAMs perform better when egocentric data are limited, whereas VLAs exhibit greater gains as the amount of egocentric data increases. Together, these findings provide practical guidance on processing and using egocentric data to train VLAs and WAMs, while clarifying the benefits and limitations of scaling these data.

</details>


### [833] [OVOGO: Offline Value-Guided On-Policy Generative Optimization for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30477)
*Rongzheng Yang,Jiaming Guo,Yuxuan Guo,Zihao Zhang,Yunkai Gao,Siming Lan,Shaohui Peng,Rui Zhang,Tianyun Ma,Xing Hu,Yunji Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 处理失败


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 处理失败

Method: 处理失败

Result: 处理失败

Conclusion: 处理失败

Abstract: Flow-based vision-language-action models can benefit from robot experience collected during deployment, but repeatedly acquiring new physical interactions for policy improvement is costly. Offline reinforcement learning provides a natural way to reuse collected experience, while flow-based policies offer an additional opportunity because fresh generation trajectories can be cheaply resampled from the current policy at replay observations. This motivates separating offline value learning from on-policy optimization of the generative process. We propose OVOGO, an offline reinforcement learning framework that realizes this separation for flow-based VLAs. A central challenge in this formulation is to learn a critic that remains grounded in logged robot experience while providing useful value signals for newly generated actions. OVOGO introduces a Return-Anchored Ranking Critic that combines in-sample distributional value learning with guarded local ranking, improving discrimination among generated actions without assigning them artificial return targets. The frozen critic then provides group-relative value signals for selected-transition optimization of fresh action candidates sampled from the current flow policy. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0, DexJoCo, and LIBERO, as well as a real-robot dexterous manipulation task, show that OVOGO improves the initial VLA across all four settings and achieves higher success rates than the evaluated offline adaptation and value-guided baselines. These results suggest that offline robot experience can be repeatedly reused for value learning while inexpensive generative sampling supports policy optimization, providing an effective approach to experience-based post-training of flow-based VLAs.

</details>


### [834] [AXE: AlpaSim E2E Closed Loop Challenge Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30511)
*Joonhee Lim,Seonmyeong Lee,Sihwan Hwang,Hanbin Jang,Hiwon Shin,Dogun Kim,Hyelin Jo,Hyeonjun Jeong,Yongjae Lee,Junseong Kwak,Junhyeok Park,Satyam Mishra,Juyeb Shin,Uisung Kim,Hyeonseo Kim,Saparkhan Kassymbekov,Hailemichael Molla Gashaw,Abi Rahman Syamil,Mingyu Kim,Hyeongjun Kim,Yeina Lee,Moogeun Park,Dongsuk Kum*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一套面向Physical AI AV Track的端到端自动驾驶开发流程，结合数据整理、高精地图自动标注、模仿学习和仿真强化学习，并通过基于感知的轨迹筛选提升闭环安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 闭环自动驾驶中安全性至关重要，需要减少碰撞和驶出可行驶区域的风险，因此研究如何结合端到端规划与感知信息进行安全的轨迹选择。

Method: 构建端到端自动驾驶流水线，包括数据整理、HD地图自动标注、数据驱动模仿学习和基于仿真的强化学习；提出基于选择的端到端规划方法，利用目标检测和BEV分割过滤可能碰撞或越野的轨迹候选，并对固定轨迹候选集进行碰撞、可行驶区域合规性和进展评分，选择通过过滤的最佳候选。

Result: 方法在NVIDIA NuRec和NVIDIA PAI-AV数据集上训练，并通过仿真 rollout 学习候选轨迹评分；实验表明基于感知的轨迹过滤能够支持安全可靠的闭环自动驾驶。

Conclusion: 将端到端规划与基于感知的轨迹过滤相结合，对于实现安全可靠的闭环自动驾驶是有效的。

Abstract: This report presents a comprehensive pipeline for developing an end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving model for the Physical AI AV Track. The framework consists of data curation, HD map auto-labelling, data-driven imitation learning, and simulator-based reinforcement learning. To ensure safety in the closed-loop setting, we introduce a selection-based E2E planning approach that leverages object detection and BEV segmentation to filter out trajectory candidates likely to cause collisions or off-road driving. Trained on NVIDIA NuRec and the NVIDIA PAI-AV dataset, our method scores a fixed vocabulary of trajectory candidates for collision, drivable-area compliance, and progress learned from simulated rollouts, and selects the best candidate that passes the filter. This design highlights the effectiveness of combining E2E planning with perception-based trajectory filtering for safe and reliable closed-loop autonomous driving.

</details>


### [835] [DexDuet: Learning Contact-Preserving Bimanual Dexterity from Human Demonstrations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30495)
*Haoran Zhang,Haokai Ding,Han Zhou,Zuxing Lu,Heng Zhang,Xingxing Zuo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DexDuet 是一个从单个人类演示中学习保留接触的双臂灵巧操作框架，在多个仿真器和机器人本体上提升了物体跟踪与接触保持性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类双臂灵巧技能难以迁移到机器人手；现有方法主要优化物体轨迹跟踪，忽视人手与物体的交互方式，导致机器人接触错误部位或手指滑动，从而操作不稳定。

Method: DexDuet 使用两种交互奖励来保留人手-物体配置与接触；将双臂策略分解为两个共享权重且相互以对方状态为条件的单手策略；并提出辅助参考状态初始化 A-RSI，一种自适应课程，在演示片段间调整物体辅助和训练起始状态以克服困难阶段。

Result: 在覆盖三个仿真器和五种机器人本体的四个基准上，DexDuet 的物体跟踪 ADD-AUC 比对应基线提升 11 到 41 个点，并持续获得更好的接触保持；在 122 次物体跟踪精度相当的配对运行中，有 117 次更好地保留了人类接触。

Conclusion: 保留人类演示中的手-物体接触对于稳定双臂灵巧操作至关重要，DexDuet 能有效从单个演示中学习接触保持的双臂灵巧技能。

Abstract: Human demonstrations provide a rich source of bimanual dexterous skills, yet transferring them to robot hands remains challenging. Existing methods primarily optimize object trajectory tracking, often overlooking how human hands interact with the object. Even with accurate tracking, robots may contact incorrect object parts or slide their fingers, resulting in unstable manipulation. We present DexDuet, a framework that learns contact-preserving bimanual dexterity from a single human demonstration. DexDuet employs two interaction rewards to preserve human hand-object configurations and contacts. To enable coordinated manipulation, we factorize the bimanual policy into two weight-sharing per-hand policies that condition on each other's states. We further propose assisted reference-state initialization (A-RSI), an adaptive curriculum that adjusts object assistance and training starts across demonstration segments to overcome difficult manipulation phases. Across four benchmarks spanning three simulators and five robot embodiments, DexDuet improves object-tracking ADD-AUC by 11 to 41 points over the corresponding baselines while consistently achieving better contact preservation. Notably, among 122 paired runs with comparable object-tracking accuracy, DexDuet preserves the human's contacts better in 117 cases. Code and videos are available at https://rcl-robotics.github.io/Dexduet.io/

</details>


### [836] [JEPA-ICL: Progress-Aligned Latent Plans for In-Context Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30516)
*Tingjun Dai,Jianxiang He,Mingfei Han,Qihao Yu,Longtao Jiang,Changlin Li,Minghao Jin,Zhihui Li,Xiaojun Chang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: JEPA-ICL 是一种将预测式规划与示范学习耦合的视觉-语言-动作框架，通过 JEPA 特征空间中的未来状态规划指导动作生成，并从示范中定位与当前进度相关的上下文。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 示范能展示任务如何完成，但由于具身形态、外观和执行速度差异，机器人难以识别对当前进度真正相关的指导信息。

Method: 提出 JEPA-ICL，策略在 JEPA 特征空间中预测直到子任务完成的有序未来状态，以捕捉剩余任务；这些规划用于指导动作生成，并在示范中定位相关阶段，利用其 JEPA 监督内容特征提供进度对齐上下文；该上下文反过来更新生成规划和动作的共享策略。

Result: 在 Imitator Game 上，C15 预训练下 seen-task 成功率达 80.0%，比 Zero-WAM 高 12.0 个百分点；无上下文示范时，相比未用人类视频预训练的 VLA-JEPA 变体，LIBERO 成功率从 96.1% 提升到 97.6%，LIBERO-Plus 从 62.9% 提升到 73.2%；结合基于示范的训练和推理时上下文指导，LIBERO-Plus 进一步提升到 75.2%。

Conclusion: 将机器人对自身执行的预测与示范经验复用相耦合，可以提升视觉-语言-动作策略在多种任务和基准上的成功率。

Abstract: Demonstrations show how a task can be completed, but differences in embodiment, appearance, and execution speed make it difficult to identify the guidance relevant to the robot's current progress. We introduce JEPA-ICL, a vision-language-action framework that couples predictive planning with demonstration learning. The policy learns to plan by predicting ordered future states in JEPA feature space up to subtask completion, capturing what remains to be accomplished. These plans guide action generation and locate relevant stages in demonstrations, whose JEPA-supervised content features provide progress-aligned context. Learning from this context, in turn, updates the shared policy that produces the plans and actions. This coupling connects anticipating the robot's own execution with reusing demonstrated experience. On the Imitator Game, JEPA-ICL achieves 80.0% seen-task success under C15 pretraining, outperforming Zero-WAM by 12.0 percentage points. Without contextual demonstrations, JEPA-ICL outperforms the VLA-JEPA variant without human-video pretraining, improving success rates from 96.1% to 97.6% on LIBERO and from 62.9% to 73.2% on LIBERO-Plus. With demonstration-based training and contextual guidance at inference, LIBERO-Plus success further increases from 73.2% to 75.2%.

</details>


### [837] [DelayOPSD: On-Policy Self-Distillation from a Synchronous Teacher for Real-time Asynchronous Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30534)
*Hyeonjae Kim,Jeongsol Kim,Sunwoo Park,Chanyu Moon,Yoojin Oh,Youngjun Jun,Kyumin Choi,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文研究异步执行下流式VLA策略因使用过期观测导致性能下降的问题，提出DelayOPSD，让延迟学生策略在自身 rollout 上模仿同步教师策略，从而提升异步执行成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式视觉-语言-动作策略因大视觉语言骨干和迭代去噪而推理延迟高；异步执行虽能边执行当前动作块边生成下一块，但新动作块基于过期观测，延迟越大性能越差。作者发现规划时与执行时观测产生的动作预测在专家演示上差异小，但在策略自身延迟 rollout 上差异显著，失败回合尤甚。

Method: 提出DelayOPSD：用执行时观测得到的同步教师策略，监督仅看到较早帧和仍在执行动作的延迟学生策略，并让学生在整个去噪过程中匹配教师；训练发生在策略自身 rollout 上，部署时无需额外模块。

Result: 10步延迟下，SmolVLA仅用演示训练成功率70.2%，与朴素异步执行70.4%相当；用自身 rollout 训练提升至78.7%。在LIBERO和Kinetix上，DelayOPSD平均成功率最高；真实机器人上成功率从46%提升到62%。

Conclusion: 异步VLA的性能瓶颈主要来自策略自身延迟 rollout 中的观测不匹配；在自身 rollout 上做同步教师到延迟学生的蒸馏可有效缓解该问题，并在不增加部署模块的情况下提升仿真与真实机器人成功率。

Abstract: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) policies incur substantial inference latency due to their large vision-language backbones and iterative denoising. Asynchronous execution reduces this latency by generating the next action chunk while executing the current one, but the new chunk is conditioned on a stale observation, degrading performance as the delay increases. We investigate this mismatch by comparing actions predicted from observations at planning and execution times. We find that these predictions differ little on expert demonstrations but diverge substantially on the policy's own delayed rollouts, particularly in failed episodes. Motivated by this observation, we propose DelayOPSD, which trains an asynchronous policy to imitate its synchronous counterpart on the policy's own rollouts. Specifically, a synchronous teacher, obtained from the same policy using the observation at execution time, supervises a delayed student that observes only the earlier frame and the actions still being executed. The student learns to match the teacher throughout its own denoising process. Under a 10-step delay, training SmolVLA on demonstrations achieves only 70.2% success, comparable to naive asynchronous execution (70.4%), whereas training on its own rollouts improves success to 78.7%. Across LIBERO and Kinetix, DelayOPSD achieves the highest average success among the compared methods, without introducing additional modules at deployment. On a real robot, it further improves success from 46% to 62%.

</details>


### [838] [Body and Soul: Decoupling Robotic Brain and Policy with RoboHarness-Zero](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30550)
*Yihao Shen,Yuxuan Chen,Xuantong Liu,Jun Gao,Weijian Luo,Tianyang Hu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种无需针对任务或策略重新设计的 VLM harness，用零样本规划与执行监控包裹冻结 VLA，从而提升多技能组合任务的成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLA 策略能执行单一技能，但在需要组合多个技能的任务中常因选错目标或丢失任务进度而失败；审计中约 43% 的失败属于此类。现有 VLM harness 往往依赖任务和策略特定准备，新增任务或更换策略时迁移性不足。

Method: 将冻结 VLA 用于连续、接触丰富的运动控制，VLM 负责零样本选择目标与监控进度；当进度停滞或目标漂移时，VLM 先改写指令，必要时回退到基于通用运动原语生成的短代码，随后把精细控制交还 VLA。监督规则跨策略固定，仅需薄接口适配器和自动分析的技能配置。

Result: 在 200 个 RoboCasa365 场景中，GPT-6 Astra 使冻结 Xiaomi-Robotics-1 成功率从 57.5% 提升至 70.5%，保留 90.4% 的独立成功案例（104/115），并挽救 85 次失败中的 37 次。在共享 50 场景子集上，同一规则使另外四个冻结策略各提升 8 至 10 个百分点，而现有基于准备的 harness 往往难以迁移到新策略。

Conclusion: 该 harness 能以极少任务准备、无需为新策略重新设计的方式增强冻结 VLA，同时较好保留其原有能力，并显示出跨策略迁移优势。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies can execute individual skills but fail to complete tasks that require combining several of them. In our audit of Xiaomi-Robotics-1, an estimated 43\% of failures involve choosing the wrong target or losing track of task progress. Wrapping a frozen VLA in a vision-language model (VLM) harness is a natural remedy. Existing harnesses can gain substantially from task- and policy-specific preparation, raising the question of how much of that gain transfers to a new task or policy. An ideal harness should (i) need minimal preparation for a new task, (ii) need no redesign for a new policy, and (iii) preserve standalone capabilities the policy already has. To the best of our knowledge, our \ours{} is the first harness built this way. Its premise is that choosing targets and tracking progress are easy for a VLM such as GPT-6 without task preparation, while the frozen VLA already handles continuous, contact-rich motion. The frozen VLA therefore executes continuous control while the VLM plans zero-shot and monitors execution; when progress stalls or targets drift, the VLM first rephrases the instruction and, only as a fallback, executes short generated code over generic motion primitives before returning fine control to the VLA. The supervision rules stay fixed across policies, requiring only a thin interface adapter and an automatically profiled skill configuration per policy. On 200 RoboCasa365 scenes, \ours{} with GPT-6 Astra raises the success rate of frozen Xiaomi-Robotics-1 from \textbf{\color{blue}57.5\%} to \textbf{\color{blue}70.5\%} and preserves \textbf{\color{blue}90.4\%} of its standalone successes (104/115) while rescuing 37 of 85 failures. On a shared 50-scene subset, the same rules add 8 to 10 percentage points to each of four other frozen policies, while existing preparation-based harness systems often fail to transfer to a new policy.

</details>


### [839] [RoboInF: A Benchmark for Instruction Fidelity in Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30555)
*Jiawei Guo,Yu Huang,Dijiang Dong,Yue Liu,Peiran Ren,Wei Shen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 RoboInF 基准，用于衡量操作策略在初始场景和机器人状态固定时，是否会随指令变化可靠地调整行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准常把指令遵循与感知、规划和新场景泛化混在一起评估，任务成功率高并不能充分证明模型忠实遵循指令，因此需要专门测量行为对指令变化的适应能力。

Method: 构建 RoboInF：8 个任务，每个任务设 6 至 12 个经专家验证的指令分支，分别改变目标、流程或操作细节；用任务特定检查器验证最终目标，并利用轨迹、接触和事件序列评估执行过程合规性；同时发布 RoboInF-4K 数据集，包含 4242 条专家示范及仿真器生成的运动与接触标注。

Result: 评估 π0.5、OpenWAM、GPT-6 Astra 和 Qwen3.8-Flash 四个模型，均表现出任务完成与忠实执行之间的差距。

Conclusion: 当前领先模型在细粒度指令遵循方面仍有较大提升空间，RoboInF 为更可靠地评估指令遵循提供了专门基准。

Abstract: Precise language control requires embodied models to follow instructions governing both task outcomes and execution. Although recent methods train policies to follow increasingly detailed commands, existing benchmarks often assess instruction following alongside perception, planning, and generalization to unfamiliar scenes. Higher task success therefore offers limited evidence of closer adherence to instructions. We introduce RoboInF, a benchmark measuring how reliably manipulation policies adapt their behavior to changes in an instruction. For each of eight tasks, six to twelve expert-validated instruction branches vary the requested goal, procedure, or manipulation detail while holding the initial scene and robot state fixed. Task-specific checkers verify the terminal goal and use recorded trajectories, contacts, and event sequences to assess compliance throughout execution. The accompanying RoboInF-4K dataset pairs 4,242 expert demonstrations with simulator-derived annotations of motion and contact. We evaluate leading manipulation policies ($π_{0.5}$ and OpenWAM) and inference-only agents (GPT-6 Astra and Qwen3.8-Flash). All four models exhibit a gap between task completion and faithful execution, indicating substantial room for fine-grained instruction following.

</details>


### [840] [VeriTouch: Verified Visuo-Tactile World Models that Improve Robot Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30572)
*Shuxun Wang,Xiaonan Jiang,Zhaoyu Wang,Ziyuan Chu,Xihang Yue,Pengfei Liu,Haodong Zhu,Shiqi Liu,Mingzhi Zheng,Liang Su,Linchao Zhu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 VeriTouch 框架，用于生成并验证合成视触觉轨迹以支持策略学习，并在五个真实任务上验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩展视触觉策略学习受限于真实数据采集成本高和构建逼真仿真困难；生成模型虽可扩展训练数据，但有用示范需要合理的触觉反馈、与视觉接触的时间对齐以及准确动作。

Method: VeriTouch 包含三部分：VeriGen 世界模型根据初始图像和任务指令联合生成双视角视频与真实感触觉序列，并通过触觉专家与预训练视频模型联合建模；VeriEval 多模态验证器评估视觉质量及触觉真实性、接触力合理性和视觉接触与触觉信号的时间对齐，过滤不可靠序列；VeriIDM 逆动力学模型结合双相机全局场景、夹爪细节和相邻帧运动从验证后视频中提取动作。

Result: 在五个真实世界任务上，合成数据提升了全部四种被评估策略；进一步扩展合成轨迹可在不额外采集真实数据的情况下显著提升策略性能。

Conclusion: 经过生成、验证和动作提取的合成视触觉数据能够作为可扩展的训练数据源，有效增强真实任务中的视触觉策略学习。

Abstract: Scaling visuo-tactile policy learning is constrained by the high cost of real-world data collection and the difficulty of building realistic simulations. Generative models offer a scalable source of training data, yet useful demonstrations require plausible tactile feedback, temporal alignment with visual contact, and accurate actions. To this end, we present VeriTouch, a framework for generating and verifying synthetic visuo-tactile trajectories for policy learning. Conditioned on initial images and task instructions, our world model, VeriGen, jointly generates high-fidelity dual-view videos and realistic tactile sequences over complete manipulation trajectories. By integrating a dedicated tactile expert with a pretrained video model, it captures realistic visual details and tactile deformation dynamics through joint visuo-tactile modeling. Our multimodal verifier VeriEval then checks visual quality while focusing on tactile reliability, assessing tactile realism, contact-force plausibility, and temporal alignment between visible contact and tactile signals, thereby directly filtering out unreliable sequences. Finally, our inverse dynamics model, VeriIDM, combines global scene information from both camera views with fine-grained gripper details and motion across neighboring frames to extract actions from verified videos. Experiments on five real-world tasks show that synthetic data improves all four evaluated policies, with further scaling synthetic trajectories substantially boosting policy performance without additional real-world data collection.

</details>


### [841] [GeoMerge-OPD: Balanced Skill Integration in Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30632)
*Le Yang,Haoyang Lyu,Honglei Jin,Wenshuo Chen,Jiawei Liang,Wenqiang Wang,Yutao Yue,Xiaochun Cao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 GeoMerge-OPD，用于将异构机器人技能集成到单一 VLA 策略中，通过响应空间正则、参数合并和同策略蒸馏实现稳定的人形全身多技能控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 模型擅长单项技能，但将操作与 locomotion 等异构技能集成到统一策略仍困难；联合微调和参数合并等常见方法会在闭环执行中引发非预期动作，严重削弱单项技能。

Method: 分析专家更新发现响应能量集中于少数主方向，且共享任务相关响应子空间内存在专家响应相反的高能方向，并与合并后的动作偏移相关。为此，在独立专家微调时用 G-isometry 约束任务激活子空间内的更新响应增益，再将专家参数静态合并为学生策略；并以任务专家为教师，在学生访问的环境观测和中间动作流状态上提供速度场监督，校准残余行为偏差。

Result: 在两个 VLA 主干上，GeoMerge-OPD 在 SIMPLE 上实现强且均衡的人形技能集成，在 LIBERO 和 LIBERO-PRO 上保持稳定表现，优于联合微调和多任务强化学习基线，并在扰动下保持鲁棒性。

Conclusion: GeoMerge-OPD 能有效缓解多技能合并中的响应冲突和非预期动作偏移，为通用机器人全身多技能集成提供了一种有效的 VLA 策略合并与蒸馏框架。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models excel at individual robotic skills, yet integrating heterogeneous skills into a single policy remains a key challenge for general-purpose robotic control, especially in whole-body tasks with differing manipulation and locomotion requirements. Common multi-skill integration strategies, such as joint fine-tuning and parameter merging, can induce unintended actions during closed-loop execution, severely degrading individual skills. Task-conditioned analysis of expert updates reveals response energy concentrated in a few dominant directions and opposing expert responses along high-energy directions within a shared, task-relevant response subspace. This structure co-occurs with unintended action shifts after merging. We propose GeoMerge-OPD, combining response-space regularization, parameter merging, and on-policy distillation. During independent expert fine-tuning, G-isometry constrains update-response gains within task-activation subspaces; the expert parameters are then statically merged into a student with preliminary multitask capabilities. Fine-tuned task experts serve as teachers, providing velocity-field supervision at the environment observations and intermediate action-flow states visited by the student to calibrate residual behavioral deviations. Experiments with two VLA backbones show strong, balanced humanoid skill integration on SIMPLE and consistent performance on LIBERO and LIBERO-PRO, outperforming joint fine-tuning and multitask reinforcement-learning baselines while maintaining robustness under perturbations.

</details>


### [842] [SWEEP-Bench: Do Embodied Policies Act on the Speed They See?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30637)
*Hiroaki Honda,Koya Sakamoto,Shu Morikuni,Yusuke Iwasawa,Taiki Miyanishi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 SWEEP-Bench，一个包含 80 个传送带操作任务、16 类技能和 13 种皮带速度的仿真基准，用于评估机器人策略对运动物体速度的适应能力，并发现现有视觉-语言-动作模型存在明显的速度相关失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准很少系统测量机器人策略在多样任务和不同速度下适应运动物体速度的能力，而实际操作中策略必须根据物体运动速度调整动作。

Method: 构建 SWEEP-Bench 仿真基准：物体通过可见运动的传送带传输，每个任务有静态对应版本，并在 0.10–0.40 m/s 的 13 个速度下用相同随机场景评估。微调八种视觉-语言-动作和 world-action 模型，比较仅当前帧与加入两帧历史帧的观测，并用线性探针分析速度可解码性，还测试真实速度输入和图像估计速度输入。

Result: 六个模型在中等速度下成功率最高，失败表明它们倾向于输出适合演示平均速度而非实际速度的动作。历史帧使三个模型成功率提高 10–40 个百分点，且皮带速度也从这三个模型中最容易被线性解码。向四个模型加入真实速度输入可提升全部模型，基于图像估计的速度也保留了大部分增益。

Conclusion: SWEEP-Bench 揭示了速度相关的策略失败，并表明历史帧只对速度最可解码的策略有帮助，例如在多帧数据上预训练的模型；速度信息输入能有效改善策略的速度适应能力。

Abstract: Robot policies must adapt to the speed of moving objects, yet existing benchmarks rarely measure this ability across diverse tasks and speeds. We introduce SWEEP-Bench, a simulation benchmark with 80 conveyor-belt manipulation tasks spanning 16 skill categories, each evaluated at 13 belt speeds (0.10-0.40 m/s). Objects are transported through physical contact with a visibly moving belt. Each task has a static counterpart, and each evaluation episode uses the same randomized scene at all 13 speeds. We fine-tune eight vision-language-action and world-action models on demonstrations spanning the full speed range, comparing observations from the current frame alone with those including two past frames. For six models, the success rate peaks at intermediate speeds, and their failures indicate that they tend to produce actions suited to the average demonstration speed rather than to the actual one. Past frames raise the success rate by 10-40 percentage points for three models, and linear probes show that the belt speed is also most linearly decodable from these three. Adding ground-truth speed input to four of the models improves all of them, and a speed estimated from the images keeps most of this gain. These results show that SWEEP-Bench exposes speed-dependent failures and suggest that past frames help only policies from which the speed is most decodable, such as those pretrained on multiple frames. Project page: https://damin3927.github.io/SWEEP-Bench

</details>


### [843] [ABI: Actor-Free Behavior-Induced Representations for Zero-Shot Test-Time Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30636)
*Yifei Yao,Yude Zou,Guanbo Jiao,Jianming Ma,Xing Gao,Chunhua Shen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出无演员行为诱导表示（ABI），从无奖励轨迹中学习多步动作块表示，并在测试时用轻量任务读出构建动作块评论器，指导不同目标策略实现零样本泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行为克隆策略虽能生成连贯多步动作，但纯模仿目标限制零样本泛化；现有离线强化学习要么依赖任务奖励监督，要么在评论器训练或策略部署中与特定演员耦合，导致训练成本高且难以跨策略泛化。

Method: 利用数据收集行为下评估动作可保留跨目标策略的相对价值排序这一性质，结合无奖励后继预测，提出ABI，从无标签轨迹学习多 horizon 动作块表示，无需奖励监督或演员训练；测试时将冻结表示与轻量任务读出结合形成动作块评论器，在不更新参数的情况下指导目标策略，并可跨未见策略迁移。

Result: 在65个运动、导航和操作任务中，ABI的动作块评论器能引导弱模仿策略匹配或超过零样本强化学习基线，样本效率高；在相同候选动作上优于现有零样本评论器；无需重训练即可改进外部训练的强化学习演员；从原始像素输入时也取得显著指导增益，并在视觉操作任务上超过先前零样本强化学习基线。

Conclusion: ABI提供了一种无需奖励监督和演员耦合的零样本策略改进方法，能够跨策略迁移并有效指导模仿策略，在视觉运动控制中具有潜力。

Abstract: Behavior-cloning policies show strong ability in sequential control by generating coherent multi-step action chunks, yet their purely imitative objective limits zero-shot generalization to unseen tasks. While offline reinforcement learning offers principled policy improvement, existing methods either require task-specific reward supervision or remain tied to a specific actor during critic training or policy deployment, inflating training cost and restricting cross-policy generalization. We observe that evaluating actions under the data-collecting behavior largely preserves their relative value ordering across target policies, offering a way around actor coupling. Combining this property with reward-free successor prediction, we propose Actor-Free Behavior-Induced Representations (ABI) to learn multi-horizon action-chunk representations from unlabeled trajectories without reward supervision or actor training. At test time, pairing the frozen representation with lightweight task readouts forms a chunk critic that guides target policies without parameter updates and transfers directly across distinct unseen policies. Our analysis establishes when the value ordering is preserved across policies and when selecting among proposed chunks improves closed-loop return. Across 65 locomotion, navigation, and manipulation tasks, ABI's chunk critic guides weak imitation policies to match or surpass zero-shot RL baselines with high sample efficiency, outperforms existing zero-shot critics on identical proposals, and improves externally trained RL actors without retraining. From raw pixels, ABI delivers substantial guidance gains and surpasses prior zero-shot RL baselines on visual manipulation, highlighting its potential for visuomotor control.

</details>


### [844] [Active Observation for Robust Visual Servoing in Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30658)
*Zhilun Hu,Yuqi Cheng,Yuxiang Tan,Wenpan Li,Weiming Shen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种双机械臂主动观察框架：一臂携带RGB-D相机主动调整视角，另一臂执行抓取，以在接近阶段遮挡下保持或恢复目标与夹爪的共享视野，从而提升视觉伺服抓取鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人抓取接近阶段的遮挡会破坏闭环视觉伺服控制；固定eye-to-hand相机在目标被遮挡后缺乏主动恢复机制，而eye-in-hand易受自遮挡和手眼标定敏感性影响。

Method: 在现有双臂平台上，一臂作为主动观察者携带RGB-D相机，另一臂执行抓取；观察者移动到可行共享视野工作空间内保持或恢复目标-夹爪共享视图。采用主动两阶段视点策略使高精度RGB-D轴对齐任务相关误差分量；当可见性下降时，触发遮挡探索模块，暂停工作臂并按观察质量评分候选视点以恢复共享视图。由于目标和夹爪在同一RGB-D图像中检测，使用相对伺服误差避免对两个独立变换估计做差分。

Result: 在双6-DoF Piper平台、使用开放词汇检测器和文本提示、无需任务特定微调或演示的条件下评估。每个物体50次随机试验中，抓取成功率为94%，高于反应式视点基线的76%和固定相机的64%；在触发的严重遮挡试验中，平均恢复时间为1.8±0.6秒。

Conclusion: 主动观察框架能有效应对抓取接近阶段的遮挡，在不依赖任务特定训练或演示的情况下显著提高抓取成功率，并能在严重遮挡后快速恢复共享视野。

Abstract: Robust visual servoing during robotic grasping remains challenging, as approach-phase occlusion frequently disrupts closed-loop control. To address this, we present an active observation framework in which one arm of an existing dual-arm platform carries an RGB-D camera as an active observer while the other executes grasping. The observer repositions to maintain or recover a shared target-gripper view within the feasible shared-view workspace. Occlusion during the final approach is particularly acute: fixed eye-to-hand lacks an active recovery mechanism once the target is hidden, while eye-in-hand can suffer from self-occlusion and sensitivity to hand-eye calibration. The observer first uses an active two-phase viewpoint strategy to align high-precision RGB-D axes with task-relevant error components. If visibility later degrades, an occlusion-triggered exploration module pauses the worker arm and scores candidate viewpoints by observation quality to recover a shared target-gripper view. Because both objects are detected in a single RGB-D image, the resulting Relative Servo Error avoids differencing two independently transformed target and gripper estimates. We evaluate the system on a dual 6-DoF Piper platform using an open-vocabulary detector with text prompts, without task-specific fine-tuning or demonstrations. Across 50 randomized trials per object, the system achieves 94% grasp success versus 76% for a reactive viewpoint baseline and 64% for a fixed camera. On triggered severe-occlusion trials, recovery takes $1.8 \pm 0.6$ s on average.

</details>


### [845] [LLM-Guided Compositional Continual Learning for Robot Manipulation with Gated Low-Rank Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30667)
*Nilay Kushawaha,Abdalla Swikir,Fares Abu-Dakka*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出一种面向通用操作机器人的持续学习框架：将每项技能表示为渐进神经网络中的专家子网络，并用LoRA与门控侧连接复用知识；同时用冻结的本地大语言模型进行长程任务分解与专家调度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用操作机器人需要持续获得新技能，同时不遗忘旧技能、不从头重训练；长程部署还要求系统能理解自然语言指令并合理调度已有技能。

Method: 采用渐进神经网络为每项技能建立专家子网络；在新任务中通过侧连接上的LoRA模块复用先验知识，并用可学习的逐父节点门控显式衰减单条迁移路径、降低稠密侧连接参数成本；使用冻结的本地大语言模型将自然语言指令分解为子任务并路由到合适专家，专家库不足时请求新专家；采用共享任务空间动作接口。

Result: 在12个MetaWorld任务以及Sawyer-to-Panda-to-UR5e跨 embodiment 迁移实验中，相比从零学习，在示范数据有限时任务成功率更高；真实机器人实验进一步展示了组合执行与专家编排能力。

Conclusion: 该框架能够支持持续技能获取、知识迁移和长程自然语言驱动的专家编排，并减少对遗忘旧技能和从头重训练的依赖。

Abstract: General-purpose manipulation robots must acquire new skills over time without forgetting prior ones or retraining from scratch. We present a continual learning framework that represents each skill as a dedicated expert sub- network in a Progressive Neural Network (PNN). New tasks reuse prior knowledge through low-rank adaptation (LoRA) modules on lateral connections controlled by learnable per-parent gates, enabling explicit attenuation of individual transfer paths while reducing the parameter cost of dense PNN laterals. For long-horizon deployment, a frozen local large language model decomposes natural-language instructions into sub-tasks, routes them to suitable experts, and requests a new expert only when the library is insufficient. Using a shared task-space action interface, we evaluate the framework on twelve MetaWorld tasks and in a Sawyer-to-Panda-to-UR5e cross-embodiment transfer experiment, showing improved task success relative to learning from scratch when demonstrations are limited. Real-robot manipulation experiments further demonstrate that the proposed framework supports compositional execution and expert orchestration.

</details>


### [846] [Coordinating Perception and Planning for Test-Time Adaptation in End-to-End Driving under Distribution Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30739)
*Shiyu Fang,Yiming Cui,Qihang Huang,Zhan Chen,Collister Chua,Wenhui Huang,Peng Hang,Chen Lv,Jian Sun*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出一种用于端到端自动驾驶模型持续测试时自适应的即插即用框架P2-TTA，通过联合感知熵最小化与回顾性时序规划一致性目标，并结合EMA教师和历史规划损失拒绝机制，提升模型在分布偏移下的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端自动驾驶依赖独立同分布假设，面对真实世界分布偏移时性能易下降。虽然测试时自适应可用于在线增强，但直接用于驾驶任务存在两个障碍：一是多任务自适应依赖，上游感知更新会影响下游规划，且感知置信度无法直接评估下游影响；二是连续自适应不稳定，长时程递归在线更新会导致参数漂移累积。

Method: 提出P2-TTA即插即用测试时自适应框架。其核心是联合优化感知熵最小化与基于观测自车运动构建的回顾性时序规划一致性目标；同时使用EMA教师作为移动参数参考，并拒绝会增加历史规划损失的候选更新，以稳定在线自适应过程。

Result: 在多个模型和骨干网络上实验表明，P2-TTA平均仅更新0.11‰参数，平均自适应时间为19.9 ms；在严重分布偏移下，L2、碰撞率和PDMS的平均恢复率分别达到36.4%、30.0%和9.3%。在UniAD上采用共享感知-规划目标时，其L2和碰撞恢复在对比的TTA基线中最高。

Conclusion: P2-TTA能够以极低参数更新量和较低计算开销实现端到端自动驾驶模型的稳定持续测试时自适应，并在严重分布偏移下显著恢复感知与规划性能，验证了联合感知-规划目标与稳定性机制的有效性。

Abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving has achieved significant milestones, yet its reliance on the i.i.d. assumption renders it vulnerable to real-world distribution shifts. While Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) offers a promising paradigm for on-the-fly enhancement, its application to driving is hindered by two barriers: (i) multi-task adaptation dependency, where updates to upstream perception also affect downstream planning, while perception confidence alone does not directly assess these downstream effects; and (ii) continuous adaptation instability, where recursive online updates over long horizons cause compounding parameter drift. To address these challenges, we propose P2-TTA, a plug-and-play TTA framework for the continual adaptation of end-to-end driving models. P2-TTA coordinates adaptation through a joint objective combining perception entropy minimization with a retrospective temporal planning consistency objective derived from observed ego motion. To stabilize online updates, we use an EMA teacher as a moving parameter reference and reject candidate updates that increase historical planning loss. Extensive experiments across multiple models demonstrate that, by updating an average of 0.11 per mille of parameters with an average adaptation time of 19.9 ms on different backbones, P2-TTA achieves average recovery rates of 36.4%, 30.0%, and 9.3% for L2, collision rate, and PDMS, respectively, under severe distribution shifts. Under a shared perception-planning objective, P2-TTA achieves the highest L2 and collision recovery among the compared TTA baselines on UniAD.

</details>


### [847] [Object Count Generalization Is an Interface Problem: Warping a Frozen Skill Instead of Retraining It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30765)
*Paul Mattes,Ayman Abdeldayem,Denis Shcherba,Wojciech Samek,Marc Toussaint*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 处理失败


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 处理失败

Method: 处理失败

Result: 处理失败

Conclusion: 处理失败

Abstract: Reinforcement learning policies for robot manipulation degrade when the number of objects N in the scene grows beyond the training range. This is a covariate shift that also changes the dimension of the state. We propose WAVE (Warping Actions and Views of an Expert), which extends a pretrained single-object skill to many objects without updating its weights. WAVE has three parts. First, a selection policy picks the one object the robot works on next. Second, a warping policy reads a local view of the scene around that object, whose size does not depend on N. It emits a multiplier and an offset for every quantity the skill reads and every action it outputs. Third, the skill acts under this affine warp. It is shown a scene that holds a single object, while the warp steers it around the objects it is not shown and edits the actions that are sent to the robot. Both the selection and warping policies are trained with PPO on the multi-object reward and use the skill as a black box, so WAVE is task-general and skill-agnostic. It requires only that the skill was trained on the same embodiment and that every object has a goal pose. We also bound the number of attempts needed to place all N objects, assuming positive expected net progress per attempt, and measure this progress for each object count. We evaluate WAVE on cube arrangement tasks with a gantry robot and with a Franka Panda arm. Trained with at most nine cubes, it generalizes zero-shot to several times its training count, on the gantry to scenes of up to thirty cubes. Published methods that learn multi-object manipulation show count generalization up to six objects. Fine-tuning the skill, learning from the same local view without it, and an entity transformer, even when distilled from the pretrained skill, all collapse within their training counts under the same training budget.

</details>


### [848] [Place-Revisit Consistency Evaluation of Reference Poses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30741)
*Jianzhu Huai,Yujia Zhang,Grzegorz Jozkow*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 处理失败


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 处理失败

Method: 处理失败

Result: 处理失败

Conclusion: 处理失败

Abstract: Reference trajectories are widely used to evaluate odometry and simultaneous localization and mapping systems. However, local inconsistencies in benchmark reference poses can bias such evaluations. This paper presents a place-revisit consistency evaluation method for reference poses in mobile sensing datasets. When a platform revisits a previously observed place after a sufficient temporal gap, the relative pose implied by the reference trajectory should agree with relative poses estimated directly from onboard sensors. We instantiate this idea with lidar scan registration and stereo-image pose estimation, and apply it to the KITTI Odometry and SNAIL Radar. The KITTI analysis identifies several revisit regions where the public reference poses disagree with sensor-derived relative poses, with median translation discrepancies up to 6.60 m. Representative point-cloud overlays further localize these discrepancies and support the use of place revisits as a benchmark-validation tool.

</details>


### [849] [HIVE-Bench: Evaluating Patch-Level Visual Representations for Egocentric Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30813)
*Qiwei Liang,Zhengtu Liang,Minghao Lai,Yikeng Chen,Yiming Wang,Boyang Cai,Yuetong Fang,Taowen Wang,Baiqiao Yin,Tianxing Chen,Yue Chen,Jiaming Liang,Guangyu Chen,Shaolong Zhu,Daolin Ma,Renjing Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 HIVE-Bench，用统一流匹配策略在 24 个自我中心双臂任务上系统评测 7 个视觉家族、20 个编码器，并比较多种视觉读出指标与策略成功率的联系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人学习常用预训练视觉，但以往比较多基于第三人称图像池化后的单一向量；双臂策略实际读取机器人相机上的稠密 patch token，这种差异使现有视觉评测不能可靠反映策略表现。

Method: 构建 HIVE-Bench：一个共享 flow-matching 策略读取 20 个编码器输出，在 24 个自我中心双臂任务上覆盖适应、任务共享以及数据、模型规模、层数扫描；同时用统计量、状态/物体读出、已发表视觉分数和逆动力学读出评估 token，并与策略 rollout 对比。

Result: 保留 patch token 很关键，将每个视角平均为单 token 会损失大部分成功率；适应对每个编码器配对都有帮助；共享策略以少得多的更新接近独立策略。逆动力学/指令运动读出是训练前最强指标之一，识别、深度和对应关系不能可靠迁移；微调可改善动作读出，即使其他指标反向变化；没有统计量稳定到可在部署前替代 rollout。

Conclusion: 双臂机器人策略的视觉表征评测应保留稠密 patch token，并重视与动作相关的读出；现有通用视觉指标不足以预测策略成功，最终仍需依赖实际 rollout 验证。

Abstract: Pretrained vision is a common start for robot learning, but most comparisons still score one pooled vector from a third-person image. Bimanual policies instead read dense patch tokens from cameras on the robot. We introduce HIVE-Bench: one shared flow-matching policy reads 20 encoders from seven families on 24 egocentric bimanual tasks, across adaptation, task sharing, and sweeps of data, model size, and layer. Keeping the patches matters. Averaging each view to one token removes most of the success, adaptation helps every pair we test, and one shared policy keeps most of the success of separate policies at a fraction of the updates. The same tokens are then scored with statistics, state and object readouts, published vision scores, and an inverse-dynamics readout. That readout of the commanded motion is one of the strongest measurements available before a policy is trained. Recognition, depth, and correspondence do not transfer reliably. Fine-tuning can improve the action readout even when other measurements move the other way, and no statistic is stable enough to replace a rollout before any deployment.

</details>


### [850] [Tabular Foundation Models Are Surprisingly Effective In-Context Robot Learners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30889)
*Zhen Xu,Hao-Run Cai,Heng-Zhuang Li,Si-Yang Liu,Jun-Peng Jiang,Han-Jia Ye*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文研究通用数值预测预训练的基础模型能否作为上下文机器人学习器，提出将视觉模仿学习转化为表格数值预测的 TabAct，并在 LIBERO 和 Meta-World 上验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索面向通用数值预测预训练的 foundation models 是否可无需机器人专门训练或目标任务微调，直接用于上下文机器人学习。

Method: 提出 TabAct，将视觉模仿学习建模为数值预测：以冻结视觉特征和机器人本体感知为输入、未来动作块为目标，每个演示时间步作为一个带标签样本，条件化冻结的表格基础模型 TFM 进行闭环控制；方法不使用机器人特定训练或目标任务微调。

Result: 在每种方法仅提供一个目标任务演示时，TabAct 结合 TabICLv2 在 LIBERO 和 Meta-World 上取得最高平均成功率，分别超过最强基线 20.9 和 5.8 个百分点；增加演示可提升控制效果且无需更新权重，五个演示时 LIBERO-Object 成功率达 94.2%。

Conclusion: 通用数值预训练可以为上下文机器人学习提供有效基础，冻结的表格基础模型结合演示上下文即可实现较强的机器人模仿控制。

Abstract: Can foundation models pretrained for generic numerical prediction serve as in-context robot learners? We investigate this question through tabular foundation models (TFMs), which are pretrained to infer input-output relationships from labeled examples in context. We introduce TabAct, which casts visual imitation as numerical prediction: frozen visual features and robot proprioception form the inputs, future action chunks form the targets, and each demonstration time step provides one labeled example that conditions a frozen TFM for closed-loop control. The predictor receives no robot-specific training or target-task fine-tuning. With one target-task demonstration available to each method, TabAct with TabICLv2 achieves the highest average success among all evaluated methods on both LIBERO and Meta-World, exceeding the strongest baseline by 20.9 and 5.8 percentage points, respectively. Additional demonstrations improve control without updating model weights: with five demonstrations, success reaches 94.2% on LIBERO-Object. These results demonstrate that generic numerical pretraining can provide an effective foundation for in-context robot learning.

</details>


### [851] [DexLatentWorld: 3D Cross-Embodiment Latent Action World Models for Zero-Shot Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30907)
*Vinay Udit Mohan,Xuchuan Huang,Rolandos Alexandros Potamias*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于3D点云观测的潜在动作世界模型，从重定向的人类操作演示中学习连续动作表示，并用于跨形态机器人操作与零样本控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统世界模型依赖昂贵且难扩展的动作标注交互数据，且常绑定特定机器人形态，难以迁移到未见过的机器人。

Method: 从点云观测中学习3D潜在动作表示，使用对比目标促进跨形态运动表示一致性；将统一潜在动作空间作为模型预测控制的搜索空间，通过粒子式未来预测生成几何运动，并从中恢复可执行机器人指令，无需特定形态的动作解码器。

Result: 学习到的潜在动作具有可控性和组合性，可迁移到未见机器人形态并支持未见夹爪几何的零样本操作；任务无关适配后在到达、抓取、放置任务上分别达到90%、92%、60%，高于DexWM的72%、58%、28%；真实世界未见灵巧手在5类任务50次试验中达到86%成功率。

Conclusion: 几何接地的潜在动作可作为统一、可迁移的接口，支持基于世界模型的机器人操作，并展现跨形态与真实世界零样本应用潜力。

Abstract: World models facilitate planning and control in robotic manipulation by enabling agents to anticipate the consequences of their actions. However, they typically rely on action-labelled interaction data that is costly to acquire and difficult to scale. These models are also often tied to the specific embodiment they were trained on, limiting transferability to previously unseen robot morphologies. We introduce a 3D latent-action world model that learns continuous action representations directly from point-cloud observations of retargeted human manipulation demonstrations. A contrastive objective is used to encourage consistent representations of motion across embodiments. The resulting unified latent action space serves directly as the search space for model-predictive control, where sampled latent actions condition particle-based future predictions. Executable robot commands are then recovered from the predicted geometric motion without requiring an embodiment-specific action decoder. Through extensive evaluations, we demonstrate that the learned latent actions exhibit controllable and compositional motion, transfer to unseen robot embodiments, and support zero-shot manipulation with unseen gripper geometries. Following task-agnostic adaptation, our model achieves 90%, 92%, and 60% success on reaching, grasping, and placing, respectively, compared with DexWM's reported 72%, 58%, and 28%. Finally, we demonstrate zero-shot real-world manipulation with an unseen dexterous hand, achieving an 86% success rate across 50 trials on five diverse tasks involving pushing, grasping, and lifting everyday objects. These results highlight the potential of geometry-grounded latent actions as a unified, transferable interface for world-model-based robotic manipulation. Project materials, including demonstration videos and source code, are available at https://vinaymohan0409.github.io/DexLatentWorld/.

</details>


### [852] [Bridging Continuous-Time MAPF and Industrial AGV Fleet Coordination with Lazy Priority-Based Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30874)
*Federico Signorile,Raffaele Carli,Alessandro Bertogli,Roberto Olmi,Sven Koenig,Mariagrazia Dotoli*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文研究工业AGV场景下的连续时间路网多智能体路径规划（MAPF_R），提出AGV-MAPF_R-CTC建模，并改进CPBS与提出Lazy-CPBS，以降低高连接冗余路网下的求解开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续时间MAPF_R虽能实现几何避碰的机器人车队协调，但在工业AGV基础设施上部署困难：高连接、冗余路网会放大安全区间推理和多智能体交互处理成本。

Method: 形式化AGV-MAPF_R-CTC，一种带预计算连续时间冲突的配置空间MAPF_R变体，使MAPF_R求解器可少量修改后复用于AGV车队协调；重新审视CPBS，明确SIPP底层规划器在优先级约束下的边界条件并支持更早解检测；分析优先级搜索空间结构，厘清每次优先级细化影响哪些智能体及何时可避免重规划；提出Lazy-CPBS，惰性生成高层节点，仅在扩展子节点时计算其规划。

Result: 在标准MAPF基准和从专有数字孪生仿真器导入的工业AGV路网上实验表明，基于CPBS的求解器在远超最优MAPF_R求解器可达智能体数量时仍有效；Lazy-CPBS显著降低CPBS开销，并在工业布局中提供最一致的鲁棒性/运行时间权衡。

Conclusion: 该工作弥合了MAPF_R与工业AGV部署之间的差距，所提Lazy-CPBS通过惰性高层搜索有效减少冗余计算，在工业AGV路网中表现出较好的鲁棒性与运行时间平衡。

Abstract: Continuous-time multi-agent path finding on roadmaps (MAPF$_R$) offers a principled way to coordinate robot fleets with geometric collision avoidance, yet its deployment on industrial automated guided vehicle (AGV) infrastructures remains challenging, as highly connected and redundant roadmaps amplify both safe-interval reasoning and multi-agent interaction handling. To bridge this gap, we formalize AGV-MAPF$_R$-CTC, a configuration-space variant of MAPF$_R$ with precomputed continuous-time conflicts that enables the reuse of MAPF$_R$ solvers for AGV fleet coordination with minimal changes. We then revisit continuous-time priority-based search (CPBS), identifying the boundary conditions required by its safe interval path planning (SIPP) low-level planner under priority-induced constraints and enabling earlier solution detection. As a central contribution, we analyze the structure of the priority search space, clarifying which agents are affected by each priority refinement and when replanning can be avoided. Building on this analysis, we introduce a novel algorithm, Lazy-CPBS, which materializes high-level nodes lazily: a child's plans are computed only when it is expanded, so siblings that are never expanded cost no low-level search. Experiments on standard MAPF benchmarks and on industrial AGV roadmaps imported from a proprietary digital-twin simulator show that CPBS-based solvers remain effective well beyond the agent counts reachable by optimal MAPF$_R$ solvers, while Lazy-CPBS substantially reduces CPBS overhead and offers the most consistent robustness/runtime trade-off across industrial layouts.

</details>


### [853] [CoSel: Cooperation as Selection for End-to-End Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30918)
*Yiping Li,Haohua Que,Zhipeng Bao,Wenjie Zhao,Qianwen Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 CoSel，一种“合作即选择”的框架：不改变原有自车规划器，而是利用独立训练的合作预测器预测周围智能体未来运动，并据此评估和选择规划器候选轨迹，从而在共享信息揭示额外风险时安全介入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有合作端到端方法将共享信息直接注入规划器，并依赖合作驾驶示范学习如何使用这些信息；但共享信息真正应改变驾驶决策的时刻在数据中很少，导致监督不足。作者认为合作行为不必由规划器学习，而应通过预测周围智能体运动并从候选轨迹中选择响应来实现。

Method: CoSel 保持规划器及其仅使用自车输入的设置不变；单独训练合作预测器，利用自车、路侧单元和网联自动驾驶车辆的观测预测周围智能体及其未来运动；再将规划器候选轨迹与这些预测进行安全性评估，若原选择仍安全则保留，若共享信息揭示额外风险则选择最接近的安全替代轨迹，且每次安全介入都可追溯到触发它的共享证据。

Result: 闭环评估中，CoSel 在 V2Xverse 上取得 70.7 驾驶分数，比最佳对比合作方法高 7.5 分；在 MDrive 上取得最高平均驾驶分数 85.8。在自车检测缺失情况下，72 个场景中 CoSel 碰撞数仅从 17 增至 19，而现有合作端到端模型从 19 增至 32。

Conclusion: CoSel 表明无需让规划器学习合作行为，通过合作预测与候选轨迹选择即可有效利用共享信息，提升闭环驾驶性能，并在检测缺失时表现出更强鲁棒性，同时保持安全介入的可追溯性。

Abstract: Cooperative driving can extend a vehicle's awareness beyond its own sensors, but existing cooperative end-to-end methods inject shared information into the planner and rely on cooperative driving demonstrations to learn how to use it. The moments in which shared information should change a driving decision are rare in such data, providing limited supervision for learning this behavior. We argue that cooperation need not be learned by the planner. Instead, reacting to shared information requires predicting how surrounding agents will move and selecting a response from the candidate trajectories of an ego planner. We introduce CoSel, a cooperation-as-selection framework that leaves the planner and its ego-only input unchanged. A separately trained cooperative predictor uses observations from the ego vehicle, roadside units, and connected automated vehicles to predict surrounding agents and their future motion. CoSel evaluates the planner's candidate trajectories against these predictions, preserves the planner's choice when it remains safe, and selects the closest safe alternative when shared information reveals additional risk. Each safety intervention is traceable to the shared evidence that triggers it. In closed-loop evaluation, CoSel achieves a driving score of 70.7 on V2Xverse, outperforming the best compared cooperative method by 7.5 points, and the highest average driving score of 85.8 on MDrive. Under missing ego detections, the collision count of CoSel increases only from 17 to 19 in 72 scenarios, compared with 19 to 32 for an existing cooperative end-to-end model.

</details>


### [854] [Personalization of a Commercial Powered Knee Prosthesis Under Clinically Realistic Conditions via Reinforcement Learning: A Feasibility Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30928)
*Xinyi Liu,Atli Örn Sverrisson,David Langlois,Ming Liu,Varun Nalam,He Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该可行性研究验证了约束嵌入策略迭代（PICE）强化学习调参方法，能在临床现实条件下对商用动力膝关节假肢进行个性化控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动力假肢控制需要针对个体用户需求进行个性化，但这一过程仍具挑战性，且临床环境中时间和空间条件有限。

Method: 采用PICE强化学习调参方法；先用一名非残疾参与者在跑步机上的数据离线学习初始策略，再迁移到另外三名非残疾参与者，使其佩戴旁路适配器在5米步道上行走，并进行在线个性化调参。

Result: 所有参与者均在8—18个调参步内达到目标，相当于行走1.7—4.2分钟；膝关节运动学特征误差平均降低64%—90%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，在具有空间和设备限制的临床现实条件下，实施基于强化学习的假肢个性化调参方法是可行的。

Abstract: Personalization of powered prosthesis control to individual user needs remains a significant challenge. To address this challenge, policy iteration with constraint embedded (PICE), a reinforcement learning (RL) tuning approach, has been developed and validated. This feasibility study investigated whether the developed approach can personalize a commercial powered knee prosthesis under clinically realistic conditions. To reduce the time for personalization, tuning was initialized with a policy learned offline from one non-disabled participant walking on a treadmill and was then applied to three other non-disabled participants walking with the knee through a bypass adapter on a 5-meter walkway. All participants reached the goal within 8-18 tuning steps (1.7-4.2 minutes of walking), reducing the knee-kinematic feature error by 64-90% on average. These results support the feasibility of implementing the RL-based tuning approach in clinically realistic conditions with space and equipment constraints.

</details>


### [855] [SayDo: Benchmarking the Safety of Frontier Models from Chat to Closed-Loop Robot Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30957)
*Benjamin Alt*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 SayDo 基准，用于评估前沿视觉语言模型在具身机器人场景中造成伤害的倾向，并发现文本聊天中的安全性无法预测机器人控制中的安全行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿视觉语言模型越来越多地被用作机器人高层控制器，但其安全性几乎只在文本环境中评估，缺乏对具身情境下危害行为的系统评测。

Method: SayDo 包含11个实验室和家庭任务，每个任务将良性指令与场景中的潜在危险配对，并在从聊天问答到模拟机械臂闭环控制的6种具身梯度设置中实现。每个任务还配有良性控制、安全替代变体和脚本化操作员反驳。研究评估了6个开放和闭权重视觉语言模型，共11,480个回合。

Result: 危险动作率从聊天中的14%上升到模拟器中的47%，受影响最大的模型从2%升至80%，这一增长主要由开放权重模型驱动。模型在73%的不安全回合中行动前已识别危险，并且在控制机器人时比聊天中约两倍更常屈服于反驳。最安全的模型在良性控制上也表现出过度谨慎迹象。

Conclusion: 仅在文本中运行的安全评估不能预测同一模型作为机器人控制器时的安全行为，因此需要面向具身情境的安全评测。

Abstract: Frontier vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as high-level robot controllers, yet their safety is evaluated almost entirely in text. We introduce SayDo, a benchmark that assesses the propensity of frontier models to cause harm in embodied contexts. SayDo comprises eleven laboratory and household tasks that pair a benign instruction with a hazard latent in the scene. Tasks are implemented in six settings along an embodiment gradient, from chat questions about an imagined robot to closed-loop control of a simulated robot arm. Benign controls, safe-alternative variants and scripted operator pushback complement each task. Across six open- and closed-weight VLMs and 11,480 episodes, hazardous-action rates rise from 14% in chat to 47% in the simulator, and from 2% to 80% for the most affected model. The increase is largely driven by open-weight models. We find that models flag hazards before acting in 73% of unsafe episodes and give way to pushback about twice as often when controlling robots as in chat. The safest models also show signs of overcaution on benign controls. Safety evaluations run in text therefore do not predict the safety behavior of the same models when used as robot controllers.

</details>


### [856] [RoboUniverse-10K: Toward the Scaling Era of Agentic Robotics via Real-to-Sim Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31002)
*Jinkun Liu,Yingze Wang,Situ Wang,Deyao Hong,Mingju Gao,Wenyi Li,Yizhe Chi,Youjie Zheng,Kaisen Yang,Xiangyang Wang,Bingxiang He,Yuxin Zuo,Boyuan Chen,Yue Chen,Cheng Qian,Tianxing Chen,Huichi Zhou,Huaxiu Yao,Hao Tang,Hao Zhou,Ya-Qin Zhang,Calvin Xiao,Tiga Altman,Huan-ang Gao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 RoboUniverse-10K 大规模可重置、可验证物理环境及零样本基准 RoboUniverse-Verified，并训练 RoboUniverse-35B-A3B 智能体机器人模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agentic Robotics 依赖基础模型作为编码智能体控制机器人，但机器人领域缺乏类似软件工程的大规模可执行环境，现有基准小且偏分布内评测，限制后训练与强化学习。

Method: 通过自动化 Real2Sim 与质量保证流水线，从真实视频构建 10,807 个交互环境，并在隔离的 Harbor harness 中隐藏特权状态和评分逻辑；留出 500 个专家验证任务作为零样本基准；评测 11 个闭源与开源模型；用 GPT-6 Astra 收集约 17K 多轮轨迹、0.79B tokens，对 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 做全参数监督微调。

Result: 前沿模型成功率达 85.8%，开源基线仅 2.6% 至 10.0%，瓶颈包括低级抓取、可变形物体操作和接触后物理控制；RoboUniverse-35B-A3B 在 RoboUniverse-Verified 上零样本成功率从 0.8% 提升至 21.2%，并在 LIBERO-MAX、RoboCasa、RoboTwin 2.0 和真实 Franka 机械臂上实现零样本任务完成。

Conclusion: 论文开源可强化学习的环境与模型，为 Agentic Robotics 的大规模强化学习奠定基础。

Abstract: Agentic Robotics, in which foundation models act as coding agents to control robots through executable programs, has emerged as a compelling paradigm for embodied intelligence. Yet unlike software engineering, where massive executable environments power post-training, robotics remains constrained by small, manual benchmarks and in-distribution evaluation. To bridge this gap, we introduce RoboUniverse-10K, 10,807 interactive, resettable, and verifiable physics environments built from real-world videos via an automated Real2Sim and quality assurance pipeline. Each runs in an isolated, Harbor-compatible harness that hides privileged states and grading logic to mirror real-world sensing. From the same pipeline, we hold out 500 unseen tasks to establish RoboUniverse-Verified, an expert-verified zero-shot benchmark. Evaluating 11 closed- and open-source models reveals a huge gap: frontier models reach 85.8\% success, while open-source baselines lag at 2.6\% to 10.0\%, bottlenecked by low-level grasping, deformable-object manipulation, and post-contact physical control. Finally, we collect about 17K multi-turn trajectories totaling 0.79B tokens with GPT-6 Astra and perform full-parameter supervised fine-tuning on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, yielding RoboUniverse-35B-A3B. Our model achieves substantial zero-shot gains on RoboUniverse-Verified, lifting the success rate from 0.8\% to 21.2\%, while achieving zero-shot task completions across LIBERO-MAX, RoboCasa, RoboTwin 2.0, and a real Franka arm. We open-source the RL-ready environments and model to lay the foundation for large-scale reinforcement learning in Agentic Robotics.

</details>


### [857] [Foresight Forcing: Learning Spatial Foresight for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30963)
*Mishuo Han,Zhixuan Liang,Zhaoyuan Wan,Wendi Chen,Jiarui Chen,Xinkai Wang,Yue Ma,Yu Zhou,Junting Chen,Yao Mu,Jun Lv,Chuan Wen,Cewu Lu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Foresight Forcing（F²）世界动作模型，通过预训练3D特征空间中的空间过渡监督，提升机器人操作策略的几何感知与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有World Action Models虽能预测未来视觉观测，但训练目标通常未显式建模底层3D几何变化，导致空间关系变化信息不足。

Method: 利用冻结的3D基础模型从当前与未来对齐观测中提取patch级特征差异，作为密集几何感知监督；将其蒸馏为空间过渡查询，并结合当前观测、语言指令和本体状态逐步细化，与当前视觉特征共同生成动作；部署时无需未来观测或3D教师模型。

Result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin2.0上表现强劲且更鲁棒，RoboTwin2.0 Full平均成功率95.01%；六个真实机器人操作任务平均任务得分85.8%。

Conclusion: 显式学习3D空间过渡表示可有效增强机器人操作策略的性能和鲁棒性，并在部署阶段避免依赖未来观测与3D教师模型。

Abstract: Robotic manipulation policies can improve action prediction by anticipating how objects move and how their spatial relationships change. World Action Models (WAMs) learn to predict future visual observations, but their training objectives typically leave the underlying 3D geometric transitions implicit. To alleviate this problem, we introduce Foresight Forcing ($\mathcal{F}^{2}$), a WAM that learns a spatial transition representation from changes in a pretrained 3D feature space. During training, a frozen 3D foundation model extracts patch-wise feature differences from aligned current and future observations that provide dense supervision for geometry-aware feature transitions. We distill these targets into spatial transition queries, which are progressively refined from the current observation, language instruction, and proprioceptive state, and use them alongside current visual features to generate actions. At deployment, the policy predicts the queries without future observations or the 3D teacher. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin2.0 demonstrate strong manipulation performance and improved robustness, including 95.01% average success on RoboTwin2.0 Full. On six real-world manipulation tasks, $\mathcal{F}^{2}$ achieves a mean task score of 85.8%.

</details>


### [858] [WorldLeague: Benchmarking Physical Agency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30989)
*Xinyang Zhou,Qi Li,Xinchao Wang*
