# eess.SY [[Back]](#toc)

### [872] [Algebraic Observability for Power System Dynamic State Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28305)
*Akhila Kandivalasa,Marcos Netto*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种直接作用于非线性电力系统微分-代数方程（DAE）的代数可观测性框架，无需Kron降阶即可保持网络代数变量和约束结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动态状态估计的可观测性方法主要针对ODE模型，而电力系统天然由DAE描述；常用DAE转ODE的Kron降阶可能掩盖代数变量和网络约束的作用。

Method: 构建由模型关系及其逐阶导数组成的Jacobian秩检验，用于判定微分变量和代数变量对已知输入与量测的代数依赖性；采用仅对定子关系求导的“简化延拓”，使潜在未定量数量随延拓阶数增加保持固定，从而提升可扩展性；并建立该秩检验与超正则性及局部可观测性之间的关系。

Result: 在单机分散设置、WSCC 9节点3机系统和IEEE 39节点10机系统上验证了代数可观测性；其中39节点测试包含257个潜在未定量，计算耗时约30秒。

Conclusion: 该框架可直接在非线性电力系统DAE上分析可观测性并保留网络结构，具有可扩展性，且与超正则性和局部可观测性存在理论联系。

Abstract: Existing observability methods for dynamic state estimation are developed for ordinary differential equation (ODE) models, whereas power systems are naturally described by differential-algebraic equations (DAEs). Applying these methods generally requires a DAE-to-ODE transformation, usually Kron reduction, which may obscure the role of algebraic variables and network constraints. This paper presents an algebraic observability framework that operates directly on nonlinear power system DAEs and preserves their structure. A Jacobian rank test constructed from the model relations and their successive derivatives certifies the algebraic dependence of differential and algebraic variables on the known inputs and measurements. A reduced prolongation that differentiates only the stator relations keeps the number of latent indeterminates fixed as the prolongation order grows, which makes the test scalable. We establish the relationship between this rank test and hyper-regularity, an alternative framework for algebraic observability, and show that algebraic observability relates to local observability. We demonstrate algebraic observability on a single-machine decentralized setup, the WSCC 9-bus 3-machine system, and the IEEE 39-bus 10-machine system. The 39-bus test, with 257 latent indeterminates, completes in about 30 s.

</details>


### [873] [Integrating a one-dimensional convolutional neural network with nonlinear model predictive control for slug flow modeling and control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28023)
*Asli Karacelik,Christian Holden*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 论文提出一个轻量级数据驱动建模与控制框架，用于管道-立管系统中的严重段塞流；先用改进的低阶机理模型生成数据，再训练1D CNN参数化神经ODE，并嵌入NMPC实现闭环调节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 严重段塞流会降低生产效率并威胁设备完整性，因此需要既准确又易于部署的控制模型。

Method: 改进常用低阶机理模型：在立管顶部饥饿期加入显式零出流边界，并重新表述立管顶部液相体积分数以保证合理边界；用该模型生成输入-输出轨迹，训练一维卷积神经网络参数化具有仿射控制的神经ODE，采用标准化数据上的8步自由滚动目标，并通过微分灵敏度检查确认显式控制通道；将学习模型嵌入带约束和速率平滑的shooting型非线性模型预测控制。

Result: 在Δt=0.1秒的闭环仿真中，控制器约15–18秒将输出驱动到恒定设定值，同时保持输入平滑有界、瞬态无振荡；表明简单1D CNN结合NMPC能够捕捉段塞流特征振荡和流型转换，并以较低计算成本实现有效调节。

Conclusion: 该框架为段塞流缓解提供了一条实用路径；虽然训练离线以保证可重复性，但其架构和辨识流程设计为可扩展到在线学习，从而支持自适应段塞流控制。

Abstract: Severe slugging in pipeline--riser systems degrades production efficiency and threatens equipment integrity, motivating the development of accurate yet deployable control models. This paper presents a lightweight, data-driven modeling and control framework specifically designed for slug flow. First, we revisit a commonly used low-order mechanistic model and introduce two changes that improve physical plausibility and numerical robustness: (i) an explicit zero-outflow boundary during the starvation period at the riser top, and (ii) a reformulated expression for the liquid volume fraction at the riser top that enforces admissible bounds. Synthetic input--output trajectories generated by this model are then used to train a one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D CNN) that parameterizes a neural ODE with an affine-in-control. Training employs an 8-step free-roll objective on standardized data; a differential sensitivity check confirms an explicit control channel. The learned model is embedded in a shooting-based nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) scheme with bounded and rate-smoothed actuation. In closed-loop simulations at Δt = 0.1 second, the controller drives the output to a constant setpoint within approximately 15--18 seconds while maintaining smooth, bounded inputs and non-oscillatory transients. The results indicate that a simple 1D CNN, coupled with NMPC, can capture the characteristic oscillations and regime transitions of slug flow and deliver effective regulation with modest computational cost. Although training is conducted offline to ensure reproducibility, the architecture and identification procedure are designed for extension to online learning, providing a practical path toward adaptive slug-flow mitigation.

</details>


### [874] [Control Barrier Functions in Motion Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28200)
*Stijn Hanegraaf,Giannis Delimpaltadakis,Hoang Chu,W. P. M. H.,Heemels*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 论文提出一类基于控制障碍函数（CBF）的运动控制器，并将其特化为CBF-HIGS，以连续动态获得平滑控制信号，在保持鲁棒性的同时提升扰动抑制并减少高阶谐波激励。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 投影型控制器（PBC）在工业高精度运动系统中性能优异，但其矢量场不连续，可能激发被控对象的高阶动态；受PBC与CBF研究启发，作者希望设计性能不劣于甚至超过PBC且控制信号平滑的控制器。

Method: 将新型CBF控制器设计特化到积分器动态，并与投影积分器HIGS联系，提出CBF-HIGS；采用描述函数分析其频域行为，并结合仿真与实验验证。

Result: 描述函数分析显示CBF-HIGS相比HIGS具有改进的相位特性和更有利的高阶谐波失真权衡；仿真与实验表明其扰动衰减更强、高阶谐波激发更少，且不损害鲁棒性。

Conclusion: CBF-HIGS利用连续矢量场实现平滑控制并提升运动系统性能，论文首次将CBF用于机电运动系统的性能改进。

Abstract: Projection-based controllers (PBCs) have significant engineering success in industrial high-precision motion systems by restricting their input-output behavior to performance-enhancing sector-sets thereby overcoming fundamental limitations of linear control. The projection results in continuous control signals, but their vector fields are discontinuous, potentially causing unwanted excitation of higher-order dynamics in the plant. Inspired by these projected controllers and the recent interest in control barrier functions (CBFs), we propose a new class of CBF-based motion controllers that (i) can mimic and exceed the performance benefits demonstrated by PBCs and (ii) have continuous dynamics thereby resulting in smooth control signals. We specialize our novel CBF-based control design to integrator dynamics, essentially connecting to a projected integrator, called Hybrid Integrator-Gain System (HIGS), thereby introducing CBF-HIGS. We analyze the CBF-HIGS's behavior using a describing function analysis, which reveals improved phase characteristics and a favorable trade-off in higher-order harmonic distortion compared to HIGS. Simulation and experimental results demonstrate that CBF-HIGS enhances disturbance attenuation and reduces the excitation of higher-order harmonics compared to HIGS due to its continuous vector field, without compromising robustness properties. The paper provides the first use of CBFs for performance improvement of mechatronic motion systems.

</details>


### [875] [Loadability Assessment for Large-Load Integration: From Repeated Power Flow Tracing to Historical Trajectory Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28375)
*Yihan Huang,Yang Weng*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该文提出一种利用历史潮流轨迹片段辅助连续潮流计算的方法，用于数据中心等大负荷场景下的电压稳定负载裕度评估，并通过注意力选择、牛顿相容性测试和数值校正实现更快、更稳定的P-V曲线追踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模数据中心负荷使电网运行条件多变，需频繁评估电压稳定负载裕度；传统连续潮流需反复预测和校正，已有用运行点作初值的方法无法捕捉后续电压响应，因此需要复用历史非线性潮流轨迹以降低在线计算量。

Method: 提出历史潮流轨迹有限段迁移的连续方法：将历史段与当前状态和连续方向对齐，补充CPF切向预测的非线性曲线形状；用短牛顿测试判断与当前潮流方程的相容性；用基于注意力的选择器综合测试结果、网络条件、负荷模式和近期连续状态；再通过数值校正和折点细化确定接受解与负载极限，并给出预测误差界及局部校正和分支保持的充分条件。

Result: 在修改的IEEE 14节点和118节点系统、可再生能源出力和数据中心负荷变化场景下，方法减少了在线计算并提高了指定连续解恢复率；负载极限评估中相对Adaptive CPF的配对在线加速比为4.88--21.62倍，相对HEAP为1.53--4.77倍。

Conclusion: 复用历史潮流轨迹片段可有效提升连续潮流在线计算效率和指定解恢复能力，适用于数据中心大负荷与可再生出力变化下的电压稳定负载裕度评估。

Abstract: Integrating large data-center loads requires utilities to evaluate voltage-stability loading margins under different generation and demand conditions. Continuation power flow (CPF) traces P--V curves through successive prediction and correction steps, but related assessments can repeatedly reconstruct similar nonlinear behavior. Reusing an operating point as an initial guess does not capture the subsequent voltage response. This paper proposes a continuation method that transfers finite segments of historical power flow (PF) trajectories. Each segment is aligned with the present state and continuation direction, supplementing the CPF tangent predictor with previously computed nonlinear curve shape. Short Newton tests evaluate compatibility with the present PF equations, and an attention-based selector combines their results with network conditions, loading patterns, and recent continuation states. Numerical correction and fold refinement determine accepted solutions and the loading limit. The analysis bounds prediction error through differences in trajectory curvature and establishes sufficient conditions for local correction and branch preservation. Studies on modified IEEE 14- and 118-bus systems under renewable-generation and data-center load variations demonstrate reduced online computation and higher observed recovery of specified continuation solutions than Adaptive CPF. For loading-limit assessment, paired online speedups are 4.88--21.62$\times$ over Adaptive CPF and 1.53--4.77$\times$ over holomorphic embedding with arc-length parametrization (HEAP) across the tested scenarios.

</details>


### [876] [Scheduling of Variable-Speed Pumped Storage via Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28310)
*SangWoo Park,Kyung-bin Kwon,Dam Kim*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 针对变速抽水蓄能电站在两结算市场中的竞价与调度问题，提出层次化强化学习框架，通过学习可交付的日前承诺与实时策略，在保证可交付性的同时提升收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VSPSH的灵活性受水力学而非额定功率限制，可交付功率范围随净水头变化并排除小出力；两结算市场中日前与实时决策循环依赖，且非凸运行域使仅靠惩罚不可行性难以同时兼顾收益与可交付性。

Method: 构建两层强化学习：实时竞价依赖日前承诺，日前奖励依赖实时策略；采用可行性约束领域随机化，先生成可交付日前调度训练实时层，再冻结实时策略优化日前层并交替迭代；通过动作空间修改保证安全，包括竞价动作掩码、结算前承诺投影和失效安全控制器替换，而非仅依赖奖励惩罚。

Result: 在48个样本外日上，所提方法比等效惩罚公式日均多赚3313美元，同时不可交付承诺中位数为零；惩罚公式无法做到这一点，且没有消融实验能在不牺牲可交付性或储能目标的情况下优于该方法。

Conclusion: 通过动作空间修改而非奖励惩罚来保证可交付性，可在非凸水力学约束下实现盈利且可交付的两结算市场竞价与调度。

Abstract: Variable-speed pumped storage hydropower (VSPSH) plants modulate power continuously in both generation and pumping, a match for the net-load ramps of rising wind and solar. Their flexibility is bounded by hydraulics rather than by a power rating, so the deliverable power range shifts with net head and excludes small outputs entirely. This paper addresses bidding and dispatch for such a plant across a two-settlement market with a hierarchical reinforcement-learning formulation. Its two layers are circularly dependent: a real-time (RT) bid is defined only against a cleared day-ahead (DA) commitment, and the DA reward only against an RT dispatch policy. Our proposed feasibility-constrained domain randomization breaks the cycle by training the RT layer on generated deliverable DA schedules before any bidding policy exists; the DA layer then optimizes against that frozen RT behavior, and the two alternate. Learning a policy at once profitable and deliverable is obstructed by the nonconvex operating region: penalizing infeasibility competes against the revenue the offer earns, discouraging an undeliverable offer without preventing one. We therefore pursue safety through action-space modification rather than through the reward, combining action masking of the bid space, projection of each commitment before settlement, and replacement by a fail-safe controller. Over 48 out-of-sample days it earns $3,313/day more than an equivalent penalty formulation while holding undeliverable commitment at a median of zero, which the penalty formulation does not, and no ablation improves on it without giving up deliverability or the storage target.

</details>


### [877] [Frequency-Domain Identification of Passive Discrete-Time Systems via Sequential Convex Programming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28386)
*Sepehr Moalemi,Jeff Scruggs,Peter Seiler*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究了从频率响应数据辨识被动离散时间线性时不变系统的方法，通过描述符形式线性矩阵不等式施加被动裕度和谱半径约束，并提出保持约束的阻尼高斯-牛顿序列凸规划算法，在数值实验中取得较低拟合误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在系统辨识中，仅拟合频率响应可能无法保证辨识模型满足被动性和谱半径等物理或稳定性要求，因此需要一种在优化过程中始终强制被动裕度与谱半径界的辨识方法。

Method: 采用对系统实现矩阵和存储证书仿射的描述符形式线性矩阵不等式来施加被动裕度和谱半径约束；使用阻尼高斯-牛顿序列凸规划，通过强凸半定子问题联合更新实现矩阵，并用Armijo回溯保证拟合误差下降且每次迭代保持约束；对无结构辨识，通过归一化描述符和证书矩阵并将动态矩阵限制为上Hessenberg形式来减少决策变量而不改变可达传递矩阵。

Result: 在随机被动对象上的数值结果表明，所提方法在完整模型阶数和降阶模型下，与多种强制被动性的方法相比，均获得最低的平均频率响应拟合误差。

Conclusion: 所提方法能够有效辨识满足被动裕度和谱半径约束的离散时间线性时不变系统，并在保持约束的同时实现优于对比方法的频率响应拟合性能。

Abstract: This paper considers identification of passive discrete-time linear time-invariant systems from frequency-response data. A prescribed passivity margin and spectral-radius bound are enforced by a descriptor-form linear matrix inequality that is affine in the system realization matrices and storage certificate. A damped Gauss--Newton sequential convex programming method jointly refines the realization matrices through strongly convex semidefinite subproblems, with Armijo backtracking decreasing the fitting error while preserving both guarantees at every iterate. For unstructured identification, the number of decision variables is reduced without changing the attainable transfer matrices by normalizing the descriptor and certificate matrices and restricting the dynamics matrix to upper Hessenberg form. Numerical results on randomized passive plants show that the proposed method achieves the lowest mean frequency-response fitting error among several passivity-enforcing methods, at both full and reduced model orders.

</details>


### [878] [Real-Time 250-kHz Spectral-Domain Optical Coherence Tomography Using a Jetson AGX Orin](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28423)
*Yash Nakadi,Austin Yetter,Toast Lobel,Jungeun Won*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该研究评估了嵌入式GPU平台NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin能否替代桌面工作站，支撑250 kHz谱域OCT的实时采集、重建、控制与可视化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高性能OCT通常依赖桌面工作站完成数据采集、重建和可视化，限制了紧凑型成像系统的集成与应用。

Method: 开发基于C++/CUDA的OCT引擎并运行于Jetson AGX Orin 64 GB，与2048像素光谱仪、Camera Link采集卡和振镜扫描器集成；在相同扫描协议下与RTX A4500工作站比较B-scan处理延迟、功耗及长时间运行稳定性。

Result: 两平台B-scan平均处理延迟均低于对应采集间隔；工作站重建延迟更低，但Jetson消除了显式主机到设备传输且延迟更稳定。Jetson实测功耗67 W，工作站155 W，墙插能效约高2.3倍；在62.6分钟GUI启用测量中，Jetson处理800,000个B-scan无丢帧并保持实时重建与可视化。

Conclusion: 嵌入式计算可支持高速OCT的采集、处理和控制，同时降低墙插功耗和计算平台尺寸，具备替代桌面工作站的潜力。

Abstract: High-performance optical coherence tomography (OCT) relies on desktop workstations for data acquisition, reconstruction, and visualization, limiting integration into compact imaging systems. We evaluated whether an embedded GPU platform could sustain real-time operation of a 250-kHz spectral-domain OCT instrument without a desktop computer. A custom C++/CUDA OCT engine running on a NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 64 GB was developed and integrated with a 2048-pixel spectrometer, Camera Link frame grabber, and galvanometer scanner, and compared against an RTX A4500 workstation under the same scan protocols. Both systems maintained mean B-scan processing latency well below the corresponding B-scan acquisition intervals. Although the RTX A4500 workstation achieved lower reconstruction latency, Jetson eliminated explicit host-to-device transfer and exhibited more consistent processing latency. Furthermore, the measured active wall power was 67 W for the Jetson and 155 W for the workstation, corresponding to approximately 2.3 times greater wall-energy efficiency for the Jetson. In a separate 62.6-min GUI-enabled measurement, the Jetson processed 800,000 B-scans without frame loss while maintaining real-time reconstruction and visualization. These results demonstrate that embedded computing can support high-speed OCT acquisition, processing, and control while reducing wall-power demand and computing-platform size.

</details>


### [879] [Real-time Priority-aware UAS Arrival Planning Framework for Multi-layer UTM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28459)
*Anisha Mohapatra,Prasanna Ramamurthy,Shridhar Velhal,M. Sethumadhavan,Suresh Sundaram*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向多层UTM终端空域的实时、优先级感知无人机到达规划框架，将终端空域建模为同心环漏斗、离散等待槽、连接边和着陆坪，并通过贪心顺序规划与滚动时域实现动态重规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 密集到达场景下终端资源有限，无人机在整个进近过程中必须保持时空分离；新到达、风扰动和紧急着陆请求还要求超越传统着陆坪排序的快速重规划能力。

Method: 将终端空域表示为同心环、离散等待槽、连接边和着陆坪组成的漏斗结构；采用贪心规划，先确定优先级感知的着陆顺序，再逐架规划无人机的槽位分配、遍历路径、着陆时间及槽位进出时间，并将已规划轨迹视为固定；通过时空约束避免等待槽、连接边和着陆坪冲突；在滚动时域中纳入新到达、响应风扰动并优先处理紧急无人机而不改变已完成操作。

Result: 计算结果表明，该方法可在运行时间限制内生成和更新可行且无冲突的到达计划，并为紧急无人机提供快速着陆通道。

Conclusion: 所提框架适用于动态多层UTM环境中响应式且安全关键的到达管理。

Abstract: This paper proposes a real-time, priority-aware UAS arrival-planning framework for multi-layer UTM terminal airspace represented as a funnel of concentric rings, discrete holding slots, connecting edges, and a landing pad. Managing dense arrivals is challenging because terminal resources are limited and UAS must remain spatially and temporally separated throughout their approaches. New arrivals, wind disturbances, and emergency landing requests further require rapid replanning beyond conventional landing-pad sequencing. To achieve computational tractability, the framework employs a greedy planning method that first establishes a priority-aware landing order and then plans the UAS sequentially. For each UAS, the method determines its slot assignments, traversal path, landing time, and slot entry and exit times while treating previously planned trajectories as fixed. Spatial and temporal constraints prevent conflicts on holding slots, connecting edges, and the landing pad. Within a rolling-horizon implementation, the framework incorporates new arrivals, reactively adjusts plans affected by wind disturbances, and prioritizes emergency UAS without altering completed operations. Computational results show that the method generates and updates feasible, conflict-free arrival plans within operational time limits while providing expedited landing access to emergency UAS. The results demonstrate the suitability of the proposed framework for responsive and safety-critical arrival management in dynamic multi-layer UTM environments. Video link: https://youtu.be/F9IP1dz-9PE

</details>


### [880] [Nonlinear Moments as Equivalence Classes: A Lyapunov-Perron Approach to the Invariance Equation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28528)
*Heein Park,Hyeonyeong Jang,Alessandro Astolfi,Hyungbo Shim,Jin Gyu Lee*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该文针对非线性矩定义中额外假设过多的问题，利用Lyapunov–Perron不动点论证，在条带条件下证明不变方程存在局部C^N解，并将非线性矩推广为函数等价类，进而扩展矩匹配概念。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性矩只要系统与外部系统谱不交即可定义，而非线性矩由不变方程定义，其存在唯一性一般不保证，需要Poisson稳定性和指数稳定性等额外假设，造成线性与非线性矩定义之间的不对称。

Method: 采用Lyapunov–Perron不动点论证；引入条带条件；分析C^1解的k^-阶接触和k=∞时的平坦等价；以多项式或形式幂级数ansatz作为等价类的代表元；并用数值例子说明。

Result: 在条带条件下存在局部C^N解，N由系统和外系统决定；任意C^1解具有由谱比k决定的k^-阶接触，k=∞时平坦等价；非线性矩被定义为等价类而非单一函数；当系统指数稳定时，矩描述所有轨迹共享的输出至k^-阶；矩匹配也自然扩展。

Conclusion: 该文将非线性矩从单一函数推广为等价类，减弱了定义所需假设，并在稳态解释不可用时给出时域解释；ansatz在扩展的非线性矩和矩匹配中起关键作用。

Abstract: The linear moment is well defined whenever the system and the exosystem have disjoint spectra. Its nonlinear counterpart is not: the existence and uniqueness of solutions to the invariance equation that defines it are in general not guaranteed, so additional assumptions such as Poisson stability of the exosystem and the exponential stability of the system are required to define the nonlinear moment. This paper reduces this asymmetry. By using the Lyapunov--Perron fixed-point argument, we show that under a condition called the strip condition, there exist local $\mathcal C^N$ solutions, with $N$ determined by the system and the exosystem, and every pair of $\mathcal C^1$ solutions has contact of order $k^-$, where $k$ is a spectral ratio determined by the system and the exosystem; the solutions are flat-equivalent when $k=\infty$. Based on this observation, we extend the concept of nonlinear moment as an equivalence class of functions rather than a function. The polynomial of degree $N$ or formal power series ansatz of the invariance equation are the distinguished representatives of the equivalence class. We also show that, when the system is exponentially stable, the moment describes the output shared by all trajectories up to the order $k^-$, which gives the moment a time-domain interpretation when the steady-state interpretation is not available. Finally, we show that the concept of moment matching also naturally extends as the definition of nonlinear moment is extended to an equivalence class. The ansatz also plays a crucial role in the extended notion of moment matching. The results are illustrated by a numerical example.

</details>


### [881] [Extended Deterministic Learning under Local Finite-Time Excitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28540)
*Chengzhi Yuan,Mingxi Zhou,Yuewei Fu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该论文提出扩展确定性学习（EDL），用于不确定非线性系统的调节控制，在不需要持续激励或循环轨迹的情况下实现局部准确学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典确定性学习（CDL）依赖周期性或重复性闭环轨迹来满足RBF神经元的局部持续激励（PE）条件，但系统调节时状态趋于常值工作点，持续激励消失，导致CDL难以继续有效学习。

Method: EDL保留CDL的局部学习机制，将自适应RBF控制器与滤波有限时间数据存储相结合，在局部有限时间激励（local FTE）条件下进行学习，而不要求持续激励或重复轨迹。

Result: 在局部FTE条件下，该方案保证所有闭环信号一致最终有界，调节状态指数收敛到期望工作点的小邻域，局部活跃RBF神经权重指数收敛到其理想值的小邻域，从而在经历区域内局部准确学习未知非线性动态。

Conclusion: EDL能够在有限学习区间后无需持续激励即可实现局部准确学习，数值例子表明其相较于CDL在局部学习性能上有改进。

Abstract: This paper develops an extension of classical deterministic learning (CDL) for the regulation of uncertain nonlinear systems, referred to as Extended Deterministic Learning (EDL). CDL relies on periodic or recurrent closed-loop trajectories to ensure that the locally active radial-basis-function (RBF) neurons satisfy a partial persistence-of-excitation (PE) condition. During regulation, however, the state approaches a constant operating point and continued excitation disappears. EDL preserves the local-learning mechanism of CDL while enabling locally accurate learning under a local finite-time excitation (local FTE) condition, which requires neither persistent excitation nor recurrent system trajectories. Specifically, an adaptive RBF controller is combined with filtered finite-time data storage. Under local FTE, the resulting scheme guarantees that all closed-loop signals are uniformly ultimately bounded, the regulation state converges exponentially to a small neighborhood of the desired operating point, and the neural weights associated with the locally active RBFs converge exponentially to small neighborhoods of their ideal values. Consequently, the unknown nonlinear dynamics are learned locally and accurately over the experienced region without requiring persistent excitation after the finite learning interval. A numerical example illustrates the improvement in local learning achieved by EDL over CDL.

</details>


### [882] [Control of Underactuated Surface Vessels---Part I: Stabilization in Polar Coordinates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28620)
*Kristin Y. Pettersen,Miroslav Krstic*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 论文研究无侧向驱动水面船舶的固定位姿镇定问题，通过引入零侧滑点将船舶运动约化为独轮车模型，并利用时不变极坐标转向律实现全局渐近稳定控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅以纵向力和偏航力矩为输入、无侧向驱动的水面船舶无法用连续时不变反馈镇定到固定位姿；已有时间变化方法轨迹振荡，不利于靠泊等实际应用。

Method: 定义零侧滑点并证明其按独轮车运动，从而直接应用Todorovski等人的GloBa和BoLSA极坐标转向律；构造严格控制Lyapunov函数，先对四状态模型证明全局渐近稳定，再通过一步反步法扩展到六状态全模型；分析还覆盖前后非对称的侧向-偏航阻尼。

Result: 所设计的时不变控制器在四状态和六状态模型下均实现全局渐近稳定，并可处理此前被对角阻尼假设排除的非对称阻尼船体；控制器产生平滑、非振荡轨迹，并在Cybership I船体模型仿真中验证。

Conclusion: 零侧滑点约化使欠驱动水面船舶能够使用时不变极坐标转向律获得全局渐近稳定，较时间变化设计更适合对接/靠泊等需要平滑轨迹的场景。

Abstract: A surface vessel with surge force and yaw moment as inputs and no sway actuation cannot be stabilized at a fixed pose by continuous time-invariant feedback. We introduce a zero-sideslip point, a point whose position relative to the hull depends on the surge and sway speeds and whose velocity points along the vessel's heading at every instant, and show that it moves as a unicycle. This reduction allows the time-invariant, polar-coordinate steering laws of Todorovski et al. (2025) to be applied to the underactuated vessel without modification. With two steering laws, GloBa and BoLSA, we construct strict control Lyapunov functions and prove global asymptotic stability, first for a four-state model with surge speed and yaw rate as virtual inputs, and then, by one step of backstepping, for the full six-state model with surge force and yaw moment. The analysis extends to hulls with fore-aft asymmetric sway-yaw damping, excluded in prior work by the assumption of diagonal damping. Unlike prior time-varying designs, the time-invariant controller yields smooth, non-oscillatory trajectories, an important practical advantage for docking. The designs are validated in simulation on the Cybership I hull model.

</details>


### [883] [PAC Infinite-Time Safety Guarantees for Stochastic Systems with Unknown Probabilistic Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28676)
*Taoran Wu,C. -H. Luke Ong,Bai Xue*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究离散时间随机系统在未知扰动分布下的无限时间安全性认证，提出仅使用有限个独立同分布扰动样本的PAC数据驱动框架，并给出以至少1-δ置信度保证未来所有时刻以至少1-ε概率保持在安全集内的认证结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无限时间安全性认证通常依赖已知扰动分布或难以处理的模型假设，而实际系统中扰动分布往往未知，仅知道其在一个紧集上具有全支撑。因此需要一种仅依赖有限样本、具有概率保证的数据驱动认证方法。

Method: 首先证明一个基本刻画：在紧安全集内存在鲁棒不变集，当且仅当存在某个初始状态使系统以正概率无限期留在安全集内。由此将无限时间安全认证分解为两个可处理子问题：鲁棒不变集计算和有限时域reach-avoid认证。随后先计算安全集内的鲁棒不变集，再利用独立同分布扰动样本，以PAC保证认证一个初始状态子集，使其在有限时域内安全到达该不变集且概率至少达到给定阈值。最后用半定规划示例说明方法。

Result: 提出了据称首个针对未知扰动分布下无限时间安全性的PAC框架。该框架仅使用有限个独立同分布样本，并以至少1-δ的置信度保证：若认证程序接受候选证书，则从证书所定义的安全集非空子集中的任意初始状态出发，系统未来所有时刻均以至少1-ε的概率保持在安全集内。

Conclusion: 无限时间安全认证可通过鲁棒不变集计算与有限时域reach-avoid PAC认证相结合来实现；所提数据驱动框架能够在未知扰动分布下提供概率安全保证，并通过半定规划示例验证了方法的可行性。

Abstract: This paper studies infinite-time safety certification for discrete-time stochastic systems with continuous dynamics and unknown disturbance distributions that have full support on a known compact disturbance set. We develop a probably approximately correct (PAC) data-driven framework that uses only finitely many i.i.d. disturbance samples: with confidence at least $1-δ$, if the certification procedure accepts a candidate certificate defining a nonempty subset of a prescribed compact safe set, then the system, starting from any state in this subset, remains within the safe set for all future times with probability at least $1-ε$. Our approach builds on a fundamental characterization of infinite-time safety. We first prove that a robust invariant set exists within a compact safe set if and only if there exists an initial state from which the system remains in the safe set indefinitely with positive probability. This reduces infinite-time safety certification to two tractable subproblems: robust invariant-set computation and finite-horizon reach-avoid certification. We first compute a robust invariant set within the safe set, then use i.i.d. disturbance samples to certify, with PAC guarantees, a subset of initial states for which the probability of reaching this set within a finite horizon while remaining safe is at least a prescribed threshold. To our knowledge, this is the first PAC framework for infinite-time safety under unknown disturbance distributions. Finally, illustrative examples demonstrate the method using semi-definite programming.

</details>


### [884] [Advanced Reactance Method - A Novel Approach for Distance Protection in Presence of Grid-Following Inverter-Based-Resources](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28829)
*Jonathan Loebel,Jannik Polster,Johann Jaeger*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 论文针对GFL逆变型资源接入后距离保护性能受影响的问题，提出Advanced Reactance Method，并给出传统电抗法的正确整定方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可再生能源和逆变型资源（IBR）大量接入，GFL IBR的故障行为尤其FRT特性不同于同步发电机，导致按同步机故障特性设计的常规距离保护可能性能下降。

Method: 提出Advanced Reactance Method，作为Classical Reactance Method的改进；利用负序电压和负序电流，使算法不依赖电源侧阻抗，从而不受GFL IBR的FRT行为影响，包括不对称故障时负序电流被抑制的情况；同时给出传统方法在GFL IBR场景下的正确整定。

Result: 摘要说明新算法与正确整定的Classical Reactance Method及Distance Protection算法进行了对比评估，但未给出具体定量结果。

Conclusion: 所提方法旨在使距离保护独立于GFL IBR的FRT行为，并为不具备高级方法的继电器提供传统方法的整定解决思路；具体性能需见论文完整评估。

Abstract: Renewable Energy Sources and consequently inverter-based resources (IBRs) are increasing worldwide.
  Grid-following (GFL) IBR control is the state-of-the-art.
  GFL IBRs exhibit different fault behavior compared to classical synchronous generators -- particularly in terms of Fault-Ride-Through (FRT) characteristics, which are critical for grid protection relaying.
  Grid protection must work securely, selectively and dependably, regardless of the feeding source.
  As common protection algorithms are designed for fault behavior determined by synchronous generators, their performance is expected to be compromised in the presence of GFL IBRs.
  Distance Protection is a widely used protection algorithm at all voltage levels.
  Literature shows that the FRT behavior of GFL IBRs impacts the Distance Protection relaying adversely.
  This paper proposes the Advanced Reactance Method, a further development of the Classical Reactance Method for Distance Protection in the presence of GFL IBRs.
  The key idea of the proposed method is to make the algorithm independent of the feeding source impedance.
  Therefore, the negative sequence voltage is taken into account along with the negative sequence current.
  This makes the algorithm independent of the FRT behavior of GFL IBRs, even in case of suppression of negative sequence current during unsymmetrical faults.
  Moreover, correct settings for the classical method in the presence of GFL IBRs are presented as a solution for relays without the advanced method.
  The novel algorithm is evaluated against the correctly parameterized Classical Reactance Method and the Distance Protection algorithm.

</details>


### [885] [Separating physics from discrepancy: Orthogonalized kernels for physics-encoded system identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28889)
*Cesare Donati,Carlo Novara,Fabrizio Dabbene,Martina Mammarella*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该论文研究物理模型与数据驱动修正相结合的辨识问题，指出核方法中物理参数缺乏明确目标，并提出通过正交化核与规范物理参数来消除这种分配歧义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在物理编码辨识中，输入输出映射可在物理模型与数据修正之间任意分配；核基模型嵌入下该分配由核决定，导致物理参数没有良定义的目标，因此需要事先消除歧义。

Method: 将规范物理参数定义为在用户给定操作域上、以加权最小二乘意义最接近无噪声映射的物理模型参数，并引入与物理模型正交的差异项；推导正交化核，使修正仅限于与物理模型正交的函数，同时保留模型嵌入的闭式解；并采用正则化处理能量有界噪声。

Result: 规范参数仅取决于预设几何，不依赖核或数据；当输入密集且噪声消失时，与数据一致的参数集合收敛到规范参数，而未正交化时通常不成立；在能量有界噪声下，适当正则化可获得最优最坏情况估计精度；数值实验显示不同核和实验下参数估计一致。

Conclusion: 正交化核与规范物理参数的定义能够先验地解决物理模型与数据修正之间的分配歧义，在保持闭式求解的同时提升参数可辨识性和估计一致性。

Abstract: Physics-encoded identification combines a physical model with a data-driven correction, but the data alone do not determine how the input-output map is split between them: components representable by the physical model may be assigned to either part. In kernel-based model embedding, this allocation is governed by the kernel. As a consequence, the physical parameters lack a well-defined target. In this work, this ambiguity is resolved a priori by defining a canonical physical parameter as the parameter of the physical model that best approximates the noise-free map, in a weighted least-squares sense, over a user-defined operating domain, together with an orthogonal discrepancy. Specifically, an orthogonalized kernel is derived that restricts the correction to functions orthogonal to the physical model. The resulting estimator keeps the closed-form solution of model embedding, while the canonical parameter depends only on the prescribed geometry, not on the kernel or the data. As the inputs become dense and the noise vanishes, the set of parameters consistent with the data converges to the canonical parameter, a property that generally fails without orthogonalization. Under energy-bounded noise, suitable regularization attains optimal worst-case estimation accuracy. Numerical examples demonstrate consistent parameter estimates across different kernels and experiments.

</details>


### [886] [Suppressing Chaos Without Silencing Excitable Oscillators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29022)
*Zixuan Fu,Unnikrishna Pillai*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 研究指出，控制可兴奋振荡器时仅追求负Lyapunov指数并不充分，因为增益可能通过抑制兴奋/放电来消除混沌；论文在三个模型中比较多种控制策略并分析其失败模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 负Lyapunov指数常被视为混沌控制目标，但在可兴奋系统中，增益可能在消除混沌的同时消除模型本应保留的激发与放电，因此需要研究这种失败模式。

Method: 用最大状态Lyapunov指数衡量混沌，用阈值穿越、快变量偏移和放电率衡量兴奋；在受迫FitzHugh-Nagumo神经元、受迫Aliev-Panfilov心肌细胞和自主Hindmarsh-Rose神经元中，比较恢复阻尼、不稳定周期轨道跟踪、Pyragas延迟反馈和快时间尺度改变；并用矩阵测度界与常度量收缩证书分析增益作用通道。

Result: 在受迫模型中，大阻尼和大速率改变通过使细胞沉默达到规律，而跟踪和延迟反馈能保持放电；在自主模型中，恢复阻尼反而使放电率提高数倍。矩阵测度界将结果联系到增益作用通道；常度量收缩证书仅在跟踪策略下与显著放电共存，该策略从快方向减去增益。

Conclusion: 负Lyapunov指数不足以保证有效控制，控制必须同时保留兴奋性；增益作用通道决定是否导致沉默，跟踪策略可在收缩证书下维持放电。

Abstract: A negative Lyapunov exponent is not a sufficient goal for controlling an excitable oscillator. A gain can remove chaos by removing the excitation that the model is meant to keep. This manuscript studies that failure mode in three models: the forced FitzHugh--Nagumo neuron, the forced Aliev--Panfilov cardiac cell, and the autonomous Hindmarsh--Rose neuron. Chaos is measured by the largest state Lyapunov exponent. Excitation is measured by threshold crossings, by the excursion of the fast variable, and by the firing rate. Recovery damping, tracking of an unstable periodic orbit, Pyragas delayed feedback, and a change of the fast time scale are compared on the same chaotic regimes. In the forced models, large damping and large rate changes reach regularity by silencing the cell, while tracking and delayed feedback keep firing. In the autonomous model, recovery damping raises the firing rate several-fold instead. A classical matrix-measure bound links these outcomes to the channel through which the gain acts. A constant-metric contraction certificate coexists with substantial firing only under tracking, which subtracts a gain from the fast direction.

</details>


### [887] [Deliverable Frequency Regulation Reserve for VPPs via Transmission-Distribution Co-Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29081)
*Ahmad Ali,Zhuorong Wang,Youssef Abdelmoneim,Hantao Cui*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出一种面向虚拟电厂的双向、感知储能的功率共享框架，用于更准确地提供频率调节服务并跟踪输配界面功率请求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 设备级功率余量不能准确代表输配界面实际可交付的功率，可能导致频率调节服务过交付或跟踪偏差。

Method: 利用构建电压灵敏度矩阵时的扰动获得交付因子，以计入馈线损耗和电压相关负荷；在功率分配中纳入电池能量限制和荷电状态权重；采用IEEE 8500节点馈线和IEEE 14节点系统进行评估。

Result: 所提方法将馈线首端请求跟踪误差控制在2%以内，而注入余量框架过交付23%至26%；在达到储能能量限制前，可多维持22%的请求功率响应时间；向输电系统运营商更新VPP备用后，暂态后区域控制误差积分面积相对固定备用注册减少80%。

Conclusion: 该框架能提高VPP频率调节功率交付的准确性、持续性和系统频率调节效果，优于传统注入余量和固定备用注册方法。

Abstract: Aggregations of distributed energy resources can provide frequency regulation services. However, device-level power headroom may not accurately represent the power deliverable at the transmission-distribution interface. This paper proposes a bidirectional, storage-aware power-sharing framework for a virtual power plant (VPP). Delivery factors obtained from the perturbations used to construct the voltage-sensitivity matrix account for feeder losses and voltage-dependent loads, while battery energy limits and state-of-charge weights are included in the allocation. The framework is evaluated using the IEEE 8500-node feeder and IEEE 14-bus system. The proposed method tracks the feeder-head request within 2% compared with 23-26% over-delivery under the injection-headroom framework. It also sustains the requested power response 22% longer before reaching the storage energy limit. Moreover, communicating the updated VPP reserve to the transmission system operator reduces the post-transient integrated area control error by 80% relative to fixed reserve registration.

</details>


### [888] [Neural Costate Guidance for Autonomous Cislunar Low-Thrust Trajectory Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29100)
*Jannik Graebner,Ryne Beeson*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该论文面向地月空间自主低推力轨迹重规划，利用数据增强与训练技术让神经网络预测间接法的初始协态，从而快速生成恢复轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未来任务需要星上自主低推力轨迹生成，以应对导航误差和推力器故障造成的飞行路径偏差；但星上计算资源难以冷启动求解长时域非凸最优控制问题，尤其在月球转移走廊等动力学复杂区域。

Method: 将backward generation of optimal examples方法扩展到圆型限制性三体问题以生成训练数据；提出锚定轨迹方法覆盖相关状态空间；采用协态重缩放和Hamiltonian损失项改进学习；通过神经网络多次查询预测初始协态，并在高效制导算法中构建恢复轨迹。

Result: 在地球高轨到L1、L2晕轨道的Earth-Moon转移中，面对导航误差和推力器故障，所提方法比标称轨迹跟踪或完全数值重优化更常到达目标轨道；星上计算量相比重优化降低超过一个数量级。

Conclusion: 结合神经网络协态预测与间接法的高效制导，可在有限星上计算资源下实现自主低推力轨迹恢复，提升复杂地月转移场景中的鲁棒性和计算效率。

Abstract: Future missions will benefit from onboard autonomous low-thrust trajectory generation to correct deviations from the nominal flight path caused by navigation errors and thruster outages. Onboard computing resources rarely allow the solution of a cold-started, long-duration nonconvex optimal control problem, especially in dynamically challenging regions such as the cislunar to translunar corridor of the Earth-Moon system. This paper develops data augmentation and training techniques that enable a neural network to predict accurate initial costates of the indirect method. A recovery trajectory is then built from repeated network queries in a computationally efficient guidance algorithm. Training data are produced by the backward generation of optimal examples method, extending prior approaches to the circular restricted three-body problem. A novel anchor trajectory approach is developed to cover the relevant state space, and costate rescaling and a Hamiltonian loss term are used to improve learning. The method is demonstrated on Earth-Moon transfers from a high Earth orbit to halo orbits about L1 and L2. Under navigation errors and thruster outages, a spacecraft reaches the target orbit more often with the proposed method than with nominal-trajectory tracking or fully numerical reoptimization. Onboard computation is reduced by more than an order of magnitude compared with reoptimization.

</details>


### [889] [Effect of Transmission Line Switching on Damping of Interarea Modes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29106)
*Vaithianathan Mani Venkatasubramanian,KC Menuka,Ran Xu,Ulyana Elliott,Gary Kobet*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究切换输电线路对区间振荡模式阻尼的影响，并结合经典测试系统与西部互联电网实际模型进行分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该现象在2025年伊比利亚大停电及北美部分振荡事件中起关键作用，因此需要评估线路切换对区间振荡阻尼的有效性和影响。

Method: 先在经典测试电力系统中研究线路切换对模式阻尼的作用，再在反映近期实时运行条件的西部互联大尺度模型中进行验证。

Result: 关键输电线路的切换会显著影响区间振荡模式的阻尼，且影响程度取决于系统运行条件。

Conclusion: 线路切换对区间振荡阻尼具有重要影响，实际应用中需结合系统运行条件进行评估。

Abstract: This paper will explore the impact of switching transmission lines on the damping of interarea oscillation modes. This phenomenon played a central role in the 2025 Iberian blackout and in some North American oscillation events. The paper first assesses the effectiveness of line switching for enhancing mode damping by studying the problem in classical test power systems. The paper then tests these observations in realistic large-scale models of the Western Interconnection that represent recent real-time system conditions. It is shown that the switching of key transmission lines can have a significant impact on the damping of inter-area modes depending on system operating conditions.

</details>


### [890] [Scaled Relative Graph Separation for Unbounded Nonlinear Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29657)
*Chao Chen,Sei Zhen Khong,Rodolphe Sepulchre*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文基于缩放相对图（SRG）研究单通道非线性反馈系统的稳定性分析，提出一种基于同伦的 SRG 分离定理，用于处理可能无界的开环非线性系统，并将常用积分器纳入该框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 SRG 反馈稳定性分析需要处理复平面中的 SRG 分离问题，但可能涉及无界开环非线性系统，尤其是积分器等常见无界系统难以直接纳入框架，因此需要发展适用于无界系统的稳定性分析工具。

Method: 采用缩放相对图（SRG）刻画系统，在复平面中分析反馈稳定性；在技术假设下建立基于同伦的 SRG 分离定理，并使用增量有向间隙作为沿同伦路径量化鲁棒反馈稳定性的关键工具；还将主要结果特化到线性系统并给出示例。

Result: 建立了基于同伦的 SRG 分离定理，使常用积分器可作为无界系统纳入 SRG 框架；给出了线性系统情形下的特化结果和说明性例子，验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 基于 SRG 的同伦分离方法能够有效分析含无界开环非线性系统的反馈稳定性，并扩展了 SRG 框架对积分器等常见无界系统的适用性。

Abstract: We investigate stability analysis of one-channel nonlinear feedback systems based on the recent notion of scaled relative graph (SRG). Our focus is on the SRG separation in the complex plane for feedback stability analysis that involves possibly unbounded open-loop nonlinear systems. Subject to a technical assumption, a homotopy-based SRG separation theorem is developed as the main result, where the incremental directed gap is utilized as a key instrument to quantify robust feedback stability along the homotopy path. Doing so enables us to incorporate commonly used integrators as unbounded systems in the SRG-based framework. Specializations of the main result to linear systems, along with illustrative examples, are also provided to demonstrate its effectiveness.

</details>


### [891] [Voltage Ride-Through-Constrained Power Capping for Large-Scale Data Centers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29906)
*Jie Zhu,Ye Tian,Yinliang*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 处理失败


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 处理失败

Method: 处理失败

Result: 处理失败

Conclusion: 处理失败

Abstract: Large-scale data centers may satisfy steady-state network constraints while violating operational limits during voltage disturbances. This paper proposes a voltage ride-through (VRT)-aware power-capping framework that integrates AC optimal power flow scheduling with dynamic ride-through assessment. The proposed dynamic model captures converter limits, DC-link energy dynamics, battery support, and IT-bus voltage response. A simulation-based checker evaluates VRT constraints under prescribed faults, and the power caps are iteratively updated to obtain feasible schedules. Case studies on the IEEE 14-bus system with two data centers demonstrate that steady-state feasible operating points may violate transient voltage and power-import limits. Selective power capping achieves approximately 5\% demand reduction during capped periods while satisfying the prescribed VRT requirements. The results highlight the necessity of incorporating dynamic security assessment into data-center operational limit determination.

</details>


### [892] [Predictive Safety Filter for Multi-Modal Learned Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30239)
*Myeonggeun Jun,Eunhyek Joa*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向多模态学习策略的预测安全滤波器，用高斯混合模型表示多模态输出，并通过KL散度最小化构造可实时求解的非线性规划，在满足非线性系统约束的同时保持轨迹处于高似然区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习策略常输出多模态动作或轨迹，直接施加安全约束可能破坏其多模态特性并造成性能下降，因此需要一种既能保证安全又尽量保留高似然行为的预测安全过滤方法。

Method: 将多模态输出建模为高斯混合模型，构造滤波器输出与该GMM之间的KL散度最小化问题，并加入非线性系统的状态与输入约束；将滤波器输出建模为协方差趋于零的高斯，使目标在零方差极限下转化为log-sum-exp代价，从而每个时间步只需一次求解可处理的非线性规划。

Result: 在自动泊车场景中与两种基线比较：仅过滤最大似然模态的方法，以及过滤所有候选模态并按有限时域折扣回报选择最佳结果的方法。所提方法取得更高的总体到达目标成功率，且每步仅需一次NLP求解，在全混合比较中墙钟时间低于Parallel SF。

Conclusion: 该方法能够在多模态学习策略下有效实施安全过滤，性能退化可由最坏情况KL散度界定，并在保证单步计算效率的同时优于对比基线。

Abstract: This paper presents a predictive safety filter (PSF) for learned policies with multi-modal outputs. We represent the multi-modal output as a Gaussian mixture model (GMM) and seek a trajectory that remains in a high-likelihood region while satisfying state and input constraints for nonlinear systems. The resulting problem is formulated as a Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence minimization between the filter output and the GMM. By modeling the filter output as a Gaussian with vanishing covariance, this objective reduces in the zero-variance limit to a log-sum-exp cost, yielding a tractable nonlinear program (NLP) solved once per time step. We show that the performance degradation due to safety enforcement is bounded by a function of the worst-case KL divergence. The proposed method is validated in autonomous parking scenarios and compared with two predictive safety filter baselines: one that filters only the maximum-likelihood mode and one that filters all candidate modes and selects the best filtered one according to the finite-horizon discounted return. The proposed method achieves higher aggregate goal-reaching success than both baselines while requiring only a single NLP per step and achieving lower wall-clock time than Parallel SF in the full-mixture comparison.

</details>


### [893] [Optimization of a Solar-Grid Water Supply System with Hydraulic Energy Storage: A Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30019)
*Mariamawit Gashahun Arega,Jesse Thornburg*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该论文研究埃塞俄比亚Afar干旱地区太阳能-电网混合供水系统，以高位水库作为“水力电池”替代昂贵电池储能，并通过技术模拟与经济优化验证其可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电网级电池成本高，发展中及低收入地区需要更经济可行的储能方案；在这些地区，利用高位水体储能往往比电池更具经济性。

Method: 采用双框架建模方法：用Python进行高分辨率技术模拟，用Xendee进行经济优化；系统以1900立方米高位水库作为“水力电池”替代传统电化学储能。

Result: 系统太阳能占比达到55.1%，内部收益率（IRR）为10%；高位水力储能显著降低了资本支出，并表现出财务可行性和供水可靠性。

Conclusion: 带水力储能的太阳能-电网混合系统可为能源受限地区提供经济可行且可靠的供水解决方案，是替代电池储能的可行路径。

Abstract: Given the high cost of grid-scale batteries, other energy storage approaches are needed for developing and low-income regions. Elevated volumes of water are often more economically feasible energy storage options than batteries in these contexts. This paper presents a dual-framework modeling approach for one such energy storage setup: a solar-grid hybrid water supply system in the arid Afar region of Ethiopia. By utilizing an elevated 1,900 m3 water reservoir as a "hydraulic battery," the system replaces traditional electrochemical storage, significantly reducing capital expenditures. Using Python for high-resolution technical simulation and Xendee for economic optimization, the study shows a 55.1% solar fraction and a 10% Internal Rate of Return (IRR). The results confirm that hybrid systems with hydraulic storage offer a financially viable and reliable solution for water access in energy-constrained regions.

</details>


### [894] [Autonomous UAV Navigation in an Unknown Environment via Multi-Trajectory Model Predictive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30463)
*Danilo Saccani,Lorenzo Fagiano*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种多轨迹模型预测控制（mt-MPC）方法，用于未知环境中无人机自主导航，并通过仿真验证其相比标准MPC有更好性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机在未知环境中仅依靠LiDAR获得局部障碍信息，约束随时间变化，需要在避障安全性与到达目标之间进行权衡。

Method: 采用分层控制架构：底层稳定并跟踪设定点，高层mt-MPC在有限时域最优控制问题中考虑多条未来状态轨迹，实现约束满足与代价最小化的部分解耦。

Result: 在时间不变环境假设下可保证递归可行性和持续避障；仿真结果表明该方法相较标准MPC有明显改进。

Conclusion: mt-MPC能够有效处理未知环境下的无人机导航问题，在安全避障与目标吸引之间取得更好平衡。

Abstract: A novel model predictive control (MPC) formulation, named multi-trajectory MPC (mt-MPC), is presented and applied to the problem of autonomous navigation of an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) in an unknown environment. The UAV is equipped with a LiDAR sensor, providing only a partial description of the surroundings and resulting in time-varying constraints as the vehicle navigates among the obstacles. The control system layout is hierarchical: the low-level loops stabilize the vehicle's trajectories and track the set-points commanded by the high-level, mt-MPC controller. The latter is required to plan the UAV trajectory trading off safety, i.e. to avoid collisions with the uncertain obstacles, and exploitation, i.e. to reach an assigned target location. To achieve this goal, mt-MPC considers different future state trajectories in the same Finite Horizon Optimal Control Problem (FHOCP), enabling a partial decoupling between constraint satisfaction (safety) and cost function minimization (exploitation). Recursive feasibility and, consequently, persistent obstacle avoidance guarantees are derived under the assumption of a time invariant environment. The performance of the approach is studied in simulation and compared with that of a standard MPC, showing good improvement.

</details>


### [895] [Passivity-Based Decentralized Stability Criterion and Active-Damping Design for DC Microgrids](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30503)
*Zelin Sun,Shanshan Jiang,Xiaoyu Peng,Xiuqiang He,Hua Geng*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于输出反馈无源性（OFP）的直流微电网分散式小信号稳定性判据，并设计OFP导向的有源阻尼策略，用于同时存在固定控制器和可调控制器设备的场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 变换器接口设备间的交互可能使直流微电网失稳；实际中详细设备模型常无法向系统运营商公开，难以集中式稳定性分析，且只能重新设计部分设备控制器。

Method: 将固定控制器设备的认证OFP指标纳入等效网络，为每个可调控制器设备给出可本地验证的OFP要求；通过全阶分析揭示有限电流环带宽对下垂控制变换器OFP指标的上界约束；提出基于输出电容电流反馈的OFP-AD策略，在保持级联PI控制和下垂特性的同时改善OFP指标。

Result: 所提判据可量化可调设备的本地OFP要求；全阶分析表明有限电流环带宽会限制下垂控制变换器的OFP指标，即使PI增益任意，指标仍可能为负，而约简阶分析可能给出正预测；OFP-AD可提升OFP指标；39节点直流微电网算例验证了判据和策略的有效性。

Conclusion: 在设备模型不完全公开且仅部分控制器可调的条件下，基于OFP的分散式稳定性判据和主动阻尼策略能够有效分析和提升直流微电网小信号稳定性。

Abstract: Interactions among converter-interfaced devices can destabilize DC microgrids (DCMGs). In practice, detailed device models often cannot be disclosed to the system operator for centralized stability analysis, and only some device controllers can be redesigned. This paper develops an output-feedback passivity (OFP)-based decentralized small-signal stability criterion for DCMGs with both fixed-controller and tunable-controller devices. By incorporating the certified OFP indices of fixed-controller devices into an equivalent network, the criterion quantifies a locally verifiable OFP requirement for each tunable-controller device. Full-order analysis further reveals that the finite current-loop bandwidth imposes upper bounds on the OFP indices of droop-controlled converters, which can remain negative for any PI gains despite positive predictions based on reduced-order analysis. Guided by the criterion and these bounds, an OFP-oriented active damping (OFP-AD) strategy is proposed for these converters. The proposed strategy improves the OFP index toward the required value while preserving the cascaded PI control and droop characteristics, using output-capacitor-current feedback. Case studies on a 39-node DCMG validate the proposed criterion and OFP-AD.

</details>


### [896] [Identax: A Toolbox for Efficient Learning of Linear, Parameter-Varying, and Nonlinear Systems in JAX](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30518)
*Roel Drenth,Maarten Schoukens,Roland Tóth*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文介绍了 Identax，一个基于 JAX 的系统辨识工具箱，用于识别线性、LPV 和非线性系统，并在 Silverbox 基准和控制力矩陀螺仪上验证了性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据驱动动力学建模方法通常计算成本高、可解释性差或可扩展性不足，因此需要一个模块化、可扩展且透明的系统辨识研究基础工具。

Method: 提出 Identax 工具箱，采用模块化设计，使模型结构、辨识准则和优化方法可独立扩展；首版支持状态空间和线性分式表示（LFR）模型、用于并行训练的多重打靶准则以及透明优化流程。

Result: 在 Silverbox 基准上，LPV-LFR 模型优于所有先前黑盒结果，且 CPU 训练时间不到三分钟；在控制力矩陀螺仪上，Identax 达到与最先进方法相当的精度。

Conclusion: Identax 为系统辨识研究提供了可扩展、透明且高效的基础工具，并在多个基准上展示了有竞争力的建模性能。

Abstract: Accurate data-driven modelling of dynamical systems is increasingly important across engineering disciplines, yet state-of-the-art identification methods are often computationally demanding, opaque, or poorly scalable. We present Identax, a JAX toolbox for identifying linear, Linear Parameter-Varying (LPV) and nonlinear systems, designed as an extensible foundation for system identification research. Its modular design allows model structures, identification criteria and optimization methods to be extended independently. The first release provides state-space and Linear Fractional Representation (LFR) models, multiple-shooting criteria for parallel training, and a transparent optimization pipeline. On the Silverbox benchmark, an LPV-LFR model outperforms all previous black-box results while training in under three minutes on a CPU. On a control moment gyroscope, Identax matches state-of-the-art accuracy.

</details>


### [897] [Boundary Stabilization of Mixed Traffic Flow With Connected Automated Vehicles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30548)
*Yihuai Zhang,Ziming Wang,Lu Liu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究人驾驶车辆与网联自动驾驶车辆混合交通中走走停停振荡的边界镇定问题，基于渗透率相关基本图与ARZ模型设计反步控制，并通过仿真和TGSIM数据校准评估性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合交通中CAV渗透率变化会影响交通流特性，走走停停振荡需要有效的边界控制方法，同时需量化不同渗透率下的控制效果和方法局限。

Method: 构建由车辆类别车头时距和有效间距得到的渗透率相关基本图，并嵌入Aw-Rascle-Zhang模型；针对名义线性化系统，利用反步法设计全状态反馈和输出反馈控制器；分析线性化系统的指数稳定性和有限时间收敛性；开展0到1渗透率下的闭环仿真，并与PI控制、输入幅值和速率约束、传感器噪声及敏感性分析进行比较；使用TGSIM数据集进行基本图校准。

Result: 仿真表明，提高CAV渗透率会提升平衡速度和流量，并缩短状态反馈与输出反馈控制器的收敛时间；所提方法在约束、噪声和敏感性条件下得到评估，并通过TGSIM数据校准验证了控制方法和仿真框架的有效性。

Conclusion: 研究量化了混合交通中CAV渗透率变化带来的交通性能改善，并识别了所提边界控制方法的适用边界和局限性。

Abstract: This paper addresses boundary stabilization of stop-and-go oscillations in mixed traffic containing human-driven vehicles (HVs) and connected automated vehicles (CAVs). A penetration-dependent fundamental diagram is constructed from vehicle-class headways and effective spacing and embedded in an Aw--Rascle--Zhang (ARZ) model. Backstepping yields full-state and output-feedback controllers for the nominal linearized system. Exponential stability and finite-time convergence are established for the linearized system. Closed-loop simulations over CAV penetration rates from 0 to 1 show that increasing penetration raises the equilibrium speed and flow and reduces the convergence time for both the state-feedback and output-feedback controllers. A proportional-integral (PI) controller benchmark, input magnitude and rate constraints, physical sensor noise, and a sensitivity analysis are also considered to assess the performance of the controllers. We further illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed control methods and the simulation framework through a fundamental diagram calibration using the TGSIM dataset. These results quantify the traffic performance changes and identify the limits of the proposed method.

</details>


### [898] [Power-Swing Blocking and Out-of-Step Tripping Scheme Using the Swing Center Voltage in Systems With Inverter-Based Resources](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30678)
*Henrik Johansson,Qianli Xing,Jaekeun Lee,Ki-Hyun Kim,Nathaniel Taylor,Xiongfei Wang*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文针对逆变型资源高渗透下距离继电器功率摇摆闭锁与失步跳闸误动问题，分析摇摆中心电压特性并提出基于SCV的PSB/OST方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统双盲区PSB/OST方案在IBR接入下存在快速功率摇摆和非传统阻抗轨迹导致的互操作性问题，且盲区法依赖视在阻抗穿越盲区时的速度，因此需要替代方法。

Method: 分析摇摆中心电压（SCV）特性及构网型（GFM）和跟网型（GFL）逆变器对其本地估计的影响；提出SCV-based PSB/OST方案，采用独立PSB激活函数使主判据可由简单系统参数整定，OST仅需一个整定值，并通过PSCAD/EMTDC仿真验证。

Result: 仿真验证了所提SCV-based PSB/OST方案的性能，并表明其能够克服盲区法在GFM和GFL逆变器场景下的局限性。

Conclusion: 基于SCV的PSB/OST方案为IBR高渗透电力系统提供了一种可行且有效的继电器保护改进方法。

Abstract: Misoperation of power-swing blocking (PSB) and out-of-step tripping (OST) schemes in distance relays is a critical concern in power systems with increasing penetration levels of inverter-based resources (IBRs). Recently, several papers have studied the impact of IBRs on conventional dual-blinder PSB/OST schemes. They highlight interoperability issues concerning fast power swings and unconventional impedance trajectories, and propose revised relay settings in attempts to deal with the problems. However, the blinder-based PSB methodology suffers from being dependent on the speed of the apparent impedance just as it crosses between the blinders. It is therefore important to consider alternative methods. This paper thoroughly analyzes the characteristics of the swing center voltage (SCV) and the impacts of grid-forming (GFM) and grid-following (GFL) inverters on its local estimation. Then, an SCV-based PSB/OST scheme is proposed, where the main PSB criterion can be tuned from simple system parameters. This is made possible by a separate PSB activation function. The OST scheme uses only one setting and is motivated from the analytical analysis of the SCV with IBRs. Extensive PSCAD/EMTDC simulations verify the performance of the proposed SCV-based PSB/OST scheme and how it overcomes limitations of blinder-based schemes with GFM and GFL inverters.

</details>


### [899] [Hierarchical Multi-Timescale Deep Reinforcement Learning for QoS-Aware AI-RAN Configuration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30695)
*Navid Keshtiarast,Amirhassan Babazadeh Darabi,Cem Tarhan,Martin Stahn,Ljiljana Simić,Marina Petrova*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种分层深度强化学习框架，用于面向异构业务QoS的O-RAN/AI-RAN无线接入网联合配置，并在ns-3与Ray RLlib联合仿真环境中验证其性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构业务场景下，RAN参数对吞吐、时延和可靠性的影响高度耦合且跨不同时间尺度演化，传统配置方法难以同时满足实时、近实时和非实时控制环路的QoS需求。

Method: 采用三个PPO智能体构成分层DRL，分别在不同时间尺度联合选择每用户MCS、用户到BWP分配、每BWP发射功率、 numerology及BWP带宽权重；共享QoS感知目标，综合吞吐需求满足度、时延和可靠性惩罚；扩展ns-3 5G-LENA并通过ns3-ai与Ray RLlib集成。

Result: 在九小区下行干扰网络中，混合URLLC、游戏、会话视频和视频流业务下，相比基线5G-NR RAN，训练后的分层DRL智能体显著降低URLLC和会话视频时延、降低残余块错误率，并避免最弱业务流接近饥饿；在容量受限时以略低的高速率视频流吞吐作为权衡。

Conclusion: 分层DRL能够与O-RAN/AI-RAN的多时间尺度控制环路对齐，实现QoS感知的联合RAN配置，在时延、可靠性和弱流公平性方面优于基线，但高吞吐视频业务存在一定吞吐折衷。

Abstract: Configuring radio access networks (RANs) for heterogeneous services requires coordinating radio parameters whose effects on throughput, delay, and reliability are closely coupled and evolve over different timescales. This paper presents a hierarchical deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework for joint, QoS-aware RAN configuration that aligns the learning structure with the real-time, near-real-time, and non-real-time control loops of O-RAN that are also adopted by AI-RAN. Three proximal policy optimization agents jointly select per-user modulation and coding schemes, user-to-bandwidth-part (BWP) assignments, per-BWP transmit power, numerology, and BWP bandwidth weights, at three timescales. The agents share a QoS-aware objective combining throughput demand satisfaction with delay and reliability penalties. We extend ns-3 5G-LENA and integrate it with Ray RLlib through ns3-ai to support the required radio controls, network observations, and hierarchical policy execution. We evaluate the agents' performance in a nine-cell downlink network with inter-cell interference, varying user populations, and mixed URLLC, gaming, conversational-video, and video-streaming traffic. Compared with the baseline 5G-NR RAN, our trained hierarchical DRL agents substantially reduce URLLC and conversational-video delays, lower the residual block error rate, and prevent the near-starvation of the weakest flows, trading off slightly lower throughput for high-rate video streaming under capacity-limited conditions.

</details>


### [900] [Closed-loop Properties of Value Iteration in Continuous Time with Approximation Errors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30786)
*Francisco Moreno-Mora,Stefan Streif*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文分析了在有限维函数近似和有限步终止条件下，连续时间非线性系统的值迭代仍能保持哪些闭环保证，并给出了稳定性、次优性与鲁棒性结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 值迭代在实际中无法精确执行：值函数需用有限维近似器表示，且迭代只能有限步停止。因此需要研究这些限制下闭环控制器是否仍具有稳定性和性能保证。

Method: 采用一种值迭代方案：每次迭代求解以先前迭代为终端代价的有限时域最优控制问题，控制器以采样数据方式在每个时域上应用最优输入。通过可对计算得到的迭代逐点检查的不等式条件分析闭环性质，并讨论模型误差下的鲁棒性，结合线性二次调节器和已知最优值函数的非线性系统进行数值研究。

Result: 若收敛容差和近似误差足够小，控制器可在计算迭代的次水平集上渐近稳定系统，并给出次优性界；该条件无需证明迭代收敛即可检查。进一步建立了对模型误差的固有鲁棒性，并恢复了线性二次调节器的经典结果。数值结果与理论保证一致，且表明次优性界较保守。

Conclusion: 在有限维近似和有限步终止下，值迭代仍可提供可检验的闭环稳定性与次优性保证，是迈向基于样本认证的第一步；但次优性界可能偏保守。

Abstract: Value iteration is an important tool for approximating solutions of infinite-horizon optimal control problems, but in practice it is never carried out exactly: value functions are represented by finite-dimensional approximators, and the iteration is stopped after finitely many steps. This paper analyzes which closed-loop guarantees remain under these limitations for continuous-time nonlinear systems. We consider a value iteration scheme in which each iteration solves a finite-horizon optimal control problem with the previous iterate as terminal cost, and the associated controller applies the optimal input of this problem over each horizon in a sampled-data fashion. We show that if the convergence tolerance and the approximation error are small enough, the controller asymptotically stabilizes the system on sublevel sets of the computed iterate, and provide a suboptimality bound. This condition consists of pointwise inequalities that can be checked for the computed iterate, without establishing convergence of the iteration, and is a first step towards sample-based certification. We further establish inherent robustness of the controller with respect to model errors and recover classical results for the linear-quadratic regulator. Numerical studies on a linear-quadratic problem and on a nonlinear system with known optimal value function are consistent with the guarantees and show that the suboptimality bound is conservative.

</details>


### [901] [Data-Driven Nonlinear Observer Design Using the Koopman Generator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30827)
*Joachim Deutscher*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究基于Koopman生成子的非线性连续时间观测器数据驱动设计方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对非线性连续时间系统，希望利用数据驱动方式设计观测器，并处理输出注入、字典不变性及有限数据误差等问题。

Method: 构造由线性系统部分和非线性输出注入组成的观测器；输出注入提供额外自由度以保证字典不变或投影误差较小。随后推广到带输入系统，并结合生成子扩展动态模式分解（generator EDMD）进行数据驱动观测器设计，推导有限数据下的概率误差界。

Result: 给出了数据驱动观测器误差动态及稳态观测误差的概率有限数据误差界，并通过具有不变字典和非不变字典的非线性系统示例验证方法有效性。

Conclusion: 所提出的基于Koopman生成子的数据驱动观测器设计能够有效处理无输入和有输入非线性系统，并具有有限数据误差保证。

Abstract: This paper deals with the data-driven design of nonlinear continuous-time observers using the Koopman generator. For systems without inputs, an observer is designed that consists of a linear system part with a nonlinear output injection. Therein, the output injection introduces additional degrees of freedom to ensure an invariant dictionary or a small projection error. Subsequently, this observer is extended to systems with inputs. These results form the basis for a data-driven nonlinear observer design using generator extended dynamic mode decomposition. Probabilistic finite-data error bounds are derived for the observer error w.r.t. the data-driven observer error dynamics and for the corresponding steady-state observation error. Examples of nonlinear systems with invariant and non-invariant dictionaries illustrate the effectiveness of the novel data-driven observer design procedure.

</details>


### [902] [Constructive continuous and sampled-data control of nonstandard singularly perturbed parabolic systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30841)
*Pengfei Wang,Emilia Fridman*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 处理失败

Result: 处理失败

Abstract: The existing results on control of singularly perturbed (SP) PDE systems are all qualitative with stability guaranteed for small values of SP parameter $\varepsilon$, whereas control design is confined to stable fast systems. In the present paper we study the finite-dimensional output-feedback boundary stabilization of SP parabolic systems with Neumann actuators and nonlocal sensors acting on both the slow and fast dynamics. This configuration allows us to treat not only unstable fast systems, but even a larger class of nonstandard SP systems (where the fast dynamics with $\varepsilon=0$ cannot be solved with respect to the fast state). We design a finite-dimensional controller based on the slow descriptor PDE system. We consider the continuous-time control and, for the first time, (even for the state-feedback for SP PDEs) its sampled-data implementation. For the latter, we introduce a multi-rate sampled-data framework in which the slow and fast variables can be sampled asynchronously. We consider time-triggered control input sampling and event-triggered output sampling. We prove the avoidance of Zeno behavior and derive LMI conditions for finding upper bounds on the observer dimension, sampling control intervals and $\varepsilon$ that preserve the stability. Our results include a new finite-dimensional controller design for the parabolic-elliptic equation. Numerical simulations demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed method.

</details>


### [903] [Data Center-Aware Load Pickup in Power System Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30978)
*Yousef Abudyak,Saleh Sadeghi Gougheri,Mohsen Alizadeh,Wei Sun*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 处理失败
