Motivation: 处理失败

Method: 处理失败

Result: 处理失败

Conclusion: 处理失败

Abstract: Data centers requiring continuous operation rely on onsite generation and battery storage during blackouts. Their return to grid supply must be coordinated with the restoration of other loads because demand fluctuations can affect system frequency. This paper adds constraints to a restoration optimization problem that coordinates load pickup, grid supply to data centers, onsite generation, and battery operation. These constraints reserve battery power and energy to accommodate bounded demand changes while maintaining approved grid supply to data centers. The method accounts for processing delays and checks resource limits using updated operating states before applying commands. Phasor-domain simulations of a low-inertia restoration scenario show that the method serves 760 MW of load outside the data centers and satisfies all tested operating limits. Nominal and frequency-aware benchmarks serve 840 MW and 800 MW, respectively, but violate operating limits.

</details>


### [904] [Marginal-Cost Clustering for Courier Dispatch: A Parallel Decomposition for Pickup and Delivery with Time Windows and Fleet Sizing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31085)
*SangWoo Park,Elson Cibaku,Sanchoy Das*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究带时间窗、批量请求、软时间窗、开放路线和固定派遣费用的快递取送问题，提出基于边际成本的聚类优先/路径次之方法，并在生成实例和Li & Lim基准上验证效率与效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统聚类规则常用质心代表整个时空工作量，无法反映快递员当前位置、空闲时间和已载请求，因此需要更准确的请求分组准则来决定批次、路线和车队规模。

Method: 以请求加入某快递员现有路线所增加的行驶与迟到成本作为边际成本；每轮固定边际成本，求解一个整数规划完成请求分配和快递员开启决策，再用重定位与交换的下降法改进；对已派遣快递员用基于已访问集合的标签设定法精确求解混合整数路径子问题。

Result: 在生成实例和改编Li & Lim基准上，相较六种已发表聚类规则，原文结果提升29%，在同样加入下降法后提升12%；与匹配墙钟时间的自适应大邻域搜索相比，生成实例领先、基准持平；约一分钟可处理1000个请求和300名快递员。

Conclusion: 边际成本分组能更好利用快递员时空状态和载货信息，结合整数规划、下降改进与精确标签路径求解，可在较大规模快递调度中取得优于传统聚类规则和竞争性ALNS的效果。

Abstract: Courier dispatch poses a pickup and delivery problem with time windows in which requests are batched, windows are soft, couriers start where they are and take open routes, and a fixed dispatch charge makes fleet size a decision. We contribute to the cluster-first, route-second family a grouping criterion that scores a request by its marginal cost, the travel and lateness it adds to the route a courier already plans, rather than by its distance to a centroid, one point standing for a whole workload in space and time. The marginal cost instead knows where a courier is, when it becomes free and what it already carries. Each pass, we hold the marginal costs fixed while we solve one integer program that assigns every request to a courier and chooses which to open, then improve its solution by a descent that relocates and swaps requests between couriers. We then route each dispatched courier exactly. That subproblem is naturally a mixed-integer program, and we solve it by label setting over visited sets, which we prove optimal and cheap enough to run every pass. On instances we generate and on adapted Li & Lim benchmark batches, we beat the best of six published clustering rules by 29% as published and by 12% once those rules carry the same descent. Against an adaptive large neighbourhood search at matched wall-clock we are ahead on the generated instances and level on the benchmark, and we handle 1000 requests and 300 couriers in about a minute.

</details>


### [905] [Data-Driven Identification of Uncertainty Sets with Conformance Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31127)
*Laura Lützow,Mykel J. Kochenderfer,Matthias Althoff*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出 ConfID 统一框架，利用测量轨迹为给定（可能非线性的）名义模型识别不确定性集合，从而建立 reachset、trace 和 simulation 三类一致性关系，并给出未见行为一致性的无分布概率保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 形式验证与控制器综合需要准确模型，而一致性关系规定模型需达到的精度。现有基于测量数据建立一致性的方法通常局限于单一关系、特定模型类或下游验证算法，缺乏统一且可保证的框架。

Method: ConfID 将未建模效应表示为非确定性而非细化名义动态；针对三种一致性关系，通过线性规划最小化可达集大小来识别不确定性集合，仅约束随关系变化；并推导识别模型对未见行为满足一致性的无分布概率界。

Result: 在仿真和真实数据上的实验评估了三种关系下识别的模型，验证了理论保证，并表明这些模型比基线更可靠地覆盖未见行为，同时具有相当或更小的集合。

Conclusion: ConfID 为从数据建立多种一致性关系提供了统一、可保证且有效的方法，能够在保持集合紧凑的同时提高对未见行为的覆盖可靠性。

Abstract: Formal verification and controller synthesis require accurate models. Conformance relations specify the required accuracy of a model such that properties established for the model carry over to the target system. Existing methods for establishing them from measured data are typically restricted to a single relation, a specific model class, or a downstream verification algorithm. We present ConfID, a unified framework that establishes reachset, trace, and simulation conformance with respect to measured traces by identifying uncertainty sets for a given, possibly nonlinear nominal model. Unmodeled effects are thus captured by nondeterminism rather than by refining the nominal dynamics. For all three conformance relations, the identification is a linear program that minimizes the size of the reachable sets; only its constraints depend on the relation. We further derive distribution-free bounds on the probability that the identified models are conformant for unseen behaviors. Experiments on simulated and real-world data evaluate the models identified for the three relations, confirm the guarantees, and show that these models cover unseen behaviors more reliably than baselines, with comparable or smaller sets.

</details>


### [906] [Topological Fairness in Continuous-State Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31150)
*Mahdi Nazeri,Alessandro Abate,Anne-Kathrin Schmuck,Sadegh Soudjani*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 论文将概率程序中的公平性抽象推广到连续状态空间，提出拓扑公平性，并研究其可靠性、完备性及在可达-避障目标综合中的应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统公平性将随机性抽象为对单个迁移的公平调度，但在不可数状态空间中每个后继概率为零，导致该抽象失效；因此需要新的公平性概念以处理连续状态空间中的几乎必然性质。

Method: 作者在状态空间拓扑的可数基上定义拓扑公平性：若某个基本开集在可能后继集合中无限频繁出现，则轨迹必须无限频繁访问该开集。随后分析该概念对加性随机扰动系统的可靠性，并构造用于reach-avoid目标的嵌套不动点算法以直接综合连续状态空间上的获胜域和记忆无关策略。

Result: 对于带加性随机扰动的系统，在任意控制策略下几乎所有轨迹都是拓扑公平的，因此基于拓扑公平轨迹的推理是原系统几乎必然性质的一个可靠证明原则。但该原则不完备，不能刻画依赖扰动结果相对似然性的几乎必然行为。对于reach-avoid目标，嵌套不动点可在一大类系统上精确计算公平获胜域及记忆无关获胜策略；案例研究表明所得获胜域显著大于通过有限抽象获得的、依赖离散化且非单调的获胜域。

Conclusion: 拓扑公平性为连续状态空间中的概率程序抽象和几乎必然性质验证提供了有效框架，支持直接在连续状态空间上综合策略，但作为证明原则并不完备；其优势在于避免有限抽象带来的离散化依赖。

Abstract: Since the early days of probabilistic programs, fairness has been used to abstract randomness in software. Intuitively, a fair scheduler reproduces the almost-sure behavior of a random choice based solely on the set of possible outcomes, independent of their (often unknown) distribution. As this abstraction attaches fairness to individual transitions, it becomes ineffective over uncountable state spaces, where every single successor has probability zero. We overcome this limitation by imposing fairness on open sets instead. This leads to the novel notion of topological fairness: every basic open set---with respect to a countable basis of the state-space topology---that lies in the set of possible successors infinitely often must be visited infinitely often. We show that topological fairness carries the intuition from program abstraction to continuous state spaces. For systems with additive stochastic disturbances, almost every trajectory is topologically fair under every control policy. Reasoning over all topologically fair trajectories is therefore a sound proof principle for almost-sure properties of the original system. Unlike in the finite-state case, however, it is not complete: topological fairness cannot capture almost-sure behavior that hinges on the relative likelihoods of disturbance outcomes. Finally, we show that topological fairness supports synthesis directly on the continuous state space. For reach-avoid objectives, we give a nested fixed point over subsets of the state space which, for a broad class of systems, computes the fair winning domain exactly together with a memoryless winning strategy. Our case studies show that this winning domain is substantially larger than the one obtained with currently available techniques, which detour through a finite abstraction and certify a winning domain that depends on the discretization in a non-monotone way.

</details>


### [907] [Self-Supervised Learning for Soft-Constrained AC-OPF in Multiphase Distribution Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31026)
*Hoang T. Nguyen,Deepjyoti Deka,Priya L. Donti,Varsha Pendyala,Nurali Virani,Wajid Muneer,Reetam Sen Biswas*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于不平衡多相配电系统快速软约束AC-OPF的自监督学习框架，无需最优解标签，直接以AC-OPF目标训练神经网络预测DER设定值，并在多系统上取得接近IPOPT的目标值和显著加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统AC最优潮流求解计算负担重，尤其在不平衡多相配电系统、广运行范围和高/低负荷场景下需要快速且可靠的求解方法；同时获取最优解标签成本高，因此希望用无标签自监督方式学习。

Method: 构建软约束AC-OPF目标，权衡运行成本、可再生能源弃电和越限惩罚；神经网络以运行条件、开关配置和目标权重为输入预测DER设定值，再经DER投影和可微AC潮流处理以强制设备限制和网络等式；训练时直接最小化AC-OPF目标，不使用最优解标签。

Result: 在123、240和906节点系统上，相对于IPOPT的平均目标间隙分别为0.32%、0.92%和0.56%；在高负荷/低发电和低负荷/高发电场景中最大平均间隙为1.04%，平均加速比为58至5272倍。

Conclusion: 该自监督框架能够在较宽运行范围内实现快速、近最优的软约束AC-OPF求解，并在多相不平衡配电系统中表现出良好的可扩展性和显著计算加速。

Abstract: This paper presents a self-supervised learning framework for fast, soft-constrained AC optimal power flow (OPF) in unbalanced multiphase distribution systems. The soft AC-OPF objective balances operating cost, renewable energy curtailment, and penalties for violating operating limits. A neural network predicts distributed energy resource (DER) setpoints conditioned on operating conditions, switch configurations, and objective weights. The predicted setpoints are then processed through a DER projection and differentiable AC power flow to enforce device limits and network equalities. The framework is trained by directly minimizing the AC-OPF objective, without optimal-solution labels. Experiments on 123-, 240-, and 906-bus systems yield mean objective gaps of 0.32%, 0.92%, and 0.56%, respectively, relative to IPOPT, across wide operating ranges. Across these systems and the evaluated high-load/low-generation and low-load/high-generation scenarios, the largest mean gap is 1.04%, with mean speedups of 58-5272 times relative to IPOPT.

</details>


### [908] [Towards a Formalised Framework for Analog Electronics and Circuit Theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31159)
*Yaohua Zhang,Zhi Kai Pong*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文迈出用 Lean 4 形式化电路理论与模拟电子学的第一步，并以理想 RC 低通滤波器为概念验证，建立可复用定义并机器验证关键定理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统电路推导常依赖未明确记录的假设和数学关系，导致验证与复用困难；作者希望将电路理论知识数字化、标准化并形式化验证。

Method: 使用 Lean 4 交互式定理证明器构建电路理论形式化框架，形式化理想 RC 低通滤波器，定义元件阻抗和电路连接，并机器检查分压、传递函数和低通行为等定理。

Result: 作为概念验证，成功形式化了理想 RC 低通滤波器，建立了可复用的阻抗与连接定义，并完成了分压、传递函数及低通特性的机器验证定理。

Conclusion: 该工作展示了形式化电路理论的可行性，并提出构建可扩展电路模型、定义与已验证结果库的愿景，以支持电路知识的系统检查、共享和复用。

Abstract: Circuit theory provides the mathematical foundation for the analysis and design of electronic circuits. However, conventional circuit derivations often rely on assumptions and mathematical relationships that are not explicitly recorded, making their verification and reuse challenging. In this paper, we present the first step towards a formalised framework for circuit theory and analog electronics using the Lean 4 interactive theorem prover. As a proof of concept, we formalise an ideal RC low-pass filter, establishing reusable definitions for component impedance and circuit connections, and machine-checked theorems for voltage division, the transfer function, and low-pass behaviour. Building upon this demonstration, we outline a broader vision for an extensible library of circuit models, definitions, and verified results. Our long-term aim is to digitise, standardise, and verify circuit theory, enabling established knowledge to be systematically checked, shared, and reused across different circuit analyses.

</details>


### [909] [Tropical Geometry-based ReLU Lyapunov Function and Controller Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31203)
*Jesse Wayment,Brian Yarbrough,Jingbo Wang,Shreyas Sundaram,Philip E. Paré*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该论文研究带ReLU激活的神经ODE系统的神经网络Lyapunov函数与镇定控制器的联合综合，借助热带几何方法保证稳定性约束并求解优化问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经ODE与ReLU网络在控制中应用广泛，但其稳定性分析和控制器综合缺乏系统工具；作者希望引入热带几何来刻画ReLU网络性质，并统一处理Lyapunov函数与控制器设计。

Method: 将候选Lyapunov函数表示为热带符号多项式的热带商，施加原点平衡条件和感兴趣区域内的正定性约束；构造沿神经ODE动力学的Lie导数对应的总Lie曲面，并建立优化问题以保证Lie导数为负；进一步联合综合ReLU神经网络镇定控制器与神经Lyapunov函数。

Result: 在若干近似为神经ODE的非线性系统上进行了验证，展示了Lyapunov函数综合以及Lyapunov函数与控制器联合综合的应用效果。

Conclusion: 该工作首次将基于热带几何的方法引入控制理论，为ReLU神经ODE系统提供了一种统一的稳定性分析与控制器综合框架。

Abstract: We investigate the joint synthesis of neural network Lyapunov functions and stabilizing controllers for systems modeled as neural ordinary differential equations (neural ODEs) with ReLU activations. Our approach leverages tools from tropical geometry, an emerging analytical framework for characterizing properties of ReLU neural networks. To the best of our knowledge, this work is the first to introduce tropical geometry-based methods into control theory. We represent candidate Lyapunov functions as tropical quotients of tropical signomials, which allows us to enforce the equilibrium condition at the origin and formulate constraints ensuring positive definiteness over a prescribed region of interest. We construct a total Lie surface representing the Lie derivative of the candidate Lyapunov function along the neural ODE dynamics and formulate an optimization problem to find Lyapunov parameters that ensure its negativity throughout the region of interest. This enables the systematic search for Lyapunov functions satisfying the desired stability conditions. Finally, we extend this framework to jointly synthesize a ReLU neural network stabilizing controller and a neural Lyapunov function, providing a unified approach to stability analysis and controller synthesis. We validate our proposed method on several nonlinear systems approximated as neural ODEs, demonstrating applications to Lyapunov function synthesis as well as joint Lyapunov function and controller synthesis.

</details>


<div id='eess.IV'></div>

# eess.IV [[Back]](#toc)

### [910] [Beyond Fidelity: Evaluating Synthetic Medical Imaging Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28154)
*Seyed Kahaki,Alexander R. Webber,Tahsin Rahman,Elim Thompson,Jana Delfino,Aldo Badano*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出 ScoreCard Toolkit，用于系统评估合成医学影像数据集（SMD）的多维质量，并在三种成像模态上展示了端到端评估流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有合成医学影像数据集评估多依赖通用计算机视觉的保真度指标，难以反映解剖合理性、数据集覆盖、元数据完整性、子组一致性和文档质量等临床相关属性，因此需要更系统的质量评估方法。

Method: 基于 7Cs 评估框架中的六个维度（Congruence、Coverage、Completeness、Consistency、Constraint、Comprehension），构建模块化 ScoreCard Toolkit，包含预处理、特征提取、指标计算、可视化和结构化评分卡生成，并支持外观、纹理、形状特征及可扩展的影像组学、深度学习嵌入和基础模型表示。

Result: 在合成数字病理全切片图像块、合成数字乳腺摄影和合成头部 CT 三种模态上完成端到端验证；评分卡揭示了不同数据集特有的质量问题，如分布偏差、覆盖缺口、约束违规、解剖形状伪影和元数据一致性问题。

Conclusion: ScoreCard 提供了一种实用、可扩展且模态无关的方法，可补充传统保真度评估，并透明报告合成医学影像数据集质量。

Abstract: The growing use of synthetic medical imaging datasets (SMD) in the development and evaluation of machine learning models has motivated interest in systematic methods to assess dataset quality across different imaging modalities. Common evaluation strategies rely heavily on fidelity-oriented metrics developed for general computer vision and may not capture clinically relevant properties such as anatomical plausibility, dataset coverage, metadata completeness, subgroup consistency, or documentation quality. We present the ScoreCard Toolkit that operationalizes six of the seven dimensions found within the 7Cs approach for SMD evaluation across Congruence, Coverage, Completeness, Consistency, Constraint, and Comprehension. The ScoreCard Toolkit provides a modular pipeline for preprocessing, feature extraction, metric computation, visualization, and structured scorecard generation. This approach complements standard fidelity-based evaluation by exposing quality characteristics not captured by those measures alone, including constraint violations, anatomically implausible shape artifacts, and metadata-related consistency issues. The toolkit supports appearance, texture, and shape features and is designed to accommodate additional feature representations, including radiomic features, deep-learning embeddings, and foundation-model representations. We demonstrate the end-to-end workflow across three imaging modalities: synthetic digital pathology whole-slide image patch data, synthetic digital mammography, and synthetic head CT. Across all three modalities, the resulting scorecards reveal dataset-specific quality characteristics, such as distributional biases and coverage gaps that may impact their effectiveness for model development or testing. ScoreCard provides a practical, extensible, and modality-agnostic approach for evaluating and transparently reporting SMD quality.

</details>


### [911] [Which Vertebral Landmark Errors Change a Cobb Angle? Geometry-Weighted Supervision for Radiographic Landmark Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28156)
*Zizhao Peng*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 论文研究脊柱曲度测量中椎角定位网络的训练目标，提出基于三角度读取器几何的损失，通过对特定旋转方向加权来降低曲度角误差，同时揭示标志点精度与几何读取一致性之间的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 椎角定位网络的像素误差下降并不一定保证脊柱曲度测量更准确；作者希望从三角度读取器的几何出发，设计训练损失，使网络更关注会旋转左右弦线的局部方向，从而改善曲度角一致性。

Method: 利用椎体四边形的八个角点位移自由度，识别出旋转左右弦线的局部方向，其角度敏感性与弦宽成反比；用正交Hadamard基对该残差方向额外加权，同时保留其余七个方向的监督。在372张前后位X线片上开展五折图像级实验，对同一标志点网络的45次拟合比较坐标监督、几何加权和加入软成对角度项三种目标。

Result: 三种子角点集成将合并对称百分比误差从坐标监督的18.45%降至几何加权的17.20%；加入软成对角度项后为16.89%，相对坐标监督配对差异为-1.56个百分点，95%图像自助区间为[-2.51,-0.61]，而软项增量区间包含零。单折比较中直接单位弦监督也降低误差，但与几何加权差异不确定。单种子运行中旋转残差误差下降36.1%，但归一化角点误差从2.60%升至2.71%。

Conclusion: 结果表明存在可测量的权衡：提高与指定几何读取器的一致性可能以标志点保真度为代价；评估基于内部图像级划分和由标志点导出的目标角度。

Abstract: A network that localizes vertebral corners can reduce pixel error while rotating the line used to measure spinal curvature. We derive a training loss from the geometry of a three-angle reader. Of the eight corner-displacement degrees of freedom of a vertebral quadrilateral, one local direction rotates its left-to-right chord. The angular sensitivity in this direction is inversely proportional to chord width. An orthonormal Hadamard basis lets us give this residual extra weight during training while retaining supervision on the other seven directions. In five-fold image-level development experiments on 372 anteroposterior radiographs, we compared three objectives across 45 fits of the same landmark network. The three-seed corner ensemble reduced pooled symmetric percentage error from 18.45% with coordinate supervision to 17.20% with geometry weighting. Adding a soft pairwise-angle term yielded 16.89%, a paired difference of $-1.56$ percentage points from coordinate supervision (95% image-bootstrap interval $[-2.51,-0.61]$). The interval for the increment from adding the soft term included zero. In a single-fold comparison, direct unit-chord supervision also reduced error, and its difference from geometry weighting was uncertain. Across single-seed runs, rotational residual error fell by 36.1% while normalized corner error rose from 2.60% to 2.71%. Perturbing one vertebra at a time also showed when a small rotation changes the selected end pair. These results identify a measurable trade-off between landmark fidelity and agreement with a specified geometric reader. The evaluation concerns an internal image-level split and landmark-derived target angles.

</details>


### [912] [Duplicate- and Patient-Overlap Leakage in Brain MRI Tumor Classification: A Multi-Model Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28161)
*Xin Li,Samson Oluwadare*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 该研究审计了Cheng/Figshare脑肿瘤MRI数据集的图像重复与患者重叠问题，比较按图像划分和按记录患者ID划分的训练评估协议对CNN分类器性能、概率误差及模型排名的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同一患者的重复MRI图像和不同切片可能同时进入训练与测试，从而高估脑肿瘤分类器性能；作者希望评估患者重叠与表观判别性能、概率校准误差和模型排名之间的关系。

Method: 使用含3,064张增强T1 MRI切片、3类肿瘤和233个记录患者ID的Cheng/Figshare数据集；在图像级和记录ID不重叠两种协议下训练四种CNN，进行5折匹配实验（40次原始运行），并用患者簇bootstrap量化不确定性；扩展实验加入60次划分种子、40次训练种子和72次固定测试的同胞切片暴露实验及类匹配其他患者对照。

Result: 未发现完全重复图像，筛查配对中跨患者近重复证据也很少；图像级评估相较记录ID不重叠评估的平衡准确率高出+0.0318至+0.0462；图像级评估样本上的期望校准误差和多类Brier分数更低；ResNet50和DenseNet121的平衡准确率差异在新种子下持续，但原始模型排名反转未复现；仅ResNet50第2折在五检验暴露家族中通过Holm校正；16个相关探索性亚组估计均为正，但无一致剂量反应。

Conclusion: 在该基准上，患者重叠与更高的表观性能相关；固定测试比较无法将患者身份与共享解剖或采集特征区分开；研究未进行独立外部临床验证。

Abstract: Background. Repeated MRI images and distinct slices from the same patient can both compromise evaluation of brain tumor classifiers.
  Objective. We audited image duplication and examined how patient overlap relates to discrimination, probability error and model ranking.
  Methods. The Cheng/Figshare dataset contains 3,064 contrast-enhanced T1 MRI slices, three tumor classes and 233 recorded patient IDs. The dataset author advised treating the IDs as individuals, but original DICOM records were unavailable for verification. Four CNN architectures were trained under image-level and recorded-ID-disjoint protocols with five folds matched on size and class counts (40 original runs). A patient-cluster bootstrap quantified uncertainty. The extension added 60 split-seed runs, 40 training-seed runs and 72 fixed-test sibling-exposure runs with class-matched other-patient controls.
  Results. We found no exact duplicate images and little evidence of cross-patient near-duplicates among screened pairs. Image-level minus recorded-ID-disjoint balanced accuracy ranged from +0.0318 to +0.0462 across models. Expected calibration error and multiclass Brier scores were lower on the image-level evaluation sample. The balanced-accuracy difference persisted across new seeds for ResNet50 and DenseNet121, but their original ranking reversal did not replicate. Only ResNet50 in fold 2 passed Holm correction in the five-test exposure family. All 16 correlated exploratory subgroup estimates were positive, with no consistent dose-response.
  Conclusions. Patient overlap was associated with higher apparent performance on this benchmark. Fixed-test comparisons could not isolate patient identity from shared anatomy or acquisition characteristics. No independent external clinical validation was performed.

</details>


### [913] [The UNIFESP Chest CT Fatty Liver Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28164)
*Augusto Sarquis Serpa,Mariana Ramos Scolari,Eduardo Moreno Judice de Mattos Farina,Eduardo Caminha Nunes,Felipe Matsuoka,Felipe Campos Kitamura,Nitamar Abdala*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 该文介绍了UNIFESP胸部CT脂肪肝数据集，包含285例未增强CT检查、264名患者，并提供脂肪肝二分类标签，用于相关竞赛和算法验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肝脂肪变性常见且常无症状，常在因其他原因进行的CT检查（包括部分包含上腹部的胸部CT）中可见，因此需要公开数据集支持基于胸部CT的脂肪肝识别研究。

Method: 在巴西单一学术中心收集264名患者的285次未增强CT检查（344个序列、99,883幅图像），包括152例胸部CT和112例腹部CT；由放射科住院医师通过比较肝内三个ROI与脾脏ROI的衰减值赋予脂肪肝二分类标签，图像以去标识化DICOM格式提供；数据集用于2022年Kaggle竞赛，其中226例用于训练、38例胸部CT用于测试。

Result: 在技术验证中，自动测量的“肝脏衰减低于脾脏衰减”标准与226名训练患者标签中的206名一致，一致率为91%。

Conclusion: 该数据集可公开获取，适用于胸部CT场景下脂肪肝检测研究、竞赛和算法技术验证。

Abstract: Hepatic steatosis is common, usually asymptomatic, and frequently visible on CT examinations performed for other reasons, including chest CT, in which the upper abdomen is partly included. We describe the UNIFESP Chest CT Fatty Liver Dataset, a public collection of 285 unenhanced CT studies (344 series, 99,883 images) from 264 patients examined at a single academic center in Brazil: 152 patients with chest CT and 112 patients with abdominal CT. Each patient has a binary label for the presence of hepatic steatosis, assigned by a radiology resident who compared the attenuation of three regions of interest in the liver with one in the spleen. Images are provided in de-identified DICOM format. The dataset was used in the UNIFESP Chest CT Fatty Liver Competition, hosted on Kaggle in 2022, with 226 patients for training and 38 patients with chest CT for testing. In a technical validation, the criterion of liver attenuation lower than spleen attenuation, measured automatically, agreed with the labels in 206 of the 226 training patients (91%). The dataset is available at https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/unifesp-fatty-liver.

</details>


### [914] [Quality-Control Policies Shape Model Behaviour in Computational Pathology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28179)
*Mario Parreño Centeno,Yu Guan,Pedro Montero Pavón,Sanna Palosaari,Juha Väyrynen*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 该文提出PathQC-3C数据集和TileNet框架，将组织/背景/伪影质量估计与任务特定的输入选择策略解耦，并系统评估质控策略对计算病理模型的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 质控策略决定哪些图像区域进入计算病理模型，但质量估计与输入选择通常耦合，难以单独评估策略效果；因此需要使质控策略显式、可配置且可测试。

Method: 构建PathQC-3C，包含来自1194张H&E全切片图像、32个癌症/组织类别的1661个密集标注区域；提出TileNet，将密集组织/背景/伪影估计与任务特定输入选择策略分离；在三个留出队列评估默认预测器并与统一质控比较，进行单病理医生盲审，并在三个下游场景测试替代策略：CAMELYON16多实例学习、弱标签肺分类和PathQCAug肿瘤-间质模型适应。

Result: 在CAMELYON16多实例学习中，固定tile预算下背景感知选择将汇总折外AUC从0.758提高到0.839；弱标签肺分类中严格排除伪影使预匹配候选池减少约43%，匹配训练集规模和患者贡献后指标差异较小且依指标而定；PathQCAug在严重留出复合伪影下提高高伪影tile的宏Dice，并在三个训练种子中优于随机擦除和清洁组织对照。

Conclusion: 将质量估计与策略执行分离可提供可审计的方式控制进入计算病理模型的图像内容；合适策略具有任务特异性，其临床效用仍待确立。

Abstract: Quality-control policies determine which image regions are used by computational pathology models, but their effects are difficult to isolate when quality estimation and input selection are coupled. We make these policies explicit, configurable and testable. We introduce PathQC-3C, comprising 1,661 densely annotated regions from 1,194 haematoxylin and eosin whole-slide images across 32 cancer/tissue categories, and TileNet, a framework that separates dense tissue/background/artefact estimation from task-specific input-selection policies. We evaluated the default predictor across three held-out cohorts and against harmonised quality-control comparators, assessed policy decisions in a blinded single-pathologist audit, and tested alternative policies in three downstream settings. In retrospective CAMELYON16 multiple-instance learning, background-aware selection improved the pooled out-of-fold area under the receiver operating characteristic curve from 0.758 to 0.839 compared with random sampling from the same exhaustive candidate pool under a fixed tile budget. In weak-label lung classification, strict artefact exclusion reduced the pre-matching candidate pool by approximately 43%, with small metric-dependent differences after matching training-set size and patient contribution. PathQCAug, which composites real artefact components during tumour-stroma model adaptation, improved macro Dice on high-artefact tiles under severe held-out composited artefacts across three training seeds and outperformed random-erasing and clean-tissue controls. Separating quality estimation from policy execution provides an auditable way to control which image content enters computational pathology models; the appropriate policy is task specific, and clinical utility remains to be established.

</details>


### [915] [EID-Net: Endoscopic Illumination-aware Degradation Correction Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28198)
*Junzhi Liu,Yinghao Zeng,Yang Liu,Huafeng Li,Xiaosong Li*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出面向内窥镜图像复杂光照退化的EID-Net，通过显式提取内窥镜退化先验并引入光照调制转置注意力，实现结构保持的光照校正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内窥镜图像在复杂光照下存在局部欠曝、过曝及颜色变化，且退化与组织结构交织，通用低光增强和图像复原方法难以在提升可见性的同时保留局部结构与颜色信息。

Method: 构建内窥镜光照感知退化校正网络EID-Net；从输入图像显式提取内窥镜导向的退化先验，并将其作为统一表示；通过光照调制转置注意力机制将该先验引入解码器，调制key-value特征子空间以自适应引导特征聚合。

Result: 在CEC、Endo4IE、EndoVis17和EndoVis18数据集上的大量实验表明，EID-Net优于近期的内窥镜增强方法和通用图像复原方法。

Conclusion: EID-Net能够有效处理内窥镜复杂光照退化，在保持局部结构和颜色线索的同时提升图像可见性，验证了显式退化先验与光照调制注意力机制的有效性。

Abstract: Endoscopic images captured under complex illumination conditions often suffer from spatially non-uniform exposure degradation, including local under-exposure, over-exposure, and illumination-induced color variation. These degradations are usually entangled with tissue structures, making it challenging for general-purpose low-light enhancement and image restoration methods to improve visibility while preserving local structural and chromatic cues. In this paper, we propose EID-Net, an endoscopic illumination-aware degradation correction network for structure-preserving endoscopic illumination correction. Rather than treating illumination correction as a global intensity adjustment, EID-Net explicitly extracts an endoscopy-oriented degradation prior from the input image to characterize illumination-related variations in a unified representation. This prior is then introduced into the decoder through an illumination-modulated transposed attention mechanism, where it adaptively guides feature aggregation by modulating the key-value feature subspace. Extensive experiments on CEC, Endo4IE, EndoVis17, and EndoVis18 datasets demonstrate that EID-Net performs favorably against recent endoscopic enhancement and general image restoration methods. The code is available at https://github.com/JUNZHIlius/EID-Net.

</details>


### [916] [Beyond Outlier Rejection: Transient-Aware Reconstruction of Multi-Stack MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28184)
*Anika Knupfer,Maximilian Lindholz,Maria Camila Bustos-Vivas,Joseph V. Hajnal,Bodo Rosenhahn,Jana Hutter*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出一种分析-合成分解方法，将临床MRI多堆栈数据拆分为共享静态解剖、每堆栈刚性与平滑非刚性运动、以及每堆栈稀疏瞬态场，从而在重建解剖的同时保留运动/瞬态等生理信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统多堆栈MRI重建（如SVRTK、NeSVoR）会把不符合静态假设的变化降权，但活体组织扫描中的胎儿运动、子宫收缩等变化本身可能具有临床意义，因此需要同时建模静态解剖与动态变化。

Method: 采用无需训练数据的逐受试者分析-合成分解：用精确采集几何解释每个体素，建模所有堆栈共享的静态解剖、每堆栈的刚性及平滑非刚性运动、以及仅在一次采集内出现的稀疏瞬态场；通过稳健重加权防止瞬态变化污染解剖。所有数据集使用同一配置，并在数字体模及子宫、前列腺、胎儿脑MRI上评估。

Result: 数字体模中静态变化完全保留在解剖中，瞬态堆栈的瞬态场在12mm半径处恢复68%。解剖预测留出堆栈的NCC优于SVRTK和NeSVoR：子宫0.897 vs 0.874/0.863（123例），前列腺0.847 vs 0.795/0.757（85例），胎儿脑0.771 vs 0.763/0.747（83胎）。瞬态场标记 corrupted fetal slices 的AUROC为0.94；作为仅用健康受试者训练的冻结异常检测器输入，解剖对放射科标注子宫病灶定位AUROC为0.76 vs 0.71/0.71（37例）。

Conclusion: 该方法能有效分离静态解剖与采集中的运动和瞬态变化，提升多堆栈MRI解剖重建的留出预测与跨站点泛化能力，并能保留和利用瞬态信息用于切片质量标记及病灶定位。

Abstract: Clinical MRI typically acquires the organ of interest as consecutive stacks of 2D slices in different orientations. Reconstruction methods such as SVRTK and NeSVoR fuse them into one volume and down-weight what does not fit, although in living tissue the change during the scan is often the signal itself and can contain clinically relevant physiological information, such as fetal motion and uterine contraction. We propose an analysis-by-synthesis decomposition that explains every acquired voxel through its exact acquisition geometry as a static anatomy shared by all stacks, a rigid and smooth non-rigid motion per stack, and a sparse transient field per stack for changes during one acquisition only. A robust reweighting keeps such changes out of the anatomy. The model is fitted per subject without training data, with one configuration for all datasets. On a digital phantom with known ground truth, static changes are kept entirely in the anatomy, and the transient field of the stack that saw a transient recovers 68% of it at 12mm radius. From identical inputs, the anatomy predicts held-out stacks better than SVRTK and NeSVoR on uterine (NCC 0.897 against 0.874 and 0.863, 123 patients) and on prostate MRI from unseen sites and scanners (0.847 against 0.795 and 0.757, 85 patients), and on fetal brain MRI as well as SVRTK and better than NeSVoR (0.771 against 0.763 and 0.747, 83 fetuses). The transient fields flag corrupted fetal slices with an AUROC of 0.94 against expert raters. As the input of a frozen anomaly detector trained on healthy subjects only, the anatomy localizes radiologist-delineated uterine lesions better than the SVRTK and NeSVoR volumes (AUROC 0.76 against 0.71 and 0.71, 37 patients).

</details>


### [917] [US-Seg: One Reference for Universal Ultrasound Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28740)
*Chen Ma,Yunshu Li,Shuyu Liang,Qin Wang,Junhu Fu,Zeju Li,Yi Guo,Yuanyuan Wang*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出 US-Seg，一种仅需单张标注参考图像即可指定目标、无需微调即可在查询图像中直接预测分割掩码的通用超声分割框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有超声基础模型虽具备强特征提取能力，但转为分割仍需在标注目标数据上微调；现有通用超声分割方法多依赖空间提示或任务提示，对训练中未见目标仍需逐图交互或目标特定适配。

Method: US-Seg 将分割重定义为从异构参考-查询对中通过掩码标签重建学习共享结构恢复过程；采用边界中心标签遮蔽强化模糊边界结构线索；使用多级双向参考-查询交互对齐目标；并用预测感知迭代解码器逐步校正残差结构误差。

Result: 无需重复交互或大量标注，US-Seg 在覆盖跨站点和跨任务的六项评估中平均 Dice 达 81.85%，比最强标签参考方法高 24.30%，同时取得最佳域内性能。

Conclusion: 单张标注参考即可实现通用超声目标分割，结构恢复式建模可减少对任务特定微调和重复交互的依赖，并在跨域跨任务场景下表现优越。

Abstract: Recent ultrasound foundation models have demonstrated strong feature extraction capabilities across organs, tasks, and imaging conditions. However, converting these representations into segmentation still requires finetuning on annotated target data. To reduce reliance on task-specific finetuning, existing universal ultrasound segmentation methods typically adopt prompt-based target specification, mainly through spatial prompts in SAM-style models or task prompts exemplified by MOFO. Yet, directly segmenting targets unseen during training still requires repeated per-image interaction or target-specific adaptation. We propose US-Seg, a universal ultrasound segmentation framework that uses only a single annotated reference to specify the target and directly predicts its mask in query images without finetuning. The fundamental insight of US-Seg is to reformulate segmentation from direct image-to-label mapping for predefined targets into a shared structural recovery process learned from heterogeneous reference-query pairs through masked label reconstruction, thereby making a single reference sufficient for target specification. Boundary-centric label masking emphasizes ambiguous boundaries, encouraging transferable structural cues rather than target-specific appearance patterns. Using these structure-enriched representations, multi-level bidirectional reference-query interaction aligns the reference-defined target with the query. Finally, a prediction-aware iterative decoder uses intermediate predictions to progressively correct residual structural errors under reference guidance. Without repeated interaction or laborious annotation, US-Seg achieves an average Dice of 81.85% across six evaluations covering cross-site and cross-task generalization, outperforming the strongest label-reference method by 24.30%, while also delivering the best in-domain performance.

</details>


### [918] [Rate-Quality-Energy Convex Hull for High Dynamic Range Adaptive Video Streaming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28817)
*Amritha Premkumar,Christian Herglotz*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种联合考虑码率、HDR感知质量和客户端处理能耗的凸包优化框架，用于构建更高效的自适应流媒体HDR码率阶梯。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HDR视频解码复杂度和能耗显著高于SDR，但现有自适应流媒体码率阶梯多基于VMAF等SDR导向指标优化，忽略HDR感知特性和解码端能耗，导致能效不佳的工作点。

Method: 提出率-质量-能耗凸包优化框架，联合考虑码率、HDR感知质量指标HDRVMAF以及客户端处理能耗（包括解码和上采样）；在LIVE HDR视频质量评估数据库的12个4K HDR序列上，每个片段评估72种表示。

Result: 传统VMAF优化阶梯常选择高分辨率编码，但在计入能耗后会被支配；相比默认HLS阶梯，所提HDR感知方法在相同HDRVMAF下最高节省54.34%码率，并在更高能耗权重下实现最高43.10%的客户端能耗降低。

Conclusion: 该框架能有效构建显式暴露并控制感知质量-能耗权衡的HDR码率阶梯，为实际HDR自适应流媒体优化提供基础。

Abstract: High Dynamic Range (HDR) video introduces substantially higher decoding complexity and energy consumption than Standard Dynamic Range (SDR), yet most adaptive streaming pipelines still rely on bitrate ladders optimized using SDR-oriented metrics such as VMAF. These ladders fail to capture HDR-specific perceptual behavior and ignore decoder-side energy, resulting in energetically inefficient operating points. This work proposes a rate-quality-energy convex-hull optimization framework that jointly considers bitrate, HDR-aware perceptual quality (HDRVMAF), and client-side processing energy, including decoding and upscaling. Experiments on twelve 4K HDR sequences from the LIVE HDR Video Quality Assessment Database evaluate 72 representations per clip and demonstrate that traditional VMAF-optimized ladders frequently select high-resolution encodes that become dominated once energy is accounted for. Compared to the Default HLS ladder, our HDR-aware method achieves substantial bitrate savings of up to 54.34% at equal HDRVMAF, while yielding relative client-side energy reductions of up to 43.10% under higher energy weighting. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework as a practical foundation for constructing HDR bitrate ladders that explicitly expose and control perceptual quality-energy trade-offs.

</details>


### [919] [Beyond the section plane: Robust 3D reconstruction of multiplex immunofluorescence exposes limitations of 2D spatial cell statistics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28905)
*Junming Ma,Olle Edgren Schüllerqvist,Hui Yu,Carina Strell,Patrick Micke,Joakim Lindblad,Artur Mezheyeuski,Nataša Sladoje*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 该研究将24个乳腺和肺肿瘤组织芯片核心的15-20张连续mIF切片重建为3D，并比较3D与单张2D切片的空间细胞统计，发现细胞类型比例可在2D中可靠估计，但细胞邻域和接触等相互作用需3D分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于单张薄切片的肿瘤微环境多重免疫荧光空间分析可能错误反映3D组织结构，并使空间细胞统计产生偏差，而这种偏差此前缺乏定量评估。

Method: 对24个乳腺和肺肿瘤组织芯片核心的15-20张连续mIF切片进行3D重建；流程结合仿射预对齐和基于RoMa v2的密集形变细化，实现跨切片细胞核链接，并比较3D与单切片的空间细胞统计。

Result: 配准中位目标误差为1.79 μm，低于细胞核尺寸；2D中细胞类型比例保持良好（Pearson r ≥ 0.99），但3D分析显示最近邻距离最多短3.8倍、邻域熵高13-19%、每细胞接触数多2-4倍。

Conclusion: 组织组成可较可靠地从单张切片估计，但细胞-细胞相互作用分析需要体积/3D分析，以避免2D切片带来的空间统计偏差。

Abstract: Spatial analysis of the tumour microenvironment with multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF) typically relies on single thin tissue sections, which misrepresent the 3D tissue organisation and bias spatial cell statistics in ways that remain largely unquantified. We reconstruct 24 breast and lung tumour tissue microarray cores in 3D, each from 15-20 serial mIF sections, and compare spatial cell statistics in 3D with those from individual sections. Our pipeline combines affine pre-alignment with dense deformable refinement using RoMa v2, achieving a median target registration error of 1.79 $μ$m, well below nuclear size, which allows nuclei to be linked across sections. While cell-type proportions are preserved in 2D (Pearson corr. $r \geq 0.99$), 3D analysis reveals up to 3.8 times shorter nearest-neighbour distances, 13-19% higher neighbourhood entropy, and 2-4 times more contacts per cell. Tissue composition can thus be reliably estimated from individual sections, whereas cell-cell interactions require volumetric analysis.

</details>


### [920] [Neural Grey: Practical Vignetting Calibration from Casual Camera Rolls](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28934)
*Yueze Wang,Spencer LaVere Smith*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: Neural Grey 通过四次近似滚动拍摄静态浅色表面，联合估计可复用的相机-镜头阴影图与墙面光照，并利用焦距条件径向选择器缓解径向镜头衰减与径向墙面光照的歧义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 滚动相机可使墙面光照在传感器上移动，而镜头阴影保持固定，因此有望从简单拍摄中分离二者；但仅靠旋转无法区分径向镜头衰减与径向墙面光照，需要解决该歧义。

Method: 从四次近似滚动拍摄中联合拟合镜头阴影场、墙面光照场以及小幅度姿态和曝光误差；采用物理阴影包络与紧凑有界神经残差表示场，并引入基于焦距和传感器尺寸的焦距条件径向选择器来选择宽径向轮廓、保留拟合的空间余项；通过组件与敏感性研究分析场表示、径向选择和数值设置的作用。

Result: 在100个合成案例上达到25.43 dB，在光线追踪镜头架构上达到24.49 dB，在7种光学配置的21次真实拍摄上达到25.38 dB；真实基准上比最强竞争方法均值高5.62 dB，并在7种配置中的5种获胜。

Conclusion: Neural Grey 能有效从少量滚动拍摄中估计可复用相机-镜头阴影图，并通过焦距条件径向选择解决径向歧义，在合成、光线追踪和真实数据上均优于竞争方法。

Abstract: Neural Grey estimates a reusable camera-lens shading map from four approximate roll captures of a static, light-colored surface. Rolling the camera moves wall illumination across the sensor while lens shading stays fixed. We fit these two fields jointly, together with small pose and exposure errors, using a physical shading envelope and compact bounded neural residuals. Rotation alone, however, cannot distinguish radial lens attenuation from radial wall illumination. A focal-conditioned radial selector addresses this ambiguity: it uses focal length and sensor size to choose the broad radial profile while retaining the fitted spatial remainder. Component and sensitivity studies separate the roles of the field representation, radial selection, and numerical settings. Neural Grey reaches 25.43 dB on 100 synthetic cases, 24.49 dB on ray-traced lens architectures, and 25.38 dB on 21 real takes from seven optical configurations. On the real benchmark, it exceeds the strongest competing mean by 5.62 dB and wins five of seven configurations.

</details>


### [921] [3D-EMCAD: Efficient Multi-scale Convolutional Attention Decoding for Volumetric Brain Tumor Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29027)
*Iftakhar Hossain,Israt Jahan Sinthia,Md. Hadiur Rahman Khan*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 该文将轻量级 EMCAD 解码器扩展到 3D 脑肿瘤分割，并在统一 3D SegResNet 编码器和训练协议下比较五种解码器，发现解码器容量增加并未带来可测的精度提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码器-解码器网络广泛用于体素级脑肿瘤分割，但高容量 3D 解码器在高分辨率下计算成本高；EMCAD 虽轻量高效，却仅在 2D 中验证。

Method: 将 EMCAD 所有操作改为 3D，并用组归一化替代标准归一化以适应小批量训练；在 BraTS 2020（369 例，三折交叉验证）上使用相同 3D SegResNet 编码器和训练协议，比较 3D-EMCAD、SegResNet 解码器、Attention U-Net 解码器、UNet++ 和普通 U-Net 解码器。

Result: 五种解码器平均 Dice 仅相差 0.0071，小于多数模型的折间波动；配对 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验显示 3D-EMCAD 与四个基线中的三个无显著差异。3D-EMCAD 参数量最少（1.15 M）、运算量最少（8.6 G），比 UNet++ 少 7.3 倍运算量且精度不更高。

Conclusion: 对于体素级脑肿瘤分割，超过适度预算的解码器容量没有可测收益；轻量级 3D-EMCAD 能以最低计算成本达到与复杂解码器相当的精度。

Abstract: Encoder-decoder networks are widely used for volumetric brain tumor segmentation, yet recent trends favor high-capacity decoders that incur steep computational costs in 3D at high spatial resolutions. The Efficient Multi-scale Convolutional Attention Decoder (EMCAD) is a lightweight decoder that achieves strong accuracy at very low cost, but it has been validated only in 2D. Here, we extend EMCAD to volumetric segmentation (3D-EMCAD) by converting all operations to 3D and replacing standard normalization layers with group normalization to suit the small batch sizes of volumetric training. To isolate the impact of decoder choice, we evaluate five decoders: the proposed 3D-EMCAD, a vanilla SegResNet decoder, an Attention U-Net decoder, UNet++, and a plain U-Net decoder using an identical 3D SegResNet encoder and training protocol on BraTS 2020 (369 cases, three-fold cross-validation). The five decoders yield statistically indistinguishable performance: their mean Dice scores span only 0.0071, less than the fold-to-fold variation of most models, and a paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test shows no significant difference between 3D-EMCAD and three of the four baselines. Importantly, 3D-EMCAD achieves this shared accuracy with the fewest decoder parameters (1.15 M) and operations (8.6 G), requiring $7.3\times$ fewer operations than UNet++, which scores no higher. These findings demonstrate that decoder capacity beyond a modest budget offers no measurable benefit for volumetric brain tumor segmentation.

</details>


### [922] [Where does pancreatic lesion segmentation fail on public CT? An attenuation-stratified analysis of a duct-guided pipeline on PanTS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29861)
*Kang-Won Byun*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 该研究不在提出新架构，而是系统报告胰腺癌病灶分割端到端流程在PanTS数据集上的失败位置与原因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CT胰腺癌检测流程中病灶分割重叠分数长期偏低，作者希望明确现有端到端流程到底在哪些环节失败，而不是继续堆叠新模型。

Method: 在PanTS上构建三阶段流程：胰腺分割、主胰管（MPD）和胆总管（CBD）预测图、病灶模型；病灶模型分别输入CT或CT加预测导管图。模型在4007例扫描上训练，在737例留出测试集（127例有病灶）上一次性评估，并采用测试前固定的比较规则。

Result: 病灶Dice在加入导管图为0.213，仅CT为0.209，配对差+0.004（95% CI -0.011至+0.019）。导管图提高了预测触及病灶的比例（+0.079，95% CI +0.024至+0.134），但也使无病灶扫描中的预测变大，且所有无病灶测试扫描均出现类病灶区域预测。折外仅保留触及病灶的预测成分，Dice仅从0.285升至0.309，主要损失来自正确位置预测的范围。明显低密度病灶覆盖率最低（中位数16.6%）。仅用预测图，MPD直径区分有病灶与无病灶测试扫描的AUC为0.794（95% CI 0.747至0.839），CBD直径较弱（AUC 0.603）且无增益。

Conclusion: 该流程的主要瓶颈不是病灶定位完全失败，而是正确位置预测的范围不准以及无病灶扫描中的假阳性；导管图对Dice无显著提升，MPD直径具有一定区分能力，CBD直径贡献有限。

Abstract: Lesion segmentation is a building block of most CT pipelines for pancreatic cancer detection, yet lesion overlap scores stay low. Instead of proposing a new architecture, we report where an end-to-end pipeline fails on a large public dataset. On PanTS we built a three-stage pipeline: pancreas segmentation, maps of the main pancreatic duct (MPD) and common bile duct (CBD), and a lesion model that receives the CT with or without the predicted duct maps. Both lesion models were trained identically on 4007 scans and evaluated once on 737 held-out test scans (127 with a lesion) under a comparison rule fixed before the test run. Lesion Dice was 0.213 with duct maps and 0.209 with CT only (paired difference +0.004, 95% CI -0.011 to +0.019). The duct maps raised the share of lesions touched by a prediction (+0.079, 95% CI +0.024 to +0.134) but also enlarged predictions in lesion-free scans, and lesion-like regions were predicted in all lesion-free test scans. Out of fold, keeping only the predicted components that touched the lesion raised Dice only from 0.285 to 0.309; the loss came mainly from the extent of correctly located predictions. Clearly hypoattenuating lesions, which intensity alone separates from normal pancreas, had the lowest coverage (median 16.6%). From the predicted maps alone, the MPD diameter separated lesion from lesion-free test scans with AUC 0.794 (95% CI 0.747 to 0.839), while the CBD diameter was weak (AUC 0.603) and added nothing. Code for training, inference and evaluation is publicly available.

</details>


### [923] [Generalizable Variable-Rate Adaptation for Image Coding for Machines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29914)
*Yui Tatsumi,Hiroshi Watanabe*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种与损失无关的蒸馏框架，将固定码率ICM模型扩展为可变码率ICM，实现单模型连续码率控制并保持任务相关特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ICM模型多针对固定工作点训练，且不同任务和模型设计的训练目标不同，导致难以直接扩展到可变码率压缩。

Method: 以预训练的固定码率ICM模型作为冻结教师，学生模型通过重要性自适应量化和蒸馏优化学习可变码率行为，无需原始任务特定损失或下游任务标签。

Result: 基于现有ICM模型的实验表明，该方法可提供连续码率控制，并在识别性能上与固定码率模型具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 所提损失无关蒸馏框架能够有效将固定码率ICM模型转化为可变码率模型，在保持任务相关潜表示的同时实现连续码率调节。

Abstract: Image Coding for Machines (ICM) aims to preserve task-relevant information for machine vision under limited bitrates. However, most ICM models are trained for a fixed operating point, and extending them to variable-rate compression is challenging because their training objectives differ across tasks and model designs. In this paper, we propose a loss-agnostic distillation framework for variable-rate ICM. A pretrained fixed-rate ICM model is used as a frozen teacher, while a student model learns variable-rate behavior through importance-adaptive quantization and distillation-based optimization. This enables continuous bitrate control with a single model while preserving task-relevant latent components, without requiring the original task-specific loss or downstream task labels. Experiments based on existing ICM models demonstrate that the proposed method provides continuous bitrate control and achieves competitive recognition performance compared with the fixed-rate models.

</details>


### [924] [Geospatial foundation models and deep learning for climate resilience: a review of transfer, uncertainty and decision readiness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30198)
*Parastoo Farajpoor,Mohammadreza Narimani*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 该综述结合137项灾害应用全文研究和37项模型/基准记录，审计地球观测基础模型在气候韧性中的迁移评估实践，并提出面向决策的评估框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地理空间基础模型可复用大规模地球观测知识，但其对气候韧性的价值取决于能否迁移到不熟悉的事件、区域和观测条件；现有研究需要更可靠的灾害监测与预警证据。

Method: 对137项灾害应用研究进行描述性审计，并参照37项模型与基准记录；区分地球观测表征学习与大气预报，分析标签、可观测性、预警提前期和决策需求对洪水、野火、干旱、高温、冰冻圈及级联灾害应用的约束；提出“决策回溯”评估框架。

Result: 98项应用研究报告了分布外实验，但主要评估中仅31项使用留出事件、25项使用留出区域、2项使用留出传感器；10项涉及地理空间基础模型微调的研究均未将传感器留出作为主要测试。16项记录不确定性方法，其中仅2项提供明确校准的概率输出。

Conclusion: 应超越宽泛的模型迁移主张，采用决策回溯评估：明确所需行动及可用信息、复现相关分布偏移、保留匹配的任务专用基线，并报告漏报、误报、可靠性和端到端延迟，使可迁移性成为气候适应与风险管理的可检验要求。

Abstract: Geospatial foundation models can reuse information learned from large Earth-observation archives, but their value for climate resilience depends on whether that information transfers to unfamiliar events, regions and observing conditions. This review connects advances in deep learning with the evidence needed for hazard monitoring and early warning. A descriptive audit of 137 full-text hazard-application studies is interpreted alongside a separate corpus of 37 model and benchmark records. Ninety-eight application studies reported an out-of-distribution experiment, whereas headline evaluations included held-out events in 31 studies, regions in 25 and sensors in only two. None of the ten studies coded for geospatial foundation-model fine-tuning used sensor holdout as a headline test. Uncertainty-related methods were recorded in 16 studies, including two with explicitly calibrated probabilistic output. These overlapping counts describe evaluation practice within the coded corpus, not a ranking of model families. We distinguish Earth-observation representation learning from atmospheric forecasting and examine how labels, observability, forecast lead time and decision requirements constrain their contribution across flood, wildfire, drought, heat, cryosphere and cascading-hazard applications. We then develop a decision-backward evaluation framework: define the action and information available when it must be taken, reproduce the relevant shift, retain a matched task-specific baseline, and report misses, false alarms, reliability and end-to-end latency. The framework turns transferability from a broad model claim into a testable requirement for climate adaptation and risk management.

</details>


### [925] [Demographic Encoding is Not Exposure: Fairness and Privacy in Chest X-ray Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31014)
*Sahar Askari,Amin Golnari*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 该论文检验医学基础模型中人口统计学编码、诊断公平性与成员推断泄漏是否一致，发现公平性与隐私漏洞基本独立，应分别审计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学基础模型会编码患者人口统计学信息，并可能泄露患者是否在训练集中；已有研究常将人口统计学编码、公平性和隐私泄漏视为同一问题，但缺乏在同一模型上的系统验证。

Method: 在冻结的BiomedCLIP、DINOv2和RAD-DINO嵌入上训练200个线性或MLP头，使用3个随机种子，并在CheXpert和NIH ChestX-ray14上同时测量人口统计学编码、诊断公平性差距和成员推断脆弱性。

Result: 人口统计学编码几乎不能解释患者脆弱性的方差，CheXpert上72个关联均统计上等价于零。擦除线性可解码的人口统计学信息未改变泄漏，但减少了年龄相关漏诊差距。泄漏主要取决于头容量和训练时长：RAD-DINO上线性头成员推断AUC为0.694，而30轮MLP为0.907，且测试性能相近。

Conclusion: 公平性与隐私应分开审计；使用线性头或缩短训练可在几乎不损失效用的前提下减少成员推断泄漏。

Abstract: Medical foundation models encode patient demographics and can reveal whether a patient was in the training set, and these properties are often treated as one problem. We tested whether they are aligned by measuring demographic encoding, diagnostic fairness gaps and membership-inference vulnerability on the same models. We trained 200 linear or multilayer-perceptron (MLP) heads on frozen BiomedCLIP, DINOv2 and RAD-DINO embeddings, with three seeds, and audited them on CheXpert and NIH ChestX-ray14. Demographic encoding explained almost no variance in patient vulnerability, and all 72 CheXpert associations were statistically equivalent to zero. Erasing linearly decodable demographics left leakage unchanged but reduced age-related underdiagnosis gaps. Leakage depended instead on head capacity and training length. On RAD-DINO, a linear head reached a membership-inference area under the curve (AUC) of 0.694, compared with 0.907 for a 30-epoch MLP, at similar test performance. Fairness and privacy should therefore be audited separately, and linear heads or shorter training reduce leakage with little or no loss of utility. The code is available on GitHub for public use.

</details>
